article_content: A creative solution has been found for the thousands of bouquets Queen Elizabeth II receives: a giant flowerpot made in her likeness. Standing 11 feet tall, the terracotta pot marks the Queen's Diamond Jubilee anniversary and sits beside an equally large pot modeled after Prince Philip. Each pot weighs over half a tonne and was crafted by a team of sculptors over two months. They contain over 100 varieties of flowers, including geraniums, hydrangeas, fresias, orchids, roses, ivy, daisies, fuchsias, gerberas, perennials, ferns, conifers, and moss. Altogether, the Royal bouquet cost more than £10,000. Displaying nearly twice the height of the Queen, the pots are showcased outside Buckingham Palace and other London landmarks. The unique sculptures will be presented to the royal couple in June, with hopes that they will enjoy the creative tribute. There is even speculation that the pots might find a permanent home at Buckingham Palace, where Prince Charles may lend his gardening expertise. The flowerpots, commissioned by TV shopping channel QVC to launch its gardening season, require gardeners to use a stepladder to trim their vibrant blooms. Richard Jackson, QVC's head gardener, noted, “We wanted to create something spectacular to celebrate the Queen’s Diamond Jubilee and inspire Brits to think creatively about their own gardens. We hope the Queen and Duke are royally amused by their floral selves.”

article_content: Wisconsin Governor Scott Walker says he feels no urgency to pursue the presidency at age 47, especially since his political rival, Hillary Clinton, is considering a run well into her 60s. 'I could run 20 years from now and still be about the same age as former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton is right now,' the Republican governor told CNN affiliate WITI in an interview on Sunday. Walker, who was recently re-elected for a second term, remarked that the closer one comes to running for president, the more daunting the challenge appears. 'The closer you get to something like that, the more you realize—and I say this only half-jokingly—that you must be a little crazy to want to be president,' he said. 'Anyone who has seen photos of this president or any past presidents can see the before-and-after. No matter their fitness or youth, they age very quickly.' Addressing the health impacts of serving in office, Walker shared that his bald spot became a campaign topic. 'One frustration for my campaign staff has been that, for whatever reason, my opponent received little scrutiny, while my bald spot became a recurring subject. It has grown into more than just the focal point of a story or two,' Walker said. 'It's just one of those moments where you raise your eyebrows and think, "really?" But it is what it is.' Despite national attention and speculation about a possible 2016 presidential run, Walker maintains that he feels called to serve as Wisconsin's governor. 'Someone should run for president not because they want to or yearn to, but because they feel called to,' he said. 'Right now, I feel called to be the governor of Wisconsin, and I'm going to focus on doing the best job I can over the next four years.' This isn't the first time Walker has referenced Clinton's age. Following the recent midterm elections, Walker told Fox News that the then-67-year-old Clinton represents 'old' politics. 'I think the biggest loser in the midterms was Hillary Clinton,' Walker said. 'She embodies Washington and the old, top-down approach to government. As governors, we offer a better alternative, and there are several of us who would be strong prospects.'

'Ek kan oor 20 jaar nog hardloop en sal steeds omtrent so oud wees soos voormalige Minister van Buitelandse Sake Hillary Clinton nou is,' het die Republikeinse goewerneur aan CNN-vennoot WITI in 'n onderhoud op Sondag gesê. Walker, wat onlangs vir 'n tweede termyn herkies is, het opgemerk dat hoe nader 'n mens kom aan 'n presidensiële veldtog, hoe meer ontmoedigend lyk dit. 'Hoe nader jy aan so iets kom, hoe meer besef jy — en ek sê dit half grappenderwys — jy moet 'n bietjie mal wees om president te wil wees,' het hy gesê. 'Enigiemand wat foto's van hierdie president of enige voormalige presidente gesien het, kan die voor-en-na vergelyk. Maak nie saak hoe fiks of jonk hulle is nie, hulle word vinnig ouer.' Walker het ook vertel dat sy kaal kol deel van die verkiesingsveldtog geword het. 'Een frustrasie vir my veldtogspan was dat, om een of ander rede, my teenstander baie min ondersoek of kritiek ontvang het, terwyl my kaal kol herhaaldelik onderwerp was. Dit het nou al meer as net 'n fokuspunt van een of twee stories geword,' het Walker gesê. 'Dis net een van daardie oomblikke waar jy jou wenkbroue lig en dink, "regtig?" Maar dit is soos dit is.' Ten spyte van nasionale aandag en spekulasie oor 'n moontlike presidensiële veldtog in 2016, sê Walker hy voel steeds geroep om as Wisconsin se goewerneur te dien. 'Enigiemand moet nie vir president wil hardloop bloot omdat hulle dit wil wees nie, maar omdat hulle geroepe voel daartoe,' het hy gesê. 'Op hierdie stadium voel ek geroep om Wisconsin se goewerneur te wees, en ek gaan fokus om my beste werk die volgende vier jaar te doen.' Dit is nie die eerste keer dat Walker na Clinton se ouderdom verwys nie. Ná die onlangse tussenverkiesings het Walker aan Fox News gesê dat Clinton, wat toe 67 was, 'ou' politiek verteenwoordig. 'Ek dink die grootste verloorder in die tussenverkiesings was Hillary Clinton,' het Walker gesê. 'Sy verteenwoordig Washington en die ou, afwaartse benadering van regering. As goewerneurs bied ons 'n beter alternatief, en daar is enkele van ons wat goeie kandidate sou wees.'

article_content: For many, origami conjures images of delicate paper creations, but now this traditional art is revolutionizing robotics. Engineers have crafted robotic wheels inspired by origami that can dynamically change shape, making machines both swift and strong. Using the well-known 'magic ball pattern,' each wheel can expand or contract through a single actuator and built-in sensors. When a robot must climb stairs or surmount obstacles, the wheels increase in size; when navigating tight spaces, they shrink, offering remarkable flexibility. The design includes a transmission system that continuously and automatically adjusts wheel size in response to the terrain and load. This overcomes the limitations of fixed-size wheels, enabling both speed and strength in a single robot. Developed jointly by Seoul National University, headed by Professor Kyu-Jin Cho, and the Harvard Microrobotics Lab, these wheels can collapse to a 5.5cm radius or expand to 12cm. This range offers significant versatility for various tasks. No manual intervention is needed. If resistance is detected, the wheels contract to increase torque, then expand when feasible. The researchers envision these adaptable wheels aiding future planetary missions, as they can be packed compactly and deployed as needed. Through innovations rooted in ancient techniques, robots are now more capable of handling diverse challenges in their environments.

article_content: A dense, toxic smog currently envelops New Delhi, severely limiting visibility around monuments and across the city’s skyline. With air quality at hazardous levels, authorities have shut down schools and stopped all construction, prompting many to don masks once again. This is an annual ordeal for over 20 million residents as officials grapple with chronic pollution. The air quality index for fine particulates has soared close to 400, which SAFAR rates as more than ten times above the global safe limit—making this the fifth straight day of extreme pollution. Srinivas Rao, visiting from Andhra Pradesh, noted his anxiety about the air as he walked near India Gate, relying on a mask for protection. Officials are deploying water sprinklers and anti-smog guns while fining drivers of older gasoline and diesel vehicles 20,000 rupees ($240) if they contribute to smog. Doctors urge everyone to limit time outdoors and wear masks to avoid respiratory ailments. The pollution’s impact extends to major events: the Cricket World Cup faced disruption when the Sri Lankan team canceled practice in the city before their game against Bangladesh at Arun Jaitley Stadium. Air purifier sales have jumped as Diwali—often associated with fireworks and worsening air—draws near. Residents like 55-year-old Renu Aggarwal fear the situation will worsen. Her daughter’s pollen allergy is aggravated by pollution, making even simple indoor activities difficult despite sealed windows and doors. New Delhi repeatedly tops lists for poor air quality, worsened in winter by the burning of crop stubble in nearby states and weather patterns that trap pollutants. Authorities offer incentives for farmers to adopt cleaner methods, but crop burning remains responsible for about 25% of the pollution, according to the Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology. Research by Respirer Living Sciences shows a sharp spike in fine particulates between 2019 and 2020, a significant drop in 2021, followed by a steady rise in 2022 and 2023. Outdoor workers are particularly affected; auto-rickshaw driver Gulshan Kumar experiences regular throat, nose, and eye irritation. His children plead for him to return to Bihar, but work opportunities keep him in New Delhi despite the risks. For now, while officials continue to implement warnings and controls, dangerous air remains an inescapable part of life in New Delhi—impacting health, daily routines, and even high-profile sporting events.

article_content: The Minister of State for Environment, Dr Iziaq Salako, has emphasized that climate action is crucial to achieving the eight presidential priorities of the current administration. Dr Salako made this statement on Friday in Abuja during the launch of a project that maps climate change impacts and policies across Nigeria’s 36 states. He noted that addressing environmental issues and climate change requires active participation from both sub-national governments and all citizens. "Managing our environment and responding to climate change effectively needs the full involvement of state governments and every Nigerian," he stated. The mapping project aims to identify how climate change affects each of the 36 states, as well as the needs of each state to adapt and implement climate policies. The minister explained that climate vulnerabilities differ across regions, with northern areas suffering more from severe effects like drought and desertification. Salako said the initiative assesses each state's level of climate awareness, actions taken so far, and what is needed to strengthen climate resilience, ensuring resources are directed to the most vulnerable areas. Speakers at the launch included lawmaker Hon. Sam Onuigbo and Governor Mohammed Bago. Hon. Onuigbo advised governors and local government chairmen to make sufficient budgetary provisions for climate change measures based on the new assessment. "Given the responsibilities given to state governors and local government chairmen by the Act, they should ensure adequate funding for stronger climate action and resilience," Onuigbo said. Governor Bago highlighted Niger State's efforts to combat climate change, including a recent Green Economy Summit focused on sustainable policies. He commended the commitment and dedication shown by the government and people of Niger State towards climate action. Governor Bago also noted that, in response to unwholesome environmental practices, the state organized its recent summit with the theme "Sustainable Future: Harnessing Green Assets and Innovation for Niger State’s Prosperity." The mapping project complements the Climate Change Act 2021, which calls for forming national climate policies that include input from states.

"Die bestuur van ons omgewing en die hantering van klimaatsverandering verg die volle betrokkenheid van staatsregerings en elke Nigeriër," het hy gestel. Die kaartsprojek het ten doel om te bepaal hoe klimaatsverandering elkeen van die 36 state raak, sowel as hul behoeftes om aan te pas en klimaatsbeleid te implementeer. Die kaartsprojek vul die Klimaatsveranderingwet van 2021 aan, wat voorsiening maak vir nasionale klimaatsbeleide wat insette van deelstate insluit.

article_content: David Moyes has officially taken over as head coach of Real Sociedad, embarking on his new role in San Sebastian after leaving Manchester United. Moyes was welcomed at the club’s picturesque Zubieta training facility, which reflects the team’s more modest circumstances compared to the Premier League. Instead of bringing in his own staff, Moyes decided to work with the existing coaching team. After Phil Neville declined his invitation, Moyes promoted Imanol Alguacil from the B team to assistant manager. Alguacil, who is Basque and a former Sociedad player, is expected to be a well-liked choice. Erik Bretos, an academy coach fluent in English, has also joined Moyes’ team to help bridge language gaps as Moyes adapts to Spanish. Moyes appeared enthusiastic at his new club, touring the facilities, making calls, and even greeting the media in Basque with 'Kaixo.' His new approach at Sociedad highlights his willingness to fit into the club’s culture, differing from his strategy at Old Trafford. The club’s captain, Xabi Prieto, and supporters are hopeful about Moyes’ arrival, noting his strong reputation and his achievements at Everton—which Sociedad aspires to match within La Liga. Fans believe Moyes can bring a similar level of performance and tenacity to the team. Prior to Moyes accepting the position, Pepe Mel, formerly of West Brom, was considered, but president Jokin Aperribay preferred Moyes. The Scot agreed to an 18-month contract after being offered a longer term. Aperribay has expressed his delight at securing Moyes, citing the international experience he brings and his potential to lead the club back into European competitions. Both fans and local media view his appointment positively, hoping for renewed spirit and greater determination from the team under his management.

article_content: Ricky Ponting's illustrious international cricket career ended on Monday with Australia suffering a heavy defeat to South Africa in Perth, the same ground where he made his Test debut 17 years ago. Ponting scored just eight runs as Australia, chasing an unlikely target of 632, lost by 309 runs. South Africa thus retained the world No. 1 ranking and became the first team since the West Indies in 1992-93 to win consecutive series in Australia. Ponting was named Cricketer of the Decade for the 2000-09 period by Cricinfo. As captain, he guided Australia to 48 Test victories before stepping down in 2011 and featured in a record 108 Test wins from his 168 appearances, tying Steve Waugh's record. Ponting is also second on Australia’s all-time run scorer list in both Tests and one-day internationals. David Richardson, the International Cricket Council’s chief executive, was one of Ponting’s first international opponents when Ponting debuted in a one-day match against South Africa in February 1995. Richardson said, 'His contribution to the international game has been immense and rightly he will be remembered as one of the sport’s true legends.' Ponting is second only to Don Bradman among Australia’s batting greats and the only player to win two consecutive ICC Cricketer of the Year awards. He captained Australia to two ICC Cricket World Cup titles and was part of a record streak of 34 consecutive World Cup victories. Richardson added, 'Ricky was a true team player, earning many personal accolades along the way. We wish him the best for the future and look forward to his continued involvement in the game.' Ponting succeeded Steve Waugh as Test captain in 2004, having taken charge of the one-day team in 2002. Australia’s dominance declined in later years and Ponting lost his third Ashes series to England in 2010-11. He remained as captain for the 2011 World Cup, stepping down after Australia were eliminated in the quarterfinals. Ponting finished with 13,378 Test runs at an average of 51.85, scoring 41 centuries, but managed just 32 runs at 6.40 in his final series. Reflecting on his career, Ponting said, 'I've always thrived on big games and series, but I haven't coped as well lately. When important moments came, I could usually deliver, but that hasn’t happened for a while.' Ponting received a standing ovation from 7,000 spectators at the WACA, and South Africa’s players formed a guard of honor as he came to the crease for his final innings. Proteas captain Graeme Smith said, 'He’s the player I respect most. It was a gesture of respect from us for someone who has given so much to the sport.' Australia’s next three-Test series, against Sri Lanka in Ponting’s home state of Tasmania, begins December 14, just five days ahead of his 38th birthday.

Ponting het slegs agt lopies aangeteken toe Australië, op soek na 'n byna onmoontlike teiken van 632, met 309 lopies verloor het. As kaptein het hy Australië tot 48 Toetsoorwinnings gelei voor hy in 2011 bedank het, en aan 'n rekord 108 Toetsseë deelgeneem, gelykstaande aan Steve Waugh se rekord. Ponting het in 2004 vir Steve Waugh as Toetskaptein opgevolg, nadat hy reeds in 2002 die een-dag span gelei het. Ponting het 'n staande ovasie gekry van 7,000 toeskouers by die WACA, en Suid-Afrika se spelers het 'n eregang gevorm toe hy vir sy laaste beurte ingeloop het. Proteas-kaptein Graeme Smith het gesê: 'Hy is die speler vir wie ek die meeste respek het. Dit was 'n gebaar van respek vir iemand wat soveel vir die sport beteken het.' Australië se volgende drie-toetsreeks, teen Sri Lanka in Ponting se tuisstaat Tasmanië, begin op 14 Desember, net vyf dae voor sy 38ste verjaardag.

article_content: Washington Redskins coach Mike Shanahan is under fire for keeping quarterback Robert Griffin III (RGIII) in the wildcard playoff game against the Seattle Seahawks, despite a visible right knee injury that became worse as the game progressed. Griffin, who entered the game still recovering from a lateral collateral ligament (LCL) sprain suffered on December 9, appeared increasingly limited and finally collapsed in pain during the fourth quarter. The full extent of Griffin's injury was unclear at the time, with further tests including an MRI scheduled. The team's playoff run ended in a 24-14 defeat by the Seahawks. Shanahan's decision to keep Griffin in the game has sparked debate, with many questioning whether he should have been removed earlier—or played at all. Controversy deepened after it was reported that Dr. James Andrews, the Redskins' sideline physician, did not clear Griffin to return after his initial knee injury, contradicting prior team statements. Dr. Andrews stated he had not examined Griffin before Griffin returned to the field. Concerns about the turf at FedEx Field were also raised. Seahawks defensive end Chris Clemons tore his ACL during the game, and both players and Clemons' agent blamed the poor field condition for his injury. Fox Sports' Erin Andrews reported players' complaints about the lack of grass, especially at midfield. Despite his pronounced limp and pain, Griffin expressed his determination to play, citing respect for authority but also personal responsibility. Some commentators, including New York Post columnist Steve Serby, argued that Shanahan had an obligation to protect his player, regardless of Griffin's wishes. Shanahan stated he monitored Griffin's health throughout the game but only reconsidered after the decisive play. Following Griffin's collapse in the fourth quarter, backup quarterback Kirk Cousins entered, but the Redskins couldn't recover. Griffin completed 10 of 19 passes for 84 yards, two touchdowns, one interception, and ran for 21 yards before leaving. The Redskins finished a remarkable season by winning seven consecutive games to take the NFC East title after starting 3-6, providing hope for the team's future. However, concerns over Griffin's long-term health and player safety overshadow that achievement, renewing discussions about coaching responsibility and athlete welfare in the NFL.

Griffin, wat die wedstryd begin het terwyl hy steeds van 'n laterale kollaterale ligament (LCL) sprain op 9 Desember herstel het, het al hoe meer beperk gelyk en het uiteindelik in pyn ineengestort in die vierde kwart. article_content:
European officials are considering increased oversight of Russian oil tankers as they pass through the Danish straits, an important route for Russia’s crude oil exports. According to the Financial Times, the European Union plans to ask Denmark to monitor so-called "ghost ships"—the nickname for the shadow fleet Russia uses to move oil without adhering to Western pricing restrictions.

In December, the G7 imposed a $60 per barrel cap on Russian oil in an effort to restrict the Kremlin’s earnings. Nonetheless, Russia has continued selling the bulk of its crude above this limit by relying on tankers that use questionable paperwork or alternatives to Western insurance. The KSE Institute, reported by Bloomberg, found that 99% of Russian oil exports last month exceeded the price cap.

The EU’s proposal involves Denmark inspecting, and possibly blocking, Russian ships that transit the Danish straits, a passage critical for moving roughly two million barrels of oil daily—equal to about 60% of Russia’s seaborne crude exports—from main ports such as Ust-Luga, Primorsk, and Saint Petersburg.

In addition to the price cap, there are worries about environmental risks due to the aging, uninsured vessels in use. International maritime law allows for the inspection and detention of ships when there’s credible evidence of environmental danger. Still, experts warn that Denmark could face significant challenges, both diplomatically and operationally. Hans Peter Michaelsen, a defense analyst, told Reuters that blocking such traffic would be unprecedented and difficult for Denmark’s small naval force, which is dwarfed in size by oil tankers.

Volgens die Financial Times gaan die Europese Unie Denemarke vra om streng toesig te hou oor sogenaamde "spook-skepe" — die naam vir die skadufleet wat Rusland gebruik om olie te vervoer sonder om aan Westerse prysbeheer te voldoen.

In Desember het die G7 'n pryslimiet van $60 per vat op Russiese olie gestel om die Kremlin se inkomste te beperk. Tog verkoop Rusland steeds die meeste van sy ru-olie bo hierdie limiet met behulp van tenkskepe wat twyfelagtige dokumentasie en nie-Westerse versekering gebruik. Volgens die KSE Instituut, soos deur Bloomberg gerapporteer, het 99% van Russiese olie-uitvoere verlede maand die pryslimiet oorskry.

article_content: Regent Street in London is adorned with purple and gold decorations to mark the 60th anniversary of Queen Elizabeth II’s coronation, bringing back memories of the lively celebrations in 1953. A special ceremony at Westminster Abbey on Tuesday will serve as the main event, attended by the Queen, senior royals such as the Duke of Edinburgh, Prince Charles, Prince Harry, the Duchess of Cornwall, and the Duke and Duchess of Cambridge. Prime Minister David Cameron and the Archbishop of Canterbury will participate in the service. The 1953 coronation attracted vast crowds, even in the rain, and occurred 16 months after Queen Elizabeth II ascended the throne. It was watched on television by 27 million people in Britain and attended by over 8,000 guests at the Abbey. Compared to last year’s Diamond Jubilee, the diamond jubilee celebrations are smaller in scale. The Queen is expected to stay at Windsor on Sunday, the anniversary day, but a service for 2,000 guests is set for June 4 at the Abbey. July brings a four-day Coronation Festival at Buckingham Palace, featuring products from over 200 Royal Warrant holders and evening concerts by performers like Katherine Jenkins and Russell Watson. Other events include a photography exhibition at Westminster Abbey and a display of coronation attire at Buckingham Palace. The London Eye is renaming one of its capsules the ‘Coronation Capsule’ in honor of the anniversary. Excitement also surrounds the Duke and Duchess of Cambridge’s upcoming baby, expected in July, destined for a future coronation. 1953 was marked by other remarkable events: England’s cricket team won the Ashes, Sir Gordon Richards claimed victory at the Derby, and Blackpool’s FA Cup win became legendary as the ‘Matthews Final’. That same year, news of Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay reaching Mount Everest’s summit reached Britain on coronation day. The year also brought adversity, including severe floods on England’s east coast that claimed over 300 lives. The Queen visited the devastated regions. Winston Churchill led the Conservative government during a time of rationing and post-war recovery, while British forces remained engaged in the Korean War. Traditional coronation regalia—including St Edward’s Crown, the coronation orb, and the ring—featured strongly in the historic ceremony.

article_content: One year ago, the leader behind the terrorist attacks on America for nearly a decade was killed in Abbottabad, Pakistan. Osama bin Laden is no longer a threat to the United States because of President Obama's leadership and national security strategies. Effective intelligence and targeted counterterrorism missions have eliminated 20 of al Qaeda's top 30 leaders, including bin Laden. This is a substantial achievement. Al Qaeda's operational strength has been significantly reduced. For U.S. economic and national security, there is a compelling argument to decrease America's military presence and safely bring troops home from Afghanistan. Most Americans support this course of action. A recent New York Times/CBS poll indicates that over two-thirds of Americans believe the U.S. should end its involvement in Afghanistan. The president initiated the withdrawal by removing 10,000 U.S. troops from Afghanistan between June and December 2011. The 33,000 'surge' troops, deployed in 2009, are scheduled to depart by this summer. The drawdown will continue until 2014, when Afghan and NATO forces are expected to take over security duties. With the core objective of disrupting al Qaeda achieved, the justification for continuing the military presence until 2014 is uncertain. Over 1,900 Americans have died and more than 15,000 have been wounded in Afghanistan. Attacks with improvised explosive devices increased last year, resulting in more double amputees. A recent study found that one in four Afghanistan and Iraq veterans were diagnosed with post-traumatic stress disorder between 2004 and 2009. Unlike previous adversaries, al Qaeda is mobile and not confined by borders. CIA reports from 2010 estimate there were fewer than 100 al Qaeda fighters in Afghanistan, calling into question the need for a large-scale troop presence, which peaked at about 100,000 last year. The argument that troops must stay in Afghanistan to prevent al Qaeda's return is unconvincing since al Qaeda also operates in lawless states such as Yemen and Somalia, where the U.S. does not deploy large forces. Given that the enemy is not restricted by borders, continued risk to U.S. troops and expenditure of billions seems unwarranted. Communities throughout the U.S. are affected by the financial burden of maintaining troops in Afghanistan. Some lawmakers advocate deep domestic spending cuts, even as the proposed Afghanistan war budget for 2013 is $88 billion. According to the Center for Strategic and Budgetary Assessments, the annual cost of supporting one U.S. soldier in Afghanistan is over $1 million—funds that could be used to employ approximately 35 Americans through federal infrastructure investment. Rather than spending large sums on a war that isn’t making the nation safer, the U.S. could better promote security by supporting democratic movements and human rights in Middle Eastern countries through meaningful action. This is one of the surest ways to counter anti-Americanism and terrorism. Congress should support President Obama’s direction. These perspectives are my own. – Keith Ellison

article_content: EL James's erotic novel Fifty Shades of Grey has created a global sensation, with Kindle sales seeing a 71 percent rise. Nicknamed 'Mummy porn' due to its popularity among married women, the novel has reignited interest in erotic fiction and sparked discussions among authors in the genre. Recently, author Jilly Cooper commented that the writing quality of EL James’s trilogy is debatable, but she acknowledged James's role in reviving attention for erotic fiction. Shirley Conran, author of 1980s bestseller Lace, has also spoken out as her own book is set for re-release. Conran, at 79, criticized Fifty Shades, stating it doesn't warrant the 'Mummy porn' title and labeling the trilogy 'infantile.' She suggested 'baby porn' as a more appropriate nickname, referencing the slow progression to explicit content. In The Times Magazine, Conran shared her disappointment with the pacing of the trilogy, noting readers wait until page 200 for any sexual content and until page 400 for more explicit scenes. She also critiqued the prose style as 'jerky' and recommended a thorough edit. Nevertheless, Conran acknowledged that the success of Fifty Shades has helped reopen doors for her own works. She theorized that the trilogy’s themes of submission may appeal to women because many have experienced patriarchal violence in their past—a sentiment she relates to, though she clarified it did not influence her own erotic interests.

article_content: Scientists in Australia have developed a brain implant designed to help people with epilepsy by predicting when they might have a seizure. The device works by monitoring the brain’s electrical signals and alerting users when they are likely to experience an epileptic episode. Epilepsy, a neurological disorder that leads to recurring seizures, develops when sudden disruptions in brain electrical activity cause unusual behavior or sensations. The condition affects over half a million people in the UK, with most diagnoses occurring during childhood, though it can appear at any age. While many people can experience a seizure in their lifetime, repeated episodes signal epilepsy. Currently, medication is the primary way to control seizures, with anti-epileptic drugs helping about 70% of patients. However, the unpredictable nature of when seizures strike remains a significant challenge. In a recent study published in The Lancet Neurology, 15 epilepsy patients at three Australian hospitals tried this new brain implant. The device records brainwaves directly from the brain’s surface and sends the information to a chest implant. That implant then calculates the risk of an impending seizure, relaying it to the patient. During the trial’s initial four months, researchers collected brain activity data to teach the system each person’s unique patterns before a seizure. Eight participants advanced to the stage where the device was fully operational, notifying them in real time about their seizure risk. In this group, the system’s accuracy at anticipating seizures ranged from 56% to a perfect 100%. Professor Mark Cook from the University of Melbourne, who led the trial, explained that being able to forecast seizures hours or minutes in advance could greatly improve independence for people with epilepsy and possibly change how medications are prescribed or developed. While the charity Epilepsy Action expressed excitement over this progress, it cautioned that the technology is still in early stages and needs further testing to confirm its reliability and safety.

article_content: Los Angeles, California (CNN) -- Marion "Suge" Knight, the influential rap music mogul and co-founder of Death Row Records, was arrested Friday night at Universal CityWalk in suburban Los Angeles. The arrest followed Knight’s failure to appear in court regarding a traffic violation, prompting authorities to issue a warrant for his arrest. Sgt. Shawn Ruda of the Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department stated that deputies recognized Knight as he left a restaurant at the popular shopping and entertainment area, located roughly nine miles northwest of downtown Los Angeles. Knight agreed to accompany officers to the West Hollywood sheriff’s station where he was booked and given a citation to appear in court again. The process took about an hour. Officials have not provided specifics about the original traffic violation. Knight, who launched Death Row Records in 1991, played a major role in the careers of prominent artists like Snoop Dogg and Tupac Shakur. He was with Shakur in Las Vegas when the rapper was fatally shot in 1996. Following that tragedy, Knight served several years in prison for parole violations related to assault and weapons offenses. These legal troubles, coupled with Shakur’s death and other business challenges, contributed to Death Row Records’ bankruptcy in 2006 after the departure of high-profile artists such as Dr. Dre and Snoop Dogg. More recently, in May of last year, Los Angeles police arrested Knight for allegedly pointing a gun at a man and driving with a suspended license. He was charged with assault with a deadly weapon and driving under suspension. Knight's attorney maintains that Knight is completely innocent of those charges.

article_content: Dayot Upamecano and Harry Kane celebrated Bayern Munich's opening goal in Der Klassiker against Borussia Dortmund. Dortmund entered the match unbeaten in 17 games and hoped to secure their first victory against Bayern Munich since 2018, especially after Bayern’s recent 2-1 loss to Saarbrücken in the DFB Pokal. However, Bayern quickly took control, with Upamecano scoring in the 4th minute and Kane adding another in the 9th. Although Dortmund increased their efforts, they finished the first half without a shot on target. Donyell Malen came close just before halftime, but his shot narrowly cleared the crossbar. After the match, Dortmund sporting director Sebastian Kehl commented, “We needed some time to sort ourselves. At that point, the match was basically finished because Bayern were very dominant and used their speed on the counterattack to take advantage of the space we allowed. Even though Gregor Kobel kept us in the game, it just wasn’t a good performance by us, and we have to accept that.” Goalkeeper Kobel made two excellent saves early on to keep Dortmund in contention. During the first 20 minutes of the second half, Dortmund showed some promise of a comeback. Head coach Edin Terzic made several substitutions, some of which had mixed results. Bringing on Felix Nmecha for Salih Özcan allowed Dortmund to press higher, but substituting Karim Adeyemi for Donyell Malen disrupted the attacking rhythm. The critical substitution came in the 67th minute when Youssoufa Moukoko replaced Julian Brandt, which led to a loss of structure in midfield. Shortly after, Kane scored to seal the result and later completed his hat-trick in the 90th minute. “He was clinical when given opportunities,” Kehl said about Harry Kane, who left the stadium with the match ball. “His teammates also created good chances for him, and we made it too easy.” Kane now has 17 goals in 14 games this season and contributes to a goal, on average, every 48 minutes for Bayern Munich. Bayern CEO Jan-Christian Dreesen expressed satisfaction with Kane’s performance, saying, “As someone partly responsible for the transfer, I’m very happy to see it working out and hope it continues.” While Kane’s form continues to impress, Dortmund must regroup. “We are disappointed,” Kehl admitted. “We believed we could get something from this match.” Despite hopes after Bayern’s midweek loss, Bayern proved to be dangerous after setbacks. Bayern midfielder Leon Goretzka commented, “A battered boxer is always dangerous. I suffered watching our defeat to Saarbrücken, but I’m glad we responded well today.” Bayern remain just two points behind league leaders Bayer Leverkusen, who defeated Hoffenheim 3-2. Dortmund are in fourth place, trailing Leverkusen by seven points and Bayern by five. Kehl added, “The standings don’t mean much right now. Even if we had won today, it wouldn’t change much. We went 17 games unbeaten before this, but today was our turn to lose, and we deserved it. We now need to refocus with an important Champions League match on Tuesday.” Manuel Veth, the author, is the host of the Bundesliga Gegenpressing Podcast and Area Manager USA at Transfermarkt. He has also written for The Guardian, Newsweek, Howler, Pro Soccer USA, and other publications. Follow him on Twitter: @ManuelVeth and on Threads: @manuveth.
translated_content: Dayot Upamecano en Harry Kane het Bayern München se openingsdoel in Der Klassiker teen Borussia Dortmund gevier. Dortmund het die wedstryd binnegekom sonder ’n nederlaag in 17 wedstryde en het gehoop om hul eerste sege teen Bayern München sedert 2018 te behaal, veral ná Bayern se onlangse 2-1 verlies teen Saarbrücken in die DFB Pokal. Bayern het egter vinnig beheer geneem, met Upamecano wat in die 4de minuut aangeteken het en Kane wat in die 9de bygevoeg het. Hoewel Dortmund hul pogings opgevoer het, het hulle die eerste helfte sonder ’n skoot op teiken afgesluit. Donyell Malen was naby net voor rustyd, maar sy skoot het net oor die dwarslat gegaan. Na die wedstryd het Dortmund se sportdirekteur, Sebastian Kehl, gesê: 'Ons het ’n bietjie tyd nodig gehad om onsself te rangskik. Op daardie stadium was die wedstryd basies klaar, want Bayern was baie dominant en het hul spoed in teenaanvalle gebruik om voordeel te trek uit die spasie wat ons toegelaat het. Al het Gregor Kobel ons in die wedstryd gehou, was dit eenvoudig nie ’n goeie vertoning van ons kant af nie, en ons moet dit aanvaar.' Doelwagter Kobel het vroeg twee uitstekende reddings gemaak om Dortmund in die wedstryd te hou. Gedurende die eerste 20 minute van die tweede helfte het Dortmund met hul spel laat blyk dat 'n terugkeer moontlik is. Hoofafrigter Edin Terzic het verskeie wissels gedoen met gemengde resultate. Deur Felix Nmecha in te bring vir Salih Özcan kon Dortmund hoër druk uitoefen, maar om Karim Adeyemi vir Donyell Malen te vervang, het die aanval se momentum verbreek. Die belangrikste wissel was in die 67ste minuut toe Youssoufa Moukoko vir Julian Brandt ingebring is, wat tot ’n verlies aan struktuur in die middelveld gelei het. Kort daarna het Kane geskor om die uitslag te verseël en later sy driekuns in die 90ste minuut voltooi. 'Hy was klinies met sy kanse,' het Kehl oor Harry Kane gesê, wat saam met die wedstrydbal die stadion verlaat het. 'Sy spanmaats het hom ook in goeie posisies gebring, en ons het dit te maklik gemaak.' Kane het nou 17 doele in 14 wedstryde van hierdie seisoen en is gemiddeld elke 48 minute by ’n doel betrokke vir Bayern München. Bayern se HUB Jan-Christian Dreesen het sy tevredenheid oor Kane se spel uitgespreek en gesê: 'As iemand wat deels verantwoordelik was vir die oordrag, is ek baie bly dat dit goed uitwerk en hoop dit gaan so voort.' Terwyl Kane steeds beïndruk, moet Dortmund hulself hergroepeer. 'Ons is teleurgesteld,' het Kehl erken. 'Ons het regtig geglo ons kan iets uit hierdie wedstryd kry.' Ten spyte van hoop ná Bayern se midweek-nederlaag, het Bayern op hul gevaarlikste geblyk toe hulle in die moeilikheid was. Bayern-middelvelder Leon Goretzka het gesê: '’n Geslaande bokser is altyd gevaarlik. Ek het gesukkel toe ek ons nederlaag teen Saarbrücken gekyk het, maar ek is bly ons het goed gereageer vandag.' Bayern is steeds net twee punte agter die liga-leiers Bayer Leverkusen, wat Hoffenheim 3-2 geklop het. Dortmund is vierde, sewe punte agter Leverkusen en vyf agter Bayern. Kehl het bygevoeg: 'Die posisie op die punteleer beteken nou niks. Selfs al het ons vandag gewen, sou dit nie veel verander nie. Ons was voorheen 17 wedstryde onoorwonne, maar vandag was dit ons beurt om te verloor, en ons het dit verdien. Ons moet fokus met ’n belangrike Champions League-wedstryd Dinsdag.' article_content: A recent DNA analysis has uncovered that Prince William possesses Indian ancestry through his maternal side, making him the possible first British monarch with such heritage. This discovery comes from studying mitochondrial DNA, which is inherited strictly from mothers, and can be traced back to William’s great-great-great-great-great-grandmother, Eliza Kewark. Although she was previously believed to be Armenian, genetic tests show she was at least half-Indian and lived in western India. The rare mitochondrial DNA variant discovered in William’s relatives is almost exclusively found in people from South Asia, as confirmed by geneticist Jim Wilson of the University of Edinburgh and BritainsDNA. These maternal genetic markers will not be passed on to William’s descendants since mitochondrial DNA is inherited only through the maternal line. Historical research reveals that Eliza Kewark formed a relationship with Scotsman Theodore Forbes, an employee with the East India Company. Their lineage continued through their daughter Katherine and eventually led to Princess Diana and then to Prince William. Letters from Eliza Kewark to Forbes point to the social and racial challenges she faced during her time, with Forbes referring to her as his ‘housekeeper’ in official documents, illustrating prejudice in that period. This revelation may renew interest in Prince William making an official visit to India, building on his family's long-standing historical connections to the region. Such findings demonstrate Britain's multicultural roots and the role of genetics in revealing shared global ancestry. Experts point out that mitochondrial DNA analysis provides important insight into historical migration and familial links, supporting a collective human heritage.

article_content: Affirm Holdings' shares surged nearly 18% on Thursday (Nov 2) after Amazon announced its business-to-business (B2B) platform would begin offering Affirm’s buy-now-pay-later (BNPL) service at checkout. Starting Thursday, Amazon Business will roll out Affirm for eligible sole proprietors, with wider availability for all eligible customers by Black Friday on November 24, according to a company statement. Affirm becomes the first BNPL provider integrated into Amazon Business. Its service is already an option for Amazon’s retail customers. The statement added that small business owners choosing Affirm at checkout can receive instant credit decisions by entering basic information such as their business name and address. Following the news, Affirm’s stock price soared to $20.72, reflecting a 17.7% gain. The stock has more than doubled this year and is on track for its largest daily percentage increase since August. According to LSEG data, the median price target among the 18 analysts covering Affirm is $16.50, with a current 'hold' recommendation. In August, Affirm reported better-than-expected quarterly results driven by increased loan transaction activity, which pushed its shares up 29% in a single session. The company is scheduled to release its next quarterly earnings report on November 8.

Vanaf Donderdag sal Amazon Business Affirm aan geskikte eenmansake uitrol, met wyer beskikbaarheid vir alle geskikte kliënte teen Black Friday op 24 November, volgens ’n maatskappyverklaring. article_content: Rick Santorum awoke Wednesday to a new reality after sweeping all three Republican presidential contests the previous day, reshaping the race to decide who will run against President Barack Obama in November. Santorum won caucuses in Minnesota and Colorado, as well as a nonbinding primary in Missouri, giving new energy to his campaign and raising questions about front-runner Mitt Romney’s ability to attract broad conservative support. Santorum’s victories strengthened his claim as the strongest conservative challenger to the more moderate Romney for the GOP nomination, and as the most viable opponent to Obama. 'I don’t stand here and claim to be the conservative alternative to Mitt Romney,' Santorum told supporters near St. Louis. 'I stand here to be the conservative alternative to Barack Obama.' Colorado was the most competitive contest, with Santorum receiving 40% of the vote, Romney 35%, Newt Gingrich 13%, and Ron Paul 12%. After a tight race, Colorado Republican Party chairman Ryan Call announced Santorum as the winner live on CNN. In Minnesota, Santorum secured 45% of the vote, followed by Paul at 27%, Romney at 17%, and Gingrich at 11%, with 88% of ballots counted. This win in a state Romney captured in his unsuccessful 2008 bid signaled Santorum’s role as a major conservative challenger. However, low turnout in all three races suggested possible dissatisfaction among Republican voters. Of the 70 delegates available, all came from Minnesota and Colorado, as Missouri’s primary was nonbinding with no delegates at stake. Delegates in the two caucus states will be officially awarded later at conventions, but media, including CNN, will offer unofficial estimates. With all of Missouri’s votes counted, Santorum led with 55%, followed by Romney with 25% and Paul with 12%. Gingrich was not on the ballot. Santorum’s strong showing reflected his appeal among Missouri’s evangelical and Tea Party supporters. 'Conservatism is alive and well in Missouri and Minnesota,' Santorum declared before Colorado’s count was complete. While Santorum had a successful night, it was disappointing for Romney and Gingrich, who have competed for conservative support. Gingrich spent little time or money in the three states, focusing instead on Super Tuesday’s contests on March 6, which offer more than 400 delegates across 10 states. Romney, having campaigned more in Colorado and to a lesser extent in Minnesota, lost momentum he had gained with previous wins in Florida and Nevada. A senior adviser signaled the Romney campaign would sharpen its approach to Santorum, portraying him as a Washington insider. Romney himself downplayed the losses, saying, 'We’d like to win everywhere, but you can’t. We’ve focused on key states for how we see a path to the nomination.' In Denver, Romney congratulated Santorum before the Colorado results were finalized and struck a conciliatory tone, urging party unity behind the eventual nominee and suggesting he expects to be that nominee. Romney also highlighted his father’s rise from humble beginnings to Michigan governor, emphasizing America as a land of opportunity. Democratic National Committee chair Debbie Wasserman Schultz said Tuesday’s results showed a weakness in Romney’s candidacy and reluctance among Republicans to rally behind him. She pointed to low turnout and stated, 'No candidate embodies that dissatisfaction more than Mitt Romney.' Missouri officials confirmed that turnout was significantly lower than predicted, at 23%. Romney’s best hope on Tuesday was Colorado, where he focused his campaigning and spent caucus night. Romney, who won big there in 2008, had invested in a strong organization in the state. Santorum said he needed strong showings to prove his campaign’s viability. Ron Paul also focused his efforts on caucus states, expecting to win delegates, and highlighted upcoming hopes in Maine. Gingrich entered the race late in both Colorado and Minnesota and did not appear on Missouri’s ballot. Instead, he looked forward to Super Tuesday states like Georgia and Ohio. Gingrich suggested Romney’s negative campaign against him allowed Santorum to capitalize, predicting the night’s results would muddle the race and challenge Romney’s status as frontrunner. After intense campaigning in Florida and Nevada, the Republican candidates criticized President Obama over new rules requiring hospitals, including Catholic ones, to provide health insurance covering contraception. Obama’s campaign responded by highlighting Romney’s record as Massachusetts governor on contraception access. Gingrich also accused Romney of requiring Catholic hospitals to provide abortion pills during his tenure as governor, suggesting Romney struggles to differentiate himself from Obama. Whether Paul, Gingrich, or Santorum have the resources to compete with Romney over the long term remains uncertain, while Obama’s campaign is well-funded. In a shift, Obama’s re-election team began encouraging donors to support a Democratic super PAC, Priorities USA Action, reflecting concerns over campaign financing laws from a 2010 Supreme Court decision. White House spokesperson Jay Carney stressed that Obama’s views against the Supreme Court ruling have not changed, but that Democrats cannot compete under two sets of rules or 'unilaterally disarm.' CNN reporters Jim Acosta, John Helton, Kevin Liptak, Rachel Streitfeld, Alan Silverleib, Jessica Yellin, and Peter Hamby contributed to this report.

Romney het ook sy pa se opgang van nederige begin tot goewerneur van Michigan beklemtoon, en Amerika as ŉ land van geleenthede uitgelig. Demokratiese Nasionale Komitee-voorsitter Debbie Wasserman Schultz het gesê Dinsdag se uitslae wys Romney se swakheid as kandidaat en huiwering onder Republikeine om hom te steun. Sy het na lae opkoms verwys en gesê: 'Geen kandidaat verteenwoordig daardie ontevredenheid meer as Mitt Romney nie.' Amptenare in Missouri het bevestig dat opkoms aansienlik laer as voorspel was, op 23%. Romney se beste hoop Dinsdag was Colorado, waar hy sy veldtog gefokus en die koukusnag deurgebring het. Romney, wat in 2008 daar groot gewen het, het ŉ sterk struktuur in die staat opgebou. Santorum het gesê hy moet goed presteer om sy veldtog se lewensvatbaarheid te bewys. Ron Paul het ook sy pogings op koukusstate gefokus en verwag om afgevaardigdes te wen, en hoop uitgespreek vir komende sukses in Maine. Gingrich het laat in Colorado en Minnesota begin en was nie op Missouri se stembrief nie. In plaas daarvan sien hy uit na Super Dinsdag-state soos Georgia en Ohio. Gingrich het gesê Romney se negatiewe veldtog teen hom het Santorum die geleentheid gegee, en voorspel dat die uitslae die wedloop sou bemoeilik en Romney se status as voorloper sou verlaag. Na intense veldtogte in Florida en Nevada het die Republikeinse kandidate president Obama gekritiseer oor nuwe reëls wat hospitale, insluitend Katolieke, verplig om gesondheidsversekering te gee wat voorbehoedmiddels dek. Obama se veldtog het gereageer deur Romney se rekord as goewerneur van Massachusetts oor toegang tot voorbehoeding uit te lig. Gingrich het Romney ook daarvan beskuldig dat hy Katolieke hospitale verplig het om aborsiepille te verskaf tydens sy ampstermyn, en voorgestel dat Romney sukkel om homself van Obama te onderskei. Of Paul, Gingrich of Santorum oor die lang termyn die hulpbronne het om met Romney mee te ding, bly onseker, terwyl Obama se veldtog goed befonds is. Obama se reëlingspan het in ŉ skuif begin om donasies na 'n Demokratiese super-PAC, Priorities USA Action, aan te moedig, wat kommer oor veldtogfinansieringswette van ŉ 2010 Hooggeregshofbesluit weerspieël. Woordvoerder van die Withuis, Jay Carney, het beklemtoon dat Obama se besware teen die Hooggeregshof-uitspraak nie verander het nie, maar dat Demokrate nie onder twee stelle reëls kan meeding of eenkantig onttrek nie. CNN-verslaggewers Jim Acosta, John Helton, Kevin Liptak, Rachel Streitfeld, Alan Silverleib, Jessica Yellin, en Peter Hamby het tot hierdie verslag bygedra.

article_content: Peggy Ann Fulford, 65, who admitted to defrauding millions from high-profile sports figures such as NBA champion Dennis Rodman and NFL all-pro Ricky Williams, has been granted early release from her 10-year prison sentence, according to a Guardian report. Fulford, who served part of her sentence in a low-security federal prison in Alabama, has now moved to a halfway house program in Orlando, Florida, confirmed by a US Bureau of Prisons spokesperson. Fulford posed as a financial adviser, falsely claiming a Harvard education and a successful Wall Street career. Among her victims were Rodman, Williams, basketball player Travis Best, and football player Lex Hilliard. Her deception led to a 2018 sentence of 10 years in prison and an order to pay over $5.7 million in restitution. Amid the COVID-19 pandemic, Fulford requested compassionate release, citing her age and desire to care for her ill father, which has sparked controversy over her early release. She had previously confessed her crimes and expressed regret in interviews and documentaries, including appearances on CNBC's American Greed and BET's American Gangster: Trap Queens. Fulford’s story sheds light on the complexities of white-collar crime, particularly how intricate financial scams can impact high-profile individuals.

Fulford, wat 'n deel van haar vonnis in 'n lae-sekuriteit federale tronk in Alabama uitgedien het, is nou oorgeplaas na 'n halfweghuis-program in Orlando, Florida, het 'n woordvoerder van die Amerikaanse Buro van Tronkke bevestig. Fulford het voorgedoen as 'n finansiële adviseur en valslik beweer sy het 'n Harvard-graad en 'n suksesvolle loopbaan op Wall Street. Van haar slagoffers was Rodman, Williams, basketbalspeler Travis Best, en sokkerspeler Lex Hilliard. Haar bedrog het daartoe gelei dat sy in 2018 tot 10 jaar tronkstraf gevonnis is en beveel is om meer as $5,7 miljoen in skadevergoeding te betaal. Gedurende die COVID-19-pandemie het Fulford aansoek gedoen vir deernisvolle vrylating, met verwysing na haar ouderdom en haar begeerte om haar siek pa te versorg. Dit het kontroversie oor haar vroeë vrylating ontketen. Sy het reeds haar skuld erken en berou getoon in onderhoude en dokumentêre reekse, insluitend verskynings op CNBC se American Greed en BET se American Gangster: Trap Queens. Fulford se verhaal beklemtoon die kompleksiteit van witboordjiebedrog, veral hoe gesofistikeerde finansiële bedrog hoëprofiel individue kan raak.

article_content: Andrew Lohse, a Dartmouth College student, drew public attention after exposing disturbing hazing rituals in his fraternity, Sigma Alpha Epsilon. Through a 2012 blog post and his book 'Confessions of an Ivy League Frat Boy,' Lohse describes forced consumption of vinegar, eating meals mixed with vomit, and being subjected to demeaning ordeals like swimming in contaminated pools. Now a campaigner for reform, Lohse advocates for opening fraternities to all genders and ending exclusivity, believing these reforms would modernize and improve campus culture. He argues that fraternity traditions promote entitlement and reinforce outdated gender divisions. Lohse’s book recounts how he was both a victim and later a participant in hazing, acknowledging this as a mistake and calling for accountability in fraternity life. He also highlights excessive fraternity expenditures, such as spending $30,000 each quarter on alcohol and paying $40,000 for a single rapper appearance. Lohse is critical of alumni and administrators for valuing tradition over safety. The deadly consequences of hazing are underscored by incidents involving Michael Deng and George Desdunes, both 19, whose deaths are linked to fraternity activities. Following his exposé, Lohse faced social isolation and disciplinary investigations, though he and others were ultimately exonerated. In March, Sigma Alpha Epsilon’s national leadership eliminated pledging—the extended initiation process for new recruits. Still, despite official bans, harmful hazing practices continue in fraternities across the country.

Lohse beywer hom nou vir hervorming en stel voor dat broederskappe vir alle geslagte oopgestel en uitsluitlikheid beëindig moet word. In Maart het Sigma Alpha Epsilon se nasionale bestuur die gebruik van 'pledging'—die lang inisiasieproses vir nuwe lede—heeltemal afgeskaf. Ten spyte van amptelike verbod bly gevaarlike ontgroeningspraktyke egter in broederskappe landwyd voortbestaan.

article_content: Seven of India's ten most valuable companies together added Rs 1,50,679.28 crore to their market value last week, with Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) and Infosys as the top performers in an overall positive equities market. The BSE benchmark index climbed 890.05 points or 1.37%. The companies that gained were Reliance Industries, TCS, HDFC Bank, Infosys, Hindustan Unilever, ITC, and Bharti Airtel. Meanwhile, ICICI Bank, State Bank of India, and Bajaj Finance saw a decline in valuation. TCS's market cap grew by Rs 62,148.99 crore to Rs 12,81,637.63 crore, leading gains among the top firms. Infosys increased by Rs 28,616.98 crore to Rs 5,96,681.75 crore. Reliance Industries' value climbed by Rs 28,111.41 crore to Rs 15,93,893.03 crore. HDFC Bank increased by Rs 11,136.61 crore, totaling Rs 11,42,215.81 crore. Hindustan Unilever advanced by Rs 10,032.75 crore to Rs 5,94,317.36 crore. Bharti Airtel was up Rs 6,828.74 crore to Rs 5,32,585.63 crore, and ITC was higher by Rs 3,803.8 crore, reaching Rs 5,47,808.43 crore. However, State Bank of India’s valuation dropped by Rs 14,502.5 crore to Rs 5,02,589.52 crore. ICICI Bank lost Rs 11,308.97 crore to end at Rs 6,46,254.41 crore, and Bajaj Finance decreased by Rs 4,973.68 crore to Rs 4,46,169.40 crore. Reliance Industries retained its status as the most valuable Indian company, followed by TCS, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Infosys, Hindustan Unilever, ITC, Bharti Airtel, State Bank of India, and Bajaj Finance. Separately, hotel and airfare prices in Ahmedabad surged before the India-Australia World Cup cricket final, affecting fans’ travel arrangements. OpenAI ousted cofounder and CEO Sam Altman due to disagreements involving AI safety and commercialization. India’s government approved IT hardware manufacturing proposals from 27 global and domestic firms, set to bring in ₹3,000 crore of investment over six years.

article_content: A research group led by Dr. Eric Vejerano, associate professor of environmental health sciences, has discovered that leaves from both coniferous and broadleaf trees are rich in biogenic persistent free radicals (BPFRs). Together with Jeonghyeon Ahn, his former Ph.D. student, Dr. Vejerano published findings in Environmental Science & Technology Letters showing significant quantities of BPFRs in various leaf types, whether fresh or decaying. Their analysis points out that enormous amounts of leaf litter existing worldwide haven't been considered as a source of persistent free radicals, which may pose risks to health if inhaled or ingested, depending on toxicity. Dr. Vejerano, who specializes in air pollution and environmental contaminants, usually researches long-lasting free radicals originating from human activity, such as traffic or industrial sources. This new study, however, investigates naturally occurring BPFRs—including those arising from forest fires and now, leaf litter. They observed that BPFR levels not only persist in leaves, but can actually build up through repeated cycles of moisture and drying. With plants making up more than 80 percent of planet Earth's land biomass, the possible effect of BPFRs in leaf litter is significant. Dr. Vejerano emphasized that BPFRs pose no threat while sealed within whole leaves, but after decomposition, they can be dispersed, potentially impacting human and environmental health.

Saam met sy voormalige Ph.D.-student Jeonghyeon Ahn, het dr. article_content: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says Russian forces have attempted to assassinate him so many times since the Kremlin launched its invasion of Ukraine nearly two years ago that he has lost count. In a recent exclusive interview with the British newspaper The Sun, Zelenskyy estimated that Ukraine's intelligence services have thwarted at least 'five or six' assassination plots. When asked how many times he has survived such attempts, Zelenskyy replied, 'I really don't know.' He compared the repeated threats to his life to experiencing COVID-19, telling the outlet from his Kyiv headquarters, 'The first one is very interesting when it is the first time, and after that it is just like COVID. First of all, people don't know what to do with it and it looks very scary.' He added, 'And then after that, it is just intelligence sharing with you details that one more group came to Ukraine to [attempt] this.' Russian President Vladimir Putin launched the full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, and the bloody war continues. Zelenskyy told The Sun that Russia still aims to remove him from power and claimed the codename for this alleged operation is 'Maidan 3.' He said the deadline for this operation is set for the end of this year. 'It is meant to change the president,' Zelenskyy said, adding, 'It's bye bye. Maybe it's not by killing. I mean it's changing. They will use any instruments they have.'

In 'n onlangse eksklusiewe onderhoud met die Britse koerant The Sun, het Zelenskyy beraam dat Oekraïne se intelligensiedienste al minstens 'vyf of ses' sluipmoordpogings verhoed het. article_content: Beirut, Lebanon – The Lebanese armed group Hezbollah and Israel’s military have exchanged artillery fire and other attacks across their shared border over the past week, raising fears that a wider regional war could erupt. The violence coincides with the ongoing bombardment and blockade of the Gaza Strip, the Palestinian territory central to the Israeli-Hamas conflict. Israel declared war on Hamas on October 8, one day after the Palestinian group launched a surprise attack from Gaza that killed approximately 1,400 Israelis. Following Israel’s aerial bombardment of Gaza, Palestinian deaths rose to nearly 2,800. The escalation prompted the Iran-backed Hezbollah to declare solidarity with the Palestinian people. Its subsequent attacks — and Israel’s retaliation — have revived memories of conflict between the two sides, which had been relatively dormant since 2006. As tensions threaten to spark again, here’s an overview of the history of the Lebanese-Israeli conflict: Pre-1948: Before Israel was established, Lebanon debated its position regarding Zionist groups in Palestine. Lebanon gained independence from France in 1943. While some Lebanese nationalists favored an alliance with the Zionists, the country's founders — mainly Riad al-Solh and Bechara el-Khoury — preferred to maintain good relations with neighboring Arab states. 1948: Israel declared independence on May 14. The following day, Egypt, Syria, Jordan, Iraq, and Lebanon declared war on Israel. Lebanon had the smallest army among the Arab nations. Israeli forces repelled the Arab armies and temporarily occupied part of southern Lebanon. An armistice was signed on March 23, 1949, and Israeli troops withdrew to the recognized border. 1965: The rise of Fatah, a Palestinian nationalist group, marked renewed border tensions. The Lebanese army opposed Fatah’s operations but public opinion in Lebanon was divided along religious and political lines. 1967: The Six-Day War began on June 5, resulting in swift Arab defeat by Israel. Many Palestinians were expelled from territories, and thousands of refugees fled to Lebanon. The PLO, under Yasser Arafat's leadership, became the leading Palestinian organization. 1969: On November 2, PLO leader Arafat and Lebanese Army General Emile Bustani signed the Cairo Accord, transferring control of 16 Palestinian refugee camps in Lebanon to the PLO, enabling cross-border operations. 1970: After being expelled from Jordan following a failed uprising, the PLO relocated its headquarters to Beirut and southern Lebanon. 1973: On April 9-10, Israeli special forces assassinated three PLO leaders in Beirut during Operation Wrath of God, also known as the Verdun Massacre. 1978: Continued Palestinian cross-border raids led to Israel’s invasion up to the Litani River. The UN Security Council passed Resolution 425, calling for Israeli withdrawal and creating UNIFIL, a peacekeeping force still present today. 1979: Egypt and Israel signed a peace agreement, shifting the regional balance. Other Arab states reconsidered direct conflict with Israel. 1982: Israel invaded Lebanon citing cross-border PLO attacks, advancing as far as Beirut and besieging the city. The PLO eventually left Lebanon. This period saw the rise of Hezbollah, backed by Iran’s Revolutionary Guard. After President-elect Bashir Gemayel’s assassination, the Sabra and Shatila massacre occurred, with hundreds or thousands killed. 1985: Israel withdrew to a security zone in southern Lebanon, maintaining an occupation until 2000. 1993: Israel launched Operation Accountability in response to Hezbollah attacks, resulting in extensive damage and more than 100 civilian deaths. 1996: Operation Grapes of Wrath and the Qana Massacre caused further civilian casualties and destruction. 2000: On May 24, Israel withdrew to the UN-designated Blue Line, ending its occupation of southern Lebanon. May 25 became a Lebanese national holiday. Most members of the South Lebanese Army left with Israeli forces. 2006: Hezbollah kidnapped two Israeli soldiers and killed three, sparking the July War. The conflict lasted 34 days, resulting in about 1,200 Lebanese and 158 Israeli deaths. 2023: The border recently saw relative calm, despite sporadic incidents and frequent Israeli airspace violations. In the latest clashes, deaths include Lebanese journalist Issam Abdallah, an elderly Lebanese couple, and one Israeli civilian.

Die geweld val saam met die voortdurende bombardement en blokkade van die Gaza-strook, die Palestynse gebied wat sentraal staan in die Israel-Hamas-konflik. Israel het oorlog teen Hamas verklaar op 8 Oktober, een dag nadat die Palestynse groep ’n verrassingsaanval vanuit Gaza geloods het wat ongeveer 1 400 Israeli’s doodgemaak het. Na Israel se lugaanvalle op Gaza het Palestynse sterftes tot byna 2 800 gestyg. Die eskalasie het daartoe gelei dat Hezbollah, gesteun deur Iran, solidariteit met die Palestynse volk verklaar het. Die daaropvolgende aanvalle van Hezbollah, en Israel se teenreaksie, het herinneringe aan konflikte tussen die twee kante herleef wat sedert 2006 relatief stil was. Soos spanning weer opvlam, is hier ’n oorsig van die geskiedenis van die Libanees-Israeliese konflik: Voor 1948: Voor Israel gestig is, het Libanon sy posisie teenoor Sionistiese groepe in Palestina oorweeg. Libanon het in 1943 onafhanklikheid van Frankryk gekry. Hoewel sommige Libanese nasionaliste ’n alliansie met die Sioniste verkies het, het die land se stigters — veral Riad al-Solh en Bechara el-Khoury — verkies om goeie betrekkinge met naburige Arabiese state te handhaaf. 1948: Israel het op 14 Mei onafhanklikheid verklaar. Die volgende dag het Egipte, Sirië, Jordanië, Irak en Libanon oorlog teen Israel verklaar. Libanon het die kleinste leër van die Arabiese lande gehad. Israeliese magte het die Arabiese leërs teruggedryf en tydelik ’n deel van Suid-Libanon beset. ’n Wapenstilstand is op 23 Maart 1949 gesluit, en Israeliese troepe het na die erkende grens onttrek. 1965: Die opkoms van Fatah, ’n Palestynse nasionalistiese groep, het nuwe grensspanning veroorsaak. Die Libanese leër was gekant teen Fatah se optrede, maar openbare mening in Libanon was godsdienstig en polities verdeel. 1967: Die Sesdae-oorlog het op 5 Junie begin, wat tot ’n vinnige Arabiese nederlaag teen Israel gelei het. Baie Palestyne is uit hul gebiede verdryf en duisende vlugtelinge het na Libanon gevlug. Die PLO, onder leiding van Yasser Arafat, het die voorste Palestynse organisasie geword. 1969: Op 2 November het PLO-leier Arafat en Libanese generaal Emile Bustani die Kaïro-ooreenkoms onderteken, wat beheer van 16 Palestynse vlugtelingkampe in Libanon aan die PLO oorgedra het, wat kruisgrensoperasies moontlik gemaak het. 1970: Na hulle uitsetting uit Jordanië ná ’n mislukte opstand, het die PLO hul hoofkwartier na Beiroet en suidelike Libanon geskuif. 1973: Op 9-10 April het Israeliese spesiale magte drie PLO-leiers in Beiroet vermoor tydens Operasie Wrath of God, ook bekend as die Verdun-slagting. 1978: Voortgesette Palestynse grensaanvalle het tot Israel se inval tot by die Litani-rivier gelei. Die VN se Veiligheidsraad het Resolusie 425 aanvaar, wat Israeliese onttrekking en die stigting van UNIFIL, ’n vredesmag, geëis het. 1979: Egipte en Israel het ’n vredesooreenkoms gesluit, wat die streekbalans verskuif het. Ander Arabiese lande het hul benadering tot regstreekse konflik met Israel heroorweeg. 1982: Israel het Libanon binnegeval na kruisgrens-aanvalle deur die PLO, en tot by Beiroet gevorder om die stad te beleër. Die PLO het uiteindelik Libanon verlaat. Gedurende hierdie tyd het Hezbollah, deur Iran se Revolusionêre Garde gesteun, ontstaan. Na die sluipmoord op president-verkose Bashir Gemayel het die Sabra-en-Shatila-bloedbad plaasgevind, met honderde of selfs duisende slagoffers. 1985: Israel het na ’n veiligheidsone in Suid-Libanon onttrek en beslag tot 2000 gehandhaaf. 1993: Israel het Operasie Accountability geloods as reaksie op Hezbollah-aanvalle, wat groot skade en meer as 100 burgerlike sterftes tot gevolg gehad het. 1996: Operasie Grapes of Wrath en die Qana-slagting het verdere burgerlike verliese en verwoesting veroorsaak. 2000: Op 24 Mei het Israel tot by die VN se Blue Line onttrek, en die besetting van Suid-Libanon beëindig. 25 Mei het ’n Libanese nasionale feesdag geword. Die meeste van die Suid-Libanese Leër het saam met Israel uitgetrek. 2006: Hezbollah het twee Israeliese soldate ontvoer en drie doodgemaak, wat die Julie-oorlog begin het. Die oorlog het 34 dae geduur, met sowat 1 200 Libanese en 158 Israeliese sterftes. 2023: Onlangs was die grens redelik kalm, behalwe vir sporadiese voorvalle en gereelde Israeliese lugruimskendings. In die jongste botsings is insluitende sterftes die Libanese joernalis Issam Abdallah, ’n bejaarde Lebaniese egpaar, en een Israeliese burger.

article_content: Marwan Bishara discusses the increasing overlap between the Palestinian liberation movement and the wider campaign for climate justice. These struggles are now deeply connected, sharing both philosophical principles and immediate real-world consequences. Currently, Palestinians face intensifying restrictions and human rights challenges under Israeli governance, alongside serious climate threats. Scientific studies by Israel indicate that the Eastern Mediterranean, including Israel and Palestine, is among the regions most exposed to climate impacts globally. While the world has warmed by about 1.1°C since the pre-industrial period, regional temperatures in Israel/Palestine have increased by approximately 1.5°C from 1950 to 2017, with projections reaching up to a 4°C rise by 2100. The Middle East at large is heating almost twice as fast as the global average, endangering the wellbeing of its roughly 400 million inhabitants. Though many Middle Eastern countries have ratified agreements such as the Paris Climate Accord, they have generally not fulfilled their commitments, and oil-rich nations especially are still boosting fossil fuel output. This was underscored when the United Arab Emirates appointed its national oil company head to chair COP28, raising concerns over conflict of interest in climate leadership. However, these shortcomings are said to be overshadowed by what critics describe as Western hypocrisy. Referencing New York Times columnist David Wallace-Wells, the article notes that despite calling climate change a major threat, the United States is on track to lead global fossil fuel expansion through mid-century. Criticism also targets Western policies towards both climate change and the Israeli–Palestinian conflict: wealthy nations are viewed as making grand promises without meaningful follow-through, frequently relying on inadequate tactics like carbon credits or diplomatic plans that sidestep fundamental issues. Environmentally, Israel is accused of using ecological projects to justify land appropriation from Palestinians, a practice described as 'green colonialism.' Designating land as nature reserves often prevents displaced Palestinians from returning. Climate justice movements have broadened in scope, now calling for justice, equity, and local control over natural resources. Many environmental groups globally have declared support for the Palestinian cause, recognizing the interconnection of social and environmental justice. Israeli restrictions in the West Bank, especially over land and water, are said to worsen Palestinian vulnerability to climate shocks. Reports indicate Israeli settlers benefit from disproportionately higher access to water compared to Palestinian residents. The Jewish National Fund, which manages a significant share of Israel’s land, is criticized for its environmental image, which detractors label as 'greenwashing,' alleging that its actions contribute to Palestinian displacement and cultural erasure. The analysis concludes by arguing that the persistence of Israeli policies and global climate injustice reflect widespread systemic failures. The article suggests that unless societies address these deeply interconnected challenges, the repercussions will be universal.

Palestyne ervaar tans toenemende beperkings en menseregteskendinge onder Israelse bewind, terwyl hulle ernstige klimaatsbedreigings moet hanteer. Wetenskaplike studies van Israel wys dat die Oostelike Middellandse See, insluitend Israel en Palestina, een van die wêreld se kwesbaarste gebiede vir klimaatsimpakte is. Sedert die pre-industriële tydperk het die wêreld se temperature gemiddeld met ongeveer 1.1°C gestyg, terwyl temperature in Israel/Palestina met sowat 1.5°C tussen 1950 en 2017 toegeneem het en na verwagting tot 4°C teen 2100 kan styg. Die Midde-Ooste oor die algemeen verhit byna dubbel so vinnig as die wêreldgemiddeld, wat die lewe van ongeveer 400 miljoen mense raak. Al het baie lande in die Midde-Ooste die Parys Klimaatakkoord onderteken, word verpligtinge min nagekom en olierike lande verhoog hul fossielbrandstofproduksie. Dit is beklemtoon toe die Verenigde Arabiese Emirate sy staat-olie uitvoerende hoof as voorsitter van COP28 aangestel het, wat kritiek ontlok het rondom leierskap en integriteit in klimaatsake. Hierdie tekortkominge, sê kritici, word selfs oortref deur Weslike skynheiligheid. Volgens New York Times-skrywer David Wallace-Wells noem die artikel dat die VSA steeds wêreldleier is in die uitbreiding van fossielbrandstowwe, ten spyte van amptelike verklarings oor klimaatsbedreigings. Die kritiek strek na Westerse benaderings tot klimaatsverandering en die Israelies-Palestynse kwessie: ryk lande maak groot beloftes, maar min volg op met betekenisvolle aksies. Hulle steun dikwels op onvoldoende meganismes soos koolstofkrediete of vredesplanne waarin kernprobleme nie aangespreek word nie. Israel word ook daarvan beskuldig dat dit omgewingsprojekte gebruik om Palestynse grond onder die vaandel van natuurbewaring te onteien – iets wat as 'groen kolonialisme' beskryf word. Hierdie gebiede word soms as reservate aangewys, en keer dat ontslape Palestyne na hul land terugkeer. Die beweging vir klimaatsgeregtigheid het uitgebrei tot oproepe vir billikheid, geregtigheid, en plaaslike beheer oor natuurlike hulpbronne. Baie omgewingsorganisasies regoor die wêreld ondersteun die Palestynse saak as deel van 'n breër streef na sosiale en omgewingsgeregtigheid. Israelse regulasies in die Wesoewer, veral oor grond en water, vererger Palestyne se kwesbaarheid teenoor klimaatsgevare, met berigte van ongelyke toegang tot water ten gunste van setlaars. Die Jewish National Fund, wat 'n groot deel van Israel se grond bestuur, word daarvan beskuldig dat hulle hulself omgewingsvriendelik voordoen terwyl hulle terselfdertyd ontheemding en uitwissing van Palestynse identiteit ondersteun – beskryf as 'groenwassery'. Die artikel sluit af dat beide Israelse beleid en wêreldwye klimaatsonreg sistemiese probleme is wat almal kan raak, tensy die onderliggende kwessies regtig aangespreek word.

article_content: If you’re considering booking a holiday to destinations such as New York, Australia, or Dubai, you may want to reconsider using Blue Skies Travel (UK) Ltd. Online review platform TripAdvisor has received numerous negative reviews from customers reporting poor experiences with the agency, which shares contact details with Bright Skies Travel and Fly Vacations. A TripAdvisor discussion thread about Blue Skies Travel (UK) Ltd, started on September 7, 2014, has already attracted 117 mostly critical posts. Many customers describe difficulties with booking confirmations and a lack of communication from company representatives. For instance, Thomas D from Belfast stated: 'Do not book with this Travel Agent! We are due to leave on Sunday 26th October and still have no holiday booked! When questioning Clive, he sent us a reservation confirmation for flights. I spoke directly to United Airlines, who confirmed that he only reserved—but did not pay for—our flights. After numerous calls and emails, Clive is now ignoring us.' Similarly, Bernadette C from Blackpool reported she had not received paperwork and struggled to communicate with Clive Allard and his team. She said, 'Jet2.com has no record of our flights. The police advised me to take further action, and I am completing a form with the Fraud Squad.' Another reviewer, Kirb80, mentioned their flight reservation was cancelled after multiple unsuccessful attempts to reach the company, due to non-payment. Blue Skies Travel (UK) Ltd is a Kent-based company registered at Companies House two years ago. The director, Clive Allard, previously led Travellers Cities—a company that collapsed leaving customers at a loss. The Fly Vacations website currently displays a message about a temporary phone line fault, suggesting customers use the online contact page for assistance. Action Fraud has referred complaints about Blue Skies Travel and Bright Skies Travel to the Metropolitan Police, while the Civil Aviation Authority is assessing public feedback. Blue Skies Travel (UK) Ltd is not connected to other similarly named firms. Despite efforts from customers and MailOnline Travel, Mr. Allard has not responded to requests for comment.
