article_content: On May 19, 1967, The Beatles celebrated the completion of their album 'Sgt Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band' at a press conference at the west London home of their manager, Brian Epstein. The LP was released on June 1st. (Photo by John Pratt/Keystone/Getty Images) Decades later, The Beatles have returned with a new single, 'Now and Then'. The track originated as a demo by John Lennon and was completed with the help of artificial intelligence. The single has become a hit on several Billboard charts, including some the band had never reached before. 'Now and Then' debuted on the Billboard Streaming Songs chart, ranking at No. 28 with 11 million streams in its first full tracking week. In the prior tracking period, the song had 2.3 million streams in just a few hours, helping it reach the Bubbling Under Hot 100 chart. Millions of streams contributed to the single’s strong debut at No. 7 on the Billboard Hot 100—a chart that combines streaming, radio play, and sales. Despite The Beatles’ legendary status, some Billboard charts were introduced long after the band’s original releases, making their appearance on newer charts significant. 'Now and Then' is currently a standalone single. Paul McCartney and Ringo Starr, the two surviving Beatles, have indicated that this will be the final song from the band. Widespread fan interest and curiosity helped power the song’s Billboard chart success, with streaming playing a major role.
translated_content: Op 19 Mei 1967 het The Beatles die voltooiing van hul album 'Sgt Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band' gevier tydens 'n perskonferensie by hul bestuurder Brian Epstein se huis in Wes-Londen. Die album is op 1 Junie vrygestel. (Foto deur John Pratt/Keystone/Getty Images) Dekades later is The Beatles terug met 'n nuwe enkelsnit, 'Now and Then'. Die liedjie het begin as 'n demoweergawe deur John Lennon en is met die hulp van kunsmatige intelligensie voltooi. Die enkelsnit het 'n treffer op verskeie Billboard-treffersparades geword, insluitend sommige waarop die groep nog nooit tevore verskyn het nie. 'Now and Then' het op die Billboard Streaming Songs-treffersparade gedebuteer, met 'n posisie van nommer 28 en 11 miljoen stroombeurte in die eerste volledige week. In die vorige periode het die liedjie 2.3 miljoen stroombeurte in net 'n paar uur gekry, wat dit gehelp het om die Bubbling Under Hot 100-treffersparade te bereik. Miljoene stroombeurte het bygedra tot die enkelsnit se sterk debuut op nommer 7 van die Billboard Hot 100—’n treffersparade wat streaming, radio-speeltyd en verkope kombineer. Ten spyte van The Beatles se ikoniese status, is sekere Billboard-treffersparades eers ingestel nadat die groep se oorspronklike musiek uitgereik is, wat hul verskyning op hierdie nuwe lyste besonder noemenswaardig maak. 'Now and Then' is tans 'n alleenstaande enkelsnit. Paul McCartney en Ringo Starr, die twee oorblywende Beatles, het aangedui dat dit waarskynlik die laaste liedjie van die groep sal wees. Wye belangstelling en nuuskierigheid van aanhangers het die liedjie se Billboard-prestasie aangevuur, met streaming wat 'n groot rol gespeel het.

article_content: Chinese President Xi Jinping is visiting the United States for the first time in six years as both countries look to ease rising tensions. Xi landed on Tuesday, with President Joe Biden expressing hopes that their upcoming talks will put US-China relations back on a stable path—particularly restarting regular communication, including between their militaries. The two leaders are set to meet just outside San Francisco on Wednesday, ahead of the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit. Their meeting is the first in a year and comes after months of diplomatic groundwork, as the relationship has been strained by disputes over trade, human rights, and the COVID-19 pandemic. Before leaving for San Francisco, Biden emphasized that the US does not intend to sever ties with China but wants to reset relations positively. He underscored the importance of open channels: 'Being able to talk directly in a crisis and maintaining contact between our militaries.' Upon arrival, Xi was greeted on the tarmac by senior US officials, including Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen and US Ambassador to China Nicholas Burns. His last US visit was in 2017, when he met with then-President Donald Trump. China, which often highlights 'red lines' on issues like Taiwan and the South China Sea, has downplayed its expectations for the summit. According to a foreign ministry spokesperson, the focus will be 'in-depth communication' on world peace. Still, experts see the dialogue as significant, regardless of the outcome. Analyst Alicia Garcia Herrero noted that even limited progress from this long-anticipated meeting should not be underestimated. Xi's motorcade was met by crowds, with both supporters and critics present—including demonstrations against the Chinese Communist Party and others warmly welcoming Xi. Outside his hotel, supporters waved flags and played patriotic music, while scuffles between demonstrators led to a brief police intervention. Similar scenes unfolded near the APEC meeting venue, with larger protests by human rights groups expected. Officials say Xi and Biden are expected to meet at the Filoli Estate near San Francisco, though the location is not officially confirmed. Their agenda will cover both economic issues—such as efforts to stem fentanyl production—and pressing geopolitical topics like the Israel-Hamas war and the conflict in Ukraine. The White House has signaled that engagement with China will not come at the cost of key US priorities. National Security Spokesperson John Kirby said Biden will address disagreements directly. Meanwhile, Secretary of State Antony Blinken told APEC ministers that the US supports a region where economies can choose their own path and operate freely, echoing previous US criticisms of China without naming it directly.
translated_content: Die Chinese president, Xi Jinping, besoek die Verenigde State vir die eerste keer in ses jaar terwyl albei lande probeer om spanning te verminder. Xi het Dinsdag geland en president Joe Biden het sy hoop uitgespreek dat hul komende gesprekke die betrekkinge tussen die VSA en China op 'n meer stabiele pad kan plaas – veral deur normale kommunikasie, insluitend tussen hul weermagte, te hervat. Die twee leiers ontmoet Woensdag net buite San Francisco, voor die Asië-Stille Oseaan Ekonomiese Samewerking (APEC) beraad. Dit is hul eerste ontmoeting in 'n jaar en volg na maande se diplomatieke voorbereiding, aangesien die verhouding gespanne is oor handel, menseregte en die COVID-19-pandemie. Voor sy vertrek na San Francisco het Biden beklemtoon dat die VSA nie van plan is om bande met China te verbreek nie, maar die verhouding positief wil hervestig. Hy het die belangrikheid van oop kommunikasiekanale uitgelig: 'Dat daar in 'n krisis direk gepraat kan word en dat daar kontak tussen ons weermagte bly.' Xi is op die lughawe deur senior VSA-amptenare, insluitend Tesourie Sekretaris Janet Yellen en VSA-ambassadeur in China Nicholas Burns, verwelkom. Sy laaste besoek aan die VSA was in 2017, toe hy die destydse president Donald Trump ontmoet het. China, wat dikwels sy 'rooi lyne' oor onderwerpe soos Taiwan en die Suid-Chinese See beklemtoon, het verwagtinge vir die beraad laag gehou. Volgens 'n woordvoerder van die buitelandse ministerie sal die fokus wees op 'diepgaande kommunikasie' oor wêreldvrede. Kenners beskou hierdie dialoog egter as betekenisvol, ongeag die uitkoms. Ontleder Alicia Garcia Herrero meen selfs beperkte vordering uit hierdie lankverwagte vergadering moet nie onderskat word nie. Xi se motorcade is deur skares verwelkom, met beide ondersteuners en teenstanders teenwoordig – insluitend betogers teen die Chinese Kommunistiese Party en ander wat Xi hartlik verwelkom het. Buite sy hotel het ondersteuners vlae geswaai en patriotiese musiek gespeel, terwyl botsings tussen betogers tot kortstondige polisie-optrede gelei het. Soortgelyke tonele het naby die APEC-beraad plaasgevind, met groter protesaksies deur menseregtegroepe wat verwag word. Amptenare sê Xi en Biden sal waarskynlik by die Filoli-landgoed naby San Francisco vergader, hoewel die plek nog nie amptelik bevestig is nie. Op die agenda sal beide ekonomiese kwessies wees – soos pogings om die produksie van fentanyl in te perk – asook belangrike geopolitieke onderwerpe soos die Israel-Hamas-konflik en die oorlog in Oekraïne. Die Withuis het aangedui dat verhoudinge met China nie ten koste van die VSA se kernbelange sal kom nie. article_content: Scots could lose the right to play the National Lottery if Scotland votes for independence, according to reports. Laws from the lottery's launch 20 years ago specify that, should Scotland leave the UK, they would also lose the right to participate in UK lottery games. Currently, only those who buy tickets within the UK or hold a UK bank account can participate in the Lotto and EuroMillions. The same rules mean Scotland would no longer be eligible for billions of pounds in grants distributed by the lottery to charities, sports, arts, historic buildings, and other causes. This potential change could significantly impact Scotland, with more than 50,000 organizations having received lottery grants totaling £2.5 billion. Nonetheless, the SNP and Scottish Government have informed groups in Scotland that a 'Yes' vote for independence would not affect the lottery funds they receive. Despite these reassurances, a Department for Culture, Media, and Sport spokesman stated: 'A new Scottish state would have no automatic right to continue being part of the UK National Lottery.' Up to 70 percent of Scots regularly play the Lotto and EuroMillions. Notably, major donors to the independence campaign and the SNP have included Scottish lottery winners Chris and Colin Weir, who donated £5.5 million after winning £161 million in the EuroMillions in 2011. The couple, from Largs in Ayrshire, have since met with SNP leader Alex Salmond at his official residence, Bute House. The Lotto program is presented by Scottish host Jenni Falconer, alongside Mollie King and Rochelle Humes of The Saturdays. A spokesman for Scottish Finance Secretary John Swinney said: 'The current Camelot contract runs to 2023. Given that Scotland already contributes to the lottery, there is absolutely no reason why it should not continue to operate as it does now.'

article_content: Concerns have been raised about the safety of the Duke and Duchess of Cambridge after the Queen's representative in New Zealand used social media to share precise details of the couple's upcoming tour. Prince William and Catherine, along with their eight-month-old son George, are scheduled for a three-week visit to New Zealand and Australia starting next week. However, the security arrangements for the trip have come under scrutiny after the Governor General of New Zealand's official Twitter account posted specific locations, timings, and maps of the couple's planned routes. The account, managed on behalf of Sir Jerry Mataparae, the Queen's representative in the country, provided timetables for royal visits in cities such as Wellington and Christchurch, and highlighted the best spots for the public to see the royals. Dai Davies, former Metropolitan Police Head of Royal Protection, expressed concern, stating that publicly revealing detailed travel information in advance could expose the royals to risks from terrorists or stalkers. He told the Daily Mirror, 'I'm appalled at the idiocy of anyone who would publish both route and location so far in advance. It goes against all security protocols.' Messages from the account, not written by Sir Jerry himself, included: 'The Duke and Duchess and Prince George arrive in Wellington at 11:45am, Monday 7 April at the Military Terminal, Wellington Airport. The best place to see them is round the bays as they drive to Government House.' Another message read: '#Auckland: Your best spots are down Beaumont/Jellicoe St, and around the harbour for match race sailing! #RoyalVisitNZ.' Maps were also shared for fans to locate the best viewing spots. While royal engagements are often announced beforehand, it is rare for exact timings and routes to be revealed beforehand due to security fears. Recent warnings about terrorism threats, such as those from Al-Qaeda targeting prominent British events, have heightened such concerns. Mr Davies referenced a 1970 assassination attempt targeting the Queen and Prince Philip in Australia, underlining the importance of alternative travel routes for security. A spokesperson for William and Kate stated the royal family was aware of the details being released and that this aligned with procedures from previous visits to New Zealand. The couple have arranged their itinerary to return to Prince George each night except for two evenings. Their recently appointed nanny Maria Teresa Turrion Borrallo will accompany them to assist with childcare. Unlike Queen Elizabeth II, who left her children at home during a long Commonwealth tour in 1953, Prince William considers leaving George behind ‘unthinkable’. A source noted the couple are only worried about how George will handle the long flight, as he is usually a happy and well-behaved baby, though he might be a bit grumpy after travel.

Die egpaar het hul program só beplan dat hulle elke nag, behalwe vir twee, na Prins George kan terugkeer. article_content: This year, I tested a wide range of smartphones, including flagships, mid-range, and budget models. While flagship phones upheld their top standards, the mid-range segment proved exceptionally strong. If you’re searching for a new phone this Cyber Monday, there are several great options available under $500. Many buyers will consider the Samsung Galaxy A54, discounted to $324. Samsung did a solid job with this phone—it delivers reliable daily performance. Nevertheless, the Google Pixel 7a stands out as an even better option in this price range. The Pixel 7a outperforms the Galaxy A54 in most critical areas, and is now available for just $374. For only $50 more than the A54, you get a significantly improved device. Google Pixel 7a (128GB): reduced from $499 to $374 on Amazon. With my extensive experience using a variety of phones, I can confidently say the Pixel 7a is the standout deal for Cyber Monday. It features the best camera system in its class, clean software, robust hardware, and overall, it’s a superior choice compared to the Galaxy A54. Why choose the Pixel 7a over the A54? Samsung hasn’t changed much with the Galaxy A54, but it does offer a vibrant 120Hz AMOLED display, decent cameras, and a big battery. In contrast, the Pixel 7a represents notable progress from its predecessor, boasting a 90Hz OLED display, an outstanding 64MP main camera with an excellent wide-angle lens, more powerful hardware than the A54, and a streamlined, enjoyable software experience. After thoroughly testing both, the Pixel 7a is the clear winner. Its 6.1-inch screen (versus 6.4 inches for the A54) makes it smaller and easier to use one-handed. Even though it’s limited to 90Hz refresh rate, the display delivers a smooth user experience. The Pixel 7a’s main strength is its camera—it far surpasses the Galaxy A54 in this area and arguably provides the best camera setup available for under $600. Additionally, the Pixel 7a comes with Android 14 out of the box and no bloatware. Google's interface is clean, colorful, and loaded with helpful extras, making it a pleasure to use—even after significant time with Samsung's One UI. While Samsung’s One UI offers benefits, it isn’t well-optimized on the A54 and includes excess pre-installed software, making it less pleasant than the Pixel 7a’s software. Subjectively, I also prefer the Pixel 7a’s design, especially its distinctive camera bar, though this may not influence everyone’s decision. The Galaxy A54 wins on battery capacity, with a 5000mAh battery that easily lasts over a day. The Pixel 7a’s 4385mAh battery consistently delivers a full day of use, though with less margin than the A54. Performance-wise, the Pixel 7a excels thanks to its custom Tensor G2 processor, which is noticeably faster than the Galaxy A54’s Exynos 1380. Both devices feature IP67 water and dust resistance. While I previously recommended Samsung devices, this year Google has taken the lead. The Pixel 7a outshines its competition in every essential area, and at $374, it’s one of the best smartphone deals of the year. If you’re upgrading this Cyber Monday, the Pixel 7a is highly recommended.

article_content: The United Nations has announced plans to bolster its peacekeeping forces in Ivory Coast by sending an additional 2,000 troops, responding to rising violence triggered by a disputed presidential election. Incumbent leader Laurent Gbagbo has refused to step down after the electoral commission declared he lost the November ballot, while the international community recognizes Alassane Ouattara as the rightfully elected president. Ouattara remains under UN protection in a hotel in Abidjan, the country's largest city. UN spokesperson Hamadoun Toure confirmed that, along with the new soldiers, three more armed helicopters will be deployed to strengthen efforts to protect civilians and maintain peace. The UN has maintained a 9,000-member peacekeeping mission in Ivory Coast for the past seven years. A standoff between opposing political camps has raised concerns among world leaders, many of whom fear the country is on the verge of another civil war like the 2002 conflict that split the country between a rebel-held north and government-controlled south. Last week, Gbagbo's forces reportedly opened fire on a peaceful women's march in Abidjan, killing at least six demonstrators. US State Department spokesperson P.J. Crowley described the attack, saying video footage captured the chaos as gunfire erupted and women screamed, leaving belongings and bodies scattered in the aftermath. Gbagbo denied his troops were responsible for the killings, dismissing the accusations as a deliberate distortion of the truth. Since the crisis began in December, about 365 people have died, according to the UN, while the fighting has forced hundreds of thousands to flee their homes. Some 200,000 residents have left Abidjan alone. The UN’s refugee agency has warned that increasing violence is making it almost impossible to reach those urgently needing humanitarian aid.

Die sittende leier, Laurent Gbagbo, weier om af te tree nadat die verkiesingskommissie verklaar het dat hy die November-stem verloor het, terwyl die internasionale gemeenskap Alassane Ouattara as die regmatige president erken. article_content: Manchester authorities are investigating a fatal incident where a woman was killed after being hit by a lorry near the Manchester Royal Infirmary. Police released CCTV images of the victim moments before the collision and footage showing a man collecting her shoes and handbag amidst the confusion that followed. Witnesses described the man, identified as Asian, as acting calmly while retrieving the belongings, contrasting with the distress of others at the scene. Police have yet to identify the woman, as no missing persons reports matching her details have been received. According to investigators, the victim—dressed in traditional Muslim clothing—was fatally struck by a truck during rush hour, causing her shoes and handbag to be thrown up to 100 yards from her body. Crowds gathered at the site, with some people posting graphic images online, a practice condemned by police. Superintendent Wasim Chaudhry highlighted the need to locate the man seen with the victim’s possessions, emphasizing that these items could help establish her identity. He assured the public that experienced investigators are handling the case and requested anyone with relevant information to come forward. The first truck driver involved appeared unaware of the accident and left the scene. Police detained a 47-year-old driver on suspicion of murder but released him without charges. Another driver, aged 40, was later arrested on suspicion of causing death by careless driving. The deceased is believed to be a local woman with black hair, wearing gold bangles, a nose ring, a toe ring, and saffron-colored South Asian attire. Police urge anyone worried about a missing person fitting this description to contact them as efforts to identify her continue.

article_content: Elderly patients in England continue to face barriers to life-saving surgeries within the NHS, despite laws designed to prevent age discrimination, leading surgeons warn. In some regions, no patients over the age of 75 are being offered crucial operations for breast cancer, and very few receive surgery for bowel cancer or undergo knee and hip replacements. This occurs despite legislation enacted in October 2012 that makes it illegal for NHS staff to deny surgery based solely on a patient’s age. The Royal College of Surgeons reports that there has been little to no improvement in the situation, and urges patients to insist on fair treatment if they feel discriminated against. In partnership with the charity Age UK, the college has highlighted a pronounced 'postcode lottery,' where the likelihood of patients over 65 accessing surgery varies significantly across England’s 211 clinical commissioning groups. Women in areas with the best access are 37 times more likely to have breast cancer surgery than those in the worst performing regions. Data shows that 17 areas offered no breast cancer surgeries to women over 75 last year, while three commissioned over 100 such procedures. Bowel cancer patients over 65 are nine times more likely to undergo surgery in the best areas compared to the worst. Similar disparities exist for hernia repairs and knee and hip replacements, where older patients in top-performing regions are 12 and 17 times more likely, respectively, to receive surgery. The college expresses concern that such stark differences mean some doctors or administrators may be unjustly denying surgery to elderly patients based purely on age. Professor Norman Williams, president of the Royal College of Surgeons, stated, 'If age is being used as a discriminator, it's absolutely wrong. Decisions should be based on individual health.' He encouraged patients who feel unfairly refused surgery to have open discussions with their GP or specialist.

In sommige streke word geen pasiënte ouer as 75 vir noodsaaklike borskanker-operasies oorweeg nie, en baie min kry chirurgie vir dikdermkanker of knie- en heupvervangings. Dit gebeur al sedert wetgewing in Oktober 2012 wat NHS-personeel verbied om enigeen bloot oor hul ouderdom van chirurgie te weerhou. Die Royal College of Surgeons sê min het verander, en moedig pasiënte aan om vir regverdige behandeling op te staan as hulle voel hulle word benadeel. Saam met Age UK wys hulle op 'n probleem van 'n 'poskode-lotery', waar chirurgie tussen Engeland se 211 kliniese kommissiegroepe dramaties verskil. Vroue in die best presterende gebiede het 37 keer meer kans op borskanker-operasies as dié in die swakste gebiede. 17 gebiede het verlede jaar geen borskankeroperasies aan vroue oor 75 aangebied nie, terwyl drie gebiede meer as 100 gedoen het. Dikdermkankerpasiënte oor 65 is nege keer meer geneig om operasies in die beste gebiede te kry as in die swakste. Vir breuk, knie- en heupvervangings is ouer pasiënte in die beste gebiede onderskeidelik 12 en 17 keer meer geneig om operasies te kry. Die kweekskool waarsku dat hierdie groot verskille beteken sommige dokters en administrateurs weier chirurgie vir bejaarde pasiënte bloot oor hul ouderdom. Professor Norman Williams, president van die Royal College of Surgeons, het gesê: 'As ouderdom as diskriminerende faktor dien, is dit verkeerd. Besluite moet op die individu se gesondheid gebaseer wees.' Hy moedig bejaardes aan om openlik met hul huisdokter of spesialis te praat as hulle voel chirurgie word onregverdig geweier.

article_content: Artificial intelligence is reshaping the world of hiring by making recruitment faster, more efficient, and fairer. Moonhub, led by founder and CEO Nancy Xu, is a pioneer in AI-powered recruiting. Motivated by her belief that opportunities should match the availability of talent, Xu founded Moonhub to help make job hunting more accessible. Recruiters no longer have to sift through hundreds of resumes; AI now quickly finds candidates who match all the essential qualifications, experience, and skills. This means recruitment teams can focus more on building relationships with potential hires instead of repetitive administrative work. Moonhub, which has support from investors such as Day One Ventures, Alphabet’s GV, Khosla Ventures, TIME Ventures, and Susan Wojcicki, uses advanced machine learning to help companies find exceptional candidates who might otherwise go unnoticed. The platform explores sources like GitHub, StackOverflow, and LinkedIn to find and shortlist applicants within minutes. Automated assessments further filter these candidates so that human recruiters can focus on evaluating the best options. According to Xu, Moonhub users typically fill roles twice as fast as through traditional methods. The process starts with AI gathering and analyzing data from various online platforms. It then presents a targeted list of candidates, which recruiters can assess in depth. Blending AI’s efficiency with human judgment streamlines hiring and enhances candidate selection. Day One Ventures’ Masha Bucher praises Moonhub’s effectiveness in delivering qualified candidates rapidly, saving employers valuable time. The platform also fosters a smooth candidate experience—valuing communication and personalization—which strengthens the employer’s reputation and helps attract outstanding talent. Moonhub’s AI also helps minimize hiring bias by focusing on data-driven decisions. Xu encourages recruiters to welcome AI as a collaborator that tackles repetitive chores, leaving humans to handle nuanced, people-centered work. While AI accelerates sourcing and pre-screening, the final decisions and relationship building remain crucially human. In summary, Moonhub showcases how AI can enhance recruitment, making hiring fairer, quicker, and smarter while ensuring that human expertise stays central to the process.

Werwers hoef nie meer deur honderde CV's te blaai nie; KI vind nou vinnig kandidate wat aan alle vereiste kwalifikasies, ervaring en vaardighede voldoen. Dit stel werwing-spanne in staat om op verhoudingsbou met potensiële aanstellings te fokus eerder as op herhalende administratiewe take. Moonhub, met ondersteuning van beleggers soos Day One Ventures, Alphabet se GV, Khosla Ventures, TIME Ventures en Susan Wojcicki, gebruik gevorderde masjienleer om firmas te help om uitstaande kandidate te ontdek wat tradisioneel miskyk kon word. article_content:
Algeria announced that Niger has accepted its offer to help mediate Niger’s current political crisis. This move follows Algeria’s previous proposal, made five weeks earlier, which recommended a six-month transition under civilian leadership.

The turmoil in Niger began on July 26, 2023, when the presidential guard detained President Mohamed Bazoum, and General Abdourahamane Tchiani assumed control by leading a new military junta. In reaction, ECOWAS, the West African regional bloc, has stated it could send troops to Niger if peaceful negotiation efforts do not succeed.

During August, Algeria’s Foreign Minister Ahmed Attaf engaged repeatedly with Niger’s military leaders, suggesting a way to restore constitutional order. Algeria also promised guarantees for all stakeholders and considered holding a Sahel development conference, though specifics have not been detailed.

Algeria’s foreign ministry, through a nationally televised statement, confirmed that Niger officially accepted President Abdelmadjid Tebboune’s mediation initiative. So far, leaders of Niger’s ruling junta have not commented publicly on the development.

Algerië het aangekondig dat Niger hul aanbod aanvaar het om in die land se huidige politieke krisis te bemiddel. Dit volg op Algerië se voorstel, vyf weke gelede, om 'n ses-maande oorgang onder burgerlike bestuur aan te stel.

Die krisis in Niger het op 26 Julie 2023 begin toe die presidensiële wag President Mohamed Bazoum in hegtenis geneem het, en generaal Abdourahamane Tchiani beheer oorgeneem het as hoof van 'n nuwe militêre junta. As reaksie het ECOWAS, die Wes-Afrikaanse streekblok, gesê hulle oorweeg dit om troepe te stuur as diplomatieke onderhandelinge misluk.

In Augustus het Ahmed Attaf, Algerië se minister van buitelandse sake, verskeie gesprekke met Niger se militêre leiers gehou en 'n plan voorgestel om die grondwetlike orde te herstel. Algerië het ook sekuriteit waarborge aan alle partye aangebied en voorgestel om 'n konferensie oor ontwikkeling in die Sahel aan te bied, maar besonderhede is nog onbekend.

Volgens 'n verklaring van die Algeriese buitelandse ministerie wat op nasionale TV voorgelees is, het Niger nou amptelik aan President Abdelmadjid Tebboune se bemiddelingsinisiatief ingestem. Niger se militêre junta het nog nie 'n openbare reaksie hierop gegee nie.

article_content: Actress Naomi Watts surprised the public when she revealed feeling that Princess Diana had given her spiritual 'permission' to portray her on screen. She is not alone in this belief that Diana communicates from beyond the grave. Ken and Jo Dobson, who call themselves 'Britain's biggest Diana fanatics,' claim to have experienced clear signals and even sightings of Diana’s spirit. The Gloucestershire couple first became captivated by Diana when she became engaged to Prince Charles in 1981. Since then, they have devoted their lives to preserving her memory, collecting Diana memorabilia worth thousands of pounds. Jo Dobson, 74, explained: 'We’ve loved Diana from day one. There was just something about her that was captivating.' After Diana’s tragic death in Paris in 1997, Jo and Ken formalized their dedication by co-founding the 'Diana Circle UK' with six others, vowing to keep Diana’s memory alive after gathering outside Kensington Palace. Their home is filled with Diana photographs, sketches, plates, and dolls—so much so that they are considering an extension or even setting up a tent to accommodate their collection. They estimate their collection to be worth a five-figure sum but insist they will never sell anything. 'We're not interested in money. We just keep collecting,' said Ken, 76. The couple regularly speaks with Diana’s former butler, Paul Burrell, and maintain strong beliefs about Diana’s death, convinced it was murder. Ken, who recently lost his sight, feels Diana’s spirit has supported him during his hospitalization. Both spiritualists, Ken and Jo believe they share a bond with Diana. Among the signs they report are white feathers, a special candle that extinguished as Diana’s body was returned to Althorp, and red blotches that appear on a rose bush near the anniversary of her death. Jo recalls a remarkable experience: during Christmas at her sister’s house, she saw Diana’s face appear on the tree-top fairy, smiling before slowly fading away. 'We believe what we saw, even if others doubt us,' Jo affirms. While aiming to honor Diana’s legacy, the Dobsons are upset by the recently released 'Diana' film, feeling it disrespects her memory. Jo stated: 'I think this movie is disgraceful. Even after 16 years, Diana can’t rest. It’s damaging her reputation.' With the closure of the official Diana museum, Ken and Jo hope to inspire the next generation to keep the memory of the 'People’s Princess' alive through the Diana Circle UK.
translated_content: Aktrise Naomi Watts het die publiek verras toe sy onthul het sy voel Prinses Diana het haar geestelike 'toestemming' gegee om haar op die skerm uit te beeld. Sy is nie alleen in die geloof dat Diana van die hiernamaals af kommunikeer nie. Ken en Jo Dobson, wat hulself 'Britain se grootste Diana-aanhangers' noem, beweer hulle het duidelike tekens en selfs waarnemings van Diana se gees ervaar. Die Gloucestershire-egpaar het vir die eerste keer in 1981 van Diana bewus geraak toe sy met Prins Charles verloof geraak het. Sedertdien het hulle hul lewens gewy om haar nagedagtenis te bewaar en het Diana-versamelstukke ter waarde van duisende pond bymekaar gemaak. Jo Dobson, 74, het verduidelik: 'Ons het vir Diana van die eerste dag af liefgehad. Daar was net iets aan haar wat betowerend was.' Na Diana se tragiese dood in Parys in 1997 het Jo en Ken hul toewyding geformaliseer deur saam met ses ander die 'Diana Circle UK' te stig, met die doel om Diana se nagedagtenis lewendig te hou ná hul samekoms buite Kensington Palace. Hul huis is vol foto's, sketse, borde en poppe van Diana — so vol dat hulle oorweeg om 'n uitbreiding aan te bou of selfs 'n tent op te sit vir hul versameling. Hulle skat hul versameling is 'n vyfsyferbedrag werd, maar dring daarop aan dat hulle nooit enigiets sal verkoop nie. 'Ons stel nie in geld belang nie. Ons bly net versamel,' sê Ken, 76. Die paartjie praat gereeld met Diana se voormalige butler, Paul Burrell, en glo vas in hul oortuiging oor Diana se dood — hulle glo sy is vermoor. Ken, wat onlangs sy sig verloor het, voel Diana se gees het hom tydens sy hospitalisasie ondersteun. Albei is spiritiste en glo hulle het 'n band met Diana. Tekens wat hulle ervaar, sluit in wit vere, 'n spesiale kers wat doodgeblaas het toe Diana se liggaam teruggebring is na Althorp, en rooi kolle wat op 'n roosbos verskyn rondom die herdenking van haar dood. Jo onthou 'n merkwaardige ervaring: tydens Kersfees by haar suster het sy Diana se gesig bo-op die kersboom se feë gesien, glimlaggend voor dit stadigweg verdwyn het. 'Ons glo wat ons gesien het, al twyfel ander,' sê Jo. Hoewel hulle poog om Diana se nalatenskap te eer, is die Dobsons ontsteld oor die onlangse rolprent 'Diana' en voel dit respekteer nie haar nagedagtenis nie. Jo het gesê: 'Ek dink hierdie fliek is skandelik. Selfs na 16 jaar kan Diana nie rus nie. Dit beskadig haar reputasie.' Met die sluiting van die amptelike Diana-museum hoop Ken en Jo om die volgende generasie te inspireer om die herinnering aan die 'People's Princess' lewendig te hou deur die Diana Circle UK.

article_content: The United Nations refugee agency reports that at least 114 million people worldwide had been forced to flee their homes by the end of September, mainly due to conflict, persecution, and human rights violations. Major drivers behind this alarming figure include the war in Ukraine and ongoing conflicts in Sudan, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Myanmar, as well as drought, floods, and insecurity in Somalia, and the protracted humanitarian crisis in Afghanistan. Filippo Grandi, the UN High Commissioner for Refugees, expressed deep concern, stating, “Globally, far too many conflicts are proliferating or escalating, shattering innocent lives and uprooting people.” He highlighted the international community’s inability to resolve or prevent conflicts, leading to widespread displacement and suffering. As of June 2023, the number of forcibly displaced individuals stood at 110 million, marking a 1.6 million increase from the end of 2022. An additional four million were estimated to have been displaced between June and September, bringing the total to 114 million. Importantly, the UNHCR’s report does not include the displacement resulting from the Israel-Palestine conflict that began on October 7, as it falls outside the report’s scope. The report also revealed that low- and middle-income countries are bearing the burden of hosting three-quarters of all people in need of international protection. Despite overwhelming challenges, High Commissioner Grandi remains resolute: “As we watch events unfold in Gaza, Sudan, and beyond, the prospect of peace and solutions for refugees and other displaced populations might feel distant. But we cannot give up. With our partners, we will keep pushing for—and finding—solutions for refugees.” The release of this report coincides with the upcoming second Global Refugee Forum, scheduled for December 13 to 15 in Geneva, which will bring together governments, refugees, local authorities, international organizations, civil society, and the private sector to focus on refugee and displacement issues.
translated_content: Die Verenigde Nasies se vlugtelingagentskap berig dat minstens 114 miljoen mense wêreldwyd teen einde September gedwing is om hul huise te verlaat, hoofsaaklik weens konflik, vervolging en menseregtevergrype. Belangrike drywers agter hierdie ontstellende syfer sluit in die oorlog in Oekraïne, voortgesette konflikte in Soedan, die Demokratiese Republiek van die Kongo, Mianmar, asook droogte, vloede en onsekerheid in Somalië, en die langdurige humanitêre krisis in Afghanistan. Filippo Grandi, die VN se Hoë Kommissaris vir Vlugtelinge, het sy ernstige kommer uitgespreek en gesê: “Wêreldwyd neem te veel konflikte toe of verskerp, en dit ruk onskuldige lewens uitmekaar en verdryf mense van hul huise.” Hy het beklemtoon die internasionale gemeenskap se onvermoë om konflikte op te los of nuwe te voorkom, lei tot wydverspreide verplasing en lyding. Teen Junie 2023 het die aantal gedwonge verplaasde individue op 110 miljoen gestaan, wat 'n toename van 1.6 miljoen sedert die einde van 2022 toon. Nog vier miljoen is volgens beraming tussen Junie en September verplaas, wat die totaal op 114 miljoen bring. Belangrik is dat die UNHCR-verslag nie die verskuiwing weens die Israel-Palestina-konflik, wat op 7 Oktober begin het, insluit nie, aangesien dit buite die verslag se bestek val. Die verslag toon ook dat lae- en middelinkomsteland hul die grootste las dra deur driekwart van alle mense wat internasionale beskerming benodig, te huisves. Ten spyte van die oorweldigende uitdagings bly Hoë Kommissaris Grandi vasberade: “Soos ons gebeure in Gasa, Soedan en elders volg, mag die vooruitsig van vrede en oplossings vir vlugtelinge en ander verplaasde groepe ver weg lyk. Maar ons mag nie moed opgee nie. Saam met ons vennote sal ons voortgaan om oplossings vir vlugtelinge te soek—en te vind.” Hierdie verslag verskyn saam met die komende tweede Globale Vlugtelingforum, geskeduleer vir 13 tot 15 Desember in Genève, waar regerings, vlugtelinge, plaaslike owerhede, internasionale organisasies, burgerlike samelewing en die private sektor bymekaar kom om op vlugteling- en verplasingskwessies te fokus.

article_content: The United Kingdom might not appear the most obvious leader in renewable energy, given its limited sunlight, space for wind farms, and absence of large rivers. However, the UK has thousands of miles of coastline with powerful tidal flows. Energy companies in Scotland and Wales are taking advantage of this by developing underwater turbines that harness predictable tidal energy, which is invisible and can generate as much electricity as traditional wind turbines. A test project in the Pentland Firth, a fast-moving marine area in northern Scotland, could eventually power up to 400,000 Scottish homes, according to a government-supported program. 'The demonstration array currently consists of four turbines with a capacity of 6MW. We hope this sparks further investment,' MeyGen CEO Dan Pearson told CNN. Construction was scheduled for completion in 2016. Because seawater is 832 times denser than air, these turbines can be relatively small while producing as much energy as wind turbines. The strong tidal currents also allow turbines to be spaced more closely, using less seabed than wind farms on land. Unlike wind or solar farms, which are affected by the weather, tidal turbines tap into a steady, reliable energy source that changes with the tides twice each day. Pearson noted, 'We can forecast the energy output years in advance because tidal patterns are so regular.' The turbine stands will be placed 525 feet (160 meters) apart and anchored to the seabed with scrap metal. With a water depth of about 130 feet (40 meters), small vessels in the area will have about 8 meters of clearance over the turbines. The design keeps most electrical equipment onshore for easier maintenance. Technological challenges like corrosion and maintenance have largely been addressed using techniques from naval engineering and subsea construction. For example, solutions from ship propellers and structures like oil rigs help ensure durability. Concerns about marine life have been managed through extensive monitoring and input from organizations like Scottish Natural Heritage and the Royal Society for the Protection of Birds. Turbines turn slowly, at about 12–18 RPM, giving sea creatures like seals, whales, and dolphins time to avoid them. Monitors have tracked local wildlife for five years, setting a clear baseline for studying the impact. Studies indicate most marine life avoids areas with strong tidal surges, and during slack tides—when the blades aren't turning—animals may approach the turbines without risk. Pearson concluded, 'We’re confident in the technology’s safety for wildlife, even as we remain vigilant.' Future expansion looks promising, with potential tidal capacity around Scotland estimated at 1.2 GW—more than double that of an average nuclear plant. Pearson also sees opportunities for the UK to become a global leader in developing and manufacturing tidal turbines, which could benefit economically disadvantaged coastal regions.
translated_content: Die Verenigde Koninkryk mag dalk nie as die mees voor die hand liggende keuse vir hernubare energie beskou word nie, met beperkte sonlig, min ruimte vir windplase en geen groot riviere nie. Maar die VK het duisende kilometers kuslyn met sterk getygolwe. Energie-maatskappye in Skotland en Wallis benut hierdie voordeel deur onderwaterturbines te ontwikkel wat op voorspelbare gety-energie werk. Hierdie turbines is onsigbaar en kan soveel elektrisiteit soos tradisionele windturbines opwek. 'n Toetsprojek in die Pentland Firth, 'n vinnigbewegende seestreek in Noord-Skotland, kan uiteindelik tot 400 000 Skotse huishoudings van elektrisiteit voorsien, volgens 'n regeringsgesteunde program. 'Die demonstrasiereeks is tans vier turbines met 'n kapasiteit van 6MW. Ons hoop dit lei tot verdere beleggings,' sê MeyGen se HUB, Dan Pearson, aan CNN. Konstruksie moes in 2016 voltooi wees. Omdat seewater 832 keer digter is as lug, kan hierdie turbines kleiner wees, terwyl dit steeds dieselfde hoeveelheid energie as windturbines opwek. Die sterk getyestrome laat toe dat turbines nader aan mekaar geplaas kan word, wat minder seebodem benodig as windplase op land. Anders as wind- of sonkrag, wat afhanklik is van die weer, gebruik gety-turbines 'n konstant, betroubare bron wat twee keer per dag saam met die gety verander. Pearson het gesê: 'Ons kan die energie-uitset vir jare vooruit voorspel omdat getypatrone so gereeld is.' Die turbine-standaarde sal 160 meter van mekaar geplaas en met skrootmetaal aan die seebodem vasgemaak word. Met 'n waterdiepte van ongeveer 40 meter sal kleiner bote in die area sowat 8 meter se vrye speling bo die turbines hê. Die ontwerp plaas meeste van die elektriese toerusting aan wal vir maklike instandhouding. Tegnologiese uitdagings soos korrosie en instandhouding is oorkom met tegnieke uit skeepsbou en onderwaterkonstruksie. Byvoorbeeld, oplossings uit skeepsskroewe en olieplatforms help met die tegnologie se duursaamheid. Bekommernisse oor seelewe is aangespreek deur intensiewe monitering en vennootskappe met Scottish Natural Heritage en die Royal Society for the Protection of Birds. Die turbines draai stadig—teen sowat 12–18 RPM—sodat robbe, walvisse en dolfyne dit maklik kan vermy. Monitors spoor plaaslike wildlewe al vyf jaar op, wat 'n goeie basislyn gee om impak te beoordeel. Studie toon meeste seelewe vermy gebiede met vinnige getyestrome, en tydens stilgetye, wanneer die lemme nie draai nie, beweeg diere soms naby sonder risiko. Pearson sluit af: 'Ons is baie vol vertroue in die tegnologie se veiligheid vir die natuurlewe, maar hou steeds goed dop.' Uitbreiding lyk belowend: Skotland se gety-energie kan tot 1,2 GW beloop—dubbel dié van ‘n tipiese kernkragstasie. Pearson meen die VK kan ‘n wêreldleier in die ontwikkeling en vervaardiging van gety-turbines word, wat armer kusgebiede ekonomies kan bevoordeel.

article_content: At least 24 people have died in Gujarat, India due to severe lightning, intense rain, and hailstorms, according to officials. The unusual weather for this time of year damaged homes and killed livestock across the western state, catching many residents off guard. Meteorologists note that such storms are rare during the winter, and the fierce rainfall led to flash floods. Lightning strikes accounted for 18 of the 24 fatalities, as detailed in an official statement released late Sunday. Heavy rain and hailstorms battered Gujarat on Sunday and Monday, with some areas experiencing up to 144mm (5.7 inches) of rain within 24 hours, according to state government data reported by Reuters. Manorama Mohanty, head of the Indian Meteorological Department in Ahmedabad, said the incident was caused by the collision of three weather systems: easterly winds from the Arabian Sea, a Western Disturbance over the Western Himalayas, and a Cyclonic Circulation over South Gujarat. Meteorologists and scientists are warning that climate change, particularly rising land and sea temperatures, is increasing the frequency and intensity of extreme weather events like these. India faces thousands of lightning and flash flood deaths each year. Official data shows that lightning killed more than 100,000 people in India between 1967 and 2019, accounting for over a third of deaths from natural hazards during that time. However, recent improvements in lightning forecasting and early warning systems have helped reduce fatalities even as lightning strikes increase; over 18 million lightning events were recorded between April 2020 and March 2021, a 34% rise from the previous year as reported by the Climate Resilient Observing Systems Promotion Council. The human toll was highlighted by the story of Yogesh Patel, a 42-year-old farmer who died after being struck by lightning while sheltering under a tree on his farm. According to his family friend Shantilal Patel, his mobile phone appeared to have exploded in his shirt pocket due to the strike. India's Home Minister Amit Shah expressed his condolences, stating he was 'deeply saddened' by the loss of life and confirming that local authorities are providing relief. Weather forecasts indicate that rain and hailstorms are expected to continue in western India.
translated_content: Minstens 24 mense is in Gujarat, Indië, dood as gevolg van swaar weerlig, intense reën en haelstorms, volgens owerhede. Die ongewone weer vir hierdie tyd van die jaar het huise beskadig en vee laat vrek oor die weste van die staat, wat baie inwoners onkant betrap het. Weervoorspellers sê sulke storms is skaars in die winter, en die hewige reënval het vloed veroorsaak. Weerlig het 18 van die 24 sterftes veroorsaak, soos in 'n amptelike verklaring laat Sondag uiteengesit is. Swaar reën en haelstorms het Gujarat op Sondag en Maandag geteister, met sommige gebiede wat tot 144 mm (5,7 duim) reën binne 24 uur ontvang het, volgens staatsregeringsdata wat deur Reuters gerapporteer is. Manorama Mohanty, hoof van die Indiese Meteorologiese Departement in Ahmedabad, het gesê die voorval is veroorsaak deur die botsing van drie weersisteme: oostelike winde uit die Arabiese See, 'n Westelike Verstoring oor die Westelike Himalajas, en 'n Sikliese Sirkulasie oor Suid-Gujarat. Weervoorspellers en wetenskaplikes waarsku dat klimaatsverandering, veral stygende land- en seetemperatuur, die frekwensie en intensiteit van uiterste weerstoestande soos hierdie verhoog. Indië staar elke jaar duisende sterftes as gevolg van weerlig en vloede in die gesig. Amptelike data toon dat weerlig meer as 100 000 mense in Indië tussen 1967 en 2019 doodgemaak het, wat meer as 'n derde van die sterftes as gevolg van natuurlike gevare gedurende daardie tydperk uitmaak. Verbeterings in weerligvoorspelling en vroeë waarskuwingstelsels het egter onlangs gehelp om sterftes te verminder, selfs al neem weerligtreffers toe; meer as 18 miljoen weerligvoorvalle is tussen April 2020 en Maart 2021 aangeteken - 'n styging van 34% van die vorige jaar volgens die Climate Resilient Observing Systems Promotion Council. Die menslike impak word beklemtoon deur die verhaal van Yogesh Patel, 'n 42-jarige boer wat dood is nadat hy deur weerlig getref is terwyl hy onder 'n boom op sy plaas geskuil het. Volgens sy familievriend Shantilal Patel het sy selfoon blykbaar in sy hemp se borssak ontplof as gevolg van die slag. Indië se Minister van Binnelandse Sake, Amit Shah, het sy meegevoel betuig en gesê hy is 'diep bedroef' oor die lewensverlies, en het bevestig dat plaaslike owerhede steun verleen. Weervoorspellings dui daarop dat reën en haelstorms in die weste van Indië kan voortduur.

article_content: Matt Lauer, the longtime co-host of NBC's Today show, is reportedly upset following the departure of executive producer Jim Bell, who is being replaced by Alexandra Wallace, according to sources cited by RadarOnline. Lauer is said to have had a poor working relationship with Wallace, a known supporter of ousted co-host Ann Curry. Jim Bell, who had led the Today show since 2005, is set to become the full-time executive producer for NBC’s Olympic coverage. Alexandra Wallace, who has worked with both NBC and CBS, is expected to take over as executive producer. Reports suggest Wallace plans to broaden the range of expert commentators on the show. The Today show, once dominant in morning television, has recently slipped in the ratings, falling behind ABC's Good Morning America. Ann Curry’s emotional on-air departure in June 2012 was criticized by viewers and was widely reported to have been influenced by Lauer, though Bell publicly accepted responsibility for the decision. NBC also faced backlash for airing an interview with Kris Jenner instead of observing a moment of silence on the 11th anniversary of the September 11 attacks—a decision overseen by Bell. NBC has not yet formally commented on the change in executive producers. Wallace will be the first woman to serve as executive producer of the Today show, at least on an interim basis, while NBC searches for a permanent replacement. Internal tensions and a lack of viewer confidence have been cited as challenges for the show. Meanwhile, Lauer has recognized ratings declines and taken public responsibility in interviews, though reports suggest he has increased control over set decisions.

article_content: A painting stolen from a New York art gallery 60 years ago has been discovered 3,000 miles away in the village of Mawdesley, Lancashire. Art conservationists are celebrating after 'Flower Market Madeline' by Edouard Léon Cortès resurfaced. Art Recovery International was notified when a Lancashire art dealer offered the painting for sale online. The piece was originally displayed at the Herbert Arnot Gallery in New York. It was one of roughly 3,000 works stolen over a 12-year period in the 1950s and 1960s by former gallery manager Louis Edelman. Edelman was arrested by the FBI in Chicago during the 1960s and convicted for transporting stolen artwork across state lines. He received a two-year prison sentence and a $10,000 fine, but most of the stolen paintings remain missing. 'Flower Market Madeline', depicting a flower market in Cortès' signature street scene style, was purchased in November 2022 by Carnes Fine Art from the Manchester-based Capes Dunn auction house. Bradley Carnes, director of Carnes Fine Art, said he paid more than £10,000 for the painting, and was shocked when Art Recovery International contacted him after he listed it for sale on his website. He explained: 'I always check for provenance—gallery labels, certificates, receipts—to ensure the authenticity of a painting, but you rarely think about stolen works. At first, I thought the message was a scam, but a quick Google search confirmed the contact was from the head of Art Recovery International. We worked together to ensure the painting was returned to its rightful owner in New York.' Mr Carnes was reimbursed for the painting. Christopher Marinello, lawyer and founder of Art Recovery International, spent several months tracing the painting's ownership. He discovered it had been consigned to Capes Dunn in 2022 by an estate in Cheshire, which said it was acquired from the MacConnal-Mason Gallery in London. Marinello expressed gratitude to Bradley Carnes, Capes Dunn, and the vendor for returning the stolen painting without conditions to the Arnot Gallery. He added: 'While we were able to convince all involved parties to reimburse one another, there will be cases where some people are not so fortunate. I cannot stress enough the importance of due diligence and authentication checks, which could have uncovered the theft decades ago.' Marinello urged buyers and sellers of works by Edouard Léon Cortès to contact the Arnot Gallery for authentication. 'We continue to recover one or two paintings per year from this 60-year-old theft, and we will not stop until every last one is returned,' he said. article_content: U.S. health officials are warning that a commonly used drug to treat gonorrhea has become ineffective, leaving only one remaining treatment option against one of America’s most widespread sexually transmitted diseases. According to a new report from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), the bacteria that cause gonorrhea (Neisseria gonorrhoeae) have developed resistance to multiple antibiotics. This announcement echoes previous warnings from the World Health Organization (WHO), which recently raised concerns that a major treatment for gonorrhea is no longer working. Each year, an estimated 700,000 cases of gonorrhea occur in the U.S., contributing to approximately 106 million cases globally. In the U.S., the disease is most prevalent among African Americans, teenagers, and young adults. Since 2007, the CDC has recommended the oral antibiotic cefixime (brand name Suprax) as the first line of defense against gonorrhea. Now, however, the CDC no longer considers cefixime effective enough for treatment. The agency is reviewing alternative treatments but notes that research and development for new gonorrhea drugs faces significant challenges. With cefixime no longer advised, only one recommended treatment remains: ceftriaxone, an injectable antibiotic. Gonorrhea, also known as ‘The Clap,’ is caused by Neisseria gonorrhoeae and is primarily transmitted through sexual contact, although it can be passed from an untreated mother to her baby during childbirth. The infection commonly grows in warm, moist areas of the reproductive tract, including the cervix, uterus, and fallopian tubes in women, and the urethra in both men and women. Many women experience no symptoms; men may notice burning during urination or unusual discharge. Untreated gonorrhea can lead to infertility and chronic pelvic pain. Most cases can be diagnosed with a simple urine test. The reliance on injectable treatment could be problematic since ceftriaxone is often not stocked in typical doctor’s offices and is generally available only in specialized STD clinics. Additionally, patients tend to prefer oral medications, possibly making them less likely to seek out the necessary injections. Health officials worry that, with only one effective treatment remaining, resistance to ceftriaxone may soon develop. Dr. Manjula Lusti-Narasimhan from WHO’s Department of Reproductive Health and Research described gonorrhea as a major public health challenge, given its prevalence and the diminishing treatment options. She cautioned that inadequate surveillance could mask the true extent of drug resistance and that, without new antibiotics, future patients could be left without an effective cure. The CDC and National Institutes of Health are continuing to evaluate new treatment approaches, but developing new drugs for gonorrhea remains a difficult challenge for pharmaceutical companies.

Volgens ’n nuwe verslag van die Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) het die bakterieë wat gonorree veroorsaak (Neisseria gonorrhoeae) weerstand ontwikkel teen verskeie antibiotika. Hierdie aankondiging eggo vorige waarskuwings van die Wêreldgesondheidsorganisasie (WGO), wat onlangs kommer uitgespreek het dat ’n belangrike behandeling vir gonorree nie meer werk nie. Jaarliks kom omtrent 700 000 gevalle van gonorree in die VSA voor, wat bydra tot sowat 106 miljoen gevalle wêreldwyd. In die VSA kom die siekte die meeste voor onder Afro-Amerikaners, tieners en jong volwassenes. Sedert 2007 het die CDC die orale antibiotika cefixime (handelsnaam Suprax) aanbeveel as eerste behandelingskeuse teen gonorree. Nou beskou die CDC egter nie meer cefixime as doeltreffend genoeg vir behandeling nie. Die agentskap hersien alternatiewe behandelings, maar waarsku dat navorsing en ontwikkeling van nuwe middels ernstige uitdagings inhou. Met cefixime wat nie meer aanbeveel word nie, bly slegs een behandeling oor: ceftriaxone, ’n inspuitbare antibiotika. Gonorree, ook bekend as ‘The Clap’, word veroorsaak deur Neisseria gonorrhoeae en word hoofsaaklik seksueel oorgedra, maar kan ook van ’n onbehandelde ma na haar baba tydens geboorte oorgedra word. Die infeksie floreer in warm, klam areas van die voortplantingstelsel, insluitend die serviks, uterus en fallopiese buise by vroue, en die uretra by beide mans en vroue. Meeste gevalle kan met ’n eenvoudige urinetoets gediagnoseer word. Verder verkies pasiënte dikwels pille, wat hulle moontlik minder geneig maak om die inspuiting te ontvang. Gesondheidsamptenare is bekommerd dat weerstand teen ceftriaxone kan ontwikkel aangesien dit nou die enigste effektiewe behandeling is. Dr Manjula Lusti-Narasimhan van WGO se Departement van Voortplantingsgesondheid en Navorsing beskryf gonorree as ’n groot openbaregesondheidsuitdaging, gegewe die hoë voorkoms en afnemende behandelingsopsies. Sy waarsku dat onvoldoende toesig die ware omvang van geneesmiddelweerstandigheid kan verbloem, en dat daar sonder nuwe antibiotika moontlik binnekort geen effektiewe genesing vir pasiënte sal wees nie. Die CDC en National Institutes of Health evalueer steeds nuwe behandelingsmetodes, maar die ontwikkeling van nuwe middels teen gonorree bly ’n uitdaging vir farmaseutiese maatskappye.

article_content: Jerusalem (CNN) -- Facebook has removed a controversial page called the 'Third Palestinian Intifada', following Israeli government complaints that it promoted violence against Jews. According to a Facebook statement, the group page—which had gained over 350,000 'likes' in the past month—was taken down because it included direct calls for violence. Initially, the page started as a call for peaceful protest, despite using a term associated with violence, and administrators removed violent comments. However, as the page gained publicity, more comments escalated to direct calls for violence, and eventually, the administrators themselves participated. After repeated warnings to the page administrators about violating Facebook policies, the page was removed. Facebook stated it supports free expression but will take down pages that degrade into hate speech or direct incitement to violence. Since the removal, several similar pages have appeared, some with similar messages. The Israeli government and pro-Israel groups criticized Facebook, accusing it of not enforcing its own terms of service, which prohibit hateful, threatening, or violent content. Yuli Edelstein, Israel's minister of public diplomacy and diaspora affairs, said the removal showed that the page abused freedom of speech to incite violence. The Anti-Defamation League praised Facebook’s decision. Abraham H. Foxman, the group's national director, said it sets an important standard for addressing incitement online. Foxman added that he hopes Facebook will continue to monitor for groups calling for violence or terrorism. Edelstein wrote to Facebook founder Mark Zuckerberg last week, warning about content on the page that promoted violence against Israelis and Jews, and the 'liberation' of Jerusalem and Palestine through violent acts. Edelstein's office stated it was satisfied with Facebook’s actions in monitoring and removing objectionable content. The page was created in early March by unidentified activists who called for a third intifada to begin on May 15, known to Palestinians as Nakba Day, marking the displacement of hundreds of thousands of Palestinians in 1948 when Israel was established. The term 'intifada', meaning 'shaking off', is commonly used for Palestinian uprisings, with previous intifadas beginning in 1987 and 2000. Violence during the second intifada resulted in thousands of deaths. The activists said the purpose of the page was to liberate Palestine and fight injustice, division, and corruption, inspired by protest movements in Tunisia, Egypt, and Libya. In a March 24 post, the administrators claimed peaceful intentions and commitment to free expression, arguing that their page was being unfairly singled out when similar content exists elsewhere. They also threatened a mass Muslim boycott of Facebook if the page was removed.

Yuli Edelstein, Israel se minister van openbare diplomatie en diasporasake, het gesê die verwydering bewys die bladsy het vryheid van spraak misbruik om tot geweld aan te hits. Die Anti-Defamation League het Facebook se besluit geprys. Abraham H. Foxman, die nasionale direkteur, het gesê dit stel 'n belangrike standaard vir die hantering van aanhitsing aanlyn. Edelstein se kantoor het gesê hulle is tevrede met Facebook se optrede om aanstootlike inhoud te monitor en te verwyder. Die bladsy is vroeg in Maart deur onbekende aktiviste geskep wat op 15 Mei 'n derde intifada wou begin, wat onder Palestyne as Nakba-dag bekend staan—'n herdenking van die verplasing van honderde duisende Palestyne toe Israel in 1948 gestig is. Die term 'intifada', wat letterlik 'afskud' beteken, verwys na Palestynse opstande; vorige intifadas het in 1987 en 2000 begin. Geweld tydens die tweede intifada het tot duisende sterftes gelei. Die aktiviste het gesê dat die bladsy se doel was om Palestina te bevry en teen onreg, verdeeldheid en korrupsie te veg, geïnspireer deur protesbewegings in Tunisië, Egipte en Libië. In 'n plasing op 24 Maart het die administrateurs verklaar dat hul benadering vreedsaam is en dat hulle toegewy is aan vryheid van spraak. Hulle het ook gesê dit is onregverdig dat hul bladsy uitgesonder word as talle soortgelyke bladsye bestaan. Hulle het 'n massa Moslemboikot van Facebook gedreig as die bladsy verwyder word.

The incident left at least 20 students and one adult injured. Assistant Principal Sam King tackled the suspect, stopping the attack after several terrifying minutes. King's quick action, along with help from a security guard, Assistant Principal Joan Mellon, and school resource officer William 'Buzz' Yakshe, brought the situation under control. Westmoreland County District Attorney John Peck and Police Chief Thomas Seefeld commended the bravery of all four individuals. Community members and students expressed deep admiration for Sam King, praising his caring nature and history of support for students. Many took to social media to share stories and tributes, describing King as a role model and hero. King, who previously served as an elementary school principal, is known for building strong relationships with students, making them feel welcome and valued. His dedication was especially evident during this crisis.

article_content: NEW DELHI: The Election Commission (EC) issued a notice on Tuesday to the president of the Delhi BJP regarding social media posts from the party’s official account that targeted Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) leader and Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal. The AAP had recently approached the poll panel, claiming that two posts from the Delhi BJP’s official social media handle contained morphed images and videos intended to harm Kejriwal’s reputation. The EC has asked the BJP’s Delhi unit to respond to the notice by the night of November 23. The notice was addressed to the president of the Delhi BJP but did not specifically name Virendra Sachdeva. In its notice, the EC reminded the Delhi BJP that parties and candidates should avoid criticism of a rival’s private life if it is not connected to public activities. The panel also stated that criticism should not be based on unverified allegations or distortions. As a national party, the EC said the BJP is expected to verify facts before publishing and sharing content in the public domain.

Die AAP het onlangs die keuringsraad genader en beweer dat twee plasings vanaf die Delhi-BJP se amptelike sosiale media-rekening vervalste beelde en video's bevat wat bedoel is om Kejriwal se reputasie te benadeel. Die VK het die BJP se Delhi-afdeling gevra om teen die aand van 23 November op die kennisgewing te reageer. Die kennisgewing is aan die president van die Delhi-BJP gerig, maar het nie Virendra Sachdeva spesifiek genoem nie. In sy kennisgewing het die VK die Delhi-BJP daaraan herinner dat partye en kandidate kritiek op 'n teenstander se private lewe moet vermy as dit nie met openbare aktiwiteite verband hou nie. Die kommissie het ook gestel dat kritiek nie op onbevestigde beskuldigings of verdraaiings gebaseer moet wees nie. As 'n nasionale party word van die BJP verwag om feite te verifieer voordat dit inhoud in die openbare domein plaas of versprei.

article_content: Australia’s tropical northern rivers remain among the few largely untouched waterways, having so far resisted significant development. However, this could change soon as current studies investigate using these rivers to irrigate agricultural land. New research published in Nature Sustainability reveals that disturbing the upstream water balance can have serious downstream consequences—even hundreds of kilometers away. Using advanced computer modeling, researchers found that developing northern water resources would significantly impact prawn, mud crab, and barramundi fisheries in the Gulf of Carpentaria. These valuable Australian marine species depend on healthy estuaries. Reduced river flows would disrupt mangrove and seagrass habitats, threatening the iconic and endangered largetooth sawfish. Freshwater flowing to the sea is essential for maintaining the productivity of freshwater, estuarine, and marine ecosystems. These complex interactions must be taken into account in any future development assessment. Globally, few rivers still run wild, and their future is uncertain as water demands increase and climate change intensifies. River development assessments often overlook the dependence of downstream estuaries and marine systems on reliable freshwater flows. Few studies have evaluated the downstream costs of upstream development on estuarine and marine ecosystems and fisheries. Australia must learn from the mistakes made in the south, where excessive water extraction for agriculture has caused serious damage. Sound planning for northern development should include careful evaluation of dam and irrigation schemes, considering not just how much water to take, but when and where, to balance trade-offs. Northern rivers are crucial as some of the last refuges for endangered species such as the largetooth sawfish, which is born in estuaries and spends its youth in freshwater. These flows also support extensive mangrove forests and seagrass beds, and periodic flooding increases food for important fisheries like prawn, barramundi, and mud crab. Additionally, these rivers hold deep cultural significance for Aboriginal communities, providing food and supporting local livelihoods. Researchers modeled scenarios by combining CSIRO’s river models with tailored ecosystem models to study how altering river flows affects downstream ecology and fishery yields. By analyzing fishery data and previous research, they tracked how natural changes in river flows have influenced catch rates for key species, and used this to predict future changes under various water resource development scenarios. For mud crabs specifically, the team linked river flow and climate drivers to their life cycle, showing that changes in flow explain variations in crab catch, particularly in rivers with seasonally variable flow. This model helps predict how crab populations might respond to different water management approaches. Integrating scientific understanding of freshwater and marine ecosystems with catchment planning is essential for sustainable management. Every plan to dam or extract water from these wild rivers must account for environmental and economic impacts, especially in a dry continent already facing the pressures of climate change. Every drop counts. Special thanks are extended to Annie Jarrett, CEO of NPF Industry Pty Ltd, representing Northern Prawn Fishery operators, for her valuable contribution to this research.
translated_content: Australië se tropiese noordelike riviere bly van die min grotendeels onaangeraakte waterweë, en het tot dusver omvangryke ontwikkeling weerstaan. Dit kan egter binnekort verander namate huidige studies ondersoek instel na die gebruik van hierdie riviere om landbougrond te besproei. Nuwe navorsing, gepubliseer in Nature Sustainability, toon dat die versteuring van die waterbalans stroomop ernstige gevolge kan hê stroomaf—selfs honderde kilometers ver. Met behulp van gevorderde rekenaarmodellering het navorsers bevind dat die ontwikkeling van noordelike waterbronne 'n beduidende impak sal hê op garnale-, modderkrap- en barramundi-visserye in die Golf van Carpentaria. Hierdie waardevolle Australiese mariene spesies is afhanklik van gesonde estuariums. Verminderde rivierlope sal mangrove- en seewierhabitate ontwrig, en die ikoniese, bedreigde grootandse-saagvis bedreig. Varswater wat na die see vloei, is noodsaaklik om die produktiwiteit van varswater-, estuarium- en mariene ekosisteme te behou. Hierdie komplekse interaksies moet in ag geneem word in enige toekomstige ontwikkelingsbeplanning. Wêreldwyd bly min riviere nog vrylik vloeiend, en hul toekoms is onseker met groeiende vraag en klimaatsverandering wat toeneem. Ontwikkelingsevaluerings fokus dikwels net op plaaslike gevolge en misken die waardes van konstante varswatervloei na estuariums en die see. Min studies het die afwentelkoste van stroomop-ontwikkeling vir gestrande en mariene ekosisteme en visserye geëvalueer. Australië moet leer uit die foute van die suide, waar oormatige waterontrekking vir landbou ernstige skade veroorsaak het. Beplanning in die noorde moet sorgvuldige evaluasie van dam- en besproeiingskemas insluit—nie net hoeveel water geneem word nie, maar ook wanneer en waar om die regte balans te kry. Noordelike riviere is van die laaste toevlugsoorde vir bedreigde spesies soos die grootandse-saagvis, wat in estuariums gebore word en sy jeug in varswater deurbring. Hierdie vloeie ondersteun ook uitgebreide mangrovewoude en seewierbeddings, en periodieke vloede verhoog kosvoorsiening vir belangrike visserye soos garnale, barramundi en modderkrap. Hierdie riviere het boonop diep kulturele waarde vir Aboriginal gemeenskappe, wat voedsel verskaf en lewensbestaan ondersteun. Navorsers het scenario's gemodelleer deur CSIRO se riviermodelle te kombineer met op maat gemaakte ekosisteemmodelle om te ondersoek hoe veranderinge in rivierlope die stroomaf-ekologie en visseryoeste beïnvloed. Deur visserydata en vorige navorsing te ontleed, is vasgestel hoe natuurlike vloei veranderings vangskoerse vir sleutelspesies beïnvloed het, en dié insigte is gebruik om toekomstige veranderinge onder verskillende waterhulpbron-ontwikkelingscenario's te voorspel. Vir modderkrappe is rivierlope en klimaatsfaktore gekoppel aan hul lewensiklus, wat toon dat vloei-veranderings variasies in krapvangs verduidelik, veral in riviere met seisoenale wisselende vloei. Hierdie model help om te voorspel hoe krappopulasies kan reageer op verskillende waterbestuursbenaderings. Die integrasie van wetenskaplike kennis oor varswater- en mariene ekosisteme met opvangsgebiedbeplanning is noodsaaklik vir volhoubare bestuur. Enige plan om hierdie wilde riviere te demp of varswater te onttrek, moet die omgewings- en ekonomiese impak verreken, veral in 'n droë kontinent wat reeds onder druk is van klimaatsverandering. Elke druppel tel. Spesiale dank aan Annie Jarrett, HUB van NPF Industry Pty Ltd, wat die Noordelike Garnale Vissery-operateurs verteenwoordig, vir haar waardevolle bydrae tot hierdie navorsing.

article_content: La Fête du Rouge is my newest go-to wine, perfect for sipping in summer and just as enjoyable as the weather turns cooler. Produced in Provence—a region I adore—the wine comes from the La Fête collection, founded in 2019 by Donae Burston, a former LVMH executive who worked with renowned brands like Dom Perignon and Ruinart before launching his own label. Since then, he has expanded his range with La Fête du Blanc and, just in time for winter, La Fête du Rouge. The Rouge is a blend of three red grapes—mainly Syrah—aged in stainless steel and concrete tanks, giving it a ruby-red color and a remarkably smooth taste. It features notes of black pepper, cherries, and pomegranate, with minimal tannins. Retailing at $34.99, it offers excellent value, delivering quality that rivals more expensive wines. Donae shares that launching a Provence red was a natural evolution for his brand, aiming to highlight the region’s often-overlooked red wines for American consumers. Provence provides an ideal climate for grape growing, with abundant sunshine, warm days, cool nights, and a variety of terroirs. Although 88% of the region’s vineyards are planted with red grapes, most are traditionally used for rosé. That is changing as local producers focus on high-quality reds. The creation of La Fête du Rouge involved sourcing top base wines from select Provence growers and precisely blending them to achieve the brand’s bright, fruit-forward style. The winemaking team avoided heavy oak aging, instead opting for stainless steel and concrete, a traditional method that softens tannins without adding wood notes. Donae describes the blending process as both scientific and collaborative, involving careful measurement, tasting, and iteration until the wine embodies the La Fête ethos. Through this process, Donae gained new appreciation for Provence’s diverse landscapes and its emerging reputation as a region for more than just rosé. He notes that visiting the area in the off season is rewarding, offering a chance to connect more deeply with local culture at a slower pace.

Sedertdien het hy die reeks uitgebrei met La Fête du Blanc, en nou, net betyds vir die winter, La Fête du Rouge. Die Rouge is ’n mengsel van drie rooidruiwe—hoofsaaklik Syrah—wat in vlekvrye staal- en betontenks verouder word. Hy het ’n pragtige robynrooi kleur en is ongelooflik glad met geure van swartpeper, kersies en ’n tikkie granaat. Met min tanniene en teen ’n prys van $34.99, bied dit goeie waarde en kwaliteit wat met duurder wyne kan meeding. Donae sê die lansering van ’n rooiwyn uit Provence was die natuurlike volgende stap vir sy handelsmerk, en help om die streek se minder bekende rooiwyne vir Amerikaners te beklemtoon. Provence het ’n ideale klimaat vir druiwekweek: baie sonskyn, warm dae, koel nagte en verskillende terroirs. Hoewel 88% van die wingerde met rooidruiwe beplant is, word die meeste vir rosé gebruik—maar dit verander soos produsente meer op topgehalte rooi fokus. Die La Fête du Rouge-span het die beste basiswyne van Provence-kwekers gekies en sorgvuldig gemeng om die helder, vrugtige styl van hul handelsmerk te kry. Hulle het eikehoutring vermy, en verkies om in staal en beton te verouder—’n metode wat tanniene versag sonder oormatige houtsmaak. article_content: The United Nations' main internet governance body is set to hold its next international forum in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia in 2024. There are possibilities that discussions about the future of an open internet may continue in Russia in 2025. Hosting the Internet Governance Forum (IGF) back-to-back in countries noted for strict internet surveillance and censorship could undermine the credibility of the process, according to some advocates. While the UN has yet to make a formal announcement regarding the host countries, Saudi Arabia's Minister of Communications and Information Technology, Abdullah Alswaha, appeared to disclose the news at this year's forum in Tokyo, which began on Sunday, October 8, and concludes tomorrow. In a brief address before the plenary, Alswaha touched on major topics for the IGF, such as generative artificial intelligence and the digital divide. He invited participants to 'continue this dialogue at Riyadh IGF '24,' reiterating this at the conclusion of his remarks and prompting much attendee discussion. Barbora Bukovská, senior director for law and policy at Article 19, a human rights group, expressed serious concerns, stating that Saudi Arabia's human rights record and restrictions on digital freedoms should prevent it from hosting. Bukovská learned of this update from colleagues in Tokyo. A representative of the IGF has confirmed to WIRED that the 2024 conference will take place in Riyadh. In recent years, Saudi authorities have conducted digital surveillance of dissidents and imposed harsh penalties on citizens criticizing the government online. Additionally, the Saudi regime ordered the 2018 killing of journalist Jamal Khashoggi. Freedom House, a pro-democracy nonprofit, assesses that Saudi Arabia maintains one of the world's most restrictive and censored internet environments, similar to Russia.

Om die Internet Governance Forum (IGF) agtereenvolgens in lande bekend vir streng toesig en internet sensuur aan te bied, kan die geloofwaardigheid van die proses ondermyn, volgens sommige advokate. Al het die VN nog nie die gasheerlande amptelik aangekondig nie, het Saoedi-Arabië se minister van kommunikasie en inligtingstegnologie, Abdullah Alswaha, blykbaar die nuus by vanjaar se forum in Tokio laat deurskemer, wat op Sondag 8 Oktober begin het en môre afsluit. In 'n kort toespraak voor die plenum het Alswaha op groot temas vir die IGF gefokus, soos generatiewe kunsmatige intelligensie en die digitale kloof. Hy het deelnemers genooi om die dialoog by 'Riyadh IGF '24' voort te sit, en dit weer aan die einde van sy toespraak beklemtoon, wat heelwat gesprekke onder die deelnemers veroorsaak het. Barbora Bukovská, senior direkteur vir reg en beleid by Article 19, 'n menseregtegroep, het ernstige kommer uitgespreek en gesê Saoedi-Arabië se menseregte rekord en beperkings op digitale vryhede behoort hulle te diskwalifiseer as gasheer.
