article_content: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) has proposed updates to the H-1B visa process, attracting mixed reactions from employers, international students, and professionals. The most notable change is how the H-1B lottery would be conducted: instead of each employer registration counting separately, selections would now be made based on unique individual applicants. The proposal, published on October 23, 2023, is open for a 60-day comment period during which revisions may be considered. One of the more controversial aspects is a narrower definition of which educational degrees qualify for an H-1B specialty occupation. Currently, when the annual H-1B cap of 85,000 (65,000 standard and 20,000 for advanced U.S. degrees) is exceeded, USCIS runs a lottery. For FY 2024, USCIS noted an uptick in registrations, driven by multiple entries for the same person. The proposed system would ensure each unique beneficiary is only entered into the selection process once, regardless of the number of registrations filed on their behalf. If chosen, all employers that registered that candidate would be notified and could submit a petition. To implement this, USCIS would require valid passport details—number, country of issuance, and expiration date—for all applicants, and beneficiaries could then choose among interested employers. Registrants would not be allowed to register someone lacking a passport. Related companies would be prohibited from filing multiple registrations for the same individual, designed to prevent abuse. Employers submitting registrations for unique candidates might benefit, improving chances of hiring preferred workers. However, the number of single-employer registrations has also risen by 66% between 2022 and 2024, highlighting ongoing demand for skilled talent. For international students on F-1 visas, the rule would automatically extend 'cap-gap' employment authorization until April 1, instead of ending on October 1. This aims to reduce interruptions for students awaiting H-1B transitions. USCIS also proposes broadening eligibility for nonprofit research organizations seeking H-1B cap exemptions. The definition would shift from those 'primarily engaged' in research to those for whom research is 'a fundamental activity,' potentially expanding cap-exempt opportunities. Entrepreneurs with a controlling interest in a business could see clarified eligibility for H-1B status, provided their primary duties align with specialty occupation requirements. Initial H-1B approvals for owner-beneficiaries would be limited to 18 months. The rule would formally require petition amendments when an H-1B holder’s workplace moves to an area outside the Labor Condition Application jurisdiction but not when changing locations within the same area. USCIS is also proposing mandatory employer compliance with site visits by the agency. Legal experts point out that upcoming fee rules could have a greater impact than these proposed regulatory changes.
translated_content: Die Amerikaanse Burgerskap- en Immigrasiediens (USCIS) het voorgestelde veranderinge aan die H-1B-visumproses aangekondig, wat gemengde reaksies van werkgewers, internasionale studente en professionele persone uitlok. Die opvallendste verandering is hoe die H-1B-lotto nou gaan werk: in plaas daarvan dat elke werkgewerregistrasie apart tel, sal seleksies nou gebaseer wees op unieke individuele aansoekers. Die voorstel, gepubliseer op 23 Oktober 2023, is oop vir 'n 60-dae kommentaarperiode waartydens hersienings oorweeg kan word. ’n Kontroversiële aspek is die enger definisie van watter kwalifikasies vir ‘n H-1B-spesialiteitsbesetting in aanmerking kom. Tans, wanneer die jaarlikse H-1B-limiet van 85,000 (65,000 standaard en 20,000 vir gevorderde Amerikaanse grade) oorskry word, hou USCIS ’n lotto. Vir die 2024-boekjaar het USCIS ’n styging in registrasies opgemerk, aangedryf deur meervoudige inskrywings vir dieselfde persoon. Die voorgestelde stelsel sal verseker dat elke unieke begunstigde slegs een keer in die keureproses ingaan, ongeag hoeveel registrasies op hul naam ingedien is. As gekies, sal alle werkgewers wat vir daardie kandidaat geregistreer het, in kennis gestel word en ’n petisie kan indien. Om dit toe te pas, sal USCIS geldige paspoortbesonderhede—nommer, uitreikingsland, en vervaldatum—vir alle aansoekers vereis, en begunstigdes kan dan tussen belangstellende werkgewers kies. Registrasie vir 'n persoon sonder paspoort sal nie meer toegelaat wees nie. Verwante maatskappye sal verbied word om meervoudige registrasies vir dieselfde individu in te dien, wat misbruik moet voorkom. Werkgewers wat unieke kandidate registreer kan baat vind, wat die kans verbeter om hul voorkeurkandidate aan te stel. Die aantal enkelwerkgewer-registrasies het egter met 66% gestyg tussen 2022 en 2024, wat die toename in vraag na vaardige talent beklemtoon. Vir internasionale studente op F-1 visums, sal die reël die 'cap-gap'-werksmagtiging outomaties verleng tot 1 April, in plaas van te eindig op 1 Oktober. Dit is gemik daarop om onderbrekings vir studente wat op H-1B-oorplasing wag, te verminder. USCIS stel ook voor om die definisie van nie-winsgewende navorsingsorganisasies wat H-1B-kapvrystelling soek, te verbreed. Die definisie sal verskuif vanaf instansies wat 'hoofsaaklik besig is' met navorsing na dié vir wie dit 'n fundamentele aktiwiteit' is, wat moontlik meer vrystellingsgeleenthede open. Entrepreneurs met 'n beheerbelang in 'n besigheid kan makliker H-1B-status kry, mits hul primêre pligte met spesialiteitsbesetting vereistes ooreenstem. Aanvanklike goedkeurings vir eienaars-begunstigdes sal beperk wees tot 18 maande. Die reël sal amptelik vereis dat petisie-wysigings ingedien word wanneer 'n H-1B-werknemer se werkplek buite die bestaande Arbeidsvoorwaardeaansoek (LCA) jurisdiksie beweeg, maar nie as hulle binne dieselfde gebied oorskakel nie. USCIS stel ook verpligte nakoming van perseelbesoeke voor. Regskenners wys uit dat verwagte fooireëls moontlik 'n groter impak as hierdie voorgestelde regulatoriese veranderinge sal hê.

article_content: India hosted the 2023 ICC Men’s Cricket World Cup, attracting more than 1.25 million fans and setting a new record for attendance at an ICC event. The use of large venues, including the 130,000-capacity Narendra Modi Stadium, contributed to this achievement. Australia secured their sixth title at the conclusion of a tournament marked by huge crowds, even as many fans faced technical issues when booking tickets online. The opening match between England and New Zealand, along with the India-Pakistan encounter, each set new benchmarks for World Cup match attendance. Chris Tetley, Head of Events at the ICC, congratulated fans for their enthusiasm and pointed out cricket’s growing ability to unite people globally. He highlighted the inspiration these events provide for future players and supporters. Beyond the in-stadium numbers, broadcast and digital viewership also reached new heights. For perspective, the 2015 World Cup had about 1,016,420 attendees, while the 2019 edition saw 752,000, making this World Cup notably the most watched and attended to date.

Die gebruik van groot venues, insluitend die Narendra Modi-stadion met sy kapasiteit van 130 000, het tot hierdie prestasie bygedra. Australië het hul sesde titel verower aan die einde van ‘n toernooi wat deur massiewe skares bygewoon is, selfs al het baie aanhangers tegniese probleme ondervind om kaartjies aanlyn te bespreek. article_content: A Hispanic woman in her 30s was found inside a cardboard box near a landfill in Irving, Texas, after allegedly consuming a spiked margarita at a Dallas nightclub. The woman had spent the evening at Angels Grill & Bar in Dallas. According to police, she appeared intoxicated and had difficulty walking through the parking lot after leaving the club. She was last seen with a man she met that night, shortly after her friend left to get her car. When the friend returned five minutes later, both the woman and the man were gone. The woman was later discovered by volunteer workers near the landfill in Irving around 9 a.m. the following morning. She was wearing only a shirt, disoriented, and unable to recall how she arrived there. The woman, who only speaks Spanish, believes her drink at the club may have been drugged. Police suspect she might have been sexually assaulted, although a rape test produced inconclusive results, according to CBSDFW. The man who found her reported that she seemed uninjured, although she had scuff marks on her knees and was without shoes. He said she initially refused help. Officers from the Dallas Police Department continue to investigate the case, including reviewing surveillance footage from cameras near the nightclub. The woman’s identity has not been released to protect her privacy.

Die vrou het die aand by Angels Grill & Bar in Dallas deurgebring. Volgens die polisie het sy gesukkel om te loop toe sy die klub verlaat weens dronkenskap. Sy is laas saam met ‘n man gesien wat sy daardie aand ontmoet het, net nadat haar vriendin die perseel verlaat het om haar motor te gaan haal. article_content: A federal judge has overturned the death sentence of Gary Sampson, who confessed to killing three people during a week-long crime spree. Judge Mark Wolf ruled that Sampson was denied his right to an impartial jury because one juror failed to disclose significant personal trauma during selection, necessitating a new sentencing trial. Sampson, originally from Abington, Massachusetts, admitted to carjacking and murdering two men in Massachusetts before fleeing to New Hampshire, where he killed a third man during a home invasion. The judge's decision has angered victims' families, especially Mike Rizzo, whose son Jonathan was among the victims. Rizzo criticized Judge Wolf’s motives and expressed disappointment at having to possibly repeat the ordeal. The undisclosed information from the juror included experiences of domestic threats and a daughter's incarceration, which Judge Wolf said could affect impartiality. Sampson was the first person to receive the federal death penalty in Massachusetts, a state without its own capital punishment law. He pleaded guilty to the killings of Jonathan Rizzo and Philip McCloskey in Massachusetts and to murdering Robert Whitney in New Hampshire, for which he received a life sentence. U.S. Attorney Carmen Ortiz confirmed Sampson's confessions and stated that prosecutors are reviewing their options, including a possible appeal, and will confer with the victims' families. Some family members are uncertain about enduring another trial. At sentencing, Sampson's defense cited a background of child abuse, mental health disorders, and substance addiction. Former U.S. Attorney Michael Sullivan voiced disappointment with the decision, contending that Sampson deserved the death penalty. This case now puts renewed attention on capital punishment controversies and the long-standing trauma for affected families.
translated_content: ’n Federale regter het die doodsvonnis van Gary Sampson, wat skuld beken het aan die moord op drie mense tydens ’n week lange misdaadtog, opgehef. Regter Mark Wolf het beslis dat Sampson ’n onpartydige jurie ontsê is omdat een jurielid belangrike persoonlike trauma tydens die keuringsproses verswyg het, wat ’n nuwe verhoor regverdig. Sampson, oorspronklik van Abington, Massachusetts, het erken dat hy twee mans in Massachusetts gekaap en vermoor het voordat hy na New Hampshire gevlug het en daar tydens ’n inbraak nog ’n man doodgemaak het. Die regter se besluit het die slagoffers se families woedend gemaak, veral Mike Rizzo, wie se seun Jonathan onder die slagoffers was. Rizzo het Regter Wolf se motiewe gekritiseer en teleurstelling uitgespreek oor die moontlikheid van ’n nuwe verhoor. Die verswygde inligting deur die jurielid sluit in ervarings van huislike dreigemente en ook haar dogter se gevangenisstraf, wat volgens Wolf onpartydigheid kon beïnvloed het. Sampson was die eerste persoon wat die federale doodsvonnis in Massachusetts ontvang het, ’n deelstaat sonder ’n eie doodstrafwet. Hy het skuld beken aan die moorde op Jonathan Rizzo en Philip McCloskey in Massachusetts en aan die moord op Robert Whitney in New Hampshire, waarvoor hy lewenslank gekry het. Amerikaanse prokureur Carmen Ortiz het Sampson se erkennings bevestig en gesê die vervolgers oorweeg hul opsies, insluitend moontlike appèl, en sal met die slagoffers se families vergader. Sommige familielede is nie seker of hulle deur die proses van nog ’n verhoor wil gaan nie. By vonnisoplegging het Sampson se verdediging na sy agtergrond van kinderlike mishandeling, geestesgesondheidsprobleme en middelafhanklikheid verwys. Voormalige Amerikaanse prokureur Michael Sullivan het sy teleurstelling uitgespreek en beweer Sampson verdien die doodstraf. Hierdie saak vestig weer aandag op die kontroversie oor die doodstraf en die voortdurende trauma van families.

article_content: PARIS, France (CNN) — On Friday, a gunman stationed across from a French nursery school in Lyon opened fire on mothers and nannies arriving to pick up children for lunch, slightly injuring eight adults, according to police. Two of the injured were taken to a hospital, while no children were harmed, as confirmed by officials at Ecole Maternelle. Police stated that the shooter, who remains at large, used an air rifle. In response, authorities closed the school and set up a security cordon around it and other schools in the district. In an interview with French radio network RTL, Lyon Mayor Thierre Philip expressed doubt that the school was the gunman's intended target. 'It was pedestrians — especially mothers or nannies collecting children — who were hurt,' he said. CNN’s Sujatha Samy contributed to this report.

Volgens die polisie is agt volwassenes lig beseer. Twee van die beseerdes is na 'n hospitaal geneem, terwyl geen kinders beseer is nie, het amptenare van die Ecole Maternelle bevestig. Die polisie het gesê die skieter, wat steeds op vrye voet is, het 'n luggeweer gebruik. As voorsorgmaatreël is die skool gesluit en 'n veiligheidskoordom rondom dié en ander skole in die distrik ingestel. In 'n onderhoud met die Franse radionetwerk RTL het Lyon se burgemeester, Thierre Philip, getwyfel of die skool die skieter se werklike teiken was. 'Dit was voetgangers — veral ma's of oppassers wat kinders kom haal het — wat beseer is,' het hy gesê. CNN se Sujatha Samy het tot hierdie verslag bygedra.

article_content: Five former Blackwater Worldwide security guards, indicted on charges of voluntary manslaughter and related offenses for the deaths of 17 Iraqis in Baghdad in 2007, were released on their own recognizance after a court hearing Monday. The Justice Department announced the charges, connected to the shootings at Baghdad's Nisour Square on September 16, 2007. Each former guard is charged with 14 counts of manslaughter, 20 counts of attempted manslaughter, and one count of using a firearm during a violent crime. Possible sentences include up to 10 years for each manslaughter count, 7 years per attempted manslaughter count, and a 30-year mandatory minimum for the firearms charge. Those indicted are Donald Ball, 26 (West Valley City, Utah); Dustin Heard, 27 (Maryville, Tennessee); Evan Liberty, 26 (Rochester, New Hampshire); Nicholas Slatten, 24 (Sparta, Tennessee); and Paul Slough, 29 (Keller, Texas). Jeremy Ridgway, 35, of California, a sixth former guard, pleaded guilty last Friday to voluntary manslaughter and attempt to commit manslaughter. The indicted guards turned themselves in to federal authorities in Salt Lake City and were released without bail. They are to appear for another court hearing in Washington on January 6. This is the first prosecution of non-Defense Department contractors under the expanded Military Extraterritorial Jurisdiction Act. Defense lawyers argue that Blackwater’s State Department contract exempts their employees from this act. Blackwater asserts its employees only fired after being attacked by insurgents and were acting in accordance with procedures, emphasizing the chaotic conditions. In contrast, an Iraqi investigation described the shootings as 'premeditated murder' and claimed the guards fired indiscriminately at civilians. U.S. military investigators reportedly found no evidence the guards were fired upon. Families of victims and Iraqi officials welcomed the indictments. Mohammad Abdul Razzaq, who lost his son, called it a 'heinous crime' and urged for justice. Legal questions remain regarding jurisdiction, contractor immunity, and whether State Department officials gave the guards assurances of immunity. A new U.S.-Iraq security agreement will soon give Iraq the main right to prosecute contractors, altering future legal proceedings. Blackwater no longer employs any of the accused guards. Meetings between U.S. prosecutors and Iraqi witnesses continue. Blackwater maintains its overall defense of its conduct but supports holding individuals accountable for proven criminal wrongdoing.

Die Departement van Justisie het die aanklagte aangekondig, wat verband hou met die skietery op Bagdad se Nisourplein op 16 September 2007. 'n Nuwe VSA-Irak veiligheidsverdrag sal binnekort Irak die primêre reg gee om kontrakteurs te vervolg, wat toekomstige regsprosesse sal beïnvloed. article_content: Wayne Rooney has made it clear that he wants to leave Manchester United after being left out of Sir Alex Ferguson’s final home game. Ferguson confirmed Rooney asked for a transfer and also requested not to be included in the squad for United’s 2-1 win over Swansea. Ferguson said, 'I don’t think Wayne was keen to play simply because he’s asked for a transfer.' Rooney celebrated with his son Kai and the Premier League trophy after the match, but he was not in the squad or on the bench. Despite not playing, Rooney had trained normally with the team all week and stayed with them at the Lowry Hotel that morning. Rooney reportedly wants a summer move to Chelsea after nine years at United. Moments after United lifted the Premier League trophy, Ferguson revealed Rooney wants to leave but added, 'He wants to think it through. We’re not going to let him go. Maybe he’s frustrated at being substituted recently.' Rooney, who has two years remaining on his £250,000-a-week contract, watched the match from an executive box and joined his teammates on the pitch for celebrations. Ferguson and Rooney had minimal interaction during the medal ceremony, with some fans jeering Rooney. New manager David Moyes plans to discuss Rooney’s future when he takes over, while Ferguson will join the club’s board. Jose Mourinho, expected to become Chelsea manager, is reportedly keen to sign Rooney for £25 million. Rooney lost his regular starting spot with the arrival of Robin van Persie, featuring in 22 league starts this season and playing in multiple positions. Rooney is expected to be included in Roy Hodgson’s England squad for upcoming friendlies against the Republic of Ireland and Brazil. Gary Neville, former United defender, commented on Rooney’s situation and advised him to reflect and be with his family. Rooney has played a total of 393 Premier League and Champions League matches for United, scoring 172 goals since joining in 2004. His 2012-13 Premier League stats include 2,126 minutes played, 22 appearances (plus 5 as a substitute), 12 goals (one penalty), 9 assists, and an 82% pass success rate.

article_content: Once believed extinct in the United States, the Mexican gray wolf is now making a gradual return. This subspecies is the rarest and most genetically unique among the 37 identified types of gray wolves. In the early 1900s, government programs aimed to eliminate them, but more recent efforts focus on restoring the population. Heritage Park Zoo in Prescott, Arizona, joined the species survival plan in 2005, welcoming five sibling Mexican gray wolves. Unlike its other 170 animal residents, the zoo keeps these wolves apart, minimizing human interaction. 'Wild animals and people make for a very bad combination,' notes zoo keeper Kim McCall in an interview with NBC. Currently, there are about 75 known Mexican gray wolves living in the wild in Arizona. The zoo’s conservation program has proven successful, with wild packs breeding and raising cubs. Adult Mexican gray wolves are similar in size to a German Shepherd, but they have a broader head, thicker neck, longer ears, and a shorter tail compared to some European wolves.

In die vroeë 1900’s het regeringsprogramme hulle probeer uitroei, maar onlangse pogings fokus op die herstel van die populasie. Heritage Park Zoo in Prescott, Arizona, het in 2005 by die spesiebehoudplan aangesluit en vyf Mexikaanse gryswolwe wat broers en susters is, ontvang. article_content: Chicago photographer Steve Spitzer recorded unusual video of a great horned owl swimming across Lake Michigan, a behavior rarely seen in this species. While at Loyola Park Beach with a birdwatcher, Spitzer spotted the owl in the water. The bird reportedly entered the lake after being pursued by two peregrine falcons. Using its wings like a breaststroke, the owl made it to shore, where it rested and dried off. Wildlife rescuers were contacted but the owl had left before they arrived. Although such swimming is uncommon, similar behavior was previously recorded by Dawn Keller, a bird rescuer, in 2011 at the Chicago Botanic Gardens. Great horned owls, also known as tiger owls, are found throughout the Americas. Spitzer shares more of his wildlife photography on his Flickr profile.

article_content: Just weeks after a light snowfall brought major disruption to parts of the southern United States, residents are now facing a new threat: an approaching ice storm that could be even more severe. Meteorologists predict that up to an inch of ice may cover large areas, posing a risk far greater than typical snow events. An inch of ice, while sounding modest, is much heavier than a foot of snow. CNN meteorologist Pedram Javaheri notes that icy buildup can make branches thirty times heavier than if they were covered with snow. Even half an inch of ice can add hundreds of pounds to power lines, leading to snapped branches and wires. In the Southern ice storm of 2000, this resulted in over 500,000 homes losing power for days. There are concerns that similar or worse power disruptions could happen again. Georgia Power’s emergency chief, Aaron Strickland, warns that the forecasted ice levels could have catastrophic impacts on the electricity grid and cause extensive cleanup costs. For example, a 1998 New England ice storm caused more than $1 billion in damages. Road conditions will also likely be far more hazardous. Kurt Van Speybroeck from the National Weather Service explains that, while snow compresses and can often be driven on, even a thin layer of ice can make roads extremely slick and dangerous. Atlanta’s traffic gridlock during the last winter storm was due mostly to this invisible ice, or black ice, making roads impassable. Freezing rain compounds the problem, as it leads to more black ice—deceptively clear and almost impossible to spot while driving, increasing the likelihood of accidents. The aftermath of such storms can be equally damaging. Ice seeps into roadway cracks and, when it freezes, expands and causes potholes. After a December ice storm in northern Texas, the resulting potholes and vehicle damage significantly increased the demand for car repairs. Javaheri adds that ice lingers much longer than snow, staying reflective and clean for days after a storm, which slows down the melting process.

article_content: Rishi Sunak is facing intense pressure regarding Home Secretary Suella Braverman after a weekend where she was accused of encouraging far-right activists involved in violence in London. This is just one of several major challenges for the prime minister, making it a significant week in Westminster. Whitehall is preparing for possible changes in government ministers, with speculation about a substantial reshuffle that could happen as early as Monday. Such reshuffles are often unpredictable and tend to disappoint more people than they please, as some are dismissed, some are overlooked, and only a few are promoted. Sunak is known for his cautious approach and is believed to have been considering a wider reshuffle for several months. For Suella Braverman, the situation has become critical following her recent comments about police bias—remarks not sanctioned by Downing Street. Increasing numbers of her ministerial colleagues are now frustrated, including some who previously tolerated her behavior. The level of dissatisfaction appears to be growing. On Wednesday, the Supreme Court will announce whether the government's plan to send some asylum seekers arriving in small boats to Rwanda can proceed. This key policy has been delayed in the courts and now faces a decisive moment. Government insiders hold mixed views on the likely outcome. If successful, it would be a notable achievement for Sunak, but actual implementation will take time and may involve further legal challenges. The policy contrasts with the Labour party’s position, as they have promised to scrap the scheme if in power while it remains active. Wednesday will also see the release of new inflation figures. The government is increasingly confident about meeting its promise to halve inflation this year, expecting that the numbers will reflect this progress. However, financial pressures on households remain significant. Meeting the inflation goal would mark a major government achievement for the year, despite unfulfilled promises such as reducing NHS waiting lists in England. A Commons vote on a ceasefire in Gaza—proposed by the Scottish National Party—is also likely on Wednesday. While the vote will not directly impact government policy, it may create difficulties for Labour leader Sir Keir Starmer, given calls for a ceasefire among some of his frontbenchers and recent resignations. Starmer currently stands by his policy unless there are major changes in the Middle East. This confluence of events makes for a pivotal week for both the prime minister and the Labour leader.

Dit is net een van verskeie groot uitdagings vir die eerste minister, wat daarop dui dat dit 'n belangrike week in Westminster gaan wees. Whitehall berei voor vir moontlike veranderinge onder regeringsministers, met bespiegelinge oor 'n groot herskommeling wat moontlik reeds Maandag kan plaasvind. Sulke herskommelinge is dikwels onvoorspelbaar en stel meer mense teleur as wat dit tevrede stel, aangesien sommige afgedank word, ander oor die hoof gesien word, en net enkeles bevorder word. Sunak is bekend vir sy versigtige benadering en daar word geglo dat hy al vir maande aan 'n breër herskommeling dink. Vir Suella Braverman het die situasie kritiek geraak ná haar onlangse opmerkings oor vooroordeel by die polisie — opmerkings wat nie deur Downing Street goedgekeur is nie. Steeds meer van haar ministeriële kollegas is nou gefrustreerd, selfs dié wat haar optrede vroeër verdra het. Die vlak van ontevredenheid neem toe. Woensdag sal die Hoogste Hof aankondig of die regering se plan om sekere asielsoekers wat per boot aankom na Rwanda te stuur, kan voortgaan. Hierdie belangrike beleid is al lank in die howe vertraag en is nou op 'n deurslaggewende oomblik. Regeringsinsiders het gemengde sienings oor die waarskynlike uitkoms. Indien suksesvol, sal dit 'n groot prestasie vir Sunak wees, maar die implementering sal steeds tyd neem en waarskynlik verdere regstappe inhou. Die beleid staan in kontras met die Arbeidersparty, wat belowe het om dit te skrap as hulle aan bewind kom terwyl dit steeds in werking is. Woensdag word ook nuwe inflasiesyfers verwag. Die regering is al hoe meer vol vertroue dat hulle hul belofte om inflasie hierdie jaar te halveer kan nakom, en verwag antwoorde op die syfers. Die finansiële druk op huishoudings bly egter groot. As die inflasiedoelwit bereik word, sal dit 'n groot prestasie vir die regering wees, ten spyte van onvervulde beloftes soos die vermindering van NHS-waglyste in Engeland. 'n Stemming in die Laerhuis oor 'n staak-die-vuur in Gasa — voorgestel deur die Skotse Nasionale Party — word ook Woensdag verwag. Hoewel hierdie stemming nie die regering se beleid direk sal verander nie, kan dit probleme veroorsaak vir die Arbeidersleier Sir Keir Starmer, aangesien sommige van sy voorste spanlede en 'n onlangs afgetrede minister 'n staak-die-vuur steun. Starmer hou steeds vas aan sy beleid, tensy daar noemenswaardige veranderinge in die Midde-Ooste plaasvind. Hierdie gebeurtenisse maak dit 'n baie belangrike week vir beide die eerste minister en die Arbeidersleier.

article_content: On the eve of the match, Everton manager Roberto Martinez spoke about his squad embracing the Europa League. He described the often-criticized competition as an opportunity to rejuvenate what has been a disappointing season for the club. Martinez emphasized that such European nights are 'in the club's DNA.' Everton was determined to do everything possible to reach victory in the Warsaw final on May 27. Romelu Lukaku, the £28 million striker who has at times embodied Everton’s struggles this season, clearly supports Martinez’s vision. In this round of 32 Europa League first-leg match against Young Boys in Bern, Lukaku delivered an outstanding hat-trick, helping Everton to an assured away performance reminiscent of the club’s historic European triumph 30 years ago. Lukaku’s goals were a much-needed boost. His first came after 24 minutes, heading Everton in front after getting past Steve von Bergen. He celebrated his opening goal with teammates, signaling renewed confidence. Later, Lukaku capitalized on Gareth Barry's low cross, scoring his second and extending Everton's lead to 3-1. Teammate Steven Naismith congratulated him on his brace. Last season, Lukaku scored 15 goals in 31 league matches, driving Everton's Champions League bid, but this term, his form has been inconsistent, and goals have been scarce. However, in Bern’s cold conditions, he was exceptional—alert and involved from the start, including an early header from Bryan Oviedo’s cross that forced a save from Yvon Mvogo. Despite falling behind to Guillaume Hoarau’s goal, Everton stayed resilient. Lukaku pressed on, and soon netted his 11th goal of the season from another Oviedo cross. Seamus Coleman also scored in the 28th minute to restore Everton's lead after Hoarau’s equalizer. Close to halftime, Lukaku tapped in Barry’s cross for Everton’s third goal. There were claims of offside, but the goal stood. During the second half, Lukaku displayed maturity, drawing Ross Barkley away from an altercation after a late tackle. Barkley soon assisted Lukaku with a precise pass, setting up his hat-trick—the first for Everton and his first since netting three against Manchester United for West Brom in 2013. Lukaku celebrated by kneeling and pointing to the sky. Everton then faced a setback when John Stones received a red card for fouling Hoarau in the box. Fortunately, the resulting penalty was missed. With Everton down to 10 men, Lukaku’s influence waned, but his effort remained evident. He showed determination, chasing lost causes and earning an ovation from traveling fans. Later, he missed a clear chance from Luke Garbutt’s cross and was denied again by Mvogo, before being substituted to another round of applause. Lukaku’s exceptional performance provided a timely resurgence for Everton’s European hopes.
translated_content: Op die vooraand van die wedstryd het Everton se bestuurder, Roberto Martinez, gepraat oor sy span wat die Europa Liga omarm. Hy het die dikwels gekritiseerde kompetisie beskryf as 'n kans om 'n teleurstellende seisoen vir die klub te vernuwe. Martinez het beklemtoon dat sulke Europese aande 'in die klub se DNA' is. Everton was vasbeslote om alles moontlik te doen om oorwinning in die Warskou-finaal op 27 Mei te behaal. Romelu Lukaku, die £28 miljoen-aanvaller wat soms Everton se sukkelende seisoen verteenwoordig het, ondersteun duidelik Martinez se visie. In hierdie Europa Liga-rondte van 32 eerste uitklopwedstryd teen Young Boys in Bern, het Lukaku 'n uitmuntende driekuns behaal en Everton gehelp om 'n selfversekerde uitwedstryd te lewer wat herinner aan die klub se historiese Europese oorwinning 30 jaar gelede. Lukaku se doele was 'n broodnodige hupstoot. Sy eerste het ná 24 minute gekom toe hy Everton in die voortou plaas met 'n kopskoot nadat hy Steve von Bergen verbygesteek het. Hy het sy openingsdoel saam met spanmaats gevier, wat hernieude selfvertroue aandui. Later het Lukaku op Gareth Barry se lae voorgee ingespeel en sy tweede doel aangeteken om Everton se voorsprong tot 3-1 uit te brei. Spanmaat Steven Naismith het hom met sy skittertwee doele gelukgewens. Verlede seisoen het Lukaku 15 doele in 31 liga-wedstryde aangeteken en Everton se Champions League-poging gedryf, maar vanjaar was sy vorm wisselvallig en het doele min gekom. In die koue toestande van Bern was hy egter uitstekend – waaksaam en betrokke van die begin af, insluitend 'n vroeë kopskoot vanaf Bryan Oviedo se voorgee wat 'n goeie red van Yvon Mvogo afgedwing het. Ten spyte daarvan dat hulle agtergeraak het na 'n doel van Guillaume Hoarau, het Everton vasgebyt. Lukaku het voortgegaan en gou sy 11de doel van die seisoen aangeteken vanaf nóg 'n Oviedo-voorgee. Seamus Coleman het ook in die 28ste minuut aangeslaan om Everton se voorsprong ná Hoarau se gelykmaker te herstel. Naby halftyd het Lukaku Barry se lae voorgee ingetik vir Everton se derde doel. Daar was bewerings van buitespel, maar die doel is toegeken. In die tweede helfte het Lukaku volwassenheid getoon toe hy Ross Barkley weggetrek het van 'n konfrontasie na 'n laat skop. Barkley het gou daarna vir Lukaku 'n keurige deursteek gegee wat gelei het tot Lukaku se driekuns – sy eerste vir Everton en eerste sedert hy drie teen Manchester United vir West Brom in 2013 aangeteken het. Lukaku het gekniel en na die hemel gewys terwyl hy feesgevier het. Everton het toe 'n terugslag ervaar toe John Stones 'n rooi kaart gekry het vir 'n oortreding op Hoarau in die boks. Gelukkig is die daaropvolgende strafskop gemis. Met Everton wat tot 10 manne moes speel, het Lukaku se invloed afgeneem, maar sy toewyding was steeds duidelik. Hy het ywer gewys, agter verlore lopies aangehardloop, en 'n luid applous van die besoekende ondersteuners ontvang. Later het hy 'n duidelike kans gemis na Luke Garbutt se voorgee en is nog 'n keer deur Mvogo gekeer, voordat hy onder applous vervang is. Lukaku se uitsonderlike vertoning het Everton se Europese hoop op die regte tyd herleef.

article_content: On Friday, Myanmar’s military government severed the country’s Internet access, restricting the spread of information about its violent crackdown on peaceful demonstrators, including Buddhist monks. Ko Htike, a blogger based in London, has been posting updates and images sent by people inside Myanmar. He announced on his blog that the junta’s action would make it difficult to continue sharing photos of the authorities’ brutality, but he pledged to persist: 'Where there is a will, there is a way.' Htike, 28, left Myanmar (formerly Burma) seven years ago to study in England. According to him, up to 40 contacts inside Myanmar send him photos or share news, often risking their safety to get information out. The military government forbids sharing such images, and anyone caught faces severe consequences, possibly including imprisonment or death. Despite this, contributors continue because they feel it is their duty to the country. With few Western journalists allowed in Myanmar, blogs like Htike’s have become major sources of news. Over 170,000 people from 175 countries have visited his blog, according to its own counter. Friday marked the third consecutive day of violence in Yangon, Myanmar’s largest city, as the military attempted to suppress protests. Reportedly, Western witnesses saw about 35 bodies near Sule Pagoda, but CNN could not independently confirm these reports. British Prime Minister Gordon Brown stated that he believes the actual death toll is higher than official reports indicate. The attacks on Buddhist monks, who are highly respected in Myanmar, may provoke greater public outrage. Social media platforms like Facebook have seen the formation of support groups for Myanmar, while international organizations and student groups have called for global demonstrations. Despite restrictions, citizens continue to use cell phones and other technology to share news and images with the outside world. Journalists and activists, aware of the risks, remain committed to telling Myanmar’s story. A student in Tokyo, Benjamin Valk, shared video footage of peaceful protests in Yangon, expressing the need for global awareness about events in Myanmar. Htike and his sources hope their efforts to publicize the violence can contribute to stopping the bloodshed in their homeland.

Ko Htike, 'n blogger gebaseer in Londen, plaas nuus en beelde wat deur mense binne-in Mianmar aan hom gestuur word. Hy het op sy blog aangekondig dat die junta se optrede dit moeilik gaan maak om voort te gaan om foto's van die owerhede se brutaliteit te plaas, maar hy het belowe om aan te hou: 'Waar daar 'n wil is, is daar 'n weg.' Htike, 28, het sewe jaar gelede Mianmar (voorheen Birma) verlaat om in Engeland te studeer. Volgens hom stuur tot 40 kontakte binne Mianmar vir hom foto's of deel nuus, dikwels met groot risiko vir hul veiligheid. Die militêre regering verbied die deel van sulke beelde, en enigiemand wat betrap word, kan ernstige gevolge in die gesig staar, insluitend moontlike tronkstraf of dood. Tog gaan bydraers voort omdat hulle voel dit is hul plig teenoor die land. Met min Westerse joernaliste toegelaat in Mianmar, het blogs soos Htike s'n belangrike bronne van nuus geword. Meer as 170,000 mense uit 175 lande het sy blog besoek, volgens sy tellertjie. Vrydag was die derde agtereenvolgende dag van geweld in Yangon, Mianmar se grootste stad, toe die weermag probeer het om betogings te onderdruk. Daar is berig dat Westerse getuies sowat 35 lyke naby die Sule Pagode gesien het, maar CNN kon nie hierdie berigte onafhanklik bevestig nie. Die Britse Eerste Minister Gordon Brown het gesê hy glo die ware dodetal is hoër as wat amptelik aangemeld word. Die aanvalle op Boeddhistiese monnike, wat hoog aangeskryf word in Mianmar, kan groter volkswoede ontlok. Sosiale media soos Facebook het ondersteuningsgroepe vir Mianmar gesien, terwyl internasionale organisasies en studentegroepe oproepe tot wêreldwye betogings gedoen het. Ten spyte van beperkings, gebruik burgers steeds selfone en ander tegnologie om nuus en beelde met die buitewêreld te deel. Joernaliste en aktiviste, bewus van die risiko’s, bly toegewyd om Mianmar se storie te vertel. ’n Student in Tokio, Benjamin Valk, het videomateriaal gedeel van vreedsame betogings in Yangon, en sê dit is belangrik dat die wêreld moet weet wat in Mianmar gebeur. Htike en sy bronne hoop hul pogings om die geweld bekend te maak, kan help om die bloedvergieting in hul vaderland te stop.

article_content: Tottenham Hotspur sporting director Franco Baldini will be present at the World Cup in Brazil to ensure the club is well-positioned in the transfer market. The experienced Italian will oversee Spurs' efforts to secure their World Cup transfer targets during the tournament. New manager Mauricio Pochettino has made signing a central defender and a left back his top priorities for the summer transfer window. The club has also allocated funds to strengthen the squad and support Pochettino as he begins his tenure. Tottenham scouts, including chief talent-spotter Ian Broomfield, will be in South America scouting top talent at the tournament. The club has already identified several transfer targets, including Swansea left back Ben Davies and Belgium striker Michy Batshuayi, who plays for Standard Liege. While Ben Davies will not be playing in Brazil, he is highly regarded by the staff at White Hart Lane. Last summer, Baldini oversaw a significant transfer campaign, with the club investing over £100 million in new talent, largely financed by Gareth Bale’s £85 million transfer to Real Madrid. This year’s transfer budget will be more restrained, but Pochettino will still have substantial resources to improve the squad ahead of his first season in charge.

article_content: Prateekshit ‘Kanu’ Pandey, who has taken up the assistant professor position at the University of California, Santa Barbara's Department of Communication, revealed his new appointment in a distinctly playful style. On X (formerly Twitter), Pandey posted a congratulatory poster that cleverly mimicked the bold, festive banners popular with Indian political parties. His creative announcement quickly gained attention, with many users on X reacting with amusement. One user joked, 'If I stay in academia, it'll be just for a chance to make this kind of announcement!' Another highlighted the inclusion of Dr. Celeste Wagner in the poster, complimenting its imaginative flair. The announcement inspired others to suggest this vibrant format become standard for job updates. Some joked that normalizing these posters would be Maharashtra’s greatest gift to the world, while others encouraged all academics to follow Pandey’s lead. Pandey’s blending of humor and academia isn’t new. Back in July, he crafted a similar poster to invite viewers to his dissertation defense, focused on the dynamic between political engagement and sharing both traditional and humorous news. That post also drew thousands of likes. UC Santa Barbara’s Department of Communication describes Pandey as a specialist in political communication, as well as an experienced improvisational comedian. From 2019 to 2023, he performed and taught improv with Comedy Sportz Philadelphia.

article_content: Archaeologists have recovered five large six-pounder cannons from the wreck of Blackbeard's ship off the coast of North Carolina. Five cannons from the Queen Anne's Revenge, the sunken flagship of Edward Teach (better known as Blackbeard), were recovered Monday by scientists from the North Carolina Department of Cultural Resources after nearly 300 years underwater at Beaufort Inlet. Working with the Coast Guard, the team brought the cannons—each weighing between 2,000 and 3,000 pounds—to the surface. Billy Ray Morris, who manages the expedition, said the largest cannon is likely Swedish-made, similar to another of the large guns once onboard that has already been recovered. The project concluded for the year, but archaeologists plan to return for another season in 2014. This recovery brings the total number of cannons salvaged from the ship to 20. Each of the cannons originally fired six-pound cannonballs. It is unclear if any of the cannons was loaded. The recovered cannons will likely be added to the Queen Anne's Revenge exhibit in Beaufort, which already features more than 280,000 artifacts. Blackbeard, born in Britain, is remembered in history for terrorizing Atlantic sailors from the American colonies to the Caribbean. After Queen Anne's Revenge was intentionally grounded in June 1718, Blackbeard escaped, leaving much of his crew behind and taking most of the treasure. The remains of Queen Anne's Revenge lie two miles off the North Carolina coast in 25 feet of water. Blackbeard lived for another six months before being killed in battle with British troops. His severed head was displayed on the bowsprit of the victorious ship.
translated_content: Argeoloë het vyf groot ses-ponder kanonne uit die wrak van Blackbeard se skip aan die kus van Noord-Carolina herwin. Vyf kanonne van die Queen Anne's Revenge, die gesonke vlagskip van Edward Teach (beter bekend as Blackbeard), is Maandag deur wetenskaplikes van die Noord-Carolina Departement van Kulturele Hulpbronne herwin nadat dit byna 300 jaar onderwater by Beaufort Inham gelê het. Saam met die Kustewag het die span die kanonne—elk wat tussen 2 000 en 3 000 pond weeg—na die oppervlak gebring. Billy Ray Morris, wat die ekspedisie bestuur, sê die grootste kanon is waarskynlik Sweeds vervaardig, soortgelyk aan nog 'n groot kanon wat reeds opgegrawe is. Die projek is vir die jaar afgehandel, maar argeoloë beplan om in 2014 vir nóg 'n seisoen terug te keer. Hierdie herwinning bring die totale aantal kanonne wat uit die skip gehaal is op 20. Elke kanon het oorspronklik ses-pond kanonkoeëls geskiet. Dit is nie duidelik of enige van die kanonne gelaai was nie. Die herwonne kanonne sal waarskynlik by die Queen Anne's Revenge-uitstalling in Beaufort gevoeg word, wat reeds meer as 280 000 artefakte het. Blackbeard, gebore in Brittanje, word in die geskiedenis onthou as 'n berugte seerower wat van die Amerikaanse kolonies tot die Karibiese See tiere het. Nadat die Queen Anne's Revenge in Junie 1718 doelbewus gestrand is, het Blackbeard ontsnap, baie van sy bemanning agtergelaat en meeste van die skat gevat. Die oorblyfsels van die Queen Anne's Revenge lê twee myl van die Noord-Carolina kus af in 25 voet water. Blackbeard het nog ses maande geleef voor hy in 'n geveg met Britse troepe gedood is. Sy kop is op die boegspriet van die oorwinnaars se skip uitgestal.

article_content: As the fourth bitcoin halving approaches, expected around April 23, 2024, bitcoin's available trading supply is experiencing significant and unprecedented tightening. Key factors driving this trend include a historic scarcity in tradable bitcoin and strong accumulation by investors storing their coins for the long term. The halving, which takes place every 210,000 blocks and halves the rate of new bitcoin creation, is viewed as a pivotal event in bitcoin's lifecycle. Past halvings have typically led to miners selling the majority of their coins due to high operating costs, but after this upcoming halving, much less bitcoin will be distributed to the market, further reducing available supply. Investor behavior is shifting, with long-term holders, or those keeping coins in illiquid wallets, accumulating more bitcoin. Analysis from Glassnode shows that only 5-10% of the total circulating supply is actively traded, with the remainder moving into illiquid or long-term storage wallets since March 2020. Metrics such as Short-Term Holder Supply and Futures Open Interest highlight declining 'available supply,' as well as significant increases in coins being stored. Currently, the rate at which coins are being stored exceeds new issuance; illiquid supply is increasing at more than twice the rate of new coin production. Glassnode also uses the realized cap to track capital flows, showing that, especially during bear markets, small inflows or outflows can cause large price swings due to the scarcity of actively traded bitcoin. The fourth halving is therefore more than just a technical milestone — it represents a major supply shift. With 'available supply' at an all-time low and storage rates far outpacing new issuance, the stage is set for a critical event with potentially far-reaching price implications. Bitcoin’s halving coincides with broader global financial trends. While bitcoin is undergoing its own form of quantitative tightening by reducing its issuance, many fiat currencies may increase their supply to maintain economic stability. This divergence in policies could have a significant impact on bitcoin's valuation. If the supply of fiat currencies expands while bitcoin supply tightens, there may be a strong upward pressure on bitcoin’s price, especially as institutional interest—such as the potential approval of a spot bitcoin ETF—continues to rise. Historically, previous halvings have coincided with price surges, suggesting the possibility of a new market cycle and all-time highs.
translated_content: Soos die vierde bitcoin-halvering nader kom, wat omstreeks 23 April 2024 verwag word, ervaar bitcoin se beskikbare verhandelbare voorraad 'n beduidende en ongekende inkrimping. Sleutelfaktore agter hierdie tendens sluit 'n historiese tekort aan verhandelbare bitcoin en proaktiewe akkumulering deur beleggers wat hul munte op die lang termyn hou, in. Die halvering, wat elke 210 000 blokke plaasvind en die tempo waarteen nuwe bitcoins geskep word halveer, word as 'n deurslaggewende mylpaal in bitcoin se lewensiklus beskou. Voorafgaande halverings het dikwels daartoe gelei dat miners die meeste van hul bitcoins verkoop het vanweë hoë bedryfskoste, maar ná hierdie volgende halvering sal baie minder bitcoin beskikbaar wees op die mark en die beskikbare voorraad verder laat daal. Beleggergedrag verander, met langtermynhouers – wat hul bitcoin in illikiede beursies hou – wat aanhou om meer op te gaar. Glassnode se ontleding toon dat slegs 5-10% van die totale sirkulerende voorraad aktief verhandel word, terwyl die res sedert Maart 2020 in illikiede of langtermynbeursies gestoor word. Maatstawwe soos Korttermynhouervoorraad en Futures Oop Rente dui op 'n afname in 'beskikbare voorraad' en 'n sterk toename in munte wat gestoor word. Op die oomblik oorskry die tempo waarteen munte gestoor word die uitreiking van nuwe munte; illikiede voorraad groei teen meer as dubbeld die tempo van nuwe munte. Glassnode gebruik ook 'gerealiseerde kapitaal' om kapitaalvloei na te spoor, wat wys dat selfs klein invloei of uitvloei in beer markte groot markreaksies veroorsaak omdat daar min bitcoin aktief verhandel word. Die vierde halvering is dus meer as net 'n tegniese mylpaal – dit verteenwoordig 'n groot verskuiwing in beskikbare voorraad. Met beskikbare voorraad op 'n alle tye laag en stoor-tempo's wat nuwe uitreiking oorskry, kan hierdie gebeurtenis verreikende prysgevolge inhou. Bitcoin se halvering vind plaas teen die agtergrond van wêreldwye finansiële verskuiwings. Terwyl bitcoin sy eie vorm van kwantitatiewe verkrapping ondergaan, kan fiat-geldeenhede hulle aanbod uitbrei om ekonomiese stabiliteit te verseker. Hierdie teenstrydige beleide mag 'n groot impak op bitcoin se prys hê. As fiat-geldeenhede hul aanbod verhoog terwyl bitcoin s'n vernou, kan dit verdere opwaartse druk op bitcoin se prys beteken, veral met die moontlike goedkeuring van 'n spot bitcoin ETF en stygende institusionele belangstelling. Geskiedkundig het vorige halverings voorgeloop op prysspronge, wat 'n nuwe markiklus en moontlike rekordhoogtes kan inlui.

article_content: Tottenham Hotspur supporters have endured anti-Semitic abuse for years, including rival fans imitating the sound of gas chambers used during the Holocaust. The use of the word 'Yid' at football matches remains contentious. While some Spurs fans use the term to reclaim it, others find its use highly offensive. Recently, the English Football Association (FA) warned fans that using the 'Y-word' could lead to prosecution, as it has historically been used both by Jewish people and as a slur against them. Spurs, a north London club with a significant Jewish following, has seen some of its supporters adopt the 'Yid Army' identity, chanting the term at matches. Prime Minister David Cameron asserted in an interview with the Jewish Chronicle that there's a key difference between fans self-identifying with the word and using it as an insult: 'You have to be motivated by hate. Hate speech should be prosecuted—but only when it's motivated by hate.' Race for Sport, an anti-racism group, criticized Cameron's remarks as 'ludicrous.' David Neita, a spokesperson and member of the Society of Black Lawyers, argued that Spurs fans' attempt to reclaim the word is indefensible: 'Tottenham fans have neither the right nor the moral authority to do so.' Peter Herbert, chairman of the Society of Black Lawyers, also censured Cameron, claiming his comments might legitimize anti-Semitism: 'Football is a part of society. The Prime Minister must consider his words, as legitimizing anti-Semitism is regrettable for any parliamentarian.' Campaigner and comedian David Baddiel, a Jewish Chelsea supporter, concurred, stating that use of the word by Spurs fans still 'legitimizes and sustains the racist abuse aimed at Spurs by other fans.' Despite the criticism, Cameron found some support from Darren Alexander, co-chair of the Spurs Supporters' Trust, who welcomed Cameron's 'common sense' and recognition that the word means different things in different contexts. Some commentators, like journalist Anshel Pfeffer in Haaretz, argued that more effort should be directed at punishing fans from other clubs who engage in anti-Semitic chants, rather than penalizing Spurs fans whose use of the term is not meant as an insult. David Aaronovitch, a columnist for The Times, echoed this, asserting the issue lies more with other supporters' racist abuse than with Spurs fans' use of the word. Overall, the debate continues over responsibility and the meaning of language within football culture.
translated_content: Tottenham Hotspur ondersteuners het vir jare anti-Semitiese mishandeling verduur, insluitend teenstanders wat die geluid van gaskamers tydens die Holocaust naboots. Die gebruik van die woord 'Yid' by sokkerwedstryde bly omstrede. Sommige Spurs-aanhangers probeer dit herwin, terwyl ander dit as hoogs aanstootlik beskou. Onlangs het die Engelse Sokkervereniging (FA) gewaarsku dat die gebruik van die 'Y-woord' tot vervolging kan lei, aangesien dit histories deur Joodse mense gebruik is en ook as 'n skeldwoord teen hulle. Spurs, 'n Noord-Londense klub met 'n beduidende Joodse ondersteunersbasis, het gesien hoe sommige aanhangers die 'Yid Army'-identiteit aanneem en die term by wedstryde skree. Eerste Minister David Cameron het in 'n onderhoud met die Jewish Chronicle gesê daar is 'n belangrike verskil tussen aanhangers wat hulself met die woord identifiseer en dié wat dit as 'n belediging gebruik: 'Jy moet deur haat gemotiveer wees. Haatspraak moet vervolg word—maar net as dit deur haat gemotiveer is.' Race for Sport, 'n teen-rassisme groep, het Cameron se opmerkings as 'belaglik' gekritiseer. David Neita, 'n woordvoerder en lid van die Society of Black Lawyers, het gesê Spurs-aanhangers se poging om die woord te herwin is onverdedigbaar: 'Tottenham-aanhangers het nie die reg of morele gesag om dit te doen nie.' Peter Herbert, voorsitter van die Society of Black Lawyers, het Cameron ook gekritiseer en beweer sy kommentaar kan anti-Semitisme regverdig: 'Sokker is deel van die samelewing. Die Eerste Minister moet sy woorde oorweeg, want om anti-Semitisme te legitimeer bly betreurenswaardig vir enige parlementslid.' Veldtogvoerder en komediant David Baddiel, 'n Joodse Chelsea-ondersteuner, het saamgestem en gesê die gebruik van die woord deur Spurs-aanhangers 'legitimeer en versterk steeds die rassistiese mishandeling wat op Spurs gemik is deur ander aanhangers.' Ten spyte van die kritiek, het Cameron steun gekry van Darren Alexander, medevoorsitter van die Spurs Supporters' Trust, wat Cameron se 'gesonde verstand' en erkenning dat die woord verskillende betekenis vir verskillende mense het, verwelkom het. Sommige kommentators, soos Anshel Pfeffer van Haaretz, het aangevoer dat daar eerder op die straf van ander klubs se aanhangers wat anti-Semitiese gesange aanhef, gefokus moet word as om Spurs-aanhangers te straf, wat die term nie as 'n belediging gebruik nie. David Aaronovitch, 'n rubriekskrywer vir The Times, het hiermee saamgestem en gesê die probleem lê meer by ander aanhangers se rassistiese mishandeling as by Spurs-aanhangers se gebruik van die woord. Algeheel duur die debat voort oor verantwoordelikheid en die betekenis van taal binne sokkerkultuur.

article_content: India will play against South Africa at Eden Gardens on Sunday, which coincides with cricket superstar Virat Kohli's 35th birthday. Kohli, now an icon in Indian sports, is being specially celebrated by fans and organizers as India maintains its unbeaten streak in the ongoing ICC World Cup. His journey from promising young talent to the face of Indian cricket has been remarkable over the past 14 years. Kohli has played a crucial role in India's cricket success and continues to inspire many people. Some credit Kohli’s global popularity as a factor in cricket’s upcoming inclusion in the 2028 Olympics. On his birthday, messages poured in from fans, fellow cricketers, and cricketing legends. Having started as captain of the Indian U-19 team, Kohli has become a prolific run-scorer and dynamic leader. Kohli is on the brink of matching Sachin Tendulkar’s record for most ODI centuries and hopes to achieve it on his birthday. With 13,525 ODI runs, 8,676 Test runs, and 4,008 T20I runs, Kohli is highly respected within the cricket community. His 35th birthday marks his extraordinary achievements and significant impact on Indian cricket.  Elsewhere, India has approved its first 100% foreign direct investment in the defense sector, permitting Sweden’s Saab to set up a rocket manufacturing facility. The State Bank of India, the nation’s largest lender, reported an 8% increase in second-quarter net profit, supported by strong demand for loans and reduced provisions. Byju’s reported a 2.3-fold increase in standalone revenue to ₹3,569 crore for the year ending March 2022, with its EBITDA loss decreasing to ₹2,253 crore compared to the previous year.

Kohli het ’n deurslaggewende rol in Indië se krieketsukses gespeel en bly baie mense inspireer. Sommige gee erkenning aan Kohli se wêreldwye gewildheid as ’n faktor in krieket se voorgenome insluiting by die 2028 Olimpiese Spele. Op sy verjaarsdag het boodskappe van aanhangers, medekrieketspelers en legendes van die spel ingestroom. Kohli het as kaptein van die Indiese O-19 span begin en het intussen ’n produktiewe lopieverwerwer en dinamiese leier geword. Kohli staan op die punt om Sachin Tendulkar se rekord vir meeste honderdtalle in eendagwedstryde te ewenaar en hoop om dit op sy verjaarsdag te behaal. Met 13 525 lopies in eendagwedstryde, 8 676 in toetse, en 4 008 in T20Is, geniet Kohli groot respek in die krieketgemeenskap. Sy 35ste verjaarsdag beklemtoon sy buitengewone prestasies en die beduidende impak wat hy op Indiese krieket gehad het.  Intussen het Indië sy eerste 100% direkte buitelandse belegging in die verdedigingsektor goedgekeur, wat aan Swede se Saab toestemming gee om ’n raketvervaardigingsfasiliteit op te rig. Die State Bank of India, die land se grootste geldskieter, het ’n 8% styging in sy tweede kwartaal wins aangemeld, ondersteun deur sterk vraag na lenings en verminderde voorsiening. Byju’s het ’n 2,3-voudige styging in binnekomste tot ₹3 569 crore vir die jaar geëindig Maart 2022 gerapporteer, met sy EBITDA-verlies wat afgeneem het tot ₹2 253 crore in vergelyking met die vorige jaar.

article_content: SAN FRANCISCO – Chinese President Xi Jinping, following his meeting with U.S. President Joe Biden, engaged in a series of discussions with leaders from the Indo-Pacific and Latin America on Thursday, amid rising competition with the United States. On the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit, Xi held separate talks with the leaders of Mexico, Peru, Fiji, Japan, and Brunei. During his meeting with Peruvian President Dina Boluarte, Xi called for strengthened economic and trade cooperation, pledging China's support for Peru as the host of next year’s APEC summit. Xi specifically stated that China is willing to import more high-quality agricultural products from Peru and would encourage Chinese businesses to participate in key Peruvian projects. Earlier, Xi met with Mexican President Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador, praising his leadership and reform initiatives, and pledging to elevate China-Mexico relations. The meeting is believed to be the first between the two leaders in person. Both sides agreed to enhance collaboration on counter-narcotics efforts. In a related development, China and the United States announced on Wednesday their commitment to work together to halt the flow of fentanyl precursors to countries such as Mexico, where the drug is finished and smuggled into the U.S. Xi expressed an interest in collaborating with Mexico in areas such as infrastructure, finance, and electric vehicles, while Lopez Obrador stated that Mexico would facilitate Chinese investment. The Mexican president also indicated his willingness to partner with China on multilateral issues and to support relations between China and Latin America, as reported by Chinese state media. Recently, a number of Chinese companies, facing U.S. tariffs and restrictions, have relocated some production to Mexico. Xi extended his sympathies to those affected by Hurricane Otis and announced that China had arranged emergency supplies for Mexico’s relief efforts. Following the meeting, Lopez Obrador posted on X (formerly Twitter) that both leaders reaffirmed their commitment to maintaining strong, mutually beneficial relations. Xi also met with Fiji’s Prime Minister, Sitiveni Rabuka, describing Fiji as ‘a good friend and a good partner’ in the Global South, a term generally referring to developing nations. Further discussions with Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida and Brunei’s Sultan Hassanal Bolkiah focused on deepening bilateral ties. Xi called the Bruneian leader ‘an old friend’ and expressed readiness to cooperate for the benefit of both nations. Xi’s engagements followed a four-hour meeting with President Biden the previous day—their first face-to-face encounter in a year.

Aan die kantlyn van die Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) beraad het Xi afsonderlik vergaderings met die leiers van Meksiko, Peru, Fidji, Japan en Brunei gehou. Tydens sy vergadering met die Peruaanse president Dina Boluarte het Xi gepleit vir sterker ekonomiese en handelsbande, en China se steun beloof aan Peru as gasheer van volgende jaar se APEC-beraad. Xi het spesifiek gesê dat China bereid is om meer hoë-gehalte landbouprodukte uit Peru in te voer en Chinese besighede aan te moedig om by belangrike projekte in Peru betrokke te raak. Vroeër het Xi die Mexikaanse president Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador ontmoet, sy leierskap en hervormingsinisiatiewe geprys, en belowe om China-Meksiko-verhoudings te bevorder. Dié ontmoeting word beskou as hul eerste gesig-tot-gesig gesprek. Beide partye het ooreengekom om samewerking in teen-dwelm pogings te versterk. In ŉ verwante ontwikkeling het China en die VSA op Woensdag hul verbintenis bevestig om saam te werk om die vloei van fentanyl-voorlopers na lande soos Meksiko te stuit, waar die dwelm verwerk en na die VSA gesmokkel word. Xi het belangstelling getoon om met Meksiko in sektore soos infrastruktuur, finansies en elektriese voertuie saam te werk, terwyl Lopez Obrador aangedui het dat Meksiko Chinese beleggings sal vergemaklik. Die Mexikaanse president het ook genoem dat Meksiko met China oor multilaterale sake sal saamwerk en betrekkinge tussen China en Latyns-Amerika sal bevorder, volgens Chinese staatsmedia. Onlangs het talle Chinese maatskappye, as gevolg van Amerikaanse tariewe en beperkings, sekere produksie na Meksiko verskuif. Xi het sy meegevoel uitgespreek met diegene wat deur Orkaan Otis geraak is en aangekondig dat China noodvoorrade aan Meksiko se rampverligting voorsien het. Na afloop van die vergadering het Lopez Obrador op X (voorheen Twitter) gesê dat die twee leiers hul verbintenis bevestig het om sterk, wedersyds voordelige betrekkinge te handhaaf. Xi het ook die Fidji-premier Sitiveni Rabuka ontmoet en na Fidji as 'n 'goeie vriend en vennoot' in die Globale Suide verwys — wat gewoonlik ontwikkelende lande beteken. Verdere besprekings met Japan se premier Fumio Kishida en Brunei se sultan Hassanal Bolkiah het op die verdieping van bilaterale bande gefokus. Xi het die Brunei-leier 'n 'ou vriend' genoem en sy bereidheid uitgespreek om saam te werk tot voordeel van beide lande. Xi se vergaderings het gevolg ná 'n vier-uur lange ontmoeting met president Biden die vorige dag — hul eerste persoonlike samensyn in 'n jaar.

article_content: Flash Coffee has closed all 11 of its outlets in Singapore, opting to focus on markets that present stronger growth opportunities. Though signage at Jurong Point implied staff were 'on strike' due to late salary payments, the company maintained that employees were not striking, but simply weren’t required to work after doors shut. Management explained that exiting Singapore will help the business become more sustainable and profitable, streamlining its efforts toward its most promising regions. With only 11 of around 200 global stores located in Singapore, this move represents a minor part of its operations. The Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA) indicates that Flash Coffee Singapore is undergoing creditors’ voluntary liquidation. Since launching in 2020, the brand had up to 30 stores locally at its peak. Flash Coffee remains active in other Asian countries, such as Indonesia, Thailand, and Hong Kong, despite pulling out of Singapore.

Bestuur het verduidelik dat die vertrek uit Singapoer die besigheid meer volhoubaar en winsgewend sal maak, sodat hulle op hul belowendste streke kan fokus. Met net 11 van sowat 200 winkels wêreldwyd in Singapoer, vorm hierdie stap ‘n klein deel van hul bedrywighede. Volgens die Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA) is Flash Coffee Singapoer tans besig met skuldeisersgedrewe likwidasie. Sedert hul bekendstelling in 2020 het die handelsmerk op sy hoogtepunt tot 30 winkels plaaslik gehad. Ten spyte van die uittrede uit Singapoer, bly Flash Coffee steeds aktief in ander Asiatiese lande soos Indonesië, Thailand en Hongkong.

article_content: The Indian National Space Promotion and Authorization Centre (IN-SPACe) has launched a pioneering 'Train the Trainers' programme designed to advance the use of space technologies in agriculture. Created in partnership with the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), Meerut Institute of Technology (MIT), non-government entities, and academic partners, the five-day course—'Using Space Technology for the Agriculture Sector'—will take place from November 20 to 24 at IIT Roorkee. Vinod Kumar, director of promotion at IN-SPACe, highlighted that this initiative supports broader societal benefits, aligning with the 'Antyodaya' mission and the commitment to adopting advanced technologies for better agricultural practices, food security, and sustainability. The course features a comprehensive curriculum with modules including agricultural land monitoring, detection and forecasting of pests and diseases, estimation of crop area and production, analysis of cropping systems, soil mapping and monitoring, and agricultural drought assessment. Hands-on activities feature soil sampling techniques, demonstrations with drones and robots, and applications of remote sensing, GIS, and artificial intelligence (AI) for farm management. IN-SPACe notes that incorporating space technology in precision farming, such as the use of satellite data and space-based resources, can empower farmers with information and unparalleled accuracy in their practices. The programme also involves analysis of climate data, weather forecasting to protect crops, identification of plant nutrient deficiencies, advances in sensing and analytics in precision agriculture, and basic applications of phytotron technology. Other practical topics include soil processing, preparing growing media, seed germination testing, managing and measuring humidity, and assessing crops' light exposure. Additional sessions cover crop inventory and health using optical methods, digital agriculture based on earth observation, global crop monitoring, and microwave remote sensing—each with hands-on instruction. Participants will also get an overview of ISRO's portals including Bhoonidhi, BHUVAN, VEDAS, and MOSDAC, which integrate space technology with AI and machine learning for comprehensive farm management solutions.
translated_content: Die Indian National Space Promotion and Authorization Centre (IN-SPACe) het 'n baanbreker 'Oplei die Opleiers'-program bekendgestel om die gebruik van ruimtetegnologieë in landbou te bevorder. Geskep in vennootskap met die Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), Meerut-instituut vir Tegnologie (MIT), nie-regeringsentiteite en akademiese vennote, vind die vyfdaagse kursus—'Gebruik van Ruimtetegnologie vir die Landbousektor'—plaas van 20 tot 24 November by IIT Roorkee. Vinod Kumar, direkteur van promosie by IN-SPACe, het beklemtoon dat hierdie inisiatief breër maatskaplike voordele ondersteun, in ooreenstemming met die 'Antyodaya'-missie en die verbintenis tot die aanwending van gevorderde tegnologie vir beter landboupraktyke, voedselsekerheid en volhoubaarheid. Die kursus bied 'n omvattende kurrikulum met modules wat insluit monitering van landbougrond, opsporing en voorspelling van plae en siektes, skatting van oessaarea en -produksie, analise van verbouingstelsels, grondkartering en -monitering, en evaluering van landboudroogte. Praktiese aktiwiteite sluit in grondmonstername-tegnieke, demonstrasies met hommeltuie en robots, asook die toepassing van afstandswaarneming, GIS en kunsmatige intelligensie (KI) vir plaasbestuur. IN-SPACe dui aan dat die inkorporering van ruimtetegnologie in presisieboerdery, soos die gebruik van satellietdata en ruimtegerigte hulpbronne, boere kan bemagtig met inligting en ongeëwenaarde akkuraatheid in hul praktyke. Die program sluit ook klimaatdata-ontleding, weervoorspelling om oeste te beskerm, identifisering van plantvoedingstekorte, vooruitgang in sensortegnologie en analise in presisieboerdery, en basiese toepassings van fitotrontegnologie in. Ander praktiese onderwerpe sluit in die verwerking van grond, voorbereiding van groeimedium, toetsing van saadontkieming, die bestuur en meting van humiditeit, en die beoordeling van ligblootstelling van gewasse. Bykomende sessies handel oor gewasinventaris en -gesondheid deur optiese metodes, digitale landbou gebaseer op aardwaarneming, globale gewasmonitering, en mikrogolfafstandwaarneming—elkeen met praktiese opleiding. Deelnemers sal ook 'n oorsig kry van ISRO se portale insluitend Bhoonidhi, BHUVAN, VEDAS, en MOSDAC, wat ruimtetegnologie met KI en masjienleer integreer vir omvattende plaasbestuursoplossings.

article_content: Fracking could play a significant role in the next general election, as more than three-quarters of the Conservative Party’s top target seats are now open for oil and gas exploration. Early today, Energy Minister Matthew Hancock struggled on live radio to identify a single village that supports having fracking nearby. Greenpeace has claimed that dozens of marginal constituencies are at risk, prompting some Conservative MPs to call for increased financial compensation for communities potentially chosen as drilling sites. The government has launched the latest bidding round for onshore oil and gas licenses, covering approximately half of the country. Shale gas development will be almost entirely banned in National Parks and other protected countryside and will only be permitted in ‘exceptional circumstances’. This move by the Department for Energy and Climate Change is likely aimed at preventing a potential backlash in rural England ahead of the upcoming election. However, Greenpeace warns that the proposed licensing area also includes freshwater aquifers and encroaches on 10 national parks. The government supports expanding shale gas, arguing it will improve energy security, create jobs, boost the economy, and lower energy prices. Opponents argue fracking is disruptive to rural communities, may trigger minor earthquakes and water pollution, and is at odds with addressing climate change. Matthew Hancock, the recently appointed energy minister, was challenged on BBC Radio 4 to name any community welcoming fracking, but avoided a direct answer. He said, 'There is potential for energy resources under the land, but we must proceed sensitively, particularly by increasing protections for national parks and areas of outstanding natural beauty, while also making use of our resources.' Three regions in Britain—in northern and southern England and Scotland—have been identified by the British Geological Survey as promising for shale gas and oil. Some believe fracking can cut energy bills, create jobs, and improve supply security, but protests continue. This latest licensing round extends the potential reach of fracking, although energy firms are expected to focus on areas with the most accessible resources. Greenpeace analysis suggests 24 of 31 cabinet ministers’ constituencies and 31 out of 40 Conservative target seats are affected by new license areas, along with a significant proportion of Labour-held seats, many national parks, major aquifers, and large cities. Simon Clydesdale of Greenpeace UK argued that launching the licensing round during MPs’ summer break demonstrates the political difficulty of the fracking issue, given how many constituencies could be affected. Conservative MP Eric Ollerenshaw warned fracking will be a serious issue in his Lancaster and Fleetwood constituency at the next election, calling for greater community payback in return for hosting energy development. Mike Jones of the Local Government Association said communities should have the final say via the planning system, and that current compensation offers from the industry are inadequate. A ComRes poll for RenewableUK found little support for fracking among voters in marginal constituencies; more voters across parties prioritize developing renewable energy over shale gas and oil.

article_content: Along Lake Ohrid’s scenic shores in Albania's Pogradec, the Lin Hatchery is working urgently to release this year’s final batch of newly bred Ohrid Trout. The hatchery breeds the Ohrid Trout (Salmo letnica), an indigenous fish facing serious decline due to habitat loss, overfishing, and pollution. Albania and North Macedonia, which both border the lake, have signed agreements to safeguard the trout as tourism and lakeshore development rise. Known as 'Koran' in Albania and 'Ohridska pastrmka' in North Macedonia, the trout is a long-time resident of this ancient lake. Fisherman Artan Male said, 'It doesn’t matter what Albanians or Macedonians call it. This fish, which crosses borders without a passport, is the King of Lake Ohrid, one of the world’s oldest lakes.' Public and private groups in Albania have increased fishery operations, aiming to produce 1.7 million hatchlings in 2023 to support the species. Hatchery worker Kopi Bici commented, 'You have to pay attention to every detail—any mistake could be fatal to the hatchlings.' Fishing is banned from December 1 to early March to protect spawning. Around 60 specially trained fishermen gather eggs and sperm for breeding. Martin Jace, of the Fishermen’s Association, explained that eggs and sperm are combined with fresh water for fertilization. The fertilized eggs are incubated, hatch into larvae, then are carefully raised to fry over six months before they return to the lake. Each step, including monitoring oxygen, temperature, and feeding, is carefully managed. For 1.7 million hatchlings this year, 200 kg of eggs were collected, leading to 3,000 kg of adult fish. After six months, the young fish are released into the lake. Workers, including Jovan Bale, go out in all weather to give the trout a healthy start. 'These are our babies, and they need to be in top shape for lake life,' said Bale. The fish are transported in oxygen-rich containers, brought to the lake’s edge, and quickly released into deeper water. Jace added, 'It’s a race against time—if the water heats up or oxygen runs out, the fish can die. October and November offer the best conditions for release.' However, the long-term future of the trout and the lake’s 145 other endemic species depends on tackling pollution and unchecked development. Locally, Ohrid Trout is a prized dish for both residents and visitors. It’s even said to have been a favorite of the late Queen Elizabeth II, although this is unconfirmed. Chef Blerina Turshina in Tushemisht said, 'If we want to keep the Ohrid trout, we need to work together.' She described it as 'the king of dishes,' enjoyed baked or grilled, with various traditional seasonings. While debates about the fish’s origins come up occasionally, locals share the view: 'It doesn’t matter. It’s the Ohrid trout.'

Die teelplaas teel die Ohrid-forel (Salmo letnica), 'n inheemse vis wat ernstig bedreig word deur habitatverlies, oorbevissing en besoedeling. article_content: Indian Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal recently met Micron Technology CEO Sanjay Mehrotra and YouTube CEO Neal Mohan to discuss expanding their companies' presence in India, highlighting the nation’s economic growth and abundant young talent as key draws. During his trip to the United States, Goyal also held meetings with entrepreneurs and venture capitalists in Silicon Valley, emphasizing India’s vibrant business environment and promising opportunities for investors. A major focus was Micron Technology’s establishment of India’s first semiconductor facility in Gujarat, a $2.7 billion initiative approved by the government in June for setting up a chip testing and packaging unit. Goyal’s agenda in San Francisco included a roundtable with Stanford University academics to explore further collaboration with Indian universities, aiming to boost knowledge exchange and tackle global challenges. He also met chartered accountants from the ICAI’s San Francisco Chapter, noting how their expertise could enhance economic ties between India and the US. On the multilateral front, India joined the US and 12 other Indo-Pacific Economic Framework members in signing an agreement to strengthen supply chain resilience—an effort to cut reliance on China for essential goods. Additionally, India and the US have inked a memorandum of understanding to foster innovation by supporting collaboration among startups, easing regulations, and sharing fundraising strategies. Separately, the Reserve Bank of India imposed stricter requirements on banks for unsecured consumer loans to manage risks associated with fast-growing lending in this segment. Meanwhile, cricketer Mohammed Shami’s outstanding World Cup performance has doubled his endorsement value, with deals now fetching around ₹1 crore each. In another development, the Mines Ministry informed Hindustan Zinc Ltd (HZL) that any significant restructuring by the company must have government clearance.
