article_content: Cleopatra, the last queen of Egypt, most likely died from ingesting a blend of poisons rather than from a snake bite, according to German historian Christoph Schaefer. Schaefer, a professor of ancient history at Trier University, challenges the long-held belief that Cleopatra committed suicide by being bitten by an asp, an Egyptian cobra. After examining ancient historical records and working with toxicologist Dietrich Mebs, Schaefer developed his theory, which is featured in a program about Cleopatra on the German channel ZDF. Schaefer argues that Cleopatra would probably have avoided death by snake, as a cobra bite does not always result in death and tends to cause a slow and painful process. Roman historian Cassius Dio wrote nearly 200 years after Cleopatra's death that she died a 'quiet and pain-free death.' Ancient sources also indicate that Cleopatra's two attendants died alongside her, which would be unlikely in the case of a single snake bite. Additionally, the high August temperatures in Egypt in 30 B.C. would have made it improbable for a snake to remain calm enough to bite on command. Schaefer highlights papyri suggesting that Cleopatra was knowledgeable about poisons and tested them herself. Collaborating with toxicologist Dietrich Mebs, Schaefer proposed that Cleopatra used a concoction of hemlock, wolfsbane, and opium, with opium responsible for producing a 'quiet and deadly sleep.' According to Schaefer, the snake story persisted over centuries primarily due to its prevalence in popular culture, with Cleopatra long portrayed alongside a snake. Early depictions symbolized her passage into the afterlife, but it was not until the 15th century that artists painted her with a snake directly on her body. Shakespeare's 'Antony and Cleopatra' further entrenched the myth of the asp. Cleopatra ruled Egypt from 51 to 30 B.C., as the last pharaoh before the country became a Roman province. She had relationships with Julius Caesar and Mark Antony, accompanying Antony to the Battle of Actium. After their defeat and Antony’s suicide, Cleopatra ended her own life.
translated_content: Cleopatra, die laaste koningin van Egipte, het waarskynlik gesterf deur 'n mengsel van gif in te neem eerder as deur 'n slangbyt, volgens die Duitse historikus Christoph Schaefer. Schaefer, 'n professor in antieke geskiedenis aan die Universiteit van Trier, daag die langbestaande oortuiging uit dat Cleopatra selfmoord gepleeg het deur deur 'n asp, 'n Egiptiese kobra, gebyt te word. Nadat hy antieke historiese bronne bestudeer het en saam met die toksikoloog Dietrich Mebs gewerk het, het Schaefer sy teorie ontwikkel, wat in 'n program oor Cleopatra op die Duitse kanaal ZDF vertoon word. Schaefer beweer dat Cleopatra waarskynlik 'n slangbyt sou vermy het, aangesien 'n kobra se byt nie altyd dodelik is nie en dikwels 'n stadige en pynlike dood veroorsaak. Die Romeinse historikus Cassius Dio het bykans 200 jaar ná Cleopatra se dood geskryf dat sy 'n 'stil en pynvrye dood' gesterf het. Antieke bronne dui ook aan dat Cleopatra se twee bediendes saam met haar gesterf het, wat onwaarskynlik sou wees as 'n enkele slang hulle almal gebyt het. Daarby sou die hoë temperature in Augustus in Egipte in 30 v.C. dit onwaarskynlik gemaak het dat 'n slang kalm genoeg sou bly om te byt. Schaefer beklemtoon papiri wat wys dat Cleopatra van gifte geweet en dit self getoets het. Deur saam met toksikoloog Dietrich Mebs te werk, het Schaefer voorgestel dat Cleopatra 'n mengsel van waterslak, wolfsgif en opium gebruik het, met opium wat 'n 'stil en dodelike slaap' bewerkstellig het. Volgens Schaefer het die slangeboutorie deur die eeue oorleef as gevolg van sy teenwoordigheid in die populêre kultuur en omdat Cleopatra dikwels saam met 'n slang uitgebeeld is. Vroeë uitbeeldings het haar oorgang na die hiernamaals gesimboliseer, terwyl kunstenaars eers in die 15de eeu begin het om haar met 'n slang op haar lyf te skilder. Shakespeare se 'Antony and Cleopatra' het die asp-mite verder gewild gemaak. Cleopatra het van 51 tot 30 v.C. oor Egipte geheers as die laaste farao voordat dit 'n Romeinse provinsie geword het. Sy het verhoudings met Julius Caesar en Markus Antonius gehad, en het Markus Antonius na die Slag van Actium vergesel. Na hul nederlaag en Markus Antonius se selfmoord, het Cleopatra selfmoord gepleeg.

article_content: Channel 4's 'Big Fat Quiz of the Year' has been cleared of wrongdoing, despite receiving hundreds of complaints over jokes made about the Queen and singer Susan Boyle. Ofcom, the UK media regulator, announced yesterday that it would not investigate the show, a decision that surprised MPs and campaigners. The programme, aired on December 30, received 180 complaints to Ofcom and another 150 to Channel 4 after comedians Jack Whitehall and James Corden allegedly made crude jokes about several public figures, including the Queen, Barack Obama, Usain Bolt, and Susan Boyle. Both appeared to be intoxicated during the broadcast. Ofcom explained that the show, which aired after the 9pm watershed and carried a warning for strong language and adult humour, met audience expectations for a satirical program. 'We assessed the complaints and decided not to investigate for a number of reasons,' said Ofcom spokesman Rhys Hurd. 'The potentially offensive material was justified by the context, and Channel 4's annual broadcast of the show since 2007 has established its comedic and satirical nature.' On New Year's Eve, Channel 4 said, 'Big Fat Quiz of the Year is a well-established comedic and satirical review of the year's events, broadcast post-watershed with appropriate warnings.' James Corden later described his role in the show as 'good fun.' However, Conservative MP Conor Burns criticized Ofcom's decision, suggesting it showed the need for a more robust regulatory body. Fellow Tory MP Mark Pritchard also voiced disappointment, arguing the comments went 'beyond the realms of decency.' Ofcom maintained that the program's timing, warnings, and established reputation justified airing content that could offend. Channel 4 executives made no further comment. The article also provides background on Jack Whitehall, noting his successful and privileged upbringing, including his education at The Harrodian School and Marlborough College, and family connections in the entertainment industry.

article_content: Singhara (water chestnut), kuttu (buckwheat), and rajgira (amaranth) are popular, nutritious, and gluten-free choices during Navratri fasting. Understanding their differences and benefits can help you make informed dietary choices, whether you're fasting or seeking healthy alternatives for regular meals. Singhara is packed with potassium, fiber, and vitamins, aiding digestion and supporting heart health. Its cooling properties make it ideal for those sensitive to heat. According to nutritionist Dr. Archana Batra, singhara flour is commonly used in dishes like Singhara Atta Halwa and Singhara Paratha. It suits people with gluten allergies and supports weight management, diabetes control, and skin and heart health. Dt Vidhi Chawla recommends singhara for those who prefer cooling foods or experience heat-related discomfort. Suggested Singhara Recipe: Singhara Flour Pancakes. Ingredients: 1 cup singhara flour, 1 cup grated bottle gourd, chopped coriander, ½ teaspoon salt, 1 teaspoon oil/ghee. Method: Mix all ingredients to form a thick batter, then cook small pancakes on a non-stick pan with minimal oil. Kuttu (buckwheat) is rich in amino acids, fiber, and minerals. Dr. Batra notes it supplies sustained energy and can help regulate blood sugar, making it suitable for people with diabetes. Kuttu is also gluten-free and suits a variety of tasty dishes such as Kuttu Ki Puri, Kuttu Ka Dosa, and Kuttu Ki Khichdi. Moderation is key, and its versatility ensures a well-rounded diet. Dr. Hansaji notes it's thyroid- and diabetes-friendly. Suggested Kuttu Recipe: Kuttu Upma. Ingredients: 1 cup kuttu flour, ½ cup boiled diced potatoes, ½ cup boiled and mashed arbi (colocasia), rock salt, 1–2 tablespoons ghee. Method: Heat ghee, roast kuttu flour until golden and aromatic, add potatoes, arbi, and salt, mix and cook briefly. Rajgira (amaranth) is a gluten-free grain high in protein, fiber, and micronutrients. Dr. Batra states it's an excellent source of calcium and beneficial for bone health and those with joint issues due to its anti-inflammatory properties. Common rajgira dishes include Rajgira Paratha, Rajgira Ladoo, and Rajgira Sheera. Rajgira is suitable for those with gluten allergies or celiac disease, and its fiber supports digestive and gut health. Suggested Rajgira Recipe: Rajgira Porridge. Ingredients: ½ cup rajgira flour, 2 cups milk/almond milk, 1–2 tbsp honey or maple syrup, cardamom powder, optional nuts and dried fruits. Method: Boil milk, whisk in rajgira flour, cook while stirring until thickened, add sweetener, cardamom, nuts, and serve. The choice among singhara, kuttu, and rajgira depends on individual health needs and preferences. Experts advise incorporating all three for varied nutrition and consulting a healthcare provider for personalized guidance. As Dr. Hansaji recommends, include these with other millets and always practice moderation to avoid health imbalances.

article_content: A World War II-era P-51 Mustang plane, the 'Galloping Ghost,' crashed during the National Championship Air Races in Reno, Nevada, on Friday, killing seven people at the scene, including the pilot, and injuring almost 70 others. Two more victims died later at local hospitals. The plane was fitted with data and video recorders, rare for its age, and investigators hope this information will help determine the accident's cause. Mark Rosekind of the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) called the discovery of the devices significant. Howard Plagens, leading the NTSB investigation, said a device recorded key data such as altitude, latitude, and oil pressure, along with an outward-facing video camera. Memory cards found at the site may contain data from these devices and will be analyzed in Washington, D.C. Investigators already possess some data from the recording device, transmitted via telemetry. Additional debris recovered includes parts of the plane's tail, an elevator trim tab, and camera fragments. The crash site was organized in a grid to aid the investigation. Authorities are working to determine if recovered parts belonged to the plane piloted by 74-year-old Jimmy Leeward. Rosekind stated that Leeward did not issue a Mayday call, as some reports previously suggested. The cause of the crash is still undetermined, but investigators are focusing on the plane's elevator trim tab, which reportedly broke apart prior to the accident, according to photos. Investigators are also reviewing extensive video footage from the scene. A preliminary report is due Friday, while the complete investigation may last six to nine months. Rosekind said the goal is to determine both what happened and why, to prevent future tragedies. Those who died include pilot Jimmy Leeward, Michael Joseph Wogan (22) of Phoenix—an Arizona State University graduate attending with his father—and George and Wendy Hewitt, members of Cascade EAA Warbirds Squadron 2. Wogan, who lived with muscular dystrophy and used a wheelchair, was remembered as adventurous and independent. His father was seriously injured. Reno Mayor Bob Cashell noted this is the first time in forty years that spectators have been killed at the air races. Remaining rounds were canceled. Renown Medical Center received 34 patients, with four critical as of Sunday. Two died at the hospital. Renown South Meadows Medical Center treated and released five people. St. Mary’s Hospital received 28 patients; as of Sunday, two were in critical condition and six in serious condition. The rest were released.
translated_content: 'n Tweede Wêreldoorlog-era P-51 Mustang-vliegtuig, die 'Galloping Ghost', het Vrydag tydens die Nasionale Kampioenskap Lugwedlope in Reno, Nevada, neergestort. Sewe mense, insluitend die loods, is op die toneel dood, en byna 70 ander is beseer. Nog twee slagoffers is later in plaaslike hospitale oorlede. Die vliegtuig was toegerus met data- en video-opnemers, wat ongewoon is vir sy ouderdom, en ondersoekers hoop hierdie inligting kan help om die oorsaak van die ongeluk te bepaal. Mark Rosekind van die Nasionale Vervoerveiligheidsraad (NTSB) het die ontdekking van hierdie toestelle as beduidend beskryf. Howard Plagens, wat die NTSB-ondersoek lei, het gesê 'n toestel het sleuteldatapunten soos hoogte, breedtegraad en oliedruk opgeneem, en daar was ook 'n buitegerigte videokamera. Geheuekaarte wat by die toneel gevind is, kan data van hierdie toestelle bevat en sal in Washington, D.C. ontleed word. Ondersoekers besit reeds sommige data van die opnemer, wat via telemetrie oorgedra is. Ander wrakstukke wat herwin is, sluit dele van die vliegtuig se stert, 'n hysvlak-trimblad en kamerafragmente in. Die ongelukstoneel is in 'n rooster georganiseer om die ondersoek te vergemaklik. Owerhede probeer vasstel of die herwonne dele aan die vliegtuig behoort het wat deur 74-jarige Jimmy Leeward bestuur is. Rosekind het bevestig dat Leeward nie ‘n noodsein (“Mayday”) uitgestuur het soos sommige vroeër beweer het nie. Die oorsaak van die ongeluk is steeds onbekend, maar ondersoekers fokus op die vliegtuig se hysvlak-trimblad wat glo voor die ongeluk losgekom het, soos op foto's gesien kan word. Ondersoekers hersien ook uitgebreide video-opnames van die toneel. ’n Voorlopige verslag word Vrydag verwag, terwyl die volledige ondersoek ses tot nege maande kan duur. Rosekind sê die doel is om vas te stel wat gebeur het en hoekom, sodat soortgelyke tragedies in die toekoms voorkom kan word. Die oorledenes sluit in: loods Jimmy Leeward, Michael Joseph Wogan (22) van Phoenix—'n Arizona State University-gegradueerde wat saam met sy pa die byeenkoms bygewoon het—en George en Wendy Hewitt, lede van Cascade EAA Warbirds Squadron 2. Wogan, wat met spierdistrofie geleef het en in ’n rolstoel was, is as avontuurlustig en selfstandig onthou. Sy pa is ernstig beseer. Reno se burgemeester, Bob Cashell, het gesê dit is die eerste keer in veertig jaar dat toeskouers by die lugwedlope dood is. Die oorblywende rondes is gekanselleer. Renown Mediese Sentrum het 34 pasiënte ontvang, waarvan vier Sondag in ‘n kritieke toestand was. Twee is in die hospitaal oorlede. Renown South Meadows Mediese Sentrum het vyf mense behandel en ontslaan. St. Mary’s Hospitaal het 28 pasiënte ontvang; teen Sondag was twee in ‘n kritieke toestand en ses in ‘n ernstige toestand. Die res is ontslaan.

article_content: Singapore-based technology company Sea announced an unexpected loss for the third quarter, caused by increased spending to expand its e-commerce business. The company’s shares dropped more than 17% following the news. Facing stronger competition from rivals like Alibaba's Lazada, ByteDance’s TikTok, and newcomer Temu (from PDD Holdings), Sea has intensified its investments, particularly in e-commerce live streaming—an approach popular in China. CEO Forrest Li confirmed plans to keep raising investments during the holiday shopping season to strengthen the company’s regional leadership. For the quarter ending September 30, Sea reported a loss of 26 cents per share, missing analysts’ expectations of a 3 cent profit per share and ending a three-quarter stretch of profitability. Despite the loss, total revenue rose 4.9% compared to last year, reaching $3.3 billion. The e-commerce division saw over 16% growth. Sea, with a market valuation of $26 billion, expanded rapidly during the pandemic, but is now adjusting to more challenging economic conditions, including implementing cost-cutting measures and staff reductions.

Die maatskappy se aandeelprys het meer as 17% gedaal ná die nuus. Stygende mededinging van mededingers soos Alibaba se Lazada, ByteDance se TikTok en die nuwe speler Temu (van PDD Holdings), het Sea genoop om sy beleggings te versterk, veral in regstreekse e-handelstroming—'n benadering wat gewild is in China. Uitvoerende hoof Forrest Li het bevestig dat die maatskappy beplan om belegging in die komende vakansieseisoen nog verder op te stoot om sy leiersposisie in die streek te versterk. Vir die kwartaal wat op 30 September geëindig het, het Sea 'n verlies van 26 sent per aandeel aangeteken, wat ontleders se verwagting van 'n wins van 3 sent per aandeel gemis het en 'n reeks van drie winsgewende kwartale beëindig het. article_content: Chancellor George Osborne announced today that the Government will proceed with budget cuts to police services, stating that increasing spending on deep-rooted social issues alone is not the solution. He asserted that reforming police forces is needed to improve officers' presence in communities and that public safety should not be measured only by officer numbers. Osborne reaffirmed plans for continuing cuts, echoing former US police chief Bill Bratton, who believes that multiple arrests do not resolve underlying social problems. President Obama commended Prime Minister David Cameron on the handling of riots during a recent phone call, expressing optimism that stability would continue. Osborne's position has been criticized by figures such as London Mayor Boris Johnson, who argued that there were too few officers on the streets during the recent riots and acts of looting. President Obama publicly praised the actions of British police during the unrest. Bill Bratton, former chief of the NYPD and LAPD, was brought in by David Cameron to offer advice on restoring order. Bratton emphasized that making numerous arrests isn't a sustainable solution, advocating instead that youth offenders and gang members should be deterred by strong law enforcement and suitable penalties. Known for 'zero-tolerance' strategies, he called for assertive policing and, where necessary, the escalation of force. Bratton stated, 'You can't arrest your way out of the problem. While arresting the most violent offenders is necessary, many issues require broader social solutions.' Police forces nationwide reported over 2,000 arrests, aided by public initiatives encouraging people to report looters. Reports last week indicated that Cameron had approached Bratton to discuss Metropolitan Police leadership, and Bratton has already become a government advisor on dealing with gangs. However, concerns have been raised regarding his eligibility: current UK legislation requires the Met Commissioner to be a 'constable' with indefinite leave to remain, which could make Bratton ineligible as a US citizen. The government also aims to restrict the number of people granted such status to control immigration. A poll conducted by The Independent found that 54% of respondents felt the Prime Minister failed to react quickly enough during the riots, as Cameron was on holiday when troubles began. A former London gang leader commented that the riots stemmed from youth frustration rather than organized criminal intent. Bratton stressed the need for young offenders to understand early the consequences of crime, telling The Telegraph, 'Criminals must fear law enforcement’s ability to disrupt their activities and enforce the law.' He described police powers to stop, talk, search, arrest, and use necessary force. The application deadline for Met Commissioner, left vacant after Sir Paul Stephenson's resignation linked to the phone hacking scandal, was extended in light of the riots. Bratton has previous consulting experience with UK police and has dealt with gangs and drug crime in US cities, utilizing increased recruitment and resources. In Los Angeles, he emphasized local responsibility for tackling crime. Bratton left the LAPD in 2009 after reducing crime rates and now leads Kroll, a security firm. The Home Office states that candidates for Met Commissioner must be British citizens. Cameron recently discussed Bratton’s potential advisory role in addressing gang crime, with further meetings planned. Some UK police leaders, such as Ian Hanson from the Greater Manchester Police Federation, criticized the move to bring in a foreign advisor, emphasizing the importance of local knowledge for policing. Hanson noted that Bratton increased police numbers in New York, a challenge in the UK given planned cuts. Nonetheless, Osborne expressed support for Bratton’s advice, underlining reforms making police more visible and effective, rather than focusing solely on numbers. Osborne told BBC Radio 4, 'We must address longstanding social problems and support communities that have fallen behind. The debate isn’t just about police numbers but about delivering an effective police service. Guidance from experts like Bill Bratton is key to tackling issues such as gang culture, but ultimately, the challenge is broader than police budgets—it’s about helping those who have been overlooked in our society.'
translated_content: Kanselier George Osborne het vandag aangekondig dat die regering voortgaan met begrotingsbesnoeiings op polisiëring en gesê dat om net meer geld aan diepgewortelde sosiale probleme te bestee, nie die oplossing is nie. Hy het gesê dat hervorming van die polisie nodig is om hul teenwoordigheid in gemeenskappe te verbeter en dat openbare veiligheid nie slegs aan getalle gemeet moet word nie. Osborne het die voortgesette besnoeiings bekragtig en die mening van voormalige Amerikaanse polisiehoof Bill Bratton beaam, wat glo veelvuldige inhegtenisnemings los nie onderliggende sosiale probleme op nie. President Obama het tydens ‘n onlangse oproep aan Eerste Minister David Cameron die hantering van die onrus deur die Britse polisie geprys en hoop uitgespreek dat stabiliteit verder sal heers. Osborne se standpunt is gekritiseer deur figure soos Londen se burgemeester Boris Johnson, wat aangevoer het dat daar te min polisiebeamptes op die strate was tydens die onlangse gewelddadigheid en plundery. President Obama het die Britse polisie se optrede tydens die onrus openlik geprys. Bill Bratton, voormalige hoof van die NYPD en LAPD, is deur David Cameron genader om advies te gee oor herstel van orde. Bratton het benadruk dat baie arrestasies op hul eie nie ‘n volhoubare oplossing is nie en het voorgestel jeugoortreders en bendelede moet afgeweer word deur stewige wetstoepassing en passende strawwe. Hy staan bekend om sy 'zero tolerance'-strategieë en bepleit selfversekerde polisiëring en, waar nodig, meer dwingende optrede. Bratton het gesê: 'Jy kan nie die probleem met net arrestasies oplos nie. Terwyl arrestasies van die mees gewelddadige oortreders nodig is, moet baie van die probleme breër aanspreek word.' Polisiekantore landwyd het meer as 2,000 arrestasies aangemeld, met suksesvolle veldtogte om looters aan te dui. Berigte lui Cameron het Bratton genader om moontlik die Metropolitaanse Polisie te lei, en hy dien reeds as regeringsadviseur oor bende-kwessies. Tog bestaan daar kommer oor Bratton se geskiktheid: Britse wetgeving vereis die Met-kommissaris moet 'n konstabel wees met permanente verblyfreg, wat Bratton as ‘n Amerikaanse burger moontlik nie is nie. Die regering probeer ook hierdie status beperk om immigrasie te kontroleer. ‘n Meningspeiling deur The Independent toon 54% van respondente meen die Eerste Minister het nie vinnig genoeg gereageer tydens die onrus nie, aangesien Cameron op daardie tydstip met vakansie was. ‘n Voormalige Londense bendeleier sê die onrus spruit meestal uit jeugfrustrasie en nie georganiseerde misdaad nie. Bratton benadruk die belang daarvan dat jong oortreders vroeg die gevolge van misdaad moet begryp—hy het aan The Telegraph gesê: 'Kriminele moet bang wees vir wetstoepassing se krag om hul aktiwiteite te stop.' Hy noem die polisie se magte om te keer, praat, deursoek, arresteer en, indien nodig, geweld aan te wend. Die sluitingsdatum vir aansoeke as Met-kommissaris, wat vakant geword het na sir Paul Stephenson se bedanking oor die foon-afluisterskandaal, is uitgestel weens die onrus. Bratton het voorheen Britste polisiemagte geadviseer en het misdaad in die VSA aansienlik verminder deur groter hulpbronne. In Los Angeles het hy die klem gelê op verantwoordelikheid in die gemeenskap vir misdaadbestryding. Bratton verlaat die LAPD in 2009 na dalende misdaadsyfers en is nou voorsitter van Kroll, ‘n sekuriteitsfirma. Die Home Office stel dit duidelik dat kandidate vir Met-kommissaris Britse burgers moet wees. Cameron het onlangs verder met Bratton gesels oor advies t.o.v. bendes, met nog vergaderings in beplanning. Sommige polisie-leiers soos Ian Hanson van Greater Manchester Police Federation het die advies van ‘n buitelander bevraagteken en onderstreep hoe belangrik plaaslike kennis is. Hanson noem dat Bratton polisiegetalle in New York verhoog het, ‘n moeilike uitdaging in Brittanje weens besnoeiings. Ten spyte hiervan ondersteun Osborne Bratton se advies en sê die hervorming behoort op effektiwiteit en sigbaarheid te fokus, nie blote getalle nie. Osborne het aan BBC Radio 4 gesê: 'Ons moet diepgaande sosiale probleme takel en agtergeblewe gemeenskappe help. Dit gaan nie net oor polisiekgetalle nie, maar om ‘n effektiewe diens te lewer. Kundigheid van mense soos Bill Bratton is belangrik om bende-kwessies aan te pak, maar die uitdaging is groter as net die polisie se begroting—dit gaan ook daaroor om verwaarloosde mense te help om weer ‘n rol in die gemeenskap te vind.'

article_content: Three remarkable New York City apartments, once owned by the reclusive heiress Huguette Clark, are now on the market for $55 million. Located at 907 Fifth Avenue near 72nd Street, the three units—spanning a total of 42 rooms—are described as 'diamonds in the rough' needing substantial renovations, and offer a glimpse into New York's Gilded Age. Two apartments occupy the entire 10,000-square-foot eighth floor, while the third is a 5,000-square-foot residence on half of the twelfth floor. All boast sweeping views of Central Park's Conservatory Water, the pond made famous by the 'Stuart Little' story and close to the Alice in Wonderland statue. The sale comes amidst a legal dispute over Clark's $400 million estate. Clark, who passed away in May of last year at age 104, left behind two sharply different wills. The first, signed at age 98, left nearly all of her assets to her family. However, just six weeks later, she signed a second will that earmarked funds for a California art museum, gave $36 million to her nurse, and bequeathed a $40 million Monet painting to the Corcoran Gallery of Art in Washington. The latter also included smaller gifts to her godchild, doctor, attorney, and accountant. Clark's family has accused these individuals of unduly influencing her. Proceeds from the apartment sales will first pay estate expenses; the remaining funds will go to the party prevailing in court. Huguette Clark also owned a $100 million oceanfront estate in Santa Barbara, California, and a $24 million country home in New Canaan, Connecticut. Interior photos of the Fifth Avenue apartments have not been released, as Clark's vast collection of dolls and fine artwork is still being removed. Brokers note that with the right buyer, the two eighth-floor apartments could be combined into a single luxurious residence. Floorplans value the three units at up to $70 million. Huguette Clark led an intensely private life, barely appearing in public—the last known photograph of her was taken over 80 years ago. She spent the last two decades of her life in New York hospitals, yet continued to pay over $300,000 yearly in apartment upkeep. Born in Paris in 1906, Clark was the youngest child of U.S. Senator William Andrews Clark, a copper magnate once second in wealth only to John D. Rockefeller. Notoriously, he married in secret at 62, fathered Huguette with his much younger wife, and left her a sizeable fortune. Huguette married William Gower in 1928, but the couple divorced less than two years later and had no children. When Senator Clark died in 1925, his vast fortune was split between all his children, and Huguette moved into 907 Fifth Avenue with her mother after their 121-room mansion was demolished. On her 21st birthday, she received the equivalent of $3.6 billion in today’s dollars. The Clark family has long captivated the media, both for their wealth and Huguette’s mysterious seclusion. Her Santa Barbara estate has stood vacant since 1963, now valued at over $100 million.

article_content: Earbuds offer a major advantage over headphones because their compact size and portability make them easy to take anywhere. Their nimble design can be especially helpful when space is limited or when integrating them into setups like virtual reality (VR) gaming. Modern gaming earbuds come in various types, including both wired and wireless models. They are engineered to meet key gaming needs such as low latency, comfort, and immersive sound. Whether you game on PC, console, VR, or mobile, these earbuds keep you connected. Our experts thoroughly test and compare products so you can choose the best option. Here are several gaming earbuds that stand out: Razer Hammerhead Pro HyperSpeed: These earbuds prioritize versatile connectivity—either via Bluetooth or through a dongle for PC or consoles. Available in separate versions for Xbox and PS5, they deliver good sound quality though the noise cancellation is not the best. Sony InZone Buds: Designed for PlayStation, PC, and mobile gaming, these provide Bluetooth or USB-C dongle connectivity. They excel in sound quality and have Sony’s strong noise cancellation, allowing for distraction-free gaming. Comfort and battery life are also strong points. GTW 270 Hybrid: These buds offer wide compatibility and work with most devices except Xbox. The provided USB-C dongle minimizes latency but disables the use of the built-in microphone. Cloud Earbuds II: Despite the move away from headphone jacks, wired earbuds like the Cloud Earbuds II deliver reliable, latency-free connections. They feature a 3-foot tangle-free cable, but the unique ear tips might not fit all users. Final Earbuds: Targeted at gamers who need to hear every detail, these headphones are ideal for immersive VR gaming and ensure connectivity remains stable. Penta Driver P50: Appealing to audiophiles and gamers, these have five drivers per earbud and multiple ear tip choices. They provide lightweight comfort and very clear sound for extended play. Hecate GX07: Distinguished by bold aesthetics like winged doors and RGB lighting, these wireless earbuds offer clear sound, active noise cancellation, and easy-to-use microphones. Turtle Beach Battle Buds: An excellent budget option, these wired earbuds feature an inline microphone and are compatible with many devices for in-game chat. Audio quality is functional and their compatibility is a highlight. SXFI Trio: These USB-C earbuds by Creative use Super X-Fi technology to deliver spatial audio on Android devices. Using a 3.5mm dongle with PCs disables the spatial audio feature. Wireless earbuds for gaming cover a range of designs and features, meeting different needs. The Razer Hammerhead Pro HyperSpeed and Sony InZone Buds stand out for compatibility and performance, while wired earbuds maintain relevance for their lag-free, stable connection—especially on devices with a headphone jack.

article_content: Carol Thatcher returned to the UK last night to help prepare for her mother, Margaret Thatcher’s funeral. Carol, who lives in Klosters, Switzerland, arrived at the family’s Belgravia home shortly before 7pm, accompanied by her boyfriend Marco Grass in a black Jaguar. She was met on the steps by her twin brother, Mark Thatcher, who comforted her and quickly led her inside. Wearing a black shawl, black trousers, and large sunglasses, the 59-year-old Carol appeared emotional. Later, Carol and Mark, with their partners Marco Grass and Sarah Thatcher, were seen outside the house. This was the Thatcher twins' first public appearance together in ten years, since their father's funeral. The family briefly gathered on the steps, united in mourning as funeral preparations continued. Meanwhile, ITV declined to air a full news special for Lady Thatcher’s funeral, choosing instead to cover it during their daytime show 'This Morning.' Presenters Holly Willoughby and Phillip Schofield will provide live updates by linking to journalist Alastair Stewart. ITV reportedly made this decision due to the estimated £500,000 cost, leading to disappointment among newsroom staff. If approved, the special would have featured Alastair Stewart and Julie Etchingham. By contrast, the BBC will provide more extensive live coverage with a three-hour special hosted by veteran broadcaster David Dimbleby. It has also been reported that Italy’s Prime Minister Silvio Berlusconi will not attend the funeral, despite repeated requests for an invitation. Italy will instead be represented by acting prime minister Mario Monti.

article_content: Widespread flooding in Pakistan has left around 4 million people without homes, forcing many to endure harsh conditions outdoors. Karachi-based aid workers Faisal Kapadia and Awab Alvi have been deeply moved by the plight of thousands of people living on muddy roadsides with no proper sanitation. For three weeks, relentless floods have submerged large parts of the country, destroying hundreds of health facilities and putting millions at risk of outbreaks from unsafe water. Although officials have reported between 1,500 and 1,600 deaths, Kapadia believes the true toll will become clearer as waters withdraw. Turning his passion for off-road driving into lifesaving action, Kapadia teamed with the Karachi 4x4 Offroaders Club to deliver crucial supplies across difficult terrain. The group has so far sent out more than 100 tents, eight truckloads of food, and at least 400 food hampers stocked with essentials such as flour, rice, oil, salt, tea, and water to flood survivors in places like Sukkur. Relief work has been grueling for volunteers, with relentless heat, poor hygiene, risk of disease, and large crowds making distribution hazardous. Kapadia shared vivid memories of children chasing aid trucks for water, highlighting the population’s desperation. As diseases like diarrhea, scabies, and respiratory infections spread, health authorities and the UN are appealing for $200 million in additional aid. The response has been slower compared to past disasters, which Kapadia attributes to donation fatigue, though he stresses that the crisis demands immediate action. Despite extreme challenges, Alvi says volunteering in the crisis was vital: 'Someone has to take the next step.'

article_content: With more than 1,000 hot springs beneath about 80% of Hungary, visiting a spa is an essential part of any trip. The therapeutic waters of Hungary were discovered by the Romans over 2,000 years ago, but it was the Ottoman Turks in the 16th century who developed the social spa culture that flourishes today. Unlike the typical image of a luxurious spa, Hungarian spas focus on health and well-being, often favoring functionality over opulence. Some facilities charge a small fee for towels, usually less than $2, but the scenic surroundings and affordable admission, often under $15 for a full day, more than compensate. Spas offer a major social hub: while the French gather in cafes, Hungarians catch up on news and play chess while soaking at the vast Szechenyi complex in Budapest, one of the largest and most beautiful in Europe. The mineral-rich thermal water is believed to have restorative properties. Egerszalok, about 80 miles east of Budapest, features the unique 'Salt Hill,' named for white mounds formed by centuries of mineral deposits. Guests can relax in the outdoor springs or use the 17 pools at the neighboring Saliris Resort. Nearby Eger offers a charming Turkish bath from the 16th century, vivid mosaics, and active outdoor pools. Traveling another 40 miles east past Bukki National Park leads to Miskolctapolca's Cave Bath, where warm thermal water flows through impressive limestone caverns. During summer, the site expands with outdoor family pools. West of Budapest lies Heviz Lake, Europe’s largest thermal lake, just past Lake Balaton. The 10-acre lake, replenished by hot springs every three days, is surrounded by woodland and parks. Swimmers share the waters with ducks and water lilies—and must tolerate a hint of sulfur from the minerals. Inside the spa complex above the lake, visitors find thermal pools, mud baths, and wellness treatments. For an even larger experience, Hajduszoboszlo houses Hungarospa, Europe’s most extensive bath complex, with an Aquapark, indoor thermal baths, themed pools, and vast outdoor swimming areas. Its Aqua Palace offers 20 differently themed pools, from Roman bath styles to tropical designs, and an immense pirate ship play area for children. In Bukfurdo, 130 miles west of Budapest, Hungary’s second-largest spa combines 32 pools in a 35-acre area, a sauna fitting 150, paddling pools for children, and Greenfield Golf, Hungary’s first 18-hole championship golf course. In Szeged, 100 miles south of Budapest, the Anna Thermal Bath features neo-Renaissance architecture and reflects vintage spa elegance. Across the Tisza River, Napfenyfurdo Aquapolis has Europe’s longest year-round water slide, adventure pools, and wellness facilities. Both adults and children find entertainment and relaxation. Mary Novakovich, an award-winning travel journalist, wrote this guide. CNN Travel occasionally features sponsored material from the destinations covered but retains full editorial control.
translated_content: Met meer as 1 000 warmwaterbronne onder ongeveer 80% van Hongarye, is 'n besoek aan 'n spa 'n moet-ervaring vir enige reisiger. Die terapeutiese waters is meer as 2 000 jaar gelede deur die Romeine ontdek, maar dit was die Ottomaanse Turke wat in die 16de eeu die sosiale spa-kultuur ontwikkel het wat vandag floreer. Anders as die tipiese beeld van luuksheid, fokus Hongaarse spas op gesondheid en welsyn, dikwels meer funksioneel as luuks. Sommige fasiliteite vra 'n klein fooi vir handdoeke, gewoonlik minder as $2, maar die pragtige omgewing en bekostigbare toegang, dikwels onder $15 per dag, maak dit heeltemal die moeite werd. Spas is 'n belangrike sosiale bymekaarkomplek: terwyl die Franse in hul kafee's kuier, gesels Hongare en speel skaak in die warm water van die Szechenyi-kompleks in Boedapest, een van die grootste en mooiste in Europa. Die mineraalryke termiese water is glo herstelbevorderend. Egerszalok, sowat 130 km oos van Boedapest, het die unieke 'Salt Hill', vernoem na die wit heuwels wat oor eeue deur mineraalafsettings gevorm is. Gaste kan in die buitelugbronne ontspan of die 17 swembaddens by die aangrensende Saliris-oord geniet. Nabygeleë Eger bied 'n Turkse bad uit die 16de eeu, helder mosaïeke en lewendige buiteswembaddens. As jy nog 64 km oos ry, verby die Bukki Nasionale Park, bereik jy die Miskolctapolca-grotbad, waar warm termiese water deur indrukwekkende kalksteengrotte vloei. Gedurende die somer brei die terrein uit met buitelug-gesinspooie. Wes van Boedapest lê die Heviz-meer, die grootste termiese meer in Europa, net verby die Balatonmeer. Hierdie 4-hektare meer word elke drie dae deur warmwaterbronne hernu en is omring deur bome en parkgronde. Swemmers deel die water met eende en waterlelies—en moet aan 'n tikkie swaelreuk gewoond raak. Binne die spa-kompleks bo die meer is daar termiese swembaddens, modderbaddens en ander welstandsbehandelings. Vir 'n nog groter ervaring is Hungarospa in Hajduszoboszlo die grootste badkompleks in Europa, met 'n Aquapark, binnenshuise termiese baddens, temaswembaddens en enorme buitelug-swembadareas. Die Aqua Palace het 20 temaswembaddens van Romaans tot tropies, en 'n groot seerowerskip-speelarea vir kinders. By Bukfurdo, 210 km wes van Boedapest, is Hongarye se tweede grootste spa met 32 baddens op 'n 14 hektaar terrein, 'n sauna vir 150, kinderplonsbaddens en Greenfield Golf, die land se eerste 18-putjie kampioengholfbaan. In Szeged, 161 km suid van Boedapest, bied die Anna Termiese Bad neo-Renaissance argitektuur en die atmosfeer van 'n klassieke spa. Oorkant die Tisza-rivier lê Napfenyfurdo Aquapolis, met Europa se langste jaarlikse waterskyfie, avontuurpoele en welstandsgeriewe. Daar is iets vir beide volwassenes en kinders. Mary Novakovich, bekroonde reisjoernalis, het hierdie gids saamgestel. CNN Travel bevat soms borgskappe van bestemmings in hul artikels, maar behou volledige redaksionele beheer.

article_content: Snowstorms swept across New England on Wednesday, grounding flights, closing schools, and making travel dangerous for residents already worn down by winter weather. Massachusetts Governor Duval Patrick declared a state of emergency, activating 250 National Guard members as a precaution while authorities warned of blizzard conditions across the state and into southern New Hampshire. "The wind is blowing very hard—that's the most unpleasant part," said Bonnie Sashin of Brookline, Massachusetts. "It's blowing ice into your face." Forecasters predicted accumulation in scattered areas across Massachusetts, Connecticut, Rhode Island, New Hampshire, and Vermont could reach up to 34 inches, with most areas expecting 8 to 16 inches of snow. The heaviest snowfall was reported at 2 to 3 inches per hour, according to the National Weather Service. In Brattleboro, Vermont, some residents traveled on snow-packed streets using cross-country skis, while others worked to clear driveways and sidewalks, said resident Caleb Clark. More than 15,000 homes lost power across Massachusetts, with thousands affected in Plymouth County by a transmission-line failure, according to the National Grid utility. The most impacted areas included Plymouth, Bristol, Essex, Norfolk, and Suffolk counties. "This is the second major storm in less than three weeks," said Christopher E. Root, senior vice president of electricity operations at National Grid. "We ask our customers to be patient as our crews work in difficult conditions to restore service as safely and quickly as possible." Boston Mayor Thomas M. Menino announced the city’s snow emergency and parking ban would end at 9 a.m. Thursday, but public schools would remain closed while road clearing continued. He encouraged residents to use public transportation. Amtrak suspended services between New York and Boston and between Springfield, Massachusetts, and New Haven, Connecticut due to extreme weather and fallen trees. "At this moment, every state except Florida has snow on the ground—even Hawaii," said CNN meteorologist Sean Morris. Cleanup was slowed by strong winds, especially along the New England coast. Heavier snow was expected to move north along the coast, with storms leaving southern Maine by Wednesday night. New York Mayor Michael Bloomberg said the city's 'weather emergency' order was lifted as crews finished clearing streets; only 30 vehicles were towed during the storm, a stark improvement from last month's blizzard, when thousands were stranded. The mayor emphasized that the city was better prepared this time. Over 1,700 flights were canceled at the New York area’s three major airports and hundreds more at Boston’s Logan International Airport. Thomas Bosco, general manager at LaGuardia Airport, said airlines canceled flights ahead of the storm to avoid the widespread delays of last month. Philadelphia declared a snow emergency Tuesday night, with schools there and in Boston closed. Non-emergency state employees in Massachusetts were told not to report to work Wednesday. However, New York City public schools stayed open, though field trips were canceled. Since 1978, New York public schools have closed only six times, totaling eight days. In the South, normally busy cities like Atlanta and Charlotte experienced rare snow and ice this week. AirTran Airways spokesman Christopher White said the airline was working quickly to return operations to normal at Atlanta’s airport, after canceling over 90 flights Wednesday and over 260 Tuesday. Delta Air Lines also canceled 1,200 flights Wednesday and 80 for Thursday because of Northeast snow, but Atlanta operations resumed as normal. CNN’s Chad Myers, Jason Kessler, Dave Alsup, Rob Marciano, Tristan Smith, Moni Basu, Holly Yan, Andy Rose, Nick Valencia, and Brian Walker contributed to this report.
translated_content: Sneeustorms het Woensdag oor New England getrek, wat vlugte tot stilstand gebring, skole gesluit en reis gevaarlik gemaak het vir inwoners wat reeds moeg is van die winterweer. Massachusetts-goewerneur Duval Patrick het 'n noodtoestand verklaar en 250 lede van die Nasionale Wag ontplooi as 'n voorsorgmaatreël, terwyl owerhede gewaarsku het oor sneeustormtoestande in die staat en suidelike New Hampshire. "Die wind waai baie hard—dis die onaangenaamste deel," sê Bonnie Sashin van Brookline, Massachusetts. "Dit waai ys in jou gesig." Voorspellers het berig dat opbou in verspreide areas oor Massachusetts, Connecticut, Rhode Island, New Hampshire, en Vermont tot 86 sentimeter kan bereik, met meeste areas wat tussen 20 en 40 sentimeter sneeu verwag. Die swaarste sneeuval het 5 tot 8 sentimeter per uur bereik, volgens die Nasionale Weerburo. In Brattleboro, Vermont, het sommige inwoners met langafstandski's op sneeubedekte strate gereis, terwyl ander probeer het om opritte en sypaadjies skoon te maak, sê inwoner Caleb Clark. Meer as 15,000 huishoudings het sonder krag gesit in Massachusetts, met duisende in Plymouth County wat geraak is deur 'n transmissielynonderbreking, volgens die National Grid nutsmaatskappy. Die ergste getrefte areas was Plymouth, Bristol, Essex, Norfolk en Suffolk. "Dit is die tweede groot storm in minder as drie weke," sê Christopher E. Root, senior vise-president van elektrisiteitsbedrywighede by National Grid. "Ons vra ons kliënte om geduldig te wees terwyl ons spanne in moeilike toestande werk om diens so veilig en vinnig as moontlik te herstel." Die burgemeester van Boston, Thomas M. Menino, het aangekondig die stad se sneeunoodeen ban op parkering sal Donderdag om 9vm opgehef word, maar openbare skole bly gesluit terwyl paaie skoongemaak word. Hy het inwoners aangemoedig om openbare vervoer te gebruik. Amtrak het treindienste tussen New York en Boston, asook tussen Springfield, Massachusetts, en New Haven, Connecticut, opgeskort weens uiterste weer en omgevalde bome. "Op die oomblik het elke deelstaat behalwe Florida sneeu op die grond—even Hawaii," sê CNN-weervoorspeller Sean Morris. Skoonmaakwerk is vertraag deur sterk winde, veral langs die New England-kus. Swaar sneeu is verwag om noord langs die kus aan te beweeg, terwyl storms suidelike Maine teen Woensdagnag verlaat. New York se burgemeester Michael Bloomberg het gesê die stad se noodordonnansie is opgehef toe spanne paaie skoongemaak het; slegs 30 voertuie is weggesleep, 'n groot verbetering teenoor laasmaand toe duisende gestrand was. Hy het beklemtoon die stad was hierdie keer beter voorbereid. Meer as 1,700 vlugte is gekanselleer by die drie groot lughawens in New York, met honderde by Boston se Logan-lughawe. Thomas Bosco, algemene bestuurder by LaGuardia, het gesê lugdienste het vlugte voor die storm uit voorsiensigheid gekanselleer om groot vertragings te voorkom. Philadelphia het Dinsdagaand 'n sneeunoodeen pas aangekondig, wat skole daar en in Boston gesluit het. Nie-nood staatsamptenare in Massachusetts is gevra om Woensdag nie te werk nie. New York se openbare skole het egter oop gebly, hoewel veldtogte gekanselleer is. Sedert 1978 het New York se skole net ses keer gesluit, altesaam agt dae. In die Suide het gewoonlik besige stede soos Atlanta en Charlotte skaars sneeu en ys hierdie week ervaar. AirTran-woordvoerder Christopher White sê die lugdiens werk vinnig om operasies by Atlanta se lughawe te herstel, ná meer as 90 vlugte Woensdag en 260 Dinsdag gekanselleer is. Delta Air Lines het ook 1,200 vlugte Woensdag en 80 vir Donderdag gekanselleer weens sneeu in die Noordooste, maar Atlanta se operasies het genormaliseer. CNN se Chad Myers, Jason Kessler, Dave Alsup, Rob Marciano, Tristan Smith, Moni Basu, Holly Yan, Andy Rose, Nick Valencia en Brian Walker het bygedra tot hierdie verslag.

article_content: In a highly anticipated Cricket World Cup semifinal at Eden Gardens in Kolkata, Australia defeated South Africa, advancing to the final against India. Australia, with five World Cup wins, demonstrated their tournament experience, while South Africa’s struggle to win knockout matches persisted. The match atmosphere was intensified by Kolkata’s Diwali and Kali Puja celebrations. Australian captain Pat Cummins highlighted his team's confidence and prior success, contrasting with South African captain Temba Bavuma's admission of nerves and limited knockout experience. South Africa lost early wickets to Mitchell Starc and Josh Hazlewood, managing only 18 runs for 2 wickets in the opening 10 overs. David Miller’s determined century, supported briefly by Heinrich Klaasen, guided South Africa to a total of 212 runs. In response, Australia’s opening pair, Travis Head and David Warner, established control during the powerplay. Despite some losses to the spin attack of Keshav Maharaj, Tabraiz Shamsi, and Aiden Markram, Australia secured victory with seven wickets down, as Pat Cummins hit the winning boundary with confidence. Australia’s decisive win showcased their composure under pressure and tournament pedigree, while South Africa faced another heartbreaking exit from the World Cup semifinals.
translated_content: In ‘n hoogs verwagte Krieket-Wêreldbeker-halfeindstryd by Eden Gardens in Kolkata het Australië Suid-Afrika geklop en daardeur na die eindstryd teen Indië deurgedring. Australië, met vyf Wêreldbeker-trofeë agter hul naam, het hul toernooi-ondervinding ten toon gestel, terwyl Suid-Afrika se stryd met halfeindstryd-nederlae voortgeduur het. Die wedstryd is verder aangevuur deur Kolkata se kleurvolle Diwali- en Kali Puja-feeste. Die Australiese kaptein Pat Cummins het sy span se selfvertroue en vorige sukses beklemtoon, terwyl die Suid-Afrikaanse kaptein Temba Bavuma eerlik sy senuwees en beperkte ervaring in halfeindstryde erken het. Suid-Afrika het vroeg paaltjies verloor teen Mitchell Starc en Josh Hazlewood en slegs 18 lopies vir 2 paaltjies in die eerste tien boulbeurte aangeteken. David Miller se volgehoue honderd, gesteun deur Heinrich Klaasen, het Suid-Afrika tot ‘n totaal van 212 lopies gebring. In reaksie het Australië se openers, Travis Head en David Warner, tydens die kragspel dadelik momentum opgebou. Ten spyte van paaltjie-verliese aan die draaiboulers Keshav Maharaj, Tabraiz Shamsi en Aiden Markram, het Australië met sewe paaltjies af gewen toe Pat Cummins die wenlopies getref het. Australië se oortuigende sege het hul kalmte onder druk bevestig, terwyl Suid-Afrika nog ‘n pynlike halfeindstryd-uitgang beleef het.
post_content: Epic clash in Kolkata! Australia knocks out South Africa in the #CWC2023 semifinal after a tense battle. David Miller shines but Aussies’ experience proves too strong. India awaits them in the final! 🏏🔥 #CricketWorldCup #AUSvSA
translated_post: Wat ‘n wedstryd in Kolkata! Australië se ervaring wys, en hulle klop Suid-Afrika in die halfeindstryd. David Miller se honderd help nie – India wag in die eindstryd! 🏏🇦🇺 #KriketWêreldbeker #AUSvSA

article_content: Mala Murthy has served as the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of Teladoc Health since 2019, joining about nine months before the onset of COVID-19. During the early days of the pandemic, as consumers, providers, and companies adapted to new healthcare challenges, Mala transitioned into her new role. She has taken an interesting path to the C-suite: growing up in Calcutta, India, and later moving to the United States after being selected to join Microsoft. Mala recently discussed her upbringing, career journey, hobbies, approach to her role as CFO, and balancing parenthood with a high-profile position. At Teladoc Health, Mala describes the company as a global leader in virtual, whole-person care, focusing on helping people live healthier lives. The platform serves over 83 million members, providing access to a wide range of healthcare services—including primary care, chronic condition management, mental health support, specialty care for joint and back pain, as well as urgent and general medical care. The mission is to address both physical and mental health, recognizing their interconnection. Reflecting on her childhood in Calcutta, one of India’s largest cities, Mala explains that she grew up in a middle-class family during a time when the city’s resources were often stretched. Power outages were common, requiring her to study without electricity. Despite these challenges, her parents believed in gender equality and encouraged her to pursue any path she chose, giving her a strong sense of possibility and ambition. Mala’s academic journey included studying engineering after a brief period in medical school, eventually studying computer science and engineering. She later decided to pursue business school. As she was preparing to join a multinational bank in India, she learned that Microsoft was recruiting and became one of only 29 people selected from India to work in the United States. Before joining Teladoc, Mala worked at American Express and PepsiCo. At PepsiCo, she held diverse roles—corporate treasury, strategy, mergers and acquisitions, business CFO, and financial planning. At American Express, she spent seven years in business-facing CFO roles, on both the consumer and commercial sides. She values having varied experience and encourages stepping outside comfort zones to learn and develop skills, even if not all roles are equally successful. Her transitions across banking, consumer packaged goods, financial services, and healthcare have taught Mala the importance of mastering her craft, developing a growth mindset, and adapting to new environments. She advises identifying and nurturing a ‘hip pocket strength’—a core professional skill—while being open to learning. With over 20 years as a financial executive, Mala notes that the CFO role has evolved. Modern CFOs can operate across a spectrum, from focusing on financial reporting to collaborating closely with CEOs as business partners. She enjoys the collaborative, strategic side and believes today's CFO must have a broad business perspective and be aware of both internal and external factors. Mala also serves on the board of Avantor. For CFOs seeking board roles, she advises building diverse experience, leveraging professional networks, and using specialized search firms. Balancing the demands of her executive role with family, Mala prioritizes key family commitments, accepting trade-offs. She emphasizes keeping promises to her daughter and managing both work and personal priorities. For well-being and reflection, Mala is an avid runner, running six days a week. She also has extensive training in Indian classical music, which taught her the benefits of daily practice and incremental improvement.
translated_content: Mala Murthy dien sedert 2019 as die Hoof Finansiële Beampte (CFO) van Teladoc Health, en het ongeveer nege maande voor die uitbreek van COVID-19 aangesluit. In die vroeë dae van die pandemie, terwyl verbruikers, gesondheidsorgverskaffers en maatskappye by nuwe uitdagings moes aanpas, het Mala in haar nuwe rol begin. Sy het 'n inspirerende reis tot by die C-suite gehad: sy het in Calcutta, Indië grootgeword en later na die Verenigde State verhuis nadat sy gekies is om by Microsoft aan te sluit. Mala het onlangs oor haar grootwordjare, loopbaanpad, stokperdjies, haar benadering as CFO en hoe sy moederskap balanseer met haar hoëprofiel-pos gepraat. By Teladoc Health beskryf Mala die maatskappy as 'n wêreldleier in virtuele, volledige persoonversorging wat fokus om mense te help gesonder lewe. Die platform bedien meer as 83 miljoen lede en bied toegang tot 'n verskeidenheid gesondheidsdienste – insluitend primêre sorg, bestuur van chroniese siektes, geestesgesondheidsbystand, spesialisversorging vir gewrigs- en rugsorg, asook dringende en algemene mediese sorg. Hul missie is om beide fisiese én geestelike gesondheid te bevorder, aangesien dié aspekte verbind is. Mala reflekteer oor haar kinderdae in Calcutta, een van Indië se grootste stede. Sy het in 'n middelklasgesin grootgeword toe hulpbronne gereeld beproef is. Kragonderbrekings was algemeen, en sy moes dikwels sonder elektrisiteit leer. Ten spyte van hierdie uitdagings het haar ouers by haar geloof in geslagsgelykheid ingeskerp en haar aangemoedig om elke moontlike geleentheid te volg, wat haar selfvertroue en ambisie gegee het. Mala se akademiese reis het begin met ingenieurswese na 'n kort periode in mediese skool; later het sy rekenaarwetenskap en ingenieurswese voltooi. Sy het toe besluit om besigheidstudies te doen. Net nadat sy gereed was om by ’n multinasionale bank in Indië aan te sluit, het sy gehoor Microsoft werf nuwe talent en was een van slegs 29 mense van Indië wat gekies is om in die VSA te gaan werk. Voor sy by Teladoc aangesluit het, het Mala by American Express en PepsiCo gewerk. By PepsiCo het sy in rolle soos korporatiewe tesourie, strategie, samesmeltings & oorname, besigheid-CFO, en finansiële beplanning gedien. By American Express was sy vir sewe jaar 'n finansiële leier aan beide verbruiker- en kommersiële kante. Mala glo waarde lê in uiteenlopende ondervinding, en spoor ander aan om uit hul gemaksones te beweeg om te groei, selfs as jy nie ál die rolle ewe goed geniet nie. Deur haar loopbaanuitstappies oor bankwese, verbruikersgoedere, finansiële dienste en gesondheidsorg, het sy die belangrikheid van bemeestering van jou vak, ’n groeimindset en aanpasbaarheid geleer. Sy beveel aan dat ‘n mens jou “hip pocket strength”—kernvaardighede—identifiseer en ontwikkel, terwyl jy oop bly vir nuwe leerervarings. Met meer as 20 jaar as ‘n finansiële uitvoerende, sê Mala die rol van ‘n CFO het baie verander. Moderne CFO's strek van tegniese finansiële rapporteerders tot strategiese vennote van die uitvoerende hoof—sy verkies die strategiese, samewerkende styl. Sy glo vandag se CFO moet ‘n wye besigheidsblik hê en bewus wees van interne sowel as eksterne invloede. Mala dien ook op die direksie by Avantor. Vir CFO’s wat op soek is na bestuursrolle, raai sy aan om uiteenlopende ondervinding op te bou, jou netwerk te gebruik en gebruik te maak van spesialis-soekfirmas. Om haar korporatiewe rol en gesinslewe te balanseer, prioritiseer Mala belangrike gesinsverpligtinge en aanvaar dat daar altyd opofferings is. Sy beklemtoon die belangrikheid om beloftes aan haar dogter te hou en albei werk- en gesinsprioriteite so goed moontlik te balanseer. Vir haar persoonlike welstand en selfrefleksie hardloop Mala ses dae per week. Sy het ook jare se opleiding in Indiese klassieke musiek wat haar die waarde van daaglikse oefening en geleidelike groei geleer het.
post_content: Meet Mala Murthy, Teladoc Health’s CFO since 2019! From Calcutta to Microsoft to Teladoc, she’s all about breaking barriers, balancing family, and leading in virtual health. She’s also a serious runner & trained singer! #InspiringWomen #Leadership #HealthTech
translated_post: Ontmoet Mala Murthy, Teladoc Health se finansiële hoof sedert 2019! Van Calcutta tot Microsoft tot die VSA – sy breek grense, balanseer gesin én bestuur virtuele gesondheid. Sy hou van hardloop en Indiese musiek! #Leierskap #VroueInBesigheid #Gesondheid

article_content: Ice Music, an orchestra based in Luleå, Sweden, pushes the boundaries of music by performing with instruments carved entirely from ice. The unique ensembles include guitars, violins, cellos, and xylophones, all hand-crafted by ice artist Tim Linhart. Musicians from various bands use these instruments, which must stay cold to remain in tune. Performances are held in an igloo-like concert hall, itself constructed from ice and seating approximately 170 people. The venue and instruments are lit with colorful lights that evoke the northern lights, creating a stunning atmosphere. The idea of ice instruments has also been explored by Terje Isungset from Norway, who is renowned for crafting and playing instruments made from natural ice, such as harps, trumpets, horns, guitars, marimbas, and the 'iceridoo,' based on the Australian didgeridoo. Each instrument is said to have a unique sound and may last for only a single concert, though some survive longer. Maintaining ice instruments is a delicate process. Musicians' breath and body heat can melt the ice, so instruments need to be re-tuned after each performance, and violins are sometimes suspended from the ceiling to avoid body warmth. The hall is kept at about -10°C to keep the instruments in tune. Originally from New Mexico, Tim Linhart moved to Luleå a decade ago, helped build one of the world’s first ice hotels, and then devoted himself to creating and developing 'ICEstruments.' Linhart's mission is to produce real, expressive music from ice, claiming that its unique stiffness produces exceptionally clear, vibrant sound unlike anything from conventional instruments.
translated_content: Ice Music, 'n orkes in Luleå, Swede, stoot die grense van musiek deur op instrumente wat heeltemal uit ys gemaak is, te speel. Hierdie unieke groep sluit kitare, viole, tjello's en xylofone in, almal met die hand vervaardig deur ys-kunstenaar Tim Linhart. Verskeie groepe se musikante gebruik die instrumente, wat koud gehou moet word om in toon te bly. Optredes vind plaas in 'n iglo-agtige konsertsaal wat self uit ys gebou is en ongeveer 170 mense huisves. Die lokaal en instrumente word verlig met kleurvolle ligte wat die noorderligte naboots, en skep so 'n magiese atmosfeer. Terje Isungset van Noorweë het die idee van ysinstrumente ook verken. Hy is bekend vir die maak en bespeling van instrumente uit natuurlike ys – harpe, trompette, horings, kitare, marimbas, en selfs die 'iceridoo', wat op die Australiese didgeridoo gebaseer is. Elke instrument het 'n unieke klank en hou soms net vir een konsert, hoewel party langer oorleef. Die instandhouding van ysinstrumente verg sorg. Musikante se asem en liggaamshitte kan die ys laat smelt, daarom moet die instrumente na elke vertoning weer gestem word, en viole word soms van die plafon gehang om hitte te vermy. Die konsertsaal word op sowat -10°C gehou om instrumente in toon te hou. Tim Linhart, oorspronklik van New Mexico, het tien jaar gelede na Luleå gekom, gehelp om een van die wêreld se eerste ys-hotelle te bou, en daarna homself toegewy aan die maak van 'ICEstruments'. Sy doel is om ware musiek uit ys te skep en glo die unieke eienskappe van ys skep 'n besonder helder en lewenskragtige klank soos min ander instrumente.

article_content: Israeli forces reported discovering a tunnel entrance, allegedly used by Hamas, at Gaza's Al Shifa hospital, the territory’s largest medical facility. The military released a video purportedly showing the tunnel shaft in an outdoor area of the hospital; Reuters has not yet independently verified the footage. The scene included a deep hole surrounded by rubble and construction debris, with a bulldozer visible nearby. Additionally, Israeli troops reportedly found a vehicle on the hospital grounds containing a significant cache of weapons. Hamas issued a statement on Thursday, rejecting claims by the Pentagon and the US State Department that the group uses Al Shifa for military activities. Hamas described these allegations as 'a repetition of a blatantly false narrative,' and accused the Israeli military spokesperson of providing unconvincing evidence. White House spokesperson John Kirby said the US trusts its intelligence regarding Hamas operating from Al Shifa but declined to provide more details or share information. Communication services throughout Gaza collapsed after the two main telecom companies, Paltel and Jawwal, announced that all energy sources powering the network were exhausted. Israel has refused to allow fuel into Gaza, arguing that Hamas could divert it for military purposes. With fuel gone and communications down, the UN's agency for Palestinian refugees, UNRWA, said it was now impossible to organize and dispatch humanitarian aid convoys. 'If fuel does not come in, people will start to die because of the lack of fuel. Exactly when, I don’t know, but it will be sooner rather than later,' warned UNRWA Commissioner-General Philippe Lazzarini. By Thursday night, Paltel and Jawwal had provided no further updates, and all internet, mobile, and landline networks in Gaza remained nonfunctional. Palestinian civilians continue to suffer greatly from Israel’s military campaign in retaliation for the October 7 Hamas attack, which Israel states killed about 1,200 people, mostly civilians. According to Gaza health authorities, figures deemed reliable by the United Nations, at least 11,500 people have been killed by Israeli bombardment and ground operations—over 4,700 of them children. Israel’s military chief stated that forces are close to dismantling Hamas’s military infrastructure in northern Gaza and are now extending operations into other parts of the enclave, home to about 2.3 million people. Israel has distributed leaflets urging residents of four towns in southern Gaza—previously identified as safe zones—to evacuate. Israeli officials assert that some of the estimated 240 hostages taken by Hamas on October 7 have been held in Al Shifa hospital. Troops reportedly found the body of a woman hostage on Thursday in a building near the hospital, along with military equipment such as Kalashnikov rifles and rocket-propelled grenades. The ongoing conflict continues to spark international debate about the protection of hospitals. Human Rights Watch noted that medical facilities are granted special protections under international humanitarian law, which they forfeit only if it can be proven the premises are used to carry out harmful acts. ‘Hospitals only lose those protections if it can be shown that harmful acts have been carried out from the premises,’ said HRW’s UN Director, Louis Charbonneau. During his first visit to Israel since the October 7 attack, EU foreign policy chief Josep Borrell called on Israel to exercise restraint and protect Gaza’s civilians. ‘I understand your rage but let me ask you not to be consumed by rage,’ Borrell said. Israeli foreign minister Eli Cohen attributed ongoing suffering in Gaza both to Hamas’s attack and their subsequent actions.
translated_content: Israelse magte het na bewering 'n tonneloopgang wat glo deur Hamas gebruik is, by Gaza se Al Shifa-hospitaal, die grootste mediese fasiliteit in die gebied, gevind. Die weermag het 'n video vrygestel wat vermoedelik die tonneloopgang in 'n buite-area van die hospitaal wys; Reuters het die beeldmateriaal nog nie onafhanklik geverifieer nie. Die toneel toon 'n diep gat omring deur rommel en boumateriaal, met 'n buldozer sigbaar in die agtergrond. Boonop het Israelse troepe glo 'n voertuig op die hospitaalterrein gevind met 'n groot aantal wapens daarin. Hamas het Donderdag in 'n verklaring beweer dat die Pentagoon en die Amerikaanse Staatsdepartement se bewerings dat die groep Al Shifa vir militêre aktiwiteite gebruik, 'n herhaling is van 'n 'klaarbliklik vals narratief', en beskuldig die Israelse weermag se woordvoerder daarvan dat hul bewyse nie oortuigend is nie. Die Witte Huis se woordvoerder John Kirby het gesê die VSA vertrou op sy eie intelligensie oor Hamas-aktiwiteite by Al Shifa, maar het geweier om besonderhede te deel. Kommunikasiedienste in Gaza het ineengestort nadat die twee hooftelekommunikasiemaatskappye, Paltel en Jawwal, aangekondig het dat alle energiebronne vir die netwerk uitgeput is. Israel het geweier om brandstof tot Gaza toe te laat met die redenasie dat Hamas dit vir militêre doeleindes kan gebruik. Met geen brandstof en kommunikasie nie, het die VN se agentskap vir Palestynse vlugtelinge, UNRWA, gesê dat dit onmoontlik geword het om humanitêre hulp-konvooie te koördineer of te stuur. 'As die brandstof nie inkom nie, gaan mense begin sterf weens die gebrek aan brandstof. Presies wanneer weet ek nie, maar dit sal eerder gou as later wees,' het UNRWA Kommissaris-Generaal Philippe Lazzarini gewaarsku. Teen Donderdagaand was daar geen verdere nuus van Paltel en Jawwal nie, en alle internet-, selfoon- en landlynnetwerke in Gaza was steeds buite werking. Palestynse burgers ly nog steeds swaar onder Israel se militêre veldtog as vergelding vir Hamas se aanval op 7 Oktober, wat volgens Israel sowat 1 200 mense, meestal burgers, doodgemaak het. Volgens Gaza se gesondheidsowerhede, wie se syfers as betroubaar deur die VN beskou word, is minstens 11 500 mense reeds in die Israelse bombardement en grondoperasies dood – meer as 4 700 van hulle kinders. Israel se militêre hoof het gesê die weermag is amper gereed om Hamas se militêre infrastruktuur in noordelike Gaza uit te skakel en brei nou uit na ander dele van die gebied, waar ongeveer 2,3 miljoen mense woon. Israel het pamflette versprei wat inwoners van vier dorpe in suidelike Gaza – wat vroeër as veilig aangewys is – aanmaan om te ontruim. Israelse owerhede beweer sommige van die sowat 240 gyselaars wat op 7 Oktober deur Hamas geneem is, is in die Al Shifa-hospitaal aangehou. Troepe het glo Donderdag die liggaam van 'n vroulike gyselaar in 'n gebou naby die hospitaal gevind, saam met militêre toerusting soos Kalasjnikov-gewere en vuurpyl aangedrewe granate. Die aanhoudende konflik laat internasionale debat woed oor die beskerming van hospitale. Human Rights Watch beklemtoon dat mediese fasiliteite spesiale beskerming ingevolge internasionale humanitêre reg het, maar dit net verloor as bewys kan word dat skadelike dade van daar af uitgevoer is. 'Hospitale verloor net daardie beskerming as dit bewys kan word dat skadelike dade vanaf die perseel uitgevoer is,' sê HRW se VN Direkteur, Louis Charbonneau. Tydens sy eerste besoek aan Israel sedert die 7 Oktober-aanval, het EU-buitenlandbeleidshoof Josep Borrell Israel gevra om selfbeheersing te toon en burgers in Gaza te beskerm. 'Ek verstaan julle woede, maar ek vra dat julle nie deur woede verteer word nie,' het Borrell gesê. Die Israelse minister van buitelandse sake, Eli Cohen, het die aanhoudende lyding in Gaza aan beide die Hamas-aanval en hul daaropvolgende optrede toegeskryf.

article_content: Former Liverpool star Dietmar Hamann has condemned Mario Balotelli for swapping shirts with Real Madrid defender Pepe at half-time during a match at Anfield. Speaking as a pundit on Irish television, Hamann expressed his frustration with Balotelli’s actions and speculated that Liverpool manager Brendan Rodgers would have been angered by the £16 million signing’s behavior. Balotelli was substituted after what was described as another ineffective first half leading Liverpool’s attack against Real Madrid. Rodgers referred to the substitution as ‘tactical’. Hamann, who played for Liverpool for seven seasons, stated that he believed Rodgers would have been upset upon seeing Balotelli come into the dressing room wearing a Real Madrid shirt. He added that he could imagine such behavior upsetting not only the manager but also the fans, especially given Liverpool’s poor performance. Hamann further suggested the shirt swap was premeditated, saying, ‘I think he did it on purpose. I think it was kind of pre-meditated. He doesn’t care.’ When host Darragh Maloney asked if Balotelli’s actions were intended to provoke Liverpool supporters, Hamann replied emphatically that he would not be surprised if that was the case.

Balotelli is vervang na wat beskryf is as nog ’n oneffektiewe eerste helfte waarin hy Liverpool se aanval teen Real Madrid gelei het. Rodgers het die wisseling as ‘takties’ beskryf. Hamann, wat sewe seisoene vir Liverpool gespeel het, het verklaar dat hy glo Rodgers sou ontsteld wees om Balotelli in die kleedkamer te sien inkom met ’n Real Madrid-trui aan. Hy het bygevoeg dat sulke gedrag nie net die bestuurder nie, maar ook die ondersteuners kon omkrap, veral gegewe Liverpool se swak vertoning. article_content: The cover of Daniel Clowes' latest graphic novel is shown, courtesy of Fantagraphics. Daniel Clowes' newest work is a labor of love, exploring themes of birth, death, and everything that might come after. How does he confront these themes in his own life? Who is Daniel Clowes? He is regarded as a legend in the world of graphic novels and comics. After a seven-year hiatus, Clowes returns with his latest work, which was released last week. In a conversation with Juana Summers, host of All Things Considered, Clowes discussed the attachment and processing he experienced while creating this novel. On whether the book is autobiographical, Clowes states: 'There's not a single fact, I think, that lines up with my life. But the beats of her life, the rhythm of her childhood and adulthood, match up almost algebraically with those of my life. For example, in the story, Monica's mother runs a candle shop, which is her dream. My own mother ran an auto repair shop, which was her dream.' Reflecting on his relationship with Monica, he adds: 'Over the years, I've created many characters who only exist in the pages of a book. But Monica feels—despite the ending, which I won't reveal—like she still exists out there. Sometimes, characters feel so real that I might actually meet them. Readers sometimes speak about these characters as if they're real people, which is always gratifying.' On straddling the line between belief and skepticism in the supernatural, Clowes explains: 'The book investigates the things we use to give life meaning—the structures we imagine, like religions or cults. It's similar to writing fiction or creating comic worlds.' Clowes notes it can feel strange to release a new work into the world. To learn more, listen to Consider This on how the battle over book bans affects librarians and budgets.

Oor of die boek outobiografies is, sê Clowes: 'Daar is nie 'n enkele feit, dink ek, wat met my lewe ooreenstem nie. Maar die ritme van haar lewe, haar kinderjare en volwassenheid, stem byna algebraïes met dié van my eie lewe ooreen. Byvoorbeeld, in die storie bestuur Monica se ma 'n kerkwinkel, wat haar droom is. Lesers praat soms oor hierdie karakters asof hulle regte mense is, wat altyd baie bevredigend is.' Oor die lyn tussen geloof en skepticisme teenoor die bonatuurlike verduidelik Clowes: 'Die boek ondersoek die dinge wat ons aan die lewe gee om dit betekenis te gee—die strukture wat ons bedink, soos godsdiens of kultusse. Dis baie soos om fiksie te skryf of wêreldsbou in strokiesprente.' Clowes sê dit kan vreemd voel om 'n nuwe werk aan die wêreld vry te stel. Luister na Consider This om meer te leer oor hoe die stryd oor boekverbods biblioteke en hul begrotings raak.

article_content: China will need to negotiate with Russia regarding electricity prices and supply volumes for 2024, following Russia's move to raise electricity prices to match an increase in export duties. This price adjustment is tied to a new export tax connected to the rouble exchange rate, which Russia implemented from October 1 to help address its budget deficit. Earlier this month, InterRAO, Russia’s state energy company, announced an agreement with China for Beijing to pay higher prices for Russian electricity, reflecting the increased taxes. Jin Wei, executive vice president at China's State Grid Corp, confirmed both companies have agreed to a price adjustment for 2023 due to the new Russian tax policy. ‘We will maintain the agreed power purchase volume for the rest of 2023,’ Jin Wei told Reuters during a conference in Singapore. ‘But the prices and volumes for China's electricity purchases next year are still to be decided.’ A spokesperson for InterRAO in Moscow said negotiations will start in November. China has seen marginal, tax-related price increases for both 2023 and 2024. Last month, InterRAO said it would raise prices by up to 7% for customers in certain countries, including China, due to the new duty. The company noted that it might limit or cut off supplies if customers do not accept the new prices. In 2022, China bought a record 4.7 billion kilowatt-hours of electricity from Russia. This year, China could become Russia’s second-largest electricity customer after Kazakhstan, following Russia's halt of power exports to Europe because of the conflict in Ukraine.

Hierdie prysaanpassing hou verband met 'n nuwe uitvoerbelasting wat aan die roebel-wisselkoers gekoppel is, en wat Rusland vanaf 1 Oktober ingestel het om sy begrotingstekort aan te spreek. Vroeër hierdie maand het InterRAO, Rusland se staatsenergie-maatskappy, aangekondig dat daar ooreengekom is dat China meer sal betaal vir ingevoerde Russiese elektrisiteit, in ooreenstemming met die verhoogde belasting. Jin Wei, uitvoerende vise-president by State Grid Corp van China, het bevestig dat albei maatskappye ingestem het tot 'n prysaanpassing vir 2023 weens Rusland se nuwe belastingbeleid. 'Ons sal die ooreengekome hoeveelheid kragaankope vir die res van 2023 handhaaf,' het Jin Wei aan Reuters tydens 'n konferensie in Singapoer gesê. 'Maar die pryse en volumes vir China se elektrisiteitsaankope volgende jaar moet nog bepaal word.' ’n Woordvoerder van InterRAO in Moskou het gesê onderhandelinge sal in November begin. China het marginaal, belastingverwante prysverhogings vir beide 2023 en 2024 beleef. Verlede maand het InterRAO gesê hulle gaan pryse tot 7% verhoog vir kliënte in sekere lande, insluitend China, weens die nuwe heffing. Die maatskappy het genoem dat dit moontlik die voorsiening sal beperk of staak as kliënte nie die nuwe pryse aanvaar nie. In 2022 het China ’n rekord 4,7 miljard kilowatt-uur elektrisiteit uit Rusland gekoop. Hierdie jaar kan China Rusland se tweede grootste elektrisiteitskliënt na Kazakstan word, nadat Rusland die uitvoer van krag na Europa gestaak het weens die konflik in Oekraïne.

article_content: The Railway Protection Force's (RPF) anti-hawker squad on Central Railway (CR) registered 21,749 cases and arrested 21,736 illegal hawkers from April to October, recovering fines totaling Rs 2.7 crore, according to CR chief spokesperson Shivraj Manaspure. This represents a 21% increase compared to the 11,967 cases recorded last year. The Mumbai division alone accounted for 8,629 cases and collected Rs 94.7 lakh in fines. In parallel efforts, the Central Railway's RPF intensified its campaign against ticket scalping, conducting raids on private travel agencies. From April to October, 269 cases were registered and 317 individuals were arrested, including 97 instances in the Mumbai Division that resulted in 117 arrests. The Central Railway urges passengers to travel with valid tickets and avoid buying from touts. In a separate development, Singapore celebrated its Favourite Hawker Food competition, which highlighted the nation’s culinary diversity and promoted the use of piped gas for sustainable cooking. Biryani and Rojak were named winning dishes. Organized by City Energy Pte Ltd, the competition awarded each winner SGD 500, a medal, and a certificate. CEO Perry Ong emphasized the role of piped gas in sustainability and recognized hawkers as key to promoting eco-friendly cooking solutions.
