article_content: Royal Liverpool Golf Club has seen much golf history, and now Europeans are anticipating another landmark moment at the 143rd Open Championship. Rory McIlroy leads heading into the final round, and if he maintains his composure, he will become the first European to win three different majors since the Masters began in 1934. Not even golf legends like Sir Nick Faldo or Seve Ballesteros managed this—each only won two of golf’s four majors. If McIlroy adds the Claret Jug to his previous US Open win (2011) and USPGA Championship (2012), it would be a remarkable achievement. He would then have a chance to complete the career Grand Slam—a feat accomplished by only five golfers—at next year’s Masters while still just 25 years old. McIlroy capped his latest round with a stunning eagle on the 18th hole, opening up a six-shot lead. When asked about the hype such a win would create ahead of Augusta, McIlroy said, smiling, ‘That would put me in illustrious company. But I’m taking nothing for granted. I know from experience that leads can disappear quickly, so I’m staying focused.’ Like Tiger Woods before him, McIlroy’s best play often seems untouchable. Woods made history at Royal Liverpool in 2006, and now McIlroy is delivering a commanding 54-hole performance. The fact that he’s doing so on a traditional links course makes it even more significant. McIlroy’s previous best position heading into the final round at the Open was nine shots behind. Now, after a round of 68 and two earlier rounds of 66, he leads by six. He has clearly learned to master links golf, capitalizing on his skills and strengthening his mental game. While he benefited from a favorable draw, he still had to execute the necessary shots. Mental strength wasn’t always McIlroy’s greatest asset, but his confident finish—especially after Rickie Fowler caught him briefly—was reminiscent of Woods. Notably, only Tiger Woods and Jack Nicklaus have won three majors at a younger age since 1934. Woods is the only one to win three majors by seven shots or more, yet McIlroy has already won two by eight shots. He finished strongly, with a powerful drive and superb five-iron to the par-five 18th, leaving an 11-foot eagle putt. That ending capped off a strong stretch: birdie-par-eagle-bogey-eagle. He is now 11 under par for the par fives. Rickie Fowler is McIlroy’s nearest challenger, six shots back. Although storms were forecast for Saturday afternoon, they never arrived, and fans enjoyed an exciting day. Despite his large lead, McIlroy remembers that nothing is guaranteed—Greg Norman once lost a six-shot lead at the Masters, and Fowler was able to catch up during the round, though he fell behind again. McIlroy remains cautious, knowing that the job isn’t finished. The day’s play rewarded thousands of fans who braved poor weather forecasts. Rain held off until after play ended, leading to excellent scoring opportunities. Sergio Garcia and Dustin Johnson also made moves, at times narrowing McIlroy’s lead. Fowler, after tying McIlroy at the 13th, struggled with bogeys on three of his next four holes. McIlroy began with a bogey but stayed calm, confident that he would find scoring chances as the round progressed. A critical 30-foot birdie on the 14th and a long birdie on the 16th gave him separation from Fowler, who continued to falter. Crowds rose to applaud McIlroy as he approached the 18th green, recognizing his historic achievement. (Tommy Armour won three majors between 1927–31 but was an American citizen by then.) McIlroy expressed gratitude for the support and delivered a performance worthy of celebration. With one round left, he is close to a significant accomplishment for European golf. His success at Royal Liverpool may soon confirm his status as one of the era’s foremost sportsmen.
translated_content: Royal Liverpool Gholfklub het reeds baie gholfgeskiedenis gesien, en nou wag Europeërs op nog ’n mylpaal met die 143ste Open Kampioenskap. Rory McIlroy lei voor die laaste ronde, en as hy sy fokus behou, sal hy die eerste Europeër wees wat sedert die stigting van die Meesters in 1934 drie verskillende majors wen. Selfs gholflegendes soos Sir Nick Faldo en Seve Ballesteros het dit nie reggekry nie—albei het slegs twee van die vier groot toernooie gewen. As McIlroy die Claret Jug by sy vorige US Open-titel (2011) en USPGA Kampioenskap (2012) voeg, is dit ’n merkwaardige prestasie. Hy sal dan die kans hê om die loopbaangroot slam te voltooi—’n prestasie wat net vyf gholfers nog bereik het—by volgende jaar se Meesters oor net 25 jaar oud. McIlroy het sy jongste ronde afgesluit met ’n verstommende arend op die 18de putjie en daarmee ’n voorsprong van ses houe opgebou. Gevra oor die opwinding wat só ’n oorwinning by Augusta sou meebring, het McIlroy gesmile en gesê: ‘Dit sou my in voortreflike geselskap plaas. Maar ek neem niks as vanselfsprekend nie. Ek weet uit ondervinding dat ’n voorsprong vinnig kan verdwyn, so ek bly gefokus.’ Soos Tiger Woods voor hom, lyk McIlroy se beste spel onaantasbaar. Woods het in 2006 geskiedenis gemaak by Royal Liverpool, en nou lewer McIlroy ’n indrukwekkende 54-putjie-vertoning. Die feit dat hy dit op ’n tradisionele skakelsbaan doen, maak dit selfs meer betekenisvol. McIlroy se vorige beste posisie by die Open se laaste ronde was nege houe agter. Nou, ná ’n ronde van 68 en twee vroeë rondtes van 66, lei hy met ses. Hy het duidelik geleer hoe om skakelsgholf te bemeester, sy vaardighede benut en sy verstandelike spel versterk. Al het hy ’n gunstige loting gehad, moes hy steeds die regte houe speel. Geesteskrag was nie altyd McIlroy se sterkste eienskap nie, maar sy selfversekerde eindstryd—veral nadat Rickie Fowler hom kortliks ingehaal het—was kenmerkend van Woods. Net Tiger Woods en Jack Nicklaus het sedert 1934 drie majors op jonger ouderdom gewen. Woods is die enigste een wat drie majors met sewe houe of meer gewen het, maar McIlroy het al twee gewen met agt houe elk. Hy het sterk afgesluit met ’n kragtige dryfhou en skitterende vyf-yster na die par-vyf 18de, sodat net ’n 11-voet arend-put oorbly. Daardie einde het ’n goeie reeks bekroon: voël-par-arend-bogey-arend. Hy is nou 11 onder vir die par-vywe. Rickie Fowler is McIlroy se naaste teenstander, ses houe agter. Al is weerligstorms vir Saterdagmiddag voorspel, het dit nooit opgedaag nie en het toeskouers ’n opwindende dag beleef. Ten spyte van die groot voorsprong besef McIlroy niks is gewaarborg nie—Greg Norman het eens ’n ses-houe voorsprong by die Meesters verloor, en Fowler het hom tydens die ronde ingehaal, maar toe weer agter geraak. McIlroy bly versigtig, want hy weet die werk is nog nie klaar nie. Die dag se spel het duisende toeskouers beloon wat die slegte weervoorspelling getrotseer het. Reën het weggegebly tot ná die laaste hou, wat goeie telling moontlik gemaak het. Sergio Garcia en Dustin Johnson het ook soms McIlroy se voorsprong verklein. Fowler, nádat hy McIlroy by die 13de ingehaal het, het toe drie van sy volgende vier putjies gebogey. McIlroy het begin met ’n bogey, maar kalm gebly en geweet daar sal geleenthede kom soos die ronde vorder. ’n Bepalende 30-voet voël-put by die 14de en ’n lang voël by die 16de het hom losgemaak van Fowler, wat steeds gesukkel het. Die skare het opgestaan om McIlroy toe te juig by die 18de setperk, en sy prestasie as ’n historiese een erken. (Tommy Armour het drie majors tussen 1927–31 gewen, maar was toe ’n Amerikaanse burger.) McIlroy het sy waardering vir die ondersteuning uitgespreek en ’n vertoning gelewer wat gevier word. Met slegs een ronde oor is hy naby aan ’n groot mylpaal vir Europese gholf. Sy sukses by Royal Liverpool gaan dalk binnekort sy status as een van die tydgenote se voorste sportlui bevestig.

article_content: A Tudor-style family home in Detroit, featuring seven bedrooms, five bathrooms, and hardwood floors, is listed for just $1,000 as part of the city’s expanded auction to address urban blight. Mayor Mike Duggan and the Detroit Land Bank Authority launched the Building Detroit website last month, encouraging people to buy and renovate vacant properties. The site now includes homes from additional neighborhoods, such as Boston Edison and Osborn. Listings include a six-bedroom, 1914 Georgian Revival property with leaded glass, a tile fireplace, elegant wainscoting, and original woodwork. Another five-bedroom brick home with five bathrooms and a three-car garage requires new plumbing, porch steps, electrical systems, a kitchen upgrade, and cosmetic improvements to the floor and wall paint. The auction started with 15 homes; now, 13 homes in Boston Edison on Detroit’s west side and 10 in Osborn on the east side have been added, reports WILX 10. In the first week, five houses sold, most for at least $30,000, despite being initially listed for $1,000. Other available homes include a 1929 East English Village brick property with three bedrooms, and a three-story 1920 home featuring ornate woodwork and historic masonry; both need repairs and updates. An 1881 historical home, converted into a two-family dwelling with four bedrooms and two bathrooms, needs some windows and door replacements. Detroit has grappled with vacant, unsafe buildings, frequently resorting to demolition. Last month, Duggan unveiled a new approach focused on rebuilding and refurbishing homes. Officials noted that owners of uninhabited and dilapidated homes must begin repairs or risk legal seizure. Salvageable properties will be auctioned. Duggan described this as 'a historic change in Detroit’s strategy in fighting blight,' now concentrating on neighborhood-wide rehabilitation instead of demolition. The city is launching a marketing campaign to attract auction interest. Duggan’s plan is based on a similar project he led as Wayne County prosecutor from 2001 to 2003, which resulted in the renovation of 1,000 homes.

article_content: Digital Trends often showcases top and underrated Netflix movies, but today, we're looking at films that might be better avoided. These five titles aren't necessarily overrated, but they tend to be undercriticized. While each has fans, critical reviews highlight significant flaws. Here are five movies that arguably warrant more scrutiny.  'Tenet,' directed by Christopher Nolan, is considered a rare misstep for the acclaimed filmmaker. Despite Nolan’s successes with 'The Dark Knight' trilogy, 'Inception,' 'Interstellar,' and 'Oppenheimer,' 'Tenet' is frequently described as confusing, with complex ideas about time inversion that are hard to follow. The main character, played by John David Washington, is simply called 'The Protagonist.' 'Tenet' is available on Google Play, Prime Video, YouTube, and Apple TV+, though viewers may want to look elsewhere.  'Crash,' which won Best Picture over 'Brokeback Mountain,' draws criticism for its treatment of race and character depth. Scenes involving a racist police officer and the lack of nuanced character development have frustrated viewers. Critics argue that 'Crash' fails to adequately address its own themes, making its exploration of race feel shallow. It is currently available on Amazon Freevee.  'The Many Saints of Newark,' the prequel to 'The Sopranos,' is narrated by the late Christopher Moltisanti and ends ambiguously. While Michael Gandolfini shines as young Tony Soprano, the film lacks a compelling main story and an effective conclusion, reminiscent of storytelling gaps in the original series. It's available on Max.  'Water for Elephants,' starring Robert Pattinson and Reese Witherspoon, adapts a successful romance novel. However, the movie is often criticized for a lack of believable chemistry between the leads. Pattinson plays Jacob, a veterinary student who joins a circus and falls for Marlena, the wife of the circus owner. Despite the ingredients for romance, the relationship feels unconvincing. The film is on Google Play, Prime Video, YouTube, and Apple TV+.  'The Hangover Part III' serves as an example of a sequel that lost its comedic edge. Diverging from previous films, it includes problematic scenes and forced plotlines, such as a controversial freeway giraffe scene. The core group, known as the Wolf Pack, reunites to help Alan with personal challenges, but the story suffers from repetition and lack of humor. The movie is available on Google Play, Prime Video, YouTube, and Apple TV+.  All five films can be streamed on various platforms, but audiences may wish to reconsider before watching them.

Ten spyte van Nolan se vorige suksesse soos die 'The Dark Knight'-trilogie, 'Inception,' 'Interstellar,' en 'Oppenheimer,' word 'Tenet' dikwels as verwarrend beskryf, met komplekse konsepte oor tyd wat moeilik is om te volg. Die hoofkarakter, gespeel deur John David Washington, word net 'The Protagonist' genoem. 'Tenet' is op Google Play, Prime Video, YouTube en Apple TV+ beskikbaar, maar kykers kan dalk iets anders oorweeg. Tonele met ’n rassistiese polisieman en ’n algehele gebrek aan karakterontwikkeling het baie kykers teleurgestel. Kritici sê die film pak sy eie temas nie regtig aan nie, wat die verwerking van ras oppervlakkig maak. Dis tans op Amazon Freevee beskikbaar.  'The Many Saints of Newark,' die voorspel tot 'The Sopranos,' word vertel deur die oorlede Christopher Moltisanti en eindig ietwat verwarrend. Hoewel Michael Gandolfini uitblink as jong Tony Soprano, kort die film 'n oortuigende storielyn en 'n bevredigende slot – dinge wat soms ook in die oorspronklike reeks gefouteer het. Die Wolf Pack help Alan, maar die storie voel herhalend en daar is min humor. Dié fliek is beskikbaar op Google Play, Prime Video, YouTube, en Apple TV+.  Al vyf flieks kan op verskeie platforms gekyk word, maar dalk is dit die moeite werd om twee keer te dink voor jy dit aanskakel.

article_content: On ESPN's First Take, host Stephen A. Smith faced significant backlash after commenting on Baltimore Ravens player Ray Rice's two-game suspension for a widely publicized domestic violence incident. Video footage revealed Rice knocking his then-fiancée unconscious in an Atlantic City casino and dragging her from an elevator. Many criticized the NFL’s punishment as too lenient. During the show, Smith argued that while men should never resort to violence, women should also avoid 'provoking' such behavior. This suggestion drew accusations of victim-blaming from viewers and colleagues alike. Michelle Beadle, another ESPN host, responded on Twitter, pointing out that responsibility always lies with the abuser, not the victim. After widespread criticism, including from Beadle, Smith at first defended his remarks on social media—before deleting those statements. Later, he issued a longer apology, clarifying that he does not believe victims are to blame for abuse and expressing regret for any misunderstanding.

article_content: Many Americans find waiting for their new or renewed passports stressful, especially before international trips. According to a Passport-Photo.Online survey of over 1,100 travelers, 52% received their passports from the State Department within five to eleven weeks of applying, while 7% reported waiting sixteen weeks or more. The State Department now processes standard passport applications in seven to ten weeks for those who applied after November 6. Paying a $60 expedite fee can reduce this wait to three to five weeks. Still, more than half of surveyed travelers expressed dissatisfaction with these timelines, and some faced complications with their travel plans. Further survey results reveal that 12% of respondents received their passports in under one month, 22% struggled with stress due to delays, 17% lost work opportunities, and 13% reported losing money on nonrefundable bookings. Max Woolf, a writer and researcher at Passport-Photo.Online, encourages travelers to apply long before their trips to avoid avoidable issues. He compares early applications to buying gifts ahead of the holidays—helping travelers focus on their upcoming journeys rather than paperwork worries. The State Department also advises applicants to follow photo guidelines closely. Incorrect photos top the list of reasons for application delays. Photos must be clear, taken without glasses, and have a white or light background—selfies and filters are not accepted.

Die Staatsdepartement hanteer nou standaard paspoortaansoeke binne sewe tot tien weke vir dié wat ná 6 November aansoek gedoen het. Verdere bevindings uit die opname wys dat 12% van die deelnemers hul paspoorte binne minder as een maand ontvang het, 22% spanning ervaar het weens vertragings, 17% werksgeleenthede verloor het en 13% geld verloor het op nie-terugbetaalbare besprekings. article_content: A 5-year-old boy in Silverdale, Washington, is in serious condition after being attacked by three Rottweilers at a home where his mother was caring for the dogs on behalf of her imprisoned ex-boyfriend. The boy was outside when the dogs, previously not known to be aggressive, mauled him unexpectedly. His mother quickly intervened, using her own body as a shield to protect her son despite suffering bites herself. Another relative was able to help remove the boy, who required emergency surgery for severe injuries to his head, face, and neck. The dogs have been placed under quarantine with Kitsap Animal Rescue for rabies testing. Authorities say there are no plans for criminal charges, as the dogs had no prior history of aggression.

article_content: Norwegian marine researchers have uncovered the missing British submarine HMS Thistle, which sank during World War II. In April 1940, a German submarine attacked HMS Thistle off the Norwegian coast, tragically killing all 53 crew members. The wreck was detected earlier this year through seabed monitors used by the Institute of Marine Research and the MAREANO project while conducting biological and geological surveys. The research crew spotted unusual patterns during mapping and decided to investigate. By sending down an underwater camera, they found the submarine more than 500 feet below the waves near Rogaland, Norway. Senior engineer Kjell Bakkeplass noted that there were no previously recorded wrecks at the site. The team then cross-checked records of lost submarines in the vicinity, working with both Norwegian and British naval officials. Their investigation pointed to either HMS Oxley, which was lost to friendly fire in 1939, or HMS Thistle, destroyed by enemy action in 1940. Although early images left some uncertainty, a return mission in October finally verified the vessel as HMS Thistle. The British Royal Navy still owns the wreck and has authority over its identification. Bakkeplass added that confusion over Thistle’s location had persisted because of old navigational data.

Die wrak is vroeër vanjaar ontdek toe die Instituut vir Mariene Navorsing saam met die MAREANO-projek die seebodem vir biologiese en geologiese doeleindes gemonitor het. Die navorsers het vreemde patrone op die kaarte opgemerk en besluit om verder ondersoek in te stel. article_content: A rarely-seen collection of Neapolitan jewelry, considered more valuable than England's crown jewels, is now on display in Rome. The Treasure of San Gennaro comprises precious artifacts donated over centuries to honor Naples’ patron saint. These treasures were mostly locked away and little known beyond Naples until now. Notable pieces at the Fondazione Roma Museum include the Necklace of St Januarius, crafted in 1679 by goldsmith Michele Dato, and a mitre adorned with 3,300 diamonds and hundreds of rubies and emeralds. The 70-piece collection arrived in Rome earlier this month under heavy security and will be shown until February. San Gennaro, or Januarius, was a third-century bishop and martyr who remains central to Catholic tradition in Naples. Thousands gather three times a year to witness whether a vial of his dried blood liquefies, considered a miracle by many and met with skepticism by others. Exhibited treasures include chalices once owned by popes and kings, and a reliquary central to the liquefaction ceremony. The original 1527 pledge—where Neapolitans vowed to build a chapel for the saint during crisis—is on display as well. The necklace, recognized as one of the world's most valuable, was assembled from separate pieces donated across generations, including a diamond and emerald cross from Napoleon and humble earrings given in the 19th century. Paolo Jorio, director of the Naples museum that usually keeps the collection, remarked, 'This necklace tells the history of Europe.'

During a high-stakes World Cup semi-final, Temba Bavuma’s captaincy came under intense scrutiny, especially regarding his use of bowlers late in the game. Despite South Africa remaining in contention to defeat Australia and reach the final, Bavuma chose not to bowl Kagiso Rabada during the crucial final stages. Instead, he opted for Gerald Coetzee, Aiden Markram, and Marco Jansen. Rabada, after delivering five overs in his initial spell, returned for only one more over and was not called upon again, even after key Australian wickets fell, including those of Steve Smith and Josh Inglis.
 This decision raised questions among fans and commentators, especially as Aiden Markram was brought on ahead of Rabada. South Africa’s coach, Rob Walters, later clarified the situation: 'If you watched closely, you would have seen Rabada limping on the field. In his comeback spell, he simply couldn’t bowl at 100 percent,' Walters explained. The injury prevented Bavuma from using Rabada for his full quota of overs, although he remained on the field.
 As a result, Markram was asked to step up and performed well throughout the game. Walters reiterated that a fully fit Rabada has been one of South Africa’s leading bowlers throughout the tournament and over the years. However, the coach emphasized that Rabada’s injury wasn’t the decisive factor in South Africa’s failure to reach the World Cup final. This marks the fifth semi-final in which South Africa have stumbled before the final. 'It was unfortunate, but I don’t see it as a defining moment in the game,' Walters concluded.

article_content: WikiLeaks founder Julian Assange is wanted by authorities and his website is under serious cyber attack. The source of the leaked U.S. government cables clearly violated U.S. law and will likely face consequences, but whether websites publishing such material are legally protected remains controversial. Many Americans, including prominent figures, believe that WikiLeaks’ 'cablegate' website is not constitutionally protected, while others argue that, once information is public, the media has a right to publish it. Increasingly, public discourse happens on digital platforms owned by private companies. This allows individual politicians to potentially pressure these companies into suppressing controversial speech. After cyber attacks, Assange moved WikiLeaks’ hosting to Amazon’s servers. Following a call from Senator Joe Lieberman, chairman of the Senate committee on homeland security, Amazon quickly removed WikiLeaks. Lieberman praised the move and urged other companies to follow suit. Previously, in 2008, Lieberman asked Google’s Eric Schmidt to remove videos from YouTube he said were produced by terrorist organizations. YouTube took down videos that violated its community guidelines but kept those protected under free speech. Schmidt emphasized YouTube's commitment to diverse opinions. The New York Times editorial board voiced concern about politicians pressuring media companies to remove content protected by the Constitution. Amazon’s action against WikiLeaks at a senator’s request highlights the ongoing debate between national security and civil liberties—a struggle often at the heart of American politics. As political discourse shifts to private online platforms governed by their own terms of service, questions arise about the effect on democracy. These companies can legally remove content at their discretion. With more debates happening on private platforms, we must ask: How do corporate decisions affect public discussion? What responsibilities do these companies have in sustaining democracy? While Amazon was within its legal rights, its decision suggests that controversial speech opposed by government officials may be quickly suppressed. The future of online freedom may depend on whether companies maintain or curtail these rights. These opinions are solely those of Rebecca MacKinnon.

Baie Amerikaners, insluitend bekende figure, glo WikiLeaks se 'cablegate'-webwerf word nie deur die Grondwet beskerm nie, terwyl ander meen dat, sodra inligting publiek is, die media die reg het om dit te publiseer. Openbare diskoers vind toenemend plaas op digitale platforms wat deur privaat maatskappye besit word. Dit stel politici in staat om hierdie maatskappye dalk te druk om kontroversiële menings te onderdruk. Ná kuber-aanvalle het Assange WikiLeaks na Amazon se bedieners geskuif. Nadat senator Joe Lieberman, voorsitter van die Senaatskomitee oor binnelandse veiligheid, Amazon gekontak het, het Amazon WikiLeaks vinnig verwyder. Lieberman het hierdie skuif geprys en ander maatskappye aangemoedig om dieselfde te doen. Voorheen, in 2008, het Lieberman vir Eric Schmidt van Google gevra om video's te verwyder wat, volgens hom, deur terreurorganisasies op YouTube geplaas is. YouTube het slegs dié verwyder wat hul riglyne oortree het en die res behou omdat dit deur vryheid van spraak beskerm is. Schmidt het daarop gewys dat YouTube verskillende opinies toelaat. Die New York Times se redaksie het hulle kommer uitgespreek oor politici wat mediamaatskappye probeer dwing om Grondwetlik-beskermde inhoud te verwyder. Amazon se optrede teen WikiLeaks op 'n senator se versoek beklemtoon die voortdurende debat tussen nasionale sekuriteit en burgerlike vryhede – 'n kwessie wat dikwels sentraal staan in Amerikaanse politiek. Soos diskoers na aanlyn privaat platforms verskuif wat hul eie reëls toepas, ontstaan vrae oor hoe dit demokrasie beïnvloed. Hierdie maatskappye mag wettiglik inhoud verwyder soos hulle goeddink. Al was Amazon binne sy reg, stuur hul besluit 'n boodskap dat kontroversiële menings wat deur regeringsamptenare afgekeur word, vinnig onderdruk kan word. Die toekoms van internetvryheid mag afhang van of maatskappye hierdie regte sal beskerm. Hierdie menings is dié van Rebecca MacKinnon alleen.

article_content: On October 29th, Singaporean Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong called on citizens to honor the legacy of the late Mr Lee Kuan Yew and the leaders of his generation in a ceremony marking what would have been Lee Kuan Yew’s 100th birthday. The event, held at Mayflower Shopping and Food Centre, focused on Lee Kuan Yew’s passion for a greener, cleaner Singapore. PM Lee recounted how the former Prime Minister’s vision shaped many aspects of the country—including strong national defense, modern public transport, widespread public housing, robust education and healthcare systems, and significant economic growth. The ceremony, named LKY100 The Greening of Singapore, drew over 800 participants, including members of the People’s Action Party (PAP), invited guests, and environmental advocates. Organized by PAP and its community groups in Ang Mio Kio GRC, Kebun Baru SMC, and Yio Chu Kang SMC, the event showcased various green initiatives. Attendees viewed a 10-minute documentary titled 'The Greening of Singapore,' created by Wally Tham of Big Red Button. The film charted Singapore’s journey from Lee Kuan Yew's 1963 launch of a tree-planting campaign to present-day environmental challenges. It began with scenes depicting extreme weather, noting that Singapore’s relatively lower temperatures are partly thanks to Lee’s foresight in urban greening. The film also included interviews with PM Lee, National Development Minister Desmond Lee, and everyday Singaporeans, before closing with visions for the island’s green future. Referred to as 'Singapore’s chief gardener,' Lee Kuan Yew was instrumental in transforming the nation’s urban landscape. Apart from starting the tree-planting campaign in 1963, he initiated the Garden City project in 1967 and introduced Tree Planting Day in 1971. In a 1995 speech at the Botanic Gardens' National Orchid Garden, Lee Kuan Yew shared his belief that nature’s greenery is vital for the human spirit, warning that urban environments made solely of concrete can be detrimental to well-being.

Die geleentheid, gehou in Mayflower Winkelsentrum en Voedsel Sentrum, het gefokus op Lee Kuan Yew se passie vir ’n groener, skoner Singapoer. Eerste Minister Lee het vertel hoe die voormalige leier se visie baie aspekte van die land gevorm het—insluitend ’n sterk nasionale verdediging, moderne openbare vervoer, uitgebreide publieke behuising, gesonde onderwys- en gesondheidstelsels, en beduidende ekonomiese groei. Die seremonie, LKY100 The Greening of Singapore genoem, het meer as 800 mense gelok, insluitend lede van die People’s Action Party (PAP), uitgenooi gaste en omgewingsaktiviste. Die PAP en hul gemeenskapsafdelings in Ang Mio Kio GGR, Kebun Baru EEK en Yio Chu Kang EEK, het die gebeurtenis gereël en verskeie groen inisiatiewe uitgelig. Die film beeld Singapoer se pad uit, van Lee Kuan Yew se eerste boomplantveldtog in 1963 tot vandag se omgewingsuitdagings. Dit het begin met tonele van uiterste weer, en wys dat Singapoer se laer temperature deels te danke is aan Lee se vooruitdenkende beplanning vir ’n groener stad. article_content: The UK government has launched a £2 million emergency action plan to address a cholera epidemic rapidly spreading in Sierra Leone. So far, approximately 200 people have died, and more than 12,000 have been infected by the water-borne disease, which causes severe vomiting and diarrhoea and can be fatal within hours if untreated. The Department for International Development (DfID) is utilizing a network known as the Rapid Response Facility—established in March—for the first time to deliver emergency medical, water, and sanitation assistance in the West African country. This network involves both private businesses and experienced aid organizations. Medecins Sans Frontieres is operating treatment centers in Sierra Leone's capital, Freetown, assisting cholera patients. Aid organizations mobilized as part of the emergency response include Save the Children, International Rescue Committee, Oxfam, Concern, Care International, and the British Red Cross. DfID's plan aims to provide clean water and sanitation to nearly two million people and offer direct treatment to up to 4,500 cholera-affected individuals. Anti-cholera drugs and water purification kits will also be shipped to Sierra Leone. The outbreak, declared a 'national emergency' by Sierra Leone’s government, has been described as the worst the country has seen in two decades. Around 170 deaths have been reported since the start of the year, with Freetown being hit hardest due to poor sanitation, high population density, and limited health services. DfID Secretary Andrew Mitchell stated: 'The cholera epidemic in Sierra Leone is fast becoming a crisis, with millions potentially at risk. The UK is, for the first time, activating the Rapid Response Facility—its network of private sector and aid experts—to make sure we get aid to where it is needed, fast. Not only will our response be rapid, it will be efficient. We will monitor closely to make sure every penny of British aid achieves results and supports those in dire need. Urgent action is required to halt the spread of disease and save lives—Britain is leading the way.' Aid organizations' relief supplies and logistics will largely be provided by DfID’s private sector partners in the coming days. Cholera cases have spread quickly across West Africa, worsening considerably in recent weeks, with nearly half the infections occurring in Sierra Leone. Save the Children warns hundreds more children could die unless the cholera outbreak is brought under control swiftly. The charity notes that ten out of Sierra Leone's thirteen districts are affected. Efforts include supporting government treatment units, supplying clean water to families, and training more community health workers. Heather Kerr, Save the Children's country director for Sierra Leone, said: 'If we can't get this outbreak under control quickly and comprehensively, it has the potential to kill many more children. Children die very quickly from cholera if they don't receive immediate medical help. The sheer volume of people contracting the disease means aid agencies need more funding now to respond more efficiently to this devastating crisis.'

Hierdie netwerk sluit sowel privaat besighede as ervare hulporganisasies in. Medecins Sans Frontieres bedryf tans behandelsentrums in Sierra Leone se hoofstad, Freetown, waar cholera-pasiënte gehelp word. Die uitbraak, wat deur Sierra Leone se regering as 'n 'nasionale noodtoestand' verklaar is, word beskryf as die ergste wat die land in twintig jaar ervaar het. Ongeveer 170 sterftes is sedert die begin van die jaar aangemeld, met Freetown wat die ergste geraak word weens swak sanitasie, hoë bevolkingsdigtheid en beperkte gesondheidsdienste. Dringende optrede is nodig om die verspreiding van die siekte te keer en lewens te red – Brittanje lei die weg.' Die meeste van die hulporganisasies se voorrade en logistiek sal in die komende dae deur DfID se privaatsektor-vennote voorsien word. Cholera-gevalle het vinnig oor Wes-Afrika versprei en die afgelope paar weke aansienlik vererger, met byna die helfte van die infeksies in Sierra Leone. Save the Children waarsku dat honderde meer kinders kan sterf, tensy die cholera-uitbraak vinnig onder beheer gebring word. Die organisasie sê tien van Sierra Leone se dertien distrikte is geraak. Hul pogings sluit in om regeringsbehandelings-eenhede te ondersteun, skoon water aan gesinne te voorsien en meer gemeenskapsgesondheidswerkers op te lei. Heather Kerr, Save the Children se landdirekteur vir Sierra Leone, sê: 'As ons nie hierdie uitbraak vinnig en volledig beheer nie, kan dit baie meer kinders se lewens eis. Kinders sterf baie vinnig aan cholera as hulle nie onmiddellik mediese hulp kry nie. Die groot aantal mense wat met die siekte besmet word, beteken dat hulporganisasies nou meer befondsing nodig het om doeltreffend op hierdie verwoestende krisis te reageer.'

article_content: Henrik Lundqvist is renowned for his career as the star goaltender for the New York Rangers. Originally from Sweden, he moved to New York in 2005 and played his entire 15-year NHL career with the team. He secured the Vezina Trophy in 2012 and was recently inducted into the Hockey Hall of Fame. Now retired, Lundqvist remains an iconic figure in New York. He co-owns Tiny’s & The Bar Upstairs in Tribeca, has launched a new fragrance line called 'Next Chapter,' and hosts the 'Club 30' podcast. Growing up in Sweden, Lundqvist recalls family traditions around moderate alcohol consumption—his parents would enjoy a glass of wine on Fridays and Saturdays. His athletic focus meant making conscious decisions about partying, often prioritizing performance over socializing. Discussing his culinary journey, Lundqvist shares that while he always enjoyed wine, his palate evolved from whites to reds, and he now favors drinks like Moscow Mules and Aperol Spritzes. He describes Tiny’s as a unique, historic place with a carefully maintained, vintage atmosphere. Lundqvist made sure Swedish meatballs were included on the menu to reflect his heritage. Comparing Swedish and New York cuisine, he notes Sweden’s emphasis on healthy food and New York’s exceptional variety, including quality steaks and sushi he didn’t try until moving to the city. Lundqvist also cherishes memorable moments like discussing the difference between music and sports with Paul McCartney at a Bruce Springsteen concert, noting that musicians receive more universal audience support, while athletes face both fans and critics. Outside hockey, Lundqvist is passionate about music. He grew up playing guitar with his siblings and continues to perform at charity events, including with John McEnroe. His treasured guitars include gifts from friends and fellow musicians like John Mayer. Philanthropy is central to his life. Through the Henrik Lundqvist Foundation, he supports children’s health and education initiatives in New York and Sweden, including work with children’s hospitals and Ronald McDonald House. Recently, he teamed up with Swedish fragrance brand Morgan Madison to launch two scents, 'Next Chapter.' The bottles are crafted by Orrefors and presented in packaging inspired by coffee table books. Lundqvist takes pride in his personal style, viewing fragrance as the final touch before heading out—a value rooted in both his athletic and public life.

Hy het die Vezina-trofee in 2012 gewen en is onlangs in die Hockey Hall of Fame opgeneem. Deesdae is Lundqvist steeds ’n ikoniese figuur in New York. Hy is mede-eienaar van Tiny’s & The Bar Upstairs in Tribeca, het ’n nuwe geurlyn genaamd 'Next Chapter' bekendgestel, en bied die 'Club 30'-podcast aan. Die bottels word deur Orrefors vervaardig en kom in verpakking wat deur koffietafelboeke geïnspireer is. Lundqvist is trots op sy persoonlike styl en sien geur as die laaste bietjie afronding voor hy die huis verlaat—’n waarde wat gewortel is in sy sport- én publieke lewe.

article_content: Geert Wilders' Party for Freedom (PVV), recognized for its right-wing and anti-immigration stance, is heading for a significant victory in the Dutch parliamentary elections, marking one of the biggest upsets in the nation's politics since World War II. This win positions Wilders to initiate coalition talks and potentially become the Netherlands' first right-wing prime minister during a period of political shifts across Europe. An exit poll by national broadcaster NOS reported that the PVV secured 35 seats in the 150-member lower house, more than doubling its previous total of 17 seats. Official results are expected on Thursday. Showing his excitement, Wilders stated, 'I had to pinch myself – 35! PVV is the largest party.' The PVV's platform includes a proposed referendum on the Netherlands' EU membership, a halt to accepting asylum-seekers, and tougher border controls. While Wilders still calls for 'de-Islamisation,' he had a softer stance on Islam during this campaign compared to prior elections. Wilders commented, 'Voters said we are sick of it – literally sick to our stomachs.' He vowed to end what he calls the 'asylum tsunami' and stated his goal is for the Dutch to be 'No. 1 again.' Despite the victory, Wilders needs to form a coalition government, a process likely to be difficult as most mainstream parties have shown reluctance to partner with the PVV. However, his party's size gives him increased leverage. Wilders has encouraged other parties to participate in coalition talks. Pieter Omtzigt, leader of the New Social Contract party (projected 20 seats), is open to discussions. The Labour-Green Left alliance, led by Frans Timmermans and forecasted for 26 seats, has ruled out joining Wilders’ coalition. Although known for his tough stances on Islam, the EU, and migration, Wilders promised he would govern within the law and constitution. This victory comes a year after Italian premier Giorgia Meloni’s win with the Brothers of Italy party, which has since shifted somewhat to the political center in Europe. Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orban, who holds similar views on EU and migration, congratulated Wilders, calling it a sign of 'the winds of change.' In the final campaign weeks, Wilders softened his image, leading to the nickname Geert 'Milders.' The NOS exit poll, typically precise within one or two seats, was released as voting ended. The election was called after Prime Minister Mark Rutte's coalition collapsed over migration policy disagreements. Rutte was succeeded by Dilan Yesilgöz-Zegerius, who could have been the first female Dutch prime minister but her party is now expected to finish with 23 seats, a decrease from before. This outcome signals a broader political realignment in the Netherlands and across Europe, with gains for hard-right and populist parties in some countries, while they have struggled in others.
translated_content: Geert Wilders se Vryheidsparty (PVV), bekend vir sy regse en anti-immigrante standpunte, is besig om 'n groot oorwinning in die Nederlandse parlementêre verkiesings te behaal. Dit is een van die grootste verrassings in die land se politiek sedert die Tweede Wêreldoorlog. Hierdie oorwinning plaas Wilders in 'n posisie om koalisie-onderhandelinge te begin en moontlik die eerste regse eerste minister van Nederland te word tydens 'n tydperk van politieke verskuiwing regoor Europa. Volgens 'n uitkomspeiling deur die nasionale uitsaaier NOS het die PVV 35 setels in die 150-lede laerhuis verower – meer as dubbel hul vorige totaal van 17 setels. Amptelike resultate word Donderdag verwag. Wilders het sy opgewondenheid gedeel en gesê: 'Ek moes myself knyp – 35! PVV is nou die grootste party.' Die PVV se beleid sluit in 'n voorgestelde referendum oor Nederland se EU-lidmaatskap, die totale stop van asielsoekers en streng grensbeheer. Alhoewel Wilders steeds 'de-Islamisering' voorstaan, was sy houding teenoor Islam vanjaar sagter as in vroeëre veldtogte. Wilders het gesê: 'Kiesers het gesê ons is moeg daarvoor – regtig moeg.' Hy het belowe om te stop wat hy die 'asieltsunami' noem en gesê sy doel is dat die Nederlanders weer 'Nommer 1' is. Ten spyte van die oorwinning moet Wilders 'n koalisieregering vorm, wat uitdagend kan wees aangesien meeste hoofstroompartye huiwerig is om saam met die PVV te werk. Tog gee sy party se grootte hom meer onderhandelingsmag. Wilders moedig ander partye aan om in koalisiegesprekke deel te neem. Pieter Omtzigt, leier van die Nuwe Sosiale Kontrak-party (met verwagte 20 setels), is oop vir besprekings. Die Arbeid–GroenLinks-alliansie, gelei deur Frans Timmermans met 'n projeksie van 26 setels, het 'n Wilders-koalisie uitgesluit. Al is Wilders bekend vir sy uitgesproke standpunte oor Islam, die EU en migrasie, het hy belowe hy sal binne die wet en grondwet regeer. Hierdie oorwinning kom 'n jaar ná Italiaanse premier Giorgia Meloni se sege met haar party Brothers of Italy, wat sedertdien meer sentristies in Europa geword het. Hongaarse eerste minister Viktor Orban, wat soortgelyke sieninge oor die EU en migrasie huldig, het Wilders gelukgewens en dit 'n teken van 'veranderingswinde' genoem. In die laaste weke van die veldtog het Wilders sy toon versag, wat gelei het tot die bynaam Geert 'Milders'. Die NOS se uitkomspeiling, wat gewoonlik binne een of twee setels akkuraat is, is uitgegee toe stemlokale gesluit het. Die verkiesing is uitgeroep nadat premier Mark Rutte se koalisie uitmekaar geval het oor meningsverskille oor migrasie. Rutte is opgevolg deur Dilan Yesilgöz-Zegerius, wat die eerste vroulike Nederlandse eerste minister kon wees, maar haar party word verwag om met 23 setels te eindig, minder as voorheen. Hierdie uitslag dui 'n groter politieke verskuiwing aan in Nederland en regoor Europa, met regse en populistiese partye wat in sommige lande steun wen, terwyl hulle elders sukkel.

article_content: The death toll from Storm Ciaran has risen to at least 15 across Western Europe, as heavy rainfall and record-breaking winds caused widespread chaos to land, sea, and air travel. In Tuscany, Italy, at least five people died. Italian authorities announced a state of emergency on Friday after weather specialists reported record rainfall. Three more people died off the coast of Portugal after a sailboat ran aground north of Lisbon in rough seas. Throughout Tuscany, rescue services responded to numerous incidents, assisting motorists stranded in flooded tunnels and people trapped by fallen trees. Tuscany governor Eugenio Giani confirmed the five deaths from the storms in Italy, including an 85-year-old man who drowned on the ground floor of his house in Montemurlo, northwest of Florence. Giani wrote on X (formerly known as Twitter), 'What happened tonight in Tuscany has a name: climate change.' Residents in Tuscany spent Friday cleaning up homes, garages, and cellars flooded by the rains, discarding ruined furniture and appliances in the streets, according to an AFP photographer. Florence Mayor Dario Nardella described the situation as critical as water levels in the Arno River continued to rise. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni announced an initial state aid package of five million euros for Tuscany to expedite funding and resources after confirming a state of emergency. Falling trees were responsible for several storm-related deaths. Across Europe, powerful winds caused fatalities. In Ghent, Belgium, a five-year-old Ukrainian boy and a 64-year-old woman were killed by falling branches. Previously, a lorry driver died in northern France's Aisne region due to a fallen tree, while a man in Le Havre died after falling from his balcony during the storm. In Portugal, three people aboard a Danish-flagged sailboat that capsized off Torres Vedras beach (north of Lisbon) were found dead near the wreckage. Further casualties were reported: one man in Venray, Netherlands; a woman in central Madrid; and another in Germany. Approximately 1.2 million French homes lost electricity as the storm hit the northwest coast. French President Emmanuel Macron visited the affected region of Brittany on Friday. In Brittany, France, wind gusts were described as 'exceptional' by national weather service Meteo-France, with many records being broken. Gusts reached up to 207 km/h at Pointe du Raz and 156 km/h at Brest. Rail, air, and maritime travel faced major disruptions. The port of Antwerp in Belgium was closed, and flights from Brussels were delayed. In southern England, hundreds of schools closed as waves powered by winds of 135 km/h battered the coast. On Jersey (Channel Islands), residents were evacuated to hotels as gusts up to 164 km/h caused home damage. Over 200 flights were canceled at Amsterdam’s Schiphol Airport. The storm’s effects reached as far as Spain and Portugal. Air, rail, and ferry services saw cancellations and significant delays. Spanish authorities warned of waves up to nine meters along the Atlantic coast, resulting in over 80 flight cancellations at 11 airports. The French weather service predicted ongoing storms into Friday, especially in the southwest and on Corsica. Disruptions to rail services in western France were expected to continue, according to Transport Minister Clement Beaune. Scientists warn that more extreme weather events are likely due to global warming from greenhouse gases. Professor Hannah Cloke, hydrologist at the University of Reading, said, 'The links between climate change and winter storms in Europe are complex. But as seas and air temperatures get warmer, we expect some winter storms to bring more rain, potentially causing more flooding.'
translated_content: Die dodetal van Storm Ciaran het tot minstens 15 oor Wes-Europa gestyg, aangesien swaar reënval en rekordsterk winde groot ontwrigting aan land-, see- en lugverkeer veroorsaak het. In Toskane, Italië, is minstens vyf mense dood. Italiaanse owerhede het Vrydag 'n noodtoestand afgekondig nadat weerspesialiste rekordreënval gerapporteer het. Drie mense is dood aan die kus van Portugal nadat 'n seilboot noord van Lissabon in rowwe see aan die grond geloop het. Regdeur Toskane het reddingsdienste op talle insidente gereageer en motoriste in versuipte tonnels en mense vasgekeer deur omgevalde bome gehelp. Die goewerneur van Toskane, Eugenio Giani, het die vyf sterftes weens die storms in Italië bevestig, insluitend 'n 85-jarige man wat aan die grondvloer van sy huis in Montemurlo, noordwes van Florence, verdrink het. Giani het op X (voorheen bekend as Twitter) geskryf: 'Wat vannag in Toskane gebeur het, het 'n naam: klimaatsverandering.' Inwoners van Toskane het Vrydag bestee om huise, motorhuise en kelders, wat deur die reën oorstroom is, skoon te maak en beskadigde meubels en toestelle op straat te sit, volgens 'n AFP-fotograaf. Florence se burgemeester, Dario Nardella, het die situasie as kritiek beskryf, aangesien die vlak van die Arnorivier aanhou styg het. Eerste Minister Giorgia Meloni het 'n aanvanklike hulp-pakket van vyf miljoen euro vir Toskane aangekondig om befondsing en hulpbronne vinnig beskikbaar te stel na 'n afgekondigde noodtoestand. Omgevalde bome was verantwoordelik vir verskeie sterftes as gevolg van die storm. Regoor Europa het kragtige winde mense se lewens geëis. In Gent, België, is 'n vyfjarige Oekraïense seun en 'n 64-jarige vrou deur vallende takke dood. Voorheen het 'n vragmotorbestuurder in Frankryk se Aisne-streek dood is weens 'n boom wat op sy voertuig geval het, terwyl 'n man in Le Havre van sy balkon geval het tydens die storm. In Portugal is drie mense aan boord van 'n Deens-vlag seilboot wat by Torres Vedras (noord van Lissabon) omgeslaan het, naby die wrak dood aangetref. Nog sterftes is aangemeld: 'n man in Venray, Nederland; 'n vrou in sentraal Madrid; en nog iemand in Duitsland. Ongeveer 1.2 miljoen Franse huise was sonder elektrisiteit toe die storm die noordwestelike kus getref het. President Emmanuel Macron van Frankryk het Vrydag die streek Bretagne besoek. In Bretagne, Frankryk, is windstote as 'uitsonderlik' beskryf deur die nasionale weerdiens Meteo-France, met baie rekords wat verbeter is. Stote het tot 207 km/h by Pointe du Raz en 156 km/h by Brest bereik. Spoor-, lug- en seeverkeer het groot ontwrigting beleef. Die hawe van Antwerpen in België is gesluit, terwyl vlugte uit Brussel vertraag is. In Suid-Engeland is honderde skole gesluit toe golwe, aangedryf deur winde van 135 km/h, teen die kus geslaan het. Op Jersey (Kanaaleilande) is inwoners na hotelle ontruim toe windstote van tot 164 km/h huise beskadig het. Meer as 200 vlugte by Amsterdam se Schiphol-lughawe is gekanselleer. Die storm se impak is selfs so ver as Spanje en Portugal gevoel. Lug-, spoor- en veerdienste is gekanselleer of vertraag. Spaanse owerhede het gewaarsku oor golwe tot nege meter hoog langs die Atlantiese kus, wat gelei het tot meer as 80 vlugkansellasies by 11 lughawens. Die Franse weerdiens voorspel aanhoudende storms tot Vrydag, veral in die suidweste en op Korsika. Ontwrigting van spoorverkeer in Wes-Frankryk sal waarskynlik voortduur, volgens Minister van Vervoer, Clement Beaune. Wetenskaplikes waarsku dat meer uiterste weerstoestande deur aardverwarming veroorsaak deur kweekhuisgasse verwag kan word. Professor Hannah Cloke, 'n hidrologe aan die Universiteit van Reading, het gesê: 'Die verbindings tussen klimaatsverandering en winterstorms in Europa is kompleks. Maar soos waters en lug warmer word, verwag ons dat sommige winterstorms meer reën sal bring en moontlik meer oorstromings sal veroorsaak.'

article_content: Tens of thousands of people in Darfur face grave danger as a meningitis outbreak spreads, according to Doctors Without Borders (MSF), which was forced out of Sudan last week. MSF had prepared to vaccinate 100,000 residents in southern and western Darfur, but the government expelled the group, halting the campaign. Gemma Davies of MSF stated, ‘We were ready to start vaccinations, but being told to leave means no one can step in now, and that’s very worrying.’ The Sudanese Ministry of Health formally reported the outbreak on March 2 at Kalma Camp, home to more than 90,000 refugees. Davies, MSF’s project coordinator in South Darfur, highlighted the increased risk of disease spread in crowded camps. Now, with medical professionals gone, meningitis cases may go untreated and vaccinations are suspended. The vaccination drive, scheduled to begin March 7, is postponed indefinitely following continued government restrictions on aid agencies. According to Davies, MSF staff were not directly harassed, but operational shutdown orders came from officials without explanation. MSF is one of 13 organizations, including Mercy Corps, Oxfam, and the International Rescue Committee, expelled from Sudan after the International Criminal Court issued an arrest warrant for President Omar Hassan al-Bashir for alleged war crimes. So far, there have been 32 confirmed meningitis cases and four deaths, plus many additional suspected cases. With MSF and other key organizations forced to withdraw, thousands in Sudanese camps and villages remain susceptible to meningitis, which can spread quickly in densely packed areas. Davies questioned whether any group could fully replace MSF’s relief efforts, especially after their feeding programs and maternal health services—supporting over 100 individuals—were stopped. A few aid groups, such as World Vision, are still operating and assisting roughly 500,000 people in South Sudan. However, the greater humanitarian situation is deteriorating. The United Nations has received reports of NGO staff detentions and Sudanese authorities seizing assets from aid organizations. The U.N. warned that losing these humanitarian groups could leave 1.1 million people without food and healthcare support, and more than a million cut off from water access. Oxfam, a major provider of clean water, can no longer operate, with most of its Sudanese staff unable to work due to fear of arrest. Catherine Bragg, U.N. Deputy Emergency Relief Coordinator, noted that expelled organizations delivered at least half of Darfur’s humanitarian assistance, and their absence could have severe consequences for vulnerable communities.
translated_content: Tienduisende mense in Darfoer verkeer in groot gevaar as gevolg van ‘n breinvliesontsteking-uitbraak, sê Dokters Sonder Grense (MSF), wat verlede week uit Soedan verwyder is. MSF was gereed om 100 000 inwoners in suidelike en westelike Darfoer te ent, maar die regering se uitsetting van die groep het die inentingsveldtog gestop. Gemma Davies van MSF het gesê: 'Ons was reg om met die entings te begin. As ons nou moet gaan, is daar niemand wat kan oorneem nie, en dit is baie sorgwekkend.' Die Soedanese Ministerie van Gesondheid het die breinvliesontsteking-uitbraak amptelik op 2 Maart by Kalma-kamp, waar meer as 90 000 vlugtelinge woon, aangekondig. Davies, MSF se projekkoördineerder in Suid-Darfoer, beklemtoon dat oorvol kampe die verspreiding van die siekte vererger. Nou dat gesondheidswerkers weg is, word gevalle nie behandel nie en entings is nie meer moontlik nie. Die inentingsveldtog sou op 7 Maart begin, maar is nou tot verdere kennisgewing vertraag omdat die regering druk op hulporganisasies uitoefen. Davies het verduidelik dat sy nie direk geteister is nie, maar MSF se leierskap moes alles stop op amptelike bevel, sonder enige verduideliking. MSF is saam met 12 ander organisasies soos Mercy Corps, Oxfam en die International Rescue Committee deur die regering verwyder nadat die Internasionale Strafhof ‘n lasbrief vir president Omar Hassan al-Bashir uitgereik het weens beweerde oorlogsmisdade. Daar is reeds 32 bevestigde gevalle van breinvliesontsteking en vier sterftes, en talle ander verdagte gevalle. Die verlies van MSF en ander belangrike organisasies beteken duisende in kampe en dorpe in Soedan bly kwesbaar vir breinvliesontsteking, wat vinnig kan versprei in dig bevolkte gebiede. Davies vra of enige ander groep regtig MSF se werk kan oorneem, veral na afloop van hul voedingsprogramme en moedersorg wat meer as 100 mense ondersteun het. Sommige hulporganisasies, soos World Vision, werk nog en help sowat 500 000 mense in Suid-Soedan, maar die groter humanitêre situasie is besig om te verswak. Volgens die VN is daar berigte dat sommige NGO-staf vir ‘n rukkie aangehou is en dat die owerhede bates van hulporganisasies geneem het. Die VN het gewaarsku dat die uitsetting van hierdie organisasies kan veroorsaak dat 1,1 miljoen mense sonder voedselhulp en gesondheidsorg gaan wees, terwyl meer as ‘n miljoen nie toegang tot water sal hê nie. Oxfam, wat skoon water verskaf, mag nie meer funksioneer nie; die meeste van hul Soedanese personeel kan nie werk uit vrees vir arrestasie nie. Catherine Bragg, VN se Adjunk-noodhulpkoördineerder, het uitgelig dat die uitgesette organisasies minstens die helfte van Darfoer se hulp verleen het. Sonder hulle lê groot gevaar vir kwesbare gemeenskappe voor.

article_content: A team of Texas A&M AgriLife scientists has completed the first comprehensive U.S. study on public awareness of PFAS—perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances. The research revealed that most Americans neither recognize what PFAS are nor understand the potential risks involved. Known as 'forever chemicals,' PFAS are a group of thousands of human-made compounds noted for their persistent bonds between carbon and fluorine. This makes them difficult to break down or remove from the environment. Dr. Allen Berthold, interim director of the Texas Water Resources Institute and lead author of the study published in PLOS ONE, explained that the vast majority of people lack a clear understanding of PFAS. These compounds have been widely used in industry and consumer goods since the 1940s, including in firefighting foam, nonstick cookware, food wrappers, and many common products. PFAS have also been detected in U.S. food and water supplies. In March, the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) proposed a national drinking water standard for PFAS. Yet, public awareness remains low. 'When I ask an audience if they’ve heard of PFAS, only a handful raise their hands. This aligns with our survey results,' said Berthold. TWRI’s Stephanie deVilleneuve, Audrey McCrary, and Michael Schramm co-authored the study, which measured public knowledge, experience, and perceptions of PFAS-related risks. The key findings include: 45.1% of respondents never heard of PFAS and did not know what they are; 31.6% heard of PFAS but didn’t know what they are; 11.5% were aware of their community’s exposure to PFAS; and 97.4% did not believe their drinking water was affected by PFAS. Research in July by the U.S. Geological Survey estimated that at least 45% of the nation’s tap water contains one or more PFAS chemicals. 'Recent studies show many Americans are exposed to PFAS through drinking water, often unknowingly. There is clearly a significant knowledge gap,' said McCrary. Schramm noted that community exposure was the strongest predictor of awareness. However, even among those aware their communities were exposed, about half didn’t know what PFAS are. Those aware of community exposure were more likely to recognize PFAS sources, adjust their use of potentially contaminated products, and believe their water could be impacted. The online survey included 1,100 participants from across the U.S. The data showed no major differences in PFAS awareness by race, gender, or age. 'The lack of statistical difference across demographics is striking,' said deVilleneuve. 'Our study establishes baseline data as interest in PFAS remediation grows.'

Die navorsing het getoon dat meeste Amerikaners nie weet wat PFAS is nie of die moontlike risiko’s verstaan nie. PFAS staan bekend as 'vir altyd'-chemikalieë omdat dit 'n groep van duisende mensgemaakte verbindings is met volgehoue bande tussen koolstof en fluoor. Dit maak dit uiters moeilik om af te breek of te verwyder uit die omgewing. Dr. Allen Berthold, waarnemende direkteur van die Texas Water Resources Institute en hoofskrywer van die studie wat in PLOS ONE gepubliseer is, het verduidelik dat die oorgrote meerderheid mense nie PFAS verstaan nie. PFAS word wyd gebruik in nywerheid en verbruikersprodukte sedert die 1940’s, insluitend branstofblusskuim, kleefwerende kookgerei, kosverpakkings en ander algemene produkte. PFAS word ook in Amerikaanse kos- en watervoorrade gevind. In Maart het die Amerikaanse Omgewingsbeskermingsagentskap (EPA) 'n nasionale standaard vir PFAS in drinkwater voorgestel. Maar min mense weet hiervan. 'Wanneer ek 'n gehoor vra of hulle al van PFAS gehoor het, steek net 'n paar mense hul hand op. Dit stem ooreen met ons opname se resultate,' sê Berthold. TWRI se Stephanie deVilleneuve, Audrey McCrary en Michael Schramm het saam die studie geskryf, wat openbare kennis, ervaring en persepsies van PFAS-verwante risiko’s gemeet het. Die belangrikste bevindinge sluit in: 45.1% van die respondente het nog nooit van PFAS gehoor nie en weet nie wat dit is nie; 31.6% het daarvan gehoor maar weet steeds nie wat dit is nie; 11.5% weet hul gemeenskap was aan PFAS blootgestel; en 97.4% glo nie hul drinkwater is geraak nie. Diegene wat bewus is van blootstelling, is meer geneig om PFAS-bronne te ken, hul gebruik van moontlik besmette produkte aan te pas, en te glo hul water kan beïnvloed wees. Die aanlyn opname het 1,100 deelnemers landswyd ingesluit. Die data toon geen groot verskille in PFAS-bewustheid tussen ras, geslag of ouderdom nie. 'Die afwesigheid van verskille in demografie is opvallend,' sê deVilleneuve. 'Hierdie studie bied basisdata namate belangstelling in PFAS-skoonmaak groei.'

article_content: Senior Congress leader Shashi Tharoor expressed confidence on Saturday that his party will form the next government in Mizoram. Speaking at a press conference, the Lok Sabha MP from Thiruvananthapuram stated that Mizoram will become the first northeastern state where Congress returns to power since the BJP-led government took the Centre in 2014. Mizoram was previously the last Congress-ruled state in the region before losing to the Mizo National Front (MNF) in the 2018 assembly elections. Tharoor emphasized the Congress party's commitment to celebrating India's diversity, opposing policies such as 'one nation, one language, one code, and one culture.' He stated the party believes in unity without sacrificing diversity. Regarding the BJP, Tharoor criticized the party for failing to deliver on its promises since 2014, citing issues like the unfulfilled pledge of depositing Rs 15 lakh into bank accounts and creating two crore jobs. Addressing young professionals, Tharoor highlighted unemployment as a major challenge in Mizoram, claiming over 23% of local youths seeking jobs are unemployed. He accused the MNF government of not fulfilling its promise to generate employment, claiming only 2,200 jobs have been created in the past five years, while there are over 4,100 police vacancies in the state. The Mizoram Assembly election for its 40 seats will be held in a single phase on November 7, with vote counting scheduled for December 3.

Mizoram was voorheen die laaste deelstaat in die streek wat deur die Kongres regeer is voordat hulle in die 2018-verkiesing teen die Mizo National Front (MNF) verloor het. Tharoor het die Kongres se verbintenis tot die viering van Indië se diversiteit beklemtoon, en hul teenkanting teen beleide soos 'een nasie, een taal, een kode en een kultuur' uitgespreek. Hy het gesê die party glo in eenheid sonder om diversiteit prys te gee. Oor die BJP het Tharoor die party gekritiseer omdat dit nie sy beloftes sedert 2014 nagekom het nie, en het verwys na sake soos die onvervulde belofte om Rs 15 lakh in bankrekeninge te deponeer en twee crore werksgeleenthede te skep. Met 'n gesprek met jong professionele persone het Tharoor beklemtoon dat werkloosheid 'n groot uitdaging in Mizoram is en beweer dat meer as 23% van die plaaslike jeug wat werk soek, werkloos is. Hy het die MNF-regering daarvan beskuldig dat hulle nie hul belofte nagekom het om werk te skep nie, en beweer dat slegs 2,200 poste in die laaste vyf jaar geskep is, terwyl daar oor die 4,100 poste in die polisie oop is. Die Mizoram-verkiesing vir sy 40 setels sal op 7 November in een fase gehou word, met stemtelling wat op 3 Desember sal plaasvind.

article_content: A recent study by the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety (IIHS) finds that trucks and SUVs with hoods over 40 inches high are about 45% more likely to cause fatal pedestrian accidents compared to vehicles with lower, sloped hoods. Earlier research had already shown SUVs and pickups pose a higher risk to pedestrians, but this new analysis focuses specifically on hood height, using data from nearly 18,000 crashes. Popular vehicles like the Ford Super Duty and Cadillac Escalade represent the trend of tall, squared-off fronts among top sellers in the US. Pedestrian deaths have been increasing faster than overall traffic fatalities since the end of pandemic lockdowns. In 2021, the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) reported that pedestrian deaths rose by 13% to 7,342—the highest since 1981—while bicycle deaths climbed 5% to 985, the most since at least 1975. Since reaching a low in 2009, pedestrian fatalities have jumped 80%, now making up 17% of all US traffic deaths. While IIHS has no regulatory power, its studies influence the industry and federal safety agencies such as NHTSA. The IIHS research shows tall, blunt vehicles (like large pickups) are over 43% more likely to cause pedestrian deaths. Vehicles with tall, sloped hoods see a 45% higher risk, and even medium-height vehicles with blunt fronts (like the Mazda CX-9 or Chevrolet Colorado) are nearly 26% more likely to cause a pedestrian fatality. IIHS recommends automakers design vehicles with lower, more sloped front ends to improve pedestrian safety, and urges NHTSA to factor increasing hood heights and blunt designs into its safety ratings. Additionally, current NHTSA fuel-efficiency standards can unintentionally encourage larger vehicle sizes since bigger models have lower mileage targets. US Transportation Secretary Pete Buttigieg has called the rise in traffic deaths a 'crisis,' and in response, the Biden administration has allocated $800 million this year for infrastructure projects to enhance vehicle and pedestrian safety.

article_content: On Friday, Australia ordered federal police to take over security at Parliament House, following one of the country's largest counter-terrorism operations in Sydney a day earlier. Prime Minister Tony Abbott said an urgent review of parliamentary security was underway, in response to intelligence reports of potential threats from terrorist support networks. Several Islamic organizations in Australia expressed concern about rising Islamophobia after Thursday's predawn raids led to the detention of at least 15 suspects. The Grand Mufti of Australia, in a statement on behalf of Islamic organizations, urged Australians not to let bigots and media figures undermine social cohesion. Hundreds of peaceful demonstrators protested against the police raids, with some holding signs that said, 'Terror raids cannot break the spirit of Muslims.' Among those detained was Australian Omarjan Azari, who has been formally charged with conspiracy to commit terrorism. He was denied bail and is expected to reappear in court on November 13, authorities said. Police told CNN that another 24-year-old man was released on bail after being charged with possession of ammunition without a license and a prohibited weapon. All other detainees have now been released, with two women issued court attendance notices. In an interview with Australia's Seven Network on Friday, Abbott said a senior Australian member of ISIS in Syria had instructed sympathizers in Australia to commit acts of violence. Abbott explained that urgent action was taken because authorities believed a demonstration execution was imminent. Authorities estimate that about 60 Australians are fighting alongside ISIS and other militant groups in the Middle East. Australia quickly supported U.S. President Barack Obama's call for an international coalition against ISIS and announced plans to send military advisers to assist the Iraqi military. Australia is also sending fighter jets and support aircraft to the United Arab Emirates to assist in the campaign against ISIS.

article_content: On Sunday, all eyes in India will be on the Cricket World Cup final as the undefeated home team faces five-time champions Australia at Ahmedabad's Narendra Modi Stadium. With key leaders Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli at the helm, India has dominated the tournament with ten wins and now aims for their third World Cup victory. Sharma emphasizes the need for focus and composure amidst enormous national expectations. Victory would evoke memories of India's celebrated 2011 home win. Coach Rahul Dravid, hoping to redeem the heartbreak of the 2003 final defeat, has been pivotal to the team's preparation, and Sharma has highlighted Dravid's significant influence. Australia, captained by Pat Cummins, recognizes the daunting task ahead but is prepared to take on the passionate Indian crowd. Many Australian players are accustomed to India's cricket atmosphere due to IPL experience. Cummins encourages his team to embrace the high-pressure environment and target a memorable win. India will continue without all-rounder Hardik Pandya, relying on their established seam trio. Australia may consider bringing in Marcus Stoinis for additional balance but is expected to largely stick to their current squad. Australia holds a historical advantage in ODI encounters, including a notable win in the 2003 World Cup final, but India has had the upper hand in recent meetings, including a victory in this tournament’s group stage. Both sides are in strong form, promising a highly competitive final. India predicted XI: Rohit Sharma (c), Shubman Gill, Virat Kohli, Shreyas Iyer, KL Rahul (wk), Suryakumar Yadav, Ravindra Jadeja, Jasprit Bumrah, Mohammed Shami, Kuldeep Yadav, Mohammed Siraj. Australia predicted XI: David Warner, Travis Head, Mitchell Marsh, Steve Smith, Marnus Labuschagne, Josh Inglis (wk), Glenn Maxwell, Mitchell Starc, Pat Cummins (c), Adam Zampa, Josh Hazlewood.

Australië, onder leiding van kaptein Pat Cummins, besef die uitdagende taak wat voorlê, maar is gereed om die passievolle Indiër-skare die hoof te bied. article_content: 'W1A' is a new comedy series following a group of senior BBC executives as the broadcaster faces a series of crises. Instead of serving as a behind-the-scenes documentary on tackling challenges, the show humorously parodies real-life scandals that have cost licence-fee payers millions. In one episode, actual BBC executive Alan Yentob makes a cameo, arm-wrestling with novelist Salman Rushdie. Set to premiere later this month, the show stars Hugh Bonneville (of Downton Abbey), who plays Ian Fletcher—a BBC official hired to lead the organization through what are described as 'recent learning opportunities,' a clear reference to ongoing public controversies. Several characters and scenarios in 'W1A' closely mirror real BBC figures and events. For example, staff struggle with a new IT system called Syncopatico, intended to revolutionize BBC workflows but ultimately failing. In reality, the BBC abandoned its 'Digital Media Initiative' in April 2013 after losing £100 million. The National Audit Office criticized senior executives for losing control over the project. Another comedic plot portrays fictional presenter Sally Wingate alleging her career was held back by the BBC's institutional bias against the West Country, echoing the true story of Miriam O’Reilly, who, in 2011, won an age discrimination case against the BBC. Bonneville’s character is appointed Head of Values and tasked with revitalizing the troubled broadcaster. During a 'Way Ahead taskforce' meeting, he calls the BBC 'one of the greatest ideas in the world' and urges the organization to meet its challenges confidently. Similarly, Tony Hall, who became Director-General in April 2013, has said the BBC must be more assertive and proactive in defending itself. The show also lampoons staff grievances about BBC’s refurbished open-plan headquarters, which features 'interactive spaces' instead of offices. In reality, the previous year, the BBC spent £500,000 on improvements—including a 'collaboration project zone'—at its £1 billion New Broadcasting House due to staff complaints about the workplace environment. Another fictional plotline, 'Britain’s Tastiest Village,' which mixes elements of Countryfile, The Great British Bake Off, and The One Show, satirizes the BBC’s emphasis on consumer and lifestyle programming—a direction critics have questioned even as the BBC Trust has called for more original, distinctive television content.

In een episode maak die regte BBC-bestuurder Alan Yentob 'n verskyning en armdruk met die skrywer Salman Rushdie. Die reeks, wat later vandeesmaand begin, spog met Hugh Bonneville (van 'Downton Abbey'-faam) as Ian Fletcher—'n BBC-amptenaar wat aangestel is om die organisasie deur sogenaamde 'onlangse leergeleenthede' te lei; hierdie term verwys duidelik na die voortdurende omstredenhede. Verskeie karakters en scenarios in 'W1A' weerspieël ware BBC-persone en gebeure. Personeel sukkel byvoorbeeld met 'n nuwe IT-stelsel genaamd Syncopatico, wat bedoel is om werkprosesse te verbeter, maar wat uiteindelik misluk. Die National Audit Office het destydse bestuur gekritiseer omdat hulle beheer verloor het. Nog ‘n komiese storielyn gaan oor die fiktiewe aanbieder Sally Wingate wat beweer haar loopbaan is benadeel deur institusionele vooroordeel teenoor die Wes-Kaap, wat ooreenstem met die werklike saak van Miriam O’Reilly wat in 2011 ‘n ouderdomsdiskriminasie-saak teen die BBC gewen het. In ‘n 'Way Ahead taskforce'-vergadering noem hy die BBC ‘een van die beste idees in die wêreld’ en spoor die organisasie aan om sy uitdagings met selfvertroue te hanteer. 'Britain’s Tastiest Village', ‘n fiktiewe program wat elemente van Countryfile, The Great British Bake Off en The One Show kombineer, satiriseer die BBC se fokus op leefstyl- en verbruikersprogramme—iets waarvoor hulle dikwels gekritiseer word selfs al eis die BBC Trust meer oorspronklike en kenmerkende inhoud.

On October 11, former president and 2024 Republican candidate Donald Trump hosted a campaign event in West Palm Beach, Florida, but did not attend a court hearing the next day in nearby Fort Pierce. During the Fort Pierce hearing, federal prosecutors and Trump's attorneys debated accusations that Trump unlawfully kept classified documents after leaving office. Judge Aileen Cannon was asked by prosecutors to review whether a lawyer representing one of Trump’s co-defendants might have a conflict of interest.

Trump faces charges of withholding and concealing classified materials from federal authorities, despite official requests for their return. Investigators eventually seized over 100 classified and top-secret documents in a search of Trump’s Mar-a-Lago resort. Prosecutors allege that Trump directed efforts to conceal these documents from investigators.

While Trump was not in court, Judge Cannon held two hearings to assess whether co-defendants Walt Nauta, Trump’s valet, and Carlos De Oliveira, Mar-a-Lago’s property manager, have proper legal representation. Their lawyers, paid by Trump, also represent others close to him, including an expected government witness. Cannon allowed John Irving to represent De Oliveira after De Oliveira agreed to waive his right to a separate attorney.

However, issues arose concerning Stanley Woodward, who represents Nauta, because Woodward previously represented Yuscil Taveras, Mar-a-Lago’s former IT director, now cooperating with prosecutors. Taveras is expected to testify about attempts by De Oliveira to persuade him to delete surveillance footage. Prosecutors argued that Woodward should not cross-examine Taveras or challenge his credibility due to this prior relationship. Judge Cannon postponed her decision on Woodward's continued representation of Nauta.

The timeline for the trial remains uncertain: Judge Cannon proposed a May start, but Trump’s legal team has repeatedly requested delays until after the 2024 election. If the trial is delayed past the election and Trump wins, he could potentially direct the Justice Department to drop the charges. Trump’s lawyers claim special counsel Jack Smith is hastening the case for political reasons. Meanwhile, Smith’s team has indicated they will show why Trump retained the documents. Speculation is focused on earlier incidents in which Trump reportedly disclosed classified information, such as a Defense Department plan to attack Iran and details about U.S. nuclear submarines. These are likely to be important elements of the trial.
translated_content:
Op 11 Oktober het die voormalige president en 2024 Republikeinse kandidaat, Donald Trump, 'n veldtogbyeenkoms in West Palm Beach, Florida, gehou, maar het nie die hofverhoor die volgende dag in die nabygeleë Fort Pierce bygewoon nie. Tydens die verhoor in Fort Pierce het federale aanklaers en Trump se regsverteenwoordigers argumente oor bewerings dat Trump geklassifiseerde dokumente onwettig teruggehou het na sy presidentskap, uitgesit. Regter Aileen Cannon is deur aanklaers gevra om te bepaal of 'n prokureur vir een van Trump se mede-beskuldigdes 'n moontlike belangebotsing het.

Trump staar aanklagte in die gesig dat hy geklassifiseerde materiaal van federale owerhede teruggehou en versteek het, ten spyte van amptelike versoeke om alles terug te gee. Speurders het uiteindelik meer as 100 geklassifiseerde en topgeheime dokumente beslag gelê met 'n deursoeking van die Mar-a-Lago-oord. Aanklaers beweer dat Trump leiding gegee het om dokumente van ondersoekers weg te hou.

Selfs al was Trump nie in die hof nie, het regter Cannon twee verhore gehou om vas te stel of die mede-beskuldigdes, Walt Nauta (Trump se bediende) en Carlos De Oliveira (Mar-a-Lago se bestuurder), behoorlik verteenwoordig word. Hul prokureurs, wat deur Trump betaal word, verteenwoordig ook ander naby aan hom, insluitend 'n verwagte getuienis vir die regering. Cannon het John Irving toegelaat om De Oliveira te verteenwoordig nadat De Oliveira afstand van sy reg op 'n onafhanklike prokureur gedoen het.

Kopzorge het ontstaan oor Stanley Woodward, Nauta se prokureur, omdat hy vroeër vir Yuscil Taveras, Mar-a-Lago se voormalige IT-direkteur, opgetree het – Taveras werk nou saam met die aanklaers en kan getuig oor pogings van De Oliveira om hom te oorreed om sekuriteitsmateriaal te verwyder. Aanklaers voer aan dat Woodward nie Taveras moet kruisverhoor of sy geloofwaardigheid ondermyn nie. Regter Cannon het haar besluit oor Woodward se voortgesette verteenwoordiging uitgestel.

Die begin van die verhoor is onseker: Regter Cannon het Mei voorgestel, maar Trump se regspan vra herhaaldelik dat dit tot ná die 2024-verkiesing uitgestel word. As Trump sou wen, kan hy moontlik die aanklagte laat vaar. Intussen sê sy prokureurs die spesiale aanklaer Jack Smith probeer die verhoor versnel vir politieke redes. Smith se span beplan om te verduidelik hoekom Trump die dokumente gehou het. Daar word gespekuleer oor vorige insidente waar Trump glo geheime inligting gedeel het, soos ‘n aanval-plan teen Iran en besonderhede van Amerikaanse kern-duikbote—hierdie sal waarskynlik sentraal staan in die hofsaak.
