article_content: Ivan Rakitic played a pivotal role as Sevilla defeated Benfica on penalties to win the Europa League final in Turin on Wednesday night. The Croatian midfielder delivered a man-of-the-match performance and later exchanged a congratulatory kiss on the cheek with teammate Daniel Carrico. Rakitic is recognized as one of Europe’s top attacking midfielders, leading to speculation about a possible transfer during the summer. When asked about his future, Rakitic said: 'Fifteen people have asked me this question already. Just let me enjoy my special day.' After a physically demanding 120 minutes that ended goalless, Sevilla secured victory in the penalty shootout, largely thanks to goalkeeper Beto's excellent saves. Rakitic commented: 'I am exhausted. Physically, mentally and emotionally... we worked so hard and Beto was amazing.' Looking ahead, Rakitic is excited to return to Seville with the trophy and celebrate with local fans. He said Thursday would be an incredible day for the city and its supporters. Rakitic will also have a chance to shine at the World Cup this summer, representing Croatia in Group A alongside Brazil, Mexico, and Cameroon. After the win, UEFA president Michel Platini presented the Europa League trophy to Rakitic and his Sevilla teammates.

Die Kroatiese middelveldspeler het 'n man-van-die-wedstryd vertoning gelewer en later 'n gelukwensende soen op die wang met spanmaat Daniel Carrico uitgeruil. Rakitic word beskou as een van Europa se top aanvallende middelveldspelers, wat gelei het tot bespiegeling oor 'n moontlike oordrag gedurende die somer. Toe hy oor sy toekoms uitgevra is, het Rakitic gesê: 'Vyftien mense het my al hierdie vraag gevra. Laat my net my spesiale dag geniet.' Na 120 minute se fisies veeleisende spel wat doellose geëindig het, het Sevilla die oorwinning in die strafdoelwedstryd behaal, grootliks danksy doelwagter Beto se puik reddings. Rakitic het gesê: 'Ek is uitgeput. Fisies, geestelik en emosioneel... ons het so hard gewerk en Beto was ongelooflik.' Rakitic sien daarna uit om terug te keer na Sevilla met die trofee en saam met plaaslike ondersteuners te vier. Hy sê Donderdag gaan 'n ongelooflike dag vir die stad en sy aanhangers wees. Rakitic kry ook 'n kans om hierdie somer by die Wêreldbeker te skitter, waar hy vir Kroasië in Groep A teen Brasilië, Meksiko en Kameroen gaan speel. Na die oorwinning het die UEFA-president Michel Platini die Europa Liga-trofee aan Rakitic en sy Sevilla-spanmaats oorhandig.

article_content: House Republicans remain embroiled in turmoil as they gather for another attempt to fill the Speaker of the House vacancy in a planned 10am meeting. Some GOP members are voicing open frustration, with Rep. Austin Scott of Georgia describing his colleagues as 'a bunch of idiots.' Rep. Don Bacon of Nebraska criticized certain members, suggesting they prefer being in the minority so they can constantly oppose measures and disrupt proceedings instead of cooperating to govern. In an interview with CNN's Manu Raju, Bacon said, 'These guys want to be in the minority. I think they prefer it because they can always vote ‘no’ and make noise. But governing requires teamwork.' Scott added that while some lawmakers are genuinely seeking a solution, others seem more interested in television appearances than negotiating a way forward. He stated, 'There are people in there who want TV time rather than real negotiations.' When pressed about the effect on the party’s image, Scott responded, 'It makes us look like a bunch of idiots.' The ongoing infighting is not only harming the Republican Party’s reputation but also putting vulnerable seats, such as Bacon’s swing district, at increased risk of shifting to Democrats.

Maar om te regeer verg spanwerk.' Scott het bygevoeg dat, hoewel sommige wetgewers werklik 'n oplossing soek, ander meer daarop ingestel is om op televisie te verskyn as om 'n uitweg te onderhandel. article_content: George Osborne, the UK Chancellor, stated that he was proud of the government’s increased spending on foreign aid. He announced an additional £809 million for international development in 2015-16 to help fulfill the coalition government’s commitment to spend 0.7% of national income on aid. To reach the 0.7% target, funding from the Home Office and Department for Business will also be counted toward the aid goal. While many Conservative backbenchers argued against protecting aid spending, calling instead for cuts, Osborne defended the decision, emphasizing fairness and the UK’s responsibility to the world’s poorest. Alongside health and education, overseas aid is one of the few spending areas protected from significant cuts—most other Whitehall departments will see budget reductions of up to 10%. In total, UK Official Development Assistance will amount to £12.22 billion, with £11.1 billion allocated for DFID in 2015-16. The aid calculation includes £100 million from the Department for Business for science research benefiting poor countries, and another £100 million from the Home Office for asylum cases. Only foreign aid, NHS, and security agencies have seen budget increases, in contrast to cuts elsewhere. Billions in extra spending have been directed to infrastructure projects in transport, justice, and business sectors to stimulate growth. Osborne told Members of Parliament: 'Fairness also means refusing to balance the budget on the backs of the world’s poorest. I’m proud to be part of the first UK government to fulfill our pledge by spending 0.7% of national income on development, not only this year, but next year and the year after. The DFID budget will be set at £11.1 billion in 2015-16. Even during tough times, we honor our commitments.'
translated_content: George Osborne, die Britse Kanselier, het gesê hy is trots op die regering se verhoogde besteding aan buitelandse hulp. Hy het 'n bykomende £809 miljoen aangekondig vir internasionale ontwikkeling in 2015-16 om die koalisieregering se verbintenis na te kom om 0.7% van die nasionale inkomste aan hulp te bestee. Om by die 0.7%-teiken uit te kom, sal befondsing van die Home Office en Department for Business ook aan die hulpdoelwit toegevoeg word. Terwyl baie Konserwatiewe agterbanklede teen die beskerming van hulpspandering geargumenteer het en vir snitte gevra het, het Osborne die besluit verdedig en beklemtoon dat dit gaan oor regverdigheid en die VK se verantwoordelikheid teenoor die wêreld se armstes. Saam met gesondheid en onderwys is buitelandse hulp een van die min bestedingsareas wat teen groot snitte beskerm word—meeste ander Whitehall-departemente gaan begrotingsverlagings van tot 10% ervaar. In totaal sal die VK se Offisiële Ontwikkelingshulp £12.22 miljard beloop, waarvan £11.1 miljard aan DFID in 2015-16 toegeken word. Die hulpsyfer sluit £100 miljoen van die Department for Business in vir wetenskapnavorsing wat arm lande bevoordeel, en nog £100 miljoen van die Home Office vir asielaangeleenthede. Slegs buitelandse hulp, die NHS en sekuriteitsagentskappe het begrotingsverhogings gesien, in kontras met snitte elders. Miljarde se ekstra besteding is aangewend vir infrastruktuurprojekte in vervoer, justisie en besighede om groei aan te wakker. Osborne het aan Lede van die Parlement gesê: 'Regverdigheid beteken ook om te weier om die begroting op die rug van die wêreld se armstes in balans te bring. Ek is trots om deel te wees van die eerste VK-regering wat ons belofte nakom deur 0.7% van nasionale inkomste aan ontwikkeling te bestee, nie net vanjaar nie, maar ook volgende jaar en die een daarna. Die DFID-begroting sal op £11.1 miljard in 2015-16 vasgestel word. Selfs in moeilike tye, eer ons ons verpligtinge.'

article_content: Nirav Karkera, Head of Research at Fisdom, says most mutual funds are investing in new age tech companies, either before IPOs at the anchor stage or after listing. Initial exposures are typically small, regardless of timing. Mutual funds' investments in IPOs and startups have been scrutinized before. Karkera explains mutual fund managers often begin with modest positions, which may evolve into more strategic investments as companies mature in the market. For underperforming tech companies, mutual funds tend to reduce their exposure, while increasing stakes in companies demonstrating profitability. He emphasizes that investors should understand the underlying holdings of their mutual funds to avoid overlapping investments and ensure proper diversification. Significant mutual fund participation was seen in recent IPOs like Tata Technologies, where 17 domestic funds took part in anchor allocations worth around Rs 355 crore. Karkera reassures that fund managers have a responsibility to conduct thorough due diligence and to actively manage exposures, adjusting holdings as company performance and prospects change. He encourages investors to maintain a long-term perspective and have confidence in their fund managers’ strategies, as long as they trust the manager’s philosophy and performance record.
translated_content: Nirav Karkera, Hoof van Navorsing by Fisdom, sê dat die meeste effektefondse tans in nuwe tegnologiemaatskappye belê, hetsy voor die IPO's tydens die ankerstadium of ná notering. Aanvanklike blootstelling is gewoonlik klein, ongeag die tydsberekening. Effektefondse se beleggings in IPO's en beginmaatskappye was al voorheen onder die loep. Karkera verduidelik dat fondsbestuurders dikwels met beskeie posisies begin, wat meer strategies kan raak soos die maatskappy groei in die mark. By tegnologiemaatskappye wat nie goed presteer nie, verminder effektefondse dikwels hul blootstelling, terwyl hulle hul beleggings in winsgewende maatskappye vergroot. Hy beklemtoon dat beleggers die onderliggende aandele in hul effektefondse moet verstaan om dubbele blootstelling te vermy en goeie diversifikasie te verseker. Belangrike effektefondsdeelname is gesien in onlangse IPO's soos Tata Technologies, waar 17 plaaslike fondse aan ankerbeleggings van sowat Rs 355 miljoen deelgeneem het. Karkera verseker beleggers dat fondsbestuurders die verantwoordelikheid het om deeglike due diligence te doen en hul blootstelling aktief te bestuur deur beleggings aan te pas soos die maatskappye se prestasie en vooruitsigte verander. Hy moedig beleggers aan om 'n langtermynbenadering te handhaaf en op hul fondsbestuurder se strategieë te vertrou, solank as wat hulle die bestuurder se filosofie en rekord glo.
post_content: Mutual funds are playing it smart: small bets in new tech IPOs like Tata Tech at first, then ramping up if the company delivers. Diversify, know what you own! #investing #IPOs #mutualfunds

article_content: A tragic accident occurred during Pope Francis's recent visit to the Philippines, resulting in the death of Kristel Padasas, a 27-year-old volunteer. Kristel, based in Samar and originally from Manila, had been working on typhoon relief with Catholic Relief Services. She was struck by scaffolding blown over by strong winds from Tropical Storm Mekkhala while assisting at a mass near Tacloban airport. Despite receiving prompt medical attention at St Paul’s Hospital, she passed away soon after the Pope's departure. Upon learning of the accident, Pope Francis expressed his condolences and looked for ways to support Kristel's family. Catholic Relief Services highlighted her dedication to helping survivors of Typhoon Haiyan and her willingness to go beyond her expected duties. Her colleagues remembered her as joyful and selfless. Heavy rains and winds, with gusts reaching 80mph, battered the mass attended by an estimated 150,000 people. Three others were injured by a falling barricade, according to the Philippine Red Cross. Separately, a jet carrying officials from the Pope's entourage veered off the runway at Tacloban airport, although no injuries occurred. The severe storm led the Pope to leave the city earlier than planned—his visit aimed to comfort those affected by the 2013 Typhoon Haiyan.

Kristel, wat oorspronklik van Manila kom en in Samar gewerk het, was besig met noodleniging saam met Catholic Relief Services. Sy is deur stellasies getref wat omgewaai is deur sterk winde van Tropiese Storm Mekkhala terwyl sy vrywillig by ’n mis naby Tacloban-lughawe gehelp het. Alhoewel sy vinnig na St Paul’s-hospitaal geneem is, is sy kort na die Pous se vertrek oorlede. Toe die Pous van die voorval hoor, het hy sy innige meegevoel betoon en het hy maniere gesoek om Kristel se familie by te staan. Catholic Relief Services het haar toegewyde diens aan tifoonoorlewendes beklemtoon en haar bereidheid om altyd te help, selfs buite haar normale pligte. Haar kollegas onthou haar as iemand wat altyd positief en onselfsugtig was. Swaar reën en winde, met rukwinde tot 130 km/h, het die byeenkoms van sowat 150,000 mense geteister. Die stormweer het veroorsaak dat die Pous sy besoek aan die stad vroeër moes beëindig—sy besoek was bedoel om troos te bring aan slagoffers van die 2013 Tifoon Haiyan.

article_content: A week-long strike that halted shipping on the St. Lawrence Seaway ended Sunday after a tentative agreement was reached between management and union workers. The strike, which began on October 22, involved about 360 Unifor union members in Ontario and Quebec who walked off the job amid a dispute over wages. This action led to the closure of 13 locks and temporarily stopped the movement of grain and other goods between the U.S. and Canada. The St. Lawrence Seaway connects the Atlantic Ocean with the Great Lakes, spanning more than 2,300 miles (3,700 kilometers) from the ocean to Lake Superior. Each year, the seaway handles over $12 billion (almost $17 billion Canadian) in cargo, with vessels known as 'salties' and 'lakers' using the route. St. Lawrence Seaway Management Corp. announced shipping would resume as employees return to work at 7 a.m. Monday. CEO Terence Bowles called the deal 'fair for workers' and important for the seaway’s future. Unifor stated its members will vote to ratify the agreement soon, with details to be shared once finalized. The Chamber of Marine Commerce estimated that the disruption, which occurred during one of the seaway’s busiest periods, cost up to $100 million per day in lost economic activity across Canada and the U.S. This was the first strike to halt the seaway since 1968. Chamber president Bruce Burrows welcomed the agreement, expressing hope that critical shipping services would soon return to normal.

Die staking, wat op 22 Oktober begin het, het sowat 360 Unifor vakbondlede in Ontario en Quebec betrek wat in ‘n geskil oor lone die werk neergelê het. article_content: A celebrity minder assaulted by police in a north London convenience store while accompanying comedian Noel Fielding has been awarded more than £100,000 in compensation. Judge Rosalind Coe QC found that Jimmy Browne’s leg was crushed during an unlawful attempted arrest. Two officers recognised Fielding, who was wearing a flamboyant stage costume, as the star of BBC’s The Mighty Boosh. On Easter Sunday, Fielding, dressed in gold boots and a boiler suit, and his acquaintance Jimmy Browne were stopped by police outside a convenience store in Kentish Town. The officers, PC O’Leary and PC Tucker, suspected the men of carrying drugs due to the area’s reputation as a ‘drugs hotspot’. Browne, who formerly worked as a security guard for Amy Winehouse, was found with a small amount of cocaine but was not charged. Browne, who has previous convictions and admits to past drug use, suffered significant injuries, leaving him with a limp and requiring occasional use of a wheelchair. He was awarded £108,491 in aggravated damages for the negative impact on his employment prospects and for the high-handed and oppressive actions of the police. The court heard that Fielding, who admitted being drunk after an all-night party, and Browne were stopped as they headed home. Browne claimed he was attacked unexpectedly from behind, while the officers alleged he struggled and tried to conceal something. The judge noted inconsistencies in both accounts but found the officers exaggerated their version of events and acted dishonestly. Browne’s leg injury required a month in hospital, and complications during recovery led to further injuries. Judge Coe determined that Fielding, described as an honest and straightforward witness, was unnecessarily restrained during the incident. While Browne’s criminal record was considered to have limited relevance, the judge observed he had no formal work history, tax records, or bank accounts. The CCTV footage from the incident, which could have served as crucial evidence, was damaged beyond use while in the custody of the police’s solicitors.

article_content: Senior Labour figures increased pressure on Ed Miliband regarding his relationship with British business, with one of the party's major donors warning it is 'in danger of promoting communism.' Former minister Geoffrey Robinson also criticized the party's leadership for what he called a 'terrible, neglectful' attitude towards industry leaders. Robinson, who served as paymaster general at the Treasury with Miliband, urged, 'The mood music is wrong. I don’t know how it’s happened, but it needs to be corrected.' Key donor and Hull City owner Assem Allam, who invited Miliband to a football match, said on the Daily Politics: 'The policies are right; the mood music is wrong. They are still New Labour, all the policies, all the statements on business. If the shadow Cabinet hasn't given that impression, it's a terrible, neglectful omission on their part. We have got to engage. We are not anti-business, we are not anti-trade union. We are for both.' Assem Allam, an Egyptian-born entrepreneur who contributed £110,000 to Labour last June, criticized the party for treating successful businessmen as if 'they should go away and die.' He said, 'I create wealth, exports and jobs. What’s wrong with that? Labour is promoting socialism – and they’re in danger of promoting communism.' Labour peer Lord Noon also criticized Ed Balls for failing to recall a business supporter’s name and Miliband for omitting the deficit from his conference speech. 'It is very embarrassing,' he said, joking that Miliband and Balls should 'eat almonds' to improve memory. Sir Charles Dunstone, founder of Carphone Warehouse, who once supported Labour, said he is 'frightened' by the prospect of a Labour win in the general election, noting that businesses feel 'isolated' by Labour's shift to the left. Miliband has introduced a series of policies targeting industries such as energy suppliers and private landlords, leading to conflict with business leaders. The most recent row began when Miliband criticized Boots CEO Stefano Pessina over his comments about a possible Labour victory, accusing him of tax avoidance. This confrontation prompted further warnings from business leaders. Miliband remained defiant, saying the row highlighted key differences between Labour and the Conservatives. 'We think a country succeeds with an economy based on a different idea, that it is only when working people succeed that Britain succeeds,' Miliband told the Western Morning News. Lord Rose, a former M&S boss and now a Conservative peer, warned Miliband was harming Britain's pro-business consensus. Robinson labelled communication with business as problematic if someone like Rose is critical. Ed Miliband also admitted he would pay the mansion tax on his £2.7 million North London home, saying he would be 'very happy' to contribute, as the tax is intended to raise money for the NHS.

article_content: This week marks 20 years since Raul’s professional football debut. The New York Cosmos, a team in the North American Soccer League, have just signed the 37-year-old Spaniard on a multi-year contract starting in 2015. Raul, who enjoyed a storied run with Real Madrid, has also been appointed as technical advisor for the Cosmos’ new youth academy, set to open the following year. On joining, Raul said: ‘Everyone knows the Cosmos and their legendary status in American soccer. I’m honored to join and share in the club’s vision for the future.’ Raul’s career achievements include six La Liga titles, three Champions League wins, and the record for most Champions League goals for Real Madrid. He scored 323 goals in 741 appearances for Madrid, played at Schalke 04 and Al Sadd, and earned 102 caps for Spain, scoring 44 times. The Cosmos are known for their past signings of global stars like Pele and Franz Beckenbauer in the original NASL. Pele starred with the Cosmos in the late ’70s, winning a league title and later becoming the club’s honorary president. Franz Beckenbauer, fresh from successes in Germany, played two terms with the Cosmos before retiring. Giorgio Chinaglia was another star, netting nearly a goal per appearance and leading the team to four league titles. Despite not securing a spot in the latest MLS expansion that went to New York City FC (a club owned by Manchester City and the Yankees, soon to feature David Villa), the Cosmos continue to aim high, shown by Raul’s acquisition. Head coach Giovanni Savarese described Raul as a world-class footballer whose experience and leadership will benefit both the main squad and the developing youth academy. Cosmos COO Erik Stover added that Raul is considered one of the greats of his generation and called his arrival monumental for the club and for soccer in America. Raul’s move to New York follows his extensive success in Europe and beyond, and signals a new chapter both for him and for the Cosmos as they invest in building the next generation of players.

article_content: By Daniel Miller. PUBLISHED: 05:39 EST, 28 August 2012 | UPDATED: 13:15 EST, 29 August 2012. Yosemite National Park has warned that 1,700 people who visited the park this summer may have been exposed to a rare rodent-borne disease linked to two deaths. In emails sent Monday evening, the park stated that anyone who was at Yosemite between mid-June and late August might have been exposed to hantavirus pulmonary syndrome. The disease can be carried in the urine, saliva, and feces of infected deer mice. Officials are now warning visitors, especially those who stayed in tent cabins in the park's Curry Village (pictured), to be aware of flu-like symptoms. Yosemite advised anyone experiencing such symptoms to see a doctor as soon as possible. The National Park Service told the LA Times: 'An outreach effort is currently underway to contact visitors who stayed in 'Signature Tent Cabins' at Curry Village from mid-June through the end of August. These individuals are being informed of the recent cases and advised to seek immediate medical attention if they show any symptoms of hantavirus.' A second person has died within a month from the rare rodent-borne hantavirus after visiting one of the most popular parts of Yosemite National Park. Yosemite, located in the western Sierra Nevada mountains of California, typically welcomes over 3.7 million visitors annually. The first victim, a 37-year-old Alameda County man, is believed to have contracted the disease while staying in a tent cabin at Curry Village in mid-June. Details of the latest victim have not been released. Hantaviruses are spread through rodent bites, urine, or saliva. Humans infected can develop potentially fatal diseases, such as hemorrhagic fever and hantavirus pulmonary syndrome. Early symptoms are similar to the flu and include chills, fever, and muscle aches. People may briefly feel better, but within 1–2 days, breathing difficulties, a dry cough, vomiting, and headaches may develop. Of the 587 documented U.S. cases since 1993, about one-third have proved fatal. There is no specific treatment for the virus. Almost all cases involving humans have been linked to contact with rodent excrement. However, human-to-human transmission has been reported with a specific Andes strain in South America. The name hantavirus comes from the Hantan River area in South Korea, where the first cases were identified in the late 1970s. The disease was previously known as Korean hemorrhagic fever. During the Korean War, several thousand United Nations soldiers became ill with the disease, sparking a 25-year search for its cause. There has been one other confirmed case of the illness, and a fourth possible case is currently being investigated. Federal health authorities say symptoms may develop up to five weeks after exposure to urine, droppings, or saliva of infected rodents. Visitors are advised to monitor for symptoms for up to six weeks. Following the first death, which was reported earlier this month, state health officials advised anyone with symptoms to seek medical attention and inform doctors if they had been camping in Yosemite. Officials note that thousands visit the park every month, making it impossible to track everyone who stayed in Curry Village. Curry Village is the most popular and economical lodging area in the park, a picturesque collection of rustic cabins at the base of the 3,000-foot-high promontory Glacier Point. Park spokesperson Scott Gediman told the San Francisco Chronicle that of the 408 tent cabins in the village, 91 are 'signature' models, where the four cases had stayed, featuring more insulation and amenities than the others. Gediman said contractors are working on the signature cabins to protect guests. 'They're doing everything they can to eliminate areas where mice can enter the cabins,' Gediman said. 'This was never due to the cabins being dirty or poorly maintained. Approximately 20 percent of all deer mice are infected with hantavirus, and they are present in Yosemite Valley.' These are the first deaths related to the disease among park visitors, although two others were stricken in remote areas in 2000 and 2010, according to officials.

In e-posse wat Maandagaand gestuur is, het die park gesê dat enigiemand wat tussen middel Junie en laat Augustus by Yosemite was, moontlik aan hantavirus longsindroom blootgestel is. Die siekte kan in die urine, speeksel en ontlasting van besmette muise voorkom. Amptenare waarsku nou veral besoekers wat in tentkajuite in die park se Curry Village (sien foto) gebly het, om bewus te wees van griepagtige simptome. Yosemite het aanbeveel dat enigiemand met sulke simptome so gou moontlik ‘n dokter moet sien. Die Nasionale Parkdiens het aan die LA Times gesê: ‘n Uitreikpoging is tans aan die gang om besoekers wat tussen middel Junie en einde Augustus by 'Handtekening Tentkajuite' in Curry Village gebly het, te kontak. Hierdie persone word ingelig oor die onlangse gevalle en word aangeraai om dadelik mediese hulp te kry as hulle enige simptome van hantavirus wys. ‘n Tweede persoon het binne ‘n maand aan die seldsame knaagdiervoorgedra hantavirus gesterf nadat hy een van die gewildste dele van Yosemite Nasionale Park besoek het. Yosemite, in die westelike Sierra Nevada-bergreeks van Kalifornië, verwelkom jaarliks meer as 3,7 miljoen besoekers. Die eerste slagoffer, ‘n 37-jarige man van Alameda County, het glo die siekte opgedoen terwyl hy in ‘n tentkajuit in Curry Village in middel Junie gebly het. Besonderhede oor die nuutste slagoffer is nie bekend gemaak nie. Hantavirusse versprei deur muisbite, urine of speeksel. Mense wat besmet word, kan potensieel dodelike siektes soos hemorragiese koors en hantavirus longsindroom ontwikkel. Vroeë simptome lyk soos griep, insluitend rillings, koors en spierpyne. Mense kan vir ‘n kort ruk beter voel, maar binne 1-2 dae kan asemhalingsprobleme, ‘n droë hoes, braking en hoofpyn opduik. Van die 587 gedokumenteerde gevalle in die VSA sedert 1993 was sowat ‘n derde dodelik. Daar is geen spesifieke behandeling vir die virus nie. Byna alle gevalle by mense is gekoppel aan kontak met muisuitwerpsels. Mens-tot-mens-oordrag is net met ‘n spesifieke Andes-variant in Suid-Amerika gerapporteer. Die naam hantavirus kom van die Hantanrivier-gebied in Suid-Korea, waar die eerste gevalle in die laat 1970’s geïdentifiseer is. Die siekte was voorheen as Koreaanse hemorragiese koors bekend. Tydens die Koreaanse Oorlog het duisende Verenigde Nasies-soldate siek geword van die siekte, wat ‘n 25 jaar lange soektog na die oorsaak tot gevolg gehad het. Daar was een ander bevestigde geval van die siekte, en ‘n vierde moontlike geval word tans ondersoek. Federale gesondheidsowerhede sê simptome kan tot vyf weke ná blootstelling aan urine, ontlasting of speeksel van besmette knaagdiere voorkom. Besoekers word aangeraai om simptome vir tot ses weke dop te hou. Na die eerste dood vroeër hierdie maand gerapporteer is, het staatsgesondheidsamptenare aanbeveel dat enigiemand met simptome mediese hulp soek en hul dokters laat weet as hulle in Yosemite gekamp het. Amptenare meld dat duisende mense die park elke maand besoek, wat dit onmoontlik maak om almal op te spoor wat in Curry Village gebly het. Curry Village is die gewildste en mees bekostigbare verblyfsarea in die park, ‘n prentjiemooi samestelling van rustieke hutte aan die voet van Glacier Point, wat 3,000 voet hoog is. Parkwoordvoerder Scott Gediman het aan die San Francisco Chronicle gesê dat van die 408 tentkajuite in die dorpie, 91 ‘handtekening’-modelle is waar die vier gevalle aangemeld is. Dié het meer isolasie en geriewe as die ander. Gediman sê kontrakteurs werk aan die handtekening-kajuite om gaste te beskerm. ‘Hulle doen alles wat hulle kan om te verhoed dat muise die kajuite binnekom,’ het Gediman gesê. ‘Dit was nooit as gevolg van vuilheid of swak onderhoud nie. Ongeveer 20 persent van alle hertmuise is besmet met hantavirus, en hulle kom voor in die Yosemite-vallei.’ Hierdie is die eerste sterftes aan die siekte onder parkbesoekers, hoewel twee ander in afgeleë gebiede in 2000 en 2010 aangemeld is, sê amptenare.

article_content: The Western Australian government caught 172 sharks and killed 50 of the largest as part of a culling program that has sparked criticism from conservationists. The three-month initiative, which ended last week, used baited lines attached to floating drums to capture sharks off popular Western Australian beaches after a series of fatal shark attacks in recent years. As part of the state's $20 million shark mitigation policy, tiger, bull, and great white sharks longer than 10 feet (3 meters) caught on the drum lines were destroyed. Fifty tiger sharks exceeding 10 feet were killed between January 25 and April 30. The largest, measuring 14.8 feet (4.5 meters), was caught in February off Perth's Floreat beach. However, none of the sharks captured were great white sharks, which are believed to be responsible for most of the recent fatal attacks in Western Australia, resulting in seven deaths over the past three years. According to government figures released Wednesday, another 14 sharks under 10 feet died on the drum lines, and four more were euthanized as they were too weak to survive. Fisheries Minister Ken Baston described the shark mitigation policy as a success, saying it helped boost beachgoers' confidence and contributed to research into shark behavior. 'The human toll from shark attacks in recent years has been too high,' Baston said in a media statement. 'While we cannot know if any of the captured sharks would have harmed someone, this government always prioritizes human life.' Environmentalists have criticized the program, saying sharks are protected species and should remain so. 'Of the 172 sharks caught, most were tiger sharks, which have not been involved in fatalities in Western Australia for decades,' said Natalie Banks, a Sea Shepherd shark campaigner, to CNN. She added that over 70% of the captured animals were not large enough to pose a threat or were other marine animals like stingrays. Banks also noted that sharks released alive often showed signs of shock known as tonic immobility and would sink to the ocean floor. In addition to the culling, the Western Australian Department of Fisheries is developing a satellite-linked shark tagging program to provide near real-time alerts of tagged sharks in the area. As part of the three-month scheme, 90 sharks were tagged and released alive. Other animals freed included seven stingrays and a north-west blowfish. Government figures also showed a decrease in beach closures due to shark sightings: 93 in 2013-14 compared to 131 the previous season. The government is seeking approval to extend the culling program for another three years.
translated_content: Die Wes-Australiese regering het 172 haaie gevang en 50 van die grootste gedood as deel van 'n uitroeiingsprogram wat kritiek van natuurbewaarders ontlok het. Die drie-maande lange inisiatief, wat verlede week geëindig het, het aaslyne aan drywende dromme gebruik om haaie by gewilde Wes-Australiese strande te vang ná 'n reeks noodlottige haaiaanvalle die afgelope paar jaar. As deel van die staat se $20 miljoen haai-mitigeringsbeleid is tier-, bul- en grootwithaaie langer as 3 meter wat aan die dromlyne gevang is, gedood. Vyftig tierhaaie langer as 3 meter is tussen 25 Januarie en 30 April gedood. Die grootste een, wat 4,5 meter was, is in Februarie by Perth se Floreat-strand gevang. Geen van die haaie wat gevang is, was egter grootwithaaie nie — die spesie wat vermoedelik verantwoordelik is vir die meeste onlangse noodlottige aanvalle in Wes-Australië, wat oor die afgelope drie jaar tot sewe sterftes gelei het. Volgens regeringsyfers wat Woensdag gepubliseer is, het nog 14 haaie korter as 3 meter aan die dromlyne gesterf, en nog vier is genadiglik doodgemaak omdat hulle te swak was om te oorleef. Visserye Minister Ken Baston het die haai-mitigeringsbeleid as 'n sukses beskryf, en gesê dit het strandgangers se selfvertroue verhoog en bygedra tot navorsing oor haai-gedrag. 'Die menslike tol van haaiaanvalle die afgelope paar jaar was te hoog,' het Baston in 'n mediaverklaring gesê. 'Al weet ons nie of enige van die gevangde haaie iemand sou seermaak nie, plaas hierdie regering altyd die hoogste waarde op menslike lewe.' Natuurbewaarders het die program gekritiseer en gesê dat haaie beskermde spesies is wat so moet bly. 'Van die 172 haaie wat gevang is, was die meeste tierhaaie, wat nie al vir dekades in dodelike aanvalle in Wes-Australië betrokke was nie,' het Natalie Banks, 'n Sea Shepherd-haai-veldtogvoerder, aan CNN gesê. Sy het bygevoeg dat meer as 70% van die diere wat gevang is, nie groot genoeg was om as bedreiging gesien te word nie, of ander seediere soos pylstert-rokke was. Banks het ook genoem dat haaie wat lewendig vrygelaat is dikwels tekens van skok getoon het, bekend as toniese onbeweeglikheid, en op die oseaanvloer gesink het. Benewens die uitroeiing, ontwikkel die Wes-Australiese Departement van Visserye 'n satelliet-gekoppelde haai-merkprogram om byna regstreekse waarskuwings te gee van gemerkte haaie in die gebied. As deel van die drie-maande lange program is 90 haaie gemerk en lewendig vrygelaat. Ander diere wat vrygelaat is, sluit sewe pylstert-rokke en 'n noordwes-blaasvis in. Regeringsyfers het ook 'n afname in strandsluitings weens haai-waarnemings getoon: daar was 93 in 2013-14 teenoor 131 die vorige seisoen. Die regering probeer nou om goedkeuring te kry om die program vir nog drie jaar te verleng.

article_content: Lea Glob’s documentary Apolonia, Apolonia earned the most nominations — four — as the IDA Documentary Awards revealed its nominees for the 39th edition of the event. Close behind, The Mother of All Lies (directed by Asmae El Moudir) and Milisuthando (directed by Milisuthando Bongela) each received three nominations. Apolonia, Apolonia is a deeply personal film, exploring the life and work of French artist Apolonia Sokol over 13 years. The film is nominated for Best Documentary Feature, Best Director, Best Writing, and Best Editing. It previously won the top prize at IDFA and has been recognized at festivals in Copenhagen, Hong Kong, and Sofia, among others. Despite this success, it has yet to secure U.S. distribution. The Mother of All Lies is nominated for Best Documentary Feature, Best Director, and Best Writing. In the film, El Moudir and her father construct a model of their old Casablanca neighborhood, helping the family process past trauma, much of it shaped by matriarch Zahra. Milisuthando, from South Africa, is a personal exploration of growing up under apartheid. Director Bongela calls it 'a meditation on difficult questions about power, fear, intimacy, and love related to race.' The film received nominations for Best Documentary Feature, Best Director, and Best Writing. A total of ten films are nominated for Best Documentary Feature, with a full list of nominees in 18 categories provided by the IDA. Nominees and shortlists were chosen by independent committees comprising 280 documentary professionals from 40 countries. Traditionally held in Los Angeles, this year’s IDA Documentary Awards ceremony will take place virtually on December 12, in response to ongoing global conflicts. The IDA expressed a commitment to storytelling as a force for empathy and peace. IDA members can view the nominees and vote for winners in the Best Feature and Best Short categories from November 21 to December 5.

The Mother of All Lies (regisseur: Asmae El Moudir) en Milisuthando (regisseur: Milisuthando Bongela) het elk drie benoemings ontvang. Apolonia, Apolonia is 'n baie persoonlike film wat die lewe en werk van die Franse kunstenaar Apolonia Sokol oor 13 jaar ondersoek. Die film is benoem vir Beste Dokumentêre Rolprent, Beste Regisseur, Beste Skryfwerk, en Beste Redigering. Dit het reeds die topprys by IDFA gewen en is by feeste in Kopenhagen, Hongkong en Sofia, onder andere, vereer. Ten spyte van hierdie sukses het die film nog nie Amerikaanse verspreiding gekry nie. Die film het benoemings ontvang vir Beste Dokumentêre Rolprent, Beste Regisseur, en Beste Skryfwerk. Die IDA Dokumentêre Toekennings word tradisioneel in Los Angeles gehou, maar hierdie jaar sal dit virtueel plaasvind op 12 Desember weens wêreldwye konflikte. article_content: Environment Secretary Owen Paterson has called on British diners to help reduce the nation’s ‘dessert deficit’ by opting for traditional British puddings instead of imported treats. Appointed this month to help boost the rural economy, Paterson urged the public to choose classic desserts such as treacle tart, apple crumble, and spotted dick, replacing foreign favorites like panna cotta, crème brulee, and tiramisu. In an interview with Farmers Weekly, Paterson stressed the importance of supporting UK farmers, particularly as many in the dairy sector struggle with the cost of milk production. He expressed alarm at the high volume of imported dairy-based desserts and highlighted the opportunity to replace them with British-made products. Peter Henderson, chairman of the Gloucestershire-based Pudding Club, supported Paterson's message, stating that government backing for British puddings is positive for the economy and traditional food culture. Official statistics show that last year, the UK imported 115,000 tonnes of ice cream, compared to only 50,000 tonnes exported. Yoghurt imports reached almost 150,000 tonnes, while just 25,000 tonnes were exported. While only 2% of liquid milk is imported, there is a much higher influx of processed dairy products from abroad. Paterson contends that if more people bought British-made desserts, it could help reverse the trend of imports and provide significant benefits to the farming industry. He also noted that popular shows like The Great British Bake Off have reignited interest in traditional British desserts. Defra is currently exploring ways to encourage consumers to purchase more British products and to expand food exports. Paterson emphasized the broader role of the department in supporting food production, promoting dairy products, and helping rural businesses thrive.

In ’n onderhoud met Farmers Weekly het Paterson die belangrikheid beklemtoon om Britse boere te ondersteun, veral aangesien baie in die suiwelsektor met produksiekoste sukkel. Hy het sy kommer uitgespreek oor die groot hoeveelheid ingevoerde suiwel-nageregte en die geleentheid uitgelig om dit met plaaslike produkte te vervang. Peter Henderson, voorsitter van die Gloucestershire-gebaseerde Pudding Club, het Paterson se boodskap gesteun en gesê regeringsondersteuning vir Britse poedings is positief vir die ekonomie en tradisionele voedselkultuur. Alhoewel net 2% van vloeibare melk ingevoer word, bly daar ‘n groot invoer van verwerkte suiwelprodukte. Paterson glo as meer mense plaaslik-gekookte nageregte koop, kan dit die invoertrend omkeer en die landbousektor bevoordeel. Hy het ook genoem dat gewilde programme soos The Great British Bake Off belangstelling in tradisionele Britse nageregte herleef het. Defra ondersoek tans maniere om verbruikers aan te moedig om meer Britse produkte te koop en voedseluitvoer te verhoog. Paterson het die breër rol van die departement beklemtoon om voedselproduksie, die bevordering van suiwelprodukte, en die ondersteuning van plattelandse besighede te versterk.

article_content: LISBON, Portugal — Portuguese Prime Minister António Costa resigned on Tuesday after his government became embroiled in a widespread corruption probe, shocking the typically stable politics of the European Union member country. Costa, 62, Portugal’s Socialist leader since 2015, insists he is innocent, but stated in a televised address that 'under these circumstances, I have submitted my resignation to the president of the republic.' Earlier in the day, police arrested his chief of staff and raided several public and private properties as part of the investigation. According to the state prosecutor’s office, the Supreme Court is examining whether suspects used the prime minister’s name and involvement while allegedly conducting illicit activities. Minister of Infrastructure João Galamba and the head of the environmental agency are among those named as suspects. President Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa quickly accepted Costa's resignation. He is expected to dissolve parliament and call for new elections. De Sousa stated he will meet with representatives of political parties in parliament on Wednesday and address the nation after the Council of State meets on Thursday. Costa became emotional while thanking his family for their support. 'I completely trust the justice system,' he said, addressing the nation. 'I want to say directly to the Portuguese people that my conscience is clear of any illicit or questionable act.' He acknowledged he is not 'above the law.' 'The dignity of the prime minister’s office is incompatible with any suspicion on my integrity or conduct, and certainly with the suspicion of criminal acts,' Costa said. An investigative judge ordered the arrest of Vítor Escária, Costa’s chief of staff, the mayor of Sines, and three others, citing a flight risk and the need to safeguard evidence. The judge is investigating alleged corruption, malfeasance, and influence peddling in relation to lithium mining near Portugal’s northern border with Spain, as well as plans for a green hydrogen plant and data center in Sines. Police raids targeted the ministries of environment and infrastructure, Sines town council, private residences, and offices. Portugal’s lithium mines and green hydrogen projects are part of EU-backed environmental initiatives. Costa strongly supported these projects and is an ally of Spain’s acting Prime Minister, Pedro Sánchez. Costa appeared likely to retain power for several more years after his Socialist Party's landslide victory in last year’s elections. However, in December 2022, his Minister of Infrastructure and Housing resigned after controversy over a €500,000 ($533,000) compensation payment to a TAP Air Portugal board member. The junior infrastructure minister also stepped down. Since Costa’s party’s 2022 election win, ten senior officials have resigned, several amid scandals. Costa said he had not received advance notice of being under legal scrutiny. 'This is a phase of my life that comes to an end,' he said. Lisbon residents expressed mixed feelings. Teresa Veiga, 62, an education assistant, voiced concern about instability, while Pedro Filipe, 29, a software developer, welcomed the change as a potential reset amid political inertia and corruption. Wilson reported, with Renata Brito contributing from Barcelona, Spain.
translated_content: LISSABON, Portugal — Die Portugese Eerste Minister António Costa het Dinsdag bedank nadat sy regering in 'n wydverspreide korrupsieondersoek betrek is, wat die gewoonlik stabiele politiek van hierdie Europese Unie-lidland geskok het. Costa, 62, die Sosialistiese leier van Portugal sedert 2015, dring daarop aan dat hy onskuldig is, maar het in 'n televisietoespraak gesê: 'Onder hierdie omstandighede het ek my bedanking aan die president van die republiek ingedien.' Vroeër die dag het die polisie sy kabinetshoof gearresteer en verskeie openbare en privaat eiendomme deursoek as deel van die ondersoek. Volgens die staatsaanklaer ondersoek die Hooggeregshof of verdagtes die eerste minister se naam en betrokkenheid gebruik het in beweerde onwettige aktiwiteite. Minister van Infrastruktuur João Galamba en die hoof van die omgewingsagentskap is onder die verdagtes. President Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa het vinnig Costa se bedanking aanvaar. Dit word verwag dat hy die parlement sal ontbind en nuwe verkiesings sal uitroep. De Sousa het gesê hy gaan Woensdag met parlementêre partyleiers vergader en die nasie Donderdag toespreek ná die Raad van State se vergadering. Costa was emosioneel toe hy sy gesin bedank het vir hul ondersteuning. 'Ek het volkome vertroue in die regstelsel,' het hy aan die nasie gesê. 'Ek wil reguit vir die Portugese mense sê dat my gewete vry is van enige onwettige of bevraagtekenbare daad.' Hy het erken hy is nie 'bo die wet' nie. 'Die waardigheid van die eerste minister se amp is nie versoenbaar met enige vermoede oor my integriteit of optrede nie, en beslis nie met die vermoede van kriminele dade nie,' het Costa gesê. 'n Ondersoekregter het die inhegtenisname van Vítor Escária, Costa se kabinetshoof, die burgemeester van Sines, en drie ander beveel, weens 'n vlugrisiko en om bewyse te beskerm. Die regter ondersoek beweerde korrupsie, wanbestuur en invloedryke bedrywighede rakende litiummynbou naby Portugal se noordgrens met Spanje, asook planne vir 'n groen waterstofaanleg en datacentrum in Sines. Polisieraids het die departemente van omgewing en infrastruktuur, Sines se stadsraad, privaat wonings en kantore geteiken. Portugal se litiummyne en groen waterstofprojekte is deel van EU-gesteunde omgewingsinisiatiewe. Costa het die projekte sterk ondersteun en is 'n bondgenoot van Spanje se waarnemende eerste minister, Pedro Sánchez. Costa sou waarskynlik nog 'n paar jaar aan bewind gebly het na sy Sosialistiese Party se oortuigende oorwinning in verlede jaar se verkiesings. In Desember 2022 het sy Minister van Infrastruktuur en Behuising egter bedank ná omstredenheid oor 'n €500,000 ($533,000) uitbetaling aan 'n TAP Air Portugal raadsheer. Die junior infrastruktuurminister het ook bedank. Tien senior regeringsamptenare het sedert Costa se party die 2022-verkiesing gewen het, bedank—verskeie weens skandale. Costa het gesê hy was nie vooraf bewus daarvan dat hy ondersoek word nie. 'Dit is 'n fase van my lewe wat nou eindig,' het hy gesê. In Lissabon het inwoners uiteenlopende reaksies getoon. Teresa Veiga, 62, 'n onderwysassistent, is bekommerd oor onsekerheid, terwyl Pedro Filipe, 29, 'n sagtewareontwikkelaar, glo die verandering is 'n kans vir 'n nuwe begin te midde van politiese traagheid en korrupsie. Wilson het berig, met Renata Brito wat bygedra het vanaf Barcelona, ​​Spanje.

article_content: Jake Foushee, a 14-year-old from America, has gone viral thanks to his impressive voice acting abilities. In a video filmed in his bedroom, Jake performs a movie trailer impression inspired by Don LaFontaine, the legendary 'Voiceover King.' The 32-second clip has amassed over 144,000 views and features Jake expressing his dream of becoming a professional voice actor. He delivers the classic movie trailer line in a deep, resonant tone: 'In a world where the Earth was no longer in our control, with our survival at stake, we have one chance... and that chance is to fight back. Get ready for the most thrill-ride motion picture event of the year: Apocalypse. In theatres everywhere. Friday.' His performance closely echoes Don LaFontaine’s distinctive style. LaFontaine, who died in 2008 at age 68, was renowned for voicing more than 5,000 movie trailers—including for classics like The Godfather Part II, Dr Strangelove, Ghostbusters, Home Alone, and Terminator. LaFontaine was also the voice behind many TV programs such as Entertainment Tonight and The Insider, plus thousands of adverts. His famous phrase, 'In a world where...,' has become a mainstay in movie culture.

In ’n video wat in sy slaapkamer opgeneem is, boots Jake ’n rolprentvoorskou na, geïnspireer deur Don LaFontaine, die legendariese ‘Voiceover King’. Die 32-sekonde video het reeds meer as 144 000 kyke gekry en wys dat Jake sy droom het om ’n professionele stemakteur te word. Hy lewer die klassieke rolprentvoorskoulijn in ’n diep, oortuigde toon: ‘In ’n wêreld waar die aarde nie meer in ons beheer is nie, en ons oorlewing op die spel is, het ons net een kans… en daardie kans is om terug te baklei. Maak gereed vir die spannendste rolprentgeleentheid van die jaar: Apocalypse. In teaters orals. Vrydag.’ Sy prestasie eggo Don LaFontaine se unieke styl. LaFontaine, wat in 2008 op 68 dood is, was beroemd vir meer as 5 000 rolprentvoorskoue—ook vir films soos The Godfather Part II, Dr Strangelove, Ghostbusters, Home Alone en Terminator. LaFontaine was ook die stem van TV-programme soos Entertainment Tonight en The Insider, asook duisende advertensies. Sy beroemde frase, ‘In ’n wêreld waar...’, is nou deel van rolprentkultuur.

article_content: Food production and border controls in Northern Ireland are facing disruption after government vets began a five-day strike. Members of the Veterinary Service Animal Health Group (VSAHG) started industrial action at midnight. These vets conduct checks on animals and certain food products arriving in Northern Ireland from Great Britain. They also oversee abattoir operations and certify some meat exports. According to the British Meat Processors Association (BMPA), no slaughter of cattle, pigs, sheep, or poultry can take place without official veterinary presence in abattoirs. This means some meat plants may have to close, leading to food supply chain disruptions. However, supermarkets are minimizing concerns about potential shortages. The Department of Agriculture, Environment and Rural Affairs (Daera), which employs the vets, said it would prioritize staffing at poultry factories. Daera announced it 'cannot guarantee the provision of official controls and activities across all slaughter and animal processing establishments from 30 October to 3 November.' To mitigate the effects, it will focus on supporting the intensive livestock sector, starting with poultry, and will review the situation daily. The red meat sector aims to keep major plants operational and does not anticipate shortages for consumers. John McClenahan from the Ulster Farmers Union commented that the timing of the strike is particularly challenging for producers, who are preparing for increased demand before Christmas. He also noted farmers’ understanding of the pay dispute but expressed concern about the burden it places on them. Louise Hosking from the Chartered Institute of Environmental Health (CIEH) emphasized the importance of maintaining food safety and animal welfare standards during this crucial time. She urged the UK government to resolve the dispute quickly. The Nipsa union, representing the vets, said the walkout is a response to an 'insulting' £552 pay award for civil service staff. Union official Carmel Gates expressed frustration over lack of engagement from Northern Ireland Secretary Chris Heaton-Harris regarding the issue, highlighting the essential role vets play in the food chain. Government vets are central to implementing post-Brexit Irish Sea border controls on some goods moving from Great Britain to Northern Ireland. The strike could force some goods—especially 'red lane' products requiring detailed checks—to be rerouted through Dublin instead of Belfast. There are concerns about animal welfare if abattoirs cannot operate, particularly for pigs, which could accumulate on farms. Overweight animals may face penalties and no compensation for farmers, while lack of space could limit intake of new animals and reduce farmers’ income before Christmas. During the strike, Daera advises that 'green lane' products should be shipped as usual, with paperwork completed later. Major supermarkets—using mainly the green lane—expect minimal disruption. Retail NI chief executive Glyn Roberts and Northern Ireland Retail Consortium director Neil Johnston both urged consumers not to panic-buy, predicting little change on supermarket shelves despite potential wider supply chain impacts. Non-supermarket operators, who use the red lane more often, will face bigger challenges, possibly needing to reroute shipments to Dublin. The movement of live animals from Great Britain to Northern Ireland—requiring vet inspection—will also be affected, and Daera recommends delaying such transfers until the strike ends. The UK government says it is working with Daera to minimize disruption, particularly in the food supply chain, and to maintain its statutory obligations.
translated_content: Voedselproduksie en grensbeheer in Noord-Ierland ondervind ontwrigting nadat staatsveeartse 'n vyfdae-staking begin het. Lede van die Veterinary Service Animal Health Group (VSAHG) het die aksie om middernag begin. Hierdie veeartse doen inspeksies op diere en sekere voedselprodukte wat uit Groot-Brittanje in Noord-Ierland aankom. Hulle hou ook toesig oor abattoirs en sertifiseer sommige vleisuitvoere. Volgens die British Meat Processors Association (BMPA) kan geen slag van bees, vark, skaap of pluimvee plaasvind sonder amptelike veearts teenwoordig in abattoirs nie. Dit beteken sommige vleisaanlegte mag dalk moet sluit, wat voedselvoorsieningsketting ontwrig. Supermarkte probeer egter bekommernisse oor moontlike tekorte verminder. Die Department of Agriculture, Environment and Rural Affairs (Daera), wat die veeartse in diens het, sê hulle gaan personeel prioritiseer by pluimveefabrieke. Daera het aangekondig dat dit 'nie kan waarborg dat amptelike beheer en aktiwiteite by alle slag- en dierverwerkingsaanlegte van 30 Oktober tot 3 November sal plaasvind nie.' Om die impak te beperk, fokus hulle daarop om die intensiewe veesektor te ondersteun, begin by pluimvee, en sal die situasie daagliks hersien. Die rooivleisbedryf poog om groot aanlegte operasioneel te hou en verwag nie tekorte vir verbruikers nie. John McClenahan van die Ulster Farmers Union het genoem dat die tydsberekening van die staking veral moeilik is vir produsente wat voorberei vir verhoogde vraag voor Kersfees. Hy het ook genoem dat boere die loongeskil verstaan, maar steeds bekommerd is oor die las wat dit op hulle plaas. Louise Hosking van die Chartered Institute of Environmental Health (CIEH) het die belangrikheid beklemtoon van die handhawing van voedselveiligheid en dierewelsynstandaarde tydens hierdie kritieke tyd. Sy het die Britse regering versoek om die geskil vinnig op te los. Die Nipsa-vakbond, wat die veeartse verteenwoordig, sê die staking is 'n reaksie op 'n 'beledigende' £552-loontoekenning aan staatsdienspersoneel. Vakbondamptenaar Carmel Gates het frustrasie uitgespreek oor die gebrek aan betrokkenheid van Noord-Ierland se sekretaris Chris Heaton-Harris en beklemtoon die belangrike rol wat veeartse in die voedselketting speel. Staatsveeartse is sentraal tot die implementering van na-Brexit Ierse See-grensbeheer op sekere produkte wat van Groot-Brittanje na Noord-Ierland beweeg. Die staking kan veroorsaak dat sekere goedere—veral 'rooi baan'-produkte wat streng inspeksie vereis—na Dublin eerder as Belfast herlei moet word. Daar is kommer oor dierewelsyn as abattoirs nie kan funksioneer nie, veral vir varke wat op plase kan opbou. Oorgewig diere kan boetes tot gevolg hê, sonder vergoeding vir boere, terwyl 'n tekort aan ruimte kan beteken nuwe diere kan nie ingebring word nie, wat inkomste voor Kersfees kan belemmer. Gedurende die staking beveel Daera aan dat 'groen baan'-produkte soos gewoonlik gestuur moet word, met papierwerk wat later voltooi sal word. Groot supermarkte—wat meestal die groen baan gebruik—verwag minimale ontwrigting. Glyn Roberts, uitvoerende hoof van Retail NI, en Neil Johnston, direkteur van die Northern Ireland Retail Consortium, het albei verbruikers aangeraai om nie paniekerig op te koop nie en voorspel min verandering aan supermarkrakke ten spyte van moontlike breër ontwrigting. Nie-supermark-operateurs, wat die rooi baan meer gebruik, gaan groter uitdagings in die gesig staar en mag dalk hul versendings na Dublin moet herlei. Die beweging van lewende diere van Groot-Brittanje na Noord-Ierland—wat veeartsenykundige inspeksie vereis—sal ook geraak word, en Daera beveel aan dat sulke oorplasings uitgestel word tot na die staking. Die Britse regering sê hulle werk saam met Daera om ontwrigting, veral in die voedselvoorsieningsketting, tot die minimum te beperk en wetlike verpligtinge na te kom.

article_content: Faux-leather leggings have established themselves as fashionable and sustainable alternatives to genuine leather. Leading brands—including Spanx, Gap, Lululemon, Good American, Loft, J.Crew, Athleta, Alo Yoga, and CRZ Yoga—offer a selection of well-reviewed options. According to research, Spanx is noted for body-shaping fabric, machine-washable care, and broad sizing (XS–3X). Customers often mention the snug but flattering fit, suggesting sizing up for a looser feel. Gap provides an affordable style featuring stretch fabric, a wide waistband, and flatlock seams, available in XXS to XXL. Some reviewers indicate issues with waist rolling and advise adjusting sizing. Commando leggings at Bloomingdales are higher-end, using fabric that resists shape loss and pilling. These are machine washable (with care) and offered in sizes XS to 3X, though some users note durability concerns. Lululemon’s Align leggings (faux-leather/black foil style) are appreciated for their comfort, moisture-wicking features, and body-contouring fit. Some reviewers mention that pilling may occur with frequent wear. Sizes run from 0 to 20. Good American, led by Emma Grede and Khloé Kardashian, offers “Better Than Faux Leather” leggings. With sizes from 0(S) to 8(5XL), these offer excellent stretch and a flattering fit, but may not be suited for high-impact activities. Loft offers petite-specific sizing, with soft, stretchy leggings and a warm lining. Reviews indicate a great fit, though a slimmer appearance may require sizing down. Other notable brands include J.Crew (polished look, dry clean only), Athleta (ideal for travel with zippered pockets), Alo Yoga (tall-friendly, foil finish), and Amazon’s CRZ Yoga (matte-finish, budget-friendly but thinner material). Forbes Vetted’s editor Kari Molvar oversees the rigorous selection based on customer opinions, materials, comfort, sizing inclusivity, and care. Faux-leather is typically easier to maintain and more affordable than real leather. Advice for buyers includes focusing on style preferences, sizing, fabric texture, intended use, and washing care. Most styles are available in black, with some brands offering various colors. Regular care recommendations include washing in cold water and hang drying. Forbes Vetted’s mission is to help consumers make informed purchases through detailed research and testing.

article_content: ISLAMABAD: The Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan (DRAP) has issued a public warning regarding the use of batch L-083 of Weena Syrup, a widely used product made by Ms Swat Pharmaceuticals in Saidu Sharif, Swat, ARY News reported. The alert follows concerns about possible health risks due to incorrect usage of the syrup, which is commonly prescribed for the treatment and prevention of iron deficiency anemia. According to the DRAP recall notice, this defective batch can cause a range of gastrointestinal side effects, including nausea, diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal pain, constipation, and dark or discolored stool. Citizens are strongly advised against using this batch of Weena Syrup, and the manufacturer has been directed to recall it immediately, according to ARY News. Pharmacies have been instructed to stop supplying batch L-083, with remaining stock to be quarantined and returned to the supplier or manufacturer. To support the recall, DRAP's regulatory field staff and provincial health departments are increasing market surveillance. This warning comes after the Punjab government recently banned five cough syrups, following a World Health Organisation (WHO) alert. The WHO's investigation, prompted by a complaint from the Maldives, found excessive amounts of alcohol in these cough syrups. Punjab's Caretaker Health Minister, Jamal Nasir, has pledged to broaden the crackdown on unsafe medicines in the province. Minister Nasir highlighted concerns that some companies were distributing and exporting substandard products, vowing strict action. The health ministry maintains its commitment to protecting public health and upholding pharmaceutical safety standards in the market, ARY News reported.

Die waarskuwing volg na kommer oor moontlike gesondheidsrisiko's weens verkeerde gebruik van die stroop, wat algemeen voorgeskryf word vir die behandeling en voorkoming van ystertekort-anemie. Volgens die DRAP-onttrekkingskennisgewing kan hierdie defektiewe bondel 'n verskeidenheid gastro-intestinale newe-effekte veroorsaak, insluitend naarheid, diarree, braking, buikpyn, hardlywigheid en donker of verkleurde stoelgang. article_content: Peter Roscoe has been trading in financial markets for 18 years. Originally from Teesside, he began his career in the finance industry, but for the past eight years, trading has been a side pursuit to his full-time job running a shooting range in Budapest. Mr. Roscoe shares insights about his trading experiences—both successes and failures—on his YouTube channel. Over the years, he has observed the growth of online trading apps, which have brought powerful financial tools, like short selling, to a wider audience. Short selling is the inverse of conventional investing. To short a stock, you borrow shares and sell them immediately, hoping the price will fall. If it does, you can buy them back at a lower price, returning them to the lender and keeping the difference. Supporters argue that short selling helps determine the true value of assets and can expose fraudulent activities. However, it remains a very high-risk strategy and was previously reserved for professional traders. Online trading platforms now enable amateurs to short sell in seconds. Mr. Roscoe does not encourage most people to try short selling. 'I get messages daily—people asking about day trading and shorting. I always respond: Are you employed? If yes, don't do it.' He adds, 'Unless you can dedicate four to five hours every weekday to watching the markets for at least six months, you have little chance. Even then, your odds of failing are still high.' Despite these warnings, short selling's popularity has surged. Dan Moczulski, UK managing director of eToro, notes that shorting on their platform has soared, especially since the pandemic. 'People working from home explored new ways to make money.' He also believes there has been a cultural shift: 'Where people once avoided discussing finances, now they’re eager to talk about their stock portfolios, wins, and losses.' Social media now features both well-known and amateur short sellers sharing their predictions about stocks expected to decline. One group drawing new attention is activist short sellers. These traders not only bet against companies but also release detailed reports with bold claims. Carson Block, from Muddy Waters, is one of the most prominent. Such firms sometimes publicly accuse companies of dishonest behavior, anticipating a drop in share value after sharing their findings. 'We provide transparency,' says Block, explaining activist short sellers' role in highlighting issues that might otherwise go unnoticed. However, these traders remain divisive, sometimes accused of unfairly distorting markets. Block notes, 'People assume activist short sellers celebrate big drops in stock prices, but in reality, it usually brings more scrutiny and stress.' This line of work is highly demanding, with high burnout rates. Block, a 13-year veteran, admits it has taken a toll. Roscoe echoes this: 'Looking back at my first 100 short trades, I won just 30% and lost 70%.' Dan Moczulski explains that eToro has safeguards for amateur short sellers. Users must pass a suitability test and, in the event of losses exceeding 50% of account capital, eToro will begin closing positions. With CFDs, customers cannot lose more than their initial deposit, further protecting retail investors compared to institutional traders who can face unlimited losses. Retail investors—those trading personal funds without professional backgrounds—are sometimes disparagingly called 'Dumb Money.' The recent GameStop saga, which has since inspired a film, highlighted retail investors’ risky foray into short selling, often resulting in losses. Even for Roscoe, short selling represents only about 5% of his trading activity. When he does profit, he celebrates: 'If I make $1,000 on a short trade, it’s steak dinner with the family. If I make $5,000, I splurge on an investment bottle of whiskey.'
translated_content: Peter Roscoe doen al 18 jaar handel op finansiële markte. Oorspronklik van Teesside, het hy sy loopbaan in die finansiële bedryf begin, maar vir die laaste agt jaar was handel slegs ‘n byverdienste terwyl hy voltyds ‘n skietbaan in Boedapest bestuur. Mnr. Roscoe deel sy insigte oor sy handels-ervarings—suksesse en mislukkings—op sy YouTube-kanaal. Oor die jare het hy gesien hoe aanlynhandelsprogramme meer finansiële instrumente, soos kortverkoping, vir die breë publiek beskikbaar maak. Kortverkoping is die teenoorgestelde van gewone belegging. Jy leen aandele en verkoop dit onmiddellik, in die hoop dat die prys sal daal. As dit gebeur, koop jy die aandele goedkoper terug, gee dit aan die uitlener terug en hou die verskil. Ondersteuners sê kortverkoping help om die ware waarde van bates te bepaal en blootstelling aan bedrog te bied. Maar dit is steeds ‘n baie riskante strategie en was vroeër slegs vir professionele persone beskore. Nou kan amateurs binne sekondes deur aanlynplatforms kortverkoop. Mnr. Roscoe moedig nie meeste mense aan om kort te verkoop nie. 'Ek kry daagliks boodskappe—mense vra oor daghandel en korting. Ek antwoord altyd: Is jy in diens? Moet dit nie doen nie.' Hy voeg by: 'Tensy jy vier tot vyf uur elke weeksdag vir ses maande lank kan toewy aan die mark, het jy min kans. Selfs dan is die kanse vir mislukking nog groot.' Ten spyte van hierdie waarskuwings het die gewildheid van kortverkoping gestyg. Dan Moczulski, UK-bestuurder van eToro, sê dat hul platform ‘n oplewing in korttransaksies beleef het, veral sedert die pandemie. 'Mense wat van die huis af werk, het nuwe maniere gesoek om geld te maak.' Hy meen daar is ook ‘n kultuurskuif: 'Waar finansies voorheen ‘n taboe was, is mense nou gewillig om hul aandeleportefeuljes, oorwinnings en verliese te bespreek.' Sosiale media bevat nou beide bekende en amateur-kortverkopers wat hul voorspellings deel oor aandele wat moontlik gaan daal. Een groep wat nuwe aandag trek, is aktivis-kortverkopers. Hierdie handelaars wed nie net teen maatskappye nie, maar publiseer ook gedetailleerde verslae met gewaagde bewerings. Carson Block van Muddy Waters is een van die bekendstes. Sulke firmas beskuldig maatskappye soms van oneerlike praktyke en voorsien ‘n daling in aandeelwaarde nadat hulle hul bevindings deel. 'Ons bring deursigtigheid,' sê Block, wat die rol van aktivis-kortverkopers beskryf. Tog bly dié handelaars verdeeld, soms beskuldig van markvervorming. Block sê, 'Mense dink ons vier groot dalings in aandelepryse, maar in werklikheid beteken dit meer kritiek en stres.' Hierdie beroep is uiters veeleisend, met ‘n hoë uitbrandkoers. Block, al 13 jaar in die bedryf, erken dit eis sy tol. Roscoe stem saam: 'Van my eerste 100 korttransaksies het ek net 30% gewen en 70% verloor.' Dan Moczulski verduidelik dat eToro sekuriteitsmaatreëls vir amateur-kortverkopers het. Gebruikers moet ‘n geskiktheidstoets slaag en as verliese meer as 50% van hul rekeningkapitaal is, begin eToro om posisies toe te maak. Met CFD’s kan kliënte nie meer as hul aanvanklike deposito verloor nie, wat kleinbeleggers meer beskerm as institusionele handelaars wat onbeperkte verliese kan ly. Kleinbeleggers—mense wat hul eie geld sonder ‘n professionele agtergrond belê—word soms spottenderwys 'Dom Geld' genoem. Die onlangse GameStop-sage, wat as 'n rolprent aangepas is, het kleinbeleggers se riskante betrokkenheid by korting uitgelig, dikwels met verliese tot gevolg. Selfs vir Roscoe, maak kortverkoping slegs sowat 5% van sy handelsaktiwiteit uit. As hy wel wins maak, vier hy behoorlik: 'As ek $1,000 op ‘n korttransaksie maak, gaan ek en die gesin uit vir ‘n biefstuk-ete. As ek $5,000 maak, koop ek ‘n duur bottel whisky vir belegging.'

article_content: A recent analysis shows that planned cuts to welfare spending by Chancellor George Osborne have not delivered the intended financial savings. According to the Institute for Fiscal Studies (IFS), people receiving the state pension are now getting £500 more each year than they did four years ago. This increase in pension payouts has overshadowed the government's hopes of reducing public spending. Despite efforts to reduce welfare costs by targeting tax credits and other benefits, the IFS reports that real-terms savings have fallen far short—only £2.5 billion less is being spent this year compared to 2010-11, instead of the £19 billion originally aimed for. The rise in welfare expenditure is mainly linked to more generous pension policies and slow wage growth that has left many relying on government assistance, such as housing benefit and working tax credits. The triple lock policy on state pensions—ensuring annual increases in line with inflation, earnings, or at least 2.5%—has added to the pension bill, which the IFS estimates will cost an extra £45 billion over the next 15 years. Housing benefit costs have also risen by £1 billion over four years, despite initial promises they would be reduced. The study indicates that low wage growth and rising rents have left more people dependent on government support. Planned reductions to tax credits have not been fully realized, with only £2.7 billion cut out of the intended £4.6 billion. Changes to disability benefits have also been delayed, leading to higher-than-expected spending. Economist Andrew Hood from the IFS notes that while spending on Jobseekers’ Allowance has dropped as unemployment fell, the government’s overall goal of curbing welfare costs has faced setbacks driven by increased pensioner numbers and support for low-paid workers.

article_content: A Twitter user who posted purported photographs of Jon Venables, one of James Bulger's killers, as an adult, has received a 14-month suspended prison sentence. James Baines, a security guard from Liverpool who is close to the Bulger family, was sentenced at London's High Court for blatant contempt of court. His sentence is suspended for 15 months, and he must pay £3,000 in legal costs. Baines admitted violating a global injunction imposed in January 2001, which bans publication of any information revealing the appearance, location, or new identities of Venables or Robert Thompson, who were both convicted of murdering two-year-old James Bulger in November 1993. The injunction exists to protect the pair from serious harm or death after their release. Attorney General Dominic Grieve referred the case after Baines uploaded images allegedly identifying Venables as an adult to his Twitter profile on February 14, the 20th anniversary of the crime. One image was a school photo of Venables as a child, alongside images of an adult male, accompanied by a tweet disputing that the photo had been removed. The Attorney General emphasized that the injunction has been in force for many years and applies to all, noting it serves to protect not only Venables and Thompson but also innocent people mistakenly identified as them. Baines's lawyer, Peter Lownds, explained that the tweet was sent during a highly emotional period for the community, two days after the anniversary of James Bulger's death. Baines admitted his actions went 'far too far' and that while his emotional reaction was strong, it does not excuse his behavior. He acknowledged wrongdoing and stated he is not entitled to take the law into his own hands. The court also reviewed correspondence from James Bulger's father, Ralph, relevant to Baines's mindset. Chief Justice Lord Thomas, presiding with Mr Justice Tugendhat, said Baines disregarded criticism and abused those who pointed out his wrongdoing. He expressed contempt for police action on Facebook and initially denied control over the Twitter account. Even after admitting the postings were his, he claimed ignorance of the injunction. Lord Thomas described the breach as extremely serious, noting Baines knowingly and flagrantly violated the injunction with a clear intent to harm Venables. Baines's only mitigation was his recent admission of wrongdoing. The sentence was suspended with significant hesitation, with the court recognizing Baines's connection to the Bulger community may explain, but not excuse, his actions.

article_content: Uruguay made history at Argentina’s famous La Bombonera stadium by securing a 2-0 win, their first on Argentine soil since 1937. With this victory and their recent success over Brazil, Uruguay has moved within two points of Argentina in South American World Cup qualifiers. In only his fifth game as manager, Marcelo Bielsa has already shaped the squad with his energetic and aggressive style. Uruguay’s defense—led by Ronald Araujo, Sebastian Caceres, Mathias Olivera, and Matias Vina—pressed Argentina’s skilled midfielders early and often, exemplifying Bielsa's tactical skills. Adopting their underdog status, Uruguay combined intense defending with quick counterattacks. Players like Maximilian Araujo covered unexpected positions, and the team's tireless running and coordination brought Bielsa’s system to life, despite minor vulnerabilities. Afterward, Lionel Messi acknowledged that Argentina never found their rhythm and that Uruguay dictated the pace. Uruguay’s forward runs and quick transitions kept Argentina’s defense under constant pressure, particularly through Darwin Nunez’s speed and attacks on the left side. Uruguay’s goals highlighted their defensive strength: Vina’s challenge set up Araujo for the opening goal, then Rodrigo Bentancur’s interception led to a decisive second goal in the 86th minute. Bielsa’s leadership is clearly influential—despite a career spanning numerous teams and countries, he swiftly brought out Uruguay’s defensive tenacity and attacking flair. Under his guidance, Uruguay is experiencing an exciting resurgence in South American football. FAQs: Q: Has Bielsa ever won a trophy? A: Yes, he has won three Argentine league titles and an Olympic gold medal. Q: What is the capacity of La Bombonera? A: The stadium holds 49,000 people.

article_content: As Tracy Ocasio's 28th birthday passed last week, her mother remained hopeful for answers regarding her daughter’s disappearance almost three months ago. Tracy vanished after watching a basketball game with friends at the Florida Tap Room, a popular Orlando sports bar. Police have named James Hataway as a person of interest and have him in custody on unrelated charges, but the case remains unsolved, according to Detective Mark Olson of the Ocoee Police Department. In honor of Tracy’s birthday, her family increased the reward for information about her disappearance to $20,000. Elizabeth Ocasio, Tracy’s mother, last spoke with her daughter around 8:30 p.m. on May 26. Tracy told her she would come home after watching the game. When Tracy did not return, her mother initially assumed she stayed with a friend, as she often did if she was too tired to drive. The next morning at 6:30, Elizabeth sent Tracy a text, but received no reply. Further calls went unanswered, with each eventually going to voicemail. Panic set in when police called on the afternoon of May 27. Officers had found Tracy's car in a rundown neighborhood about three miles from her home, after residents reported it for towing. Tracy's purse was found inside, but her ID, phone, and car keys were missing. By 7 p.m., she was officially reported missing, prompting a county-wide search involving waterways and wooded areas, with investigations ongoing. Detectives focused on James Hataway, 28, after surveillance footage showed him leaving the bar with Tracy. He told investigators she had given him a ride home, but that he had not seen her after she dropped him off. His home is just 200 yards from where her car was recovered. Hataway took a polygraph test, which reportedly showed some discrepancies, but he is not charged in connection with Tracy’s disappearance. Police found no evidence in the car suggesting she was injured there. Bloodhounds did not detect Tracy’s scent at the car’s location, leading investigators to believe she did not park it herself. Hataway is being held on unrelated charges at Orange County Jail, with bail set at $250,000. These charges stem from an August 2008 incident in Seminole County, where he is accused of assaulting a woman who had given him a ride. He has not yet entered a plea. Following questioning in Tracy’s case, the public defender’s office took up his defense, and he ceased cooperation with police. Authorities urge anyone with information regarding Tracy Ocasio’s disappearance to call the tip line at 1-800-423-TIPS. The $20,000 reward remains available.
