article_content:
Student housing managers in Cardiff have been grappling with an unusual challenge: fake tan stains are damaging mattresses and leading to extra expenses. John Winter, who manages several student properties in Cathays, noticed the issue several years ago when orange, body-shaped stains started appearing on mattresses. Joe Harris, an employee, revealed that these marks result from fake tan rubbing off onto bedding and soaking through to mattresses. 

Originally, custom pocket-sprung mattresses were used, but frequent replacements became necessary due to staining. To combat this, the company switched to memory foam mattresses with removable covers, which can be washed or changed. While this has helped reduce the number of ruined covers from 220 to 147 per year, some stains still manage to penetrate deep enough to ruin mattresses completely. 

Most students housed are female, and according to Harris, fake tanning products are common in their rooms. He recalls witnessing multiple stained mattresses being removed from a house at once. New covers cost about £30 each, not including VAT, so expenses add up quickly. 

Carina Barcoe, a beautician from Birchgrove’s Blush Hair and Beauty, believes that stains can be avoided if students follow advice like wearing loose pyjamas and washing bedding soon after tanning. However, Harris notes that some stains are impossible to remove and jokingly remarks that the city seems full of people with an orange tint due to the fake tan trend.

Studentehuisbestuurders in Cardiff stry al vir 'n paar jaar met 'n ongewoon probleem: vals sonbrandmiddel vlek matrasse en bring ekstra koste. John Winter, wat baie studentewoonstelle in Cathays bestuur, het eers die probleem opgemerk toe oranje liggaamsvormige vlekke op matrasse begin verskyn het. Volgens werknemer Joe Harris is hierdie merke die gevolg van vals sonbrand wat deur lakens op die matrasse indring. 

Hulle het oorspronklik sakgeveerde matrasse gehad, maar moes dit gereeld vervang weens hardnekkige vlekke. Die bestuurspan het toe oorgeskakel na geheueskuimmatrasse met verwyderbare oortreksels wat maklik gewas of vervang kan word. Hierdie verandering het gehelp – die aantal beskadigde oortreksels het van 220 tot 147 per jaar gedaal – maar party vlekke bederf nog steeds die hele matras. 

Die meeste van die 400 studente is vroue, en Harris sê fake tan produkte is orals in die kamers. Hy het eens gesien hoe 'n hele paar matrasse gelyk na die asblik geneem word. Nuwe oortreksels kos sowat £30 elk, plus BTW, wat die koste vinnig opstoot. 

Volgens Carina Barcoe, skoonheidskundige van Blush Hair and Beauty in Birchgrove, kan vlekke verhoed word as studente los slaapklere dra en beddegoed gou was. Harris sê egter sommige vlekke is te hardnekkig, en spot dat dit soms lyk asof daar net oranje mense in Cardiff is van al die fake tan.

article_content: It was a true fairytale moment when Rory Donald, 38, proposed to his girlfriend of four years, Cheryl Lucas, 34, in a unique and heartfelt way. As the illustrator of the children's book 'Pigs Might Surf', Rory took the opportunity to print his proposal on the book’s dedication page. When authors Olly Miles and Anna Louise offered him space for a message, Rory wrote: 'To Cheryl, will you marry me? Rory x.' Rory, from Tintagel in North Cornwall, admitted that proposing in such a public way was nerve-racking, since his question would be visible to all. He joked that, had Cheryl said no, he would have needed to buy every copy of the book to hide the page. Cheryl discovered the proposal when Rory gave her a copy of 'Pigs Might Surf' at their local pub, The Millhouse Inn in Trebarwith, Cornwall, and she immediately accepted his touching gesture. The couple later tied the knot at the same pub. Rory wore a Willy Wonka-inspired outfit as a nod to his favorite children's book character, while Cheryl chose a traditional white dress, adding her own twist with purple trainers. 'Pigs Might Surf', written by husband-and-wife team Olly Miles and Anna Louise, tells the story of Bailie the pig, who dreams of becoming the first pig to surf, and is set in Cornwall.

As die illustreerder van die kinderboek 'Pigs Might Surf', het Rory die kans gebruik om sy voorstel op die boek se toewydingsbladsy te plaas. article_content: Reliance Jio has expanded its portfolio by launching the JioPhone Prima 4G, a feature phone priced at Rs 2,599. The device supports WhatsApp, UPI payments, live video streaming, and more. It is available through offline and online retail channels, including Reliance Digital, JioMart, and Amazon. The JioPhone Prima 4G features a 2.4-inch display, an 1800mAh battery, and supports 23 local languages. It runs on KaiOS, offering access to popular apps like WhatsApp, YouTube, Google Assistant, and Facebook. Users can also access JioCinema and JioTV, Jio's proprietary multimedia apps. UPI payments are enabled via JioPay, which supports QR code-based transactions. The phone has VGA cameras on both the front and back. The JioPhone Prima 4G is a follow-up to the original JioPhone, launched in 2017. It sits between the JioPhone Next and the more affordable JioPhone Bharat. The device was showcased at the India Mobile Congress 2023. Jio, India's leading telecom company, operates the Jio Bharat platform, which allows other feature phone brands to develop 4G phones with multimedia features. The company aims to migrate 250 million 2G users to its 4G network. Jio's head of devices, Sunil Dutt, stated that they are in discussions with other major manufacturers, including Nokia, Lava, and Itel, to create their own versions of JioPhone Bharat.

article_content: The BBC has submitted its live coverage of the police raid on Sir Cliff Richard’s home for a leading television journalism award, despite ongoing controversy. The coverage is competing for ‘Scoop of the Year’ at the Royal Television Society Television Journalism Awards. A source stated, ‘It was a strong story and important to stand by our journalism. Despite controversy, this was among the top scoops of the year.’ The BBC has faced possible legal action from Sir Cliff Richard since broadcasting live helicopter footage of the raid at his £3.5 million Berkshire residence last August. Reporters were at the property before police arrived. Sir Cliff, 74, has denied an allegation of sexual abuse of a boy under 16 at a Christian event in 1985. He has not been charged. His lawyer, Gideon Benaim, claimed the BBC’s report caused 'immeasurable harm' and was 'premature and disproportionate.' Tony Hall, Director-General of the BBC, was questioned by MPs after it emerged journalists had been tipped off by South Yorkshire Police. A report from the Home Affairs Select Committee in October described South Yorkshire Police as ‘utterly inept’ but added the BBC was ‘within its rights’ to run the story. Because of the tipoff, reporters filmed live aerial footage of the raid on August 14, showing officers searching Sir Cliff’s home, while journalists broadcast from the gates. After the broadcast, the BBC received hundreds of complaints, with many saying the coverage made Sir Cliff appear guilty. The select committee’s report also alleged that a BBC reporter threatened to publish the story early unless given access to the raid. Committee chairman Keith Vaz MP said, ‘South Yorkshire Police’s response was utterly inept. No British citizen should have to watch their home raided live on television. Sir Cliff Richard’s reputation has suffered enormous and irreparable harm, and he is owed an apology.’ Sir Cliff was interviewed under caution by police ten days after the raid. He asserts the allegation is 'completely false' and has received support from public figures, including Cilla Black, who has expressed confidence in his innocence. The Royal Television Awards will be held on February 18. The BBC declined to comment.

Die dekking ding mee vir 'Scoop of the Year' tydens die Royal Television Society se Television Journalism Awards. article_content: Rockstar Games has confirmed that a trailer for the next Grand Theft Auto title will premiere in early December, coinciding with the studio’s 25th anniversary. While the company did not explicitly call it 'GTA 6,' it is clear from the context that this is the much-anticipated sequel. Rockstar founder Sam Houser expressed excitement about the upcoming reveal and promised ongoing engagement with fans. Reports have already hinted that the new game may revisit Vice City and feature a plot inspired by Bonnie and Clyde, including the introduction of the series’ first female protagonist. Although a precise release date has not been disclosed, analysts anticipate a late 2024 launch, citing projected financial gains from Take Two. The chosen reveal window closely aligns with The Game Awards on December 7, an event well-known for major announcements and premieres. However, Rockstar may choose to unveil the trailer independently, given the global anticipation for the game. With GTA 5’s phenomenal success—having sold 185 million copies—the expectations for this next Grand Theft Auto installment are immense.

article_content: Britney Spears received a remarkable welcome as she debuted as a judge on 'The X Factor' in Austin, Texas. Yet, it was fellow new judge Demi Lovato who quickly began to steal the limelight during the filming. Across two days, Spears, Lovato, L.A. Reid, and Simon Cowell watched and evaluated 31 aspiring performers competing for a $5 million recording contract and advancement to the next round in Los Angeles. Introduced last to the enthusiastic crowd of more than 4,000 at the Frank Erwin Center, Spears, dressed in a vivid pink dress, drew enthusiastic applause. The inclusion of both Spears and Lovato raised curiosity about their chemistry with the established judges. Spears offered concise, supportive feedback and was the most generous with 'yes' votes, sometimes predicting superstar futures for singers or simply commending their confidence. When criticism was necessary, Spears kept it brief and diplomatic. On the other hand, 19-year-old Lovato engaged warmly and humorously with contestants and the audience, often playing off Cowell’s comments with her own sharp wit. Their exchanges were a highlight, bringing laughter and light competition to the panel, much to the delight of both the audience and the show’s producers. A memorable exchange occurred when Cowell playfully expressed interest in a contestant, leading Lovato to chime in with a clever remark and prompt banter. These lively interactions are expected to continue, with producers looking to inject fresh energy into the series and attract viewers following changes to the judging lineup.

article_content: David Bowie's iconic Ziggy Stardust jumpsuit and handwritten lyrics are among more than 300 items chosen from his extensive archive of 60,000 objects that will go on public display for the first time. Curators at London's Victoria and Albert Museum (V&A) had rare access to Bowie's vast personal collection in New York, as they prepared what is being billed as the first major museum retrospective of his career. The exhibition, opening next spring, will showcase costumes, instruments, sketches, musical scores, diary entries, and album artwork. The V&A has selected 60 stage costumes, along with photographs, films, music videos, set designs, and storyboards. Among the highlights are the Ziggy Stardust jumpsuit (1972), co-designed by Bowie and inspired by Stanley Kubrick's 'A Clockwork Orange'; a bodysuit created by Kansai Yamamoto for the 1973 Aladdin Sane tour; and the Union Jack coat designed by Alexander McQueen for the cover of his 1997 'Earthling' album. The museum is also planning an academic symposium about Bowie and his work. Bowie, now 65, clarified on Facebook that while the Archive gave unprecedented access to the museum, he is not a co-curator and had no part in the curatorial decisions. Organizers say the exhibition will trace Bowie's continual reinvention across five decades, highlight his influence encouraging freedom of expression, and examine his impact on art and culture, which curators argue is both cultural and political. Geoffrey Marsh, co-curator, described the exhibition as 'ground-breaking,' aligning with Bowie's own legacy as an artist. The exhibition will also feature set models from the Diamond Dogs tour, the contact sheet from the Aladdin Sane album cover shoot—famed for the lightning flash design—and excerpts from films like 'The Man Who Fell To Earth' and music videos such as 'Boys Keep Swinging' and 'Let’s Dance.' Visitors will see rare photographs from Bowie’s early days, including a publicity shot with his first band, The Kon-rads, in 1963, as well as a photograph with William Burroughs from 1974. The exhibition, sponsored by Gucci and Sennheiser, runs from March 23 to July 28, 2013, and may tour around the UK and internationally. Bowie, born David Robert Jones in Brixton, South London in 1947, created his most famous alter ego Ziggy Stardust in 1972, presenting a vision that continues to inspire artists and fans worldwide.

article_content: One in six UK families have mortgages that are more than four times greater than their salaries, according to a Bank of England report released today. The findings highlight a significant divide, with half of families having no mortgage or only a small loan—less than twice their salary—while 16% carry a debt-to-income ratio above four. For instance, a worker earning the average full-time salary of £27,000 would have a mortgage exceeding £108,000, or a couple with a joint income of £50,000 would have a mortgage surpassing £200,000. Of those struggling with their mortgage, many are also in negative equity, meaning their loan is larger than the value of their property. The Bank’s quarterly bulletin reveals that one in 25 families currently faces this issue—a sharp increase from just 1% in 2007, the year of the credit crunch, to 4% today. Other forms of debt are also rising: for households with unsecured debts like personal loans, the average amount increased by nearly £1,000 over the past year, from £5,400 to £6,300. Nearly two-thirds of families with mortgages amounting to 75% or more of their home's value report being ‘somewhat or very concerned’ about their debt levels. The Bank of England has kept its base rate at 0.5%, the lowest in its 319-year history, leading to concerns about how families will manage if rates rise. When asked how they would cope with a 2.5 percentage point increase in mortgage rates without a pay rise, half of families said they would need to cut spending or work longer hours. The Council of Mortgage Lenders reported that mortgage lending in November reached £17 billion—a 30% increase over the same month last year and the highest since November 2007. However, Bob Pannell, Chief Economist at the CML, noted this is still ‘a far cry’ from pre-crisis levels, as financial institutions remain more risk-averse. With wages stagnating or falling over the past five years and house prices still rising, the pressure to buy homes is intense. Young buyers now face average loans of £119,500 and need incomes of £36,460—either individually or jointly—to enter the property market, according to the CML. Adding to this challenge, house prices are forecasted to continue rising. The Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors predicts an 8% increase in 2014, with London expecting an 11% rise and Northern Ireland 4%. Peter Bolton King, RICS’s global residential director, said that, although new home construction is increasing, it will not be sufficient to meet demand, making inadequate housing supply the main driver of further price rises.

article_content: A personal envoy to North Korean leader Kim Jong Un indicated that North Korea is open to restarting nuclear disarmament talks, according to Chinese state media reports on Friday. This comes as China's President Xi Jinping urged Pyongyang to return to negotiations. Kim's envoy, Choe Ryong-hae, was on a three-day visit to China, during which he hand-delivered a letter from Kim to President Xi at a meeting in Beijing before returning to North Korea, as confirmed by state media. While the contents of Kim's letter were not disclosed, Choe told Chinese officials that North Korea is willing to 'take positive actions to solve problems through dialogue,' as reported by China Daily. Choe gave no specifics on when or how the six-party talks might resume. The talks, including the United States and China, collapsed in 2008 when North Korea pulled out over disagreements on nuclear inspections. Most observers think North Korea is unlikely to return if preconditions require it to abandon its nuclear arsenal. North Korea is believed to have a limited but unreliable nuclear ballistic missile capacity. According to Xinhua, Choe said the letter aimed to 'improve, consolidate, and develop' relations between North Korea and China. During their meeting, Xi Jinping told Choe that North Korea should 'stick to solving problems through dialogue and consultation,' according to China Daily and CCTV. Xi's comments come less than two weeks ahead of his planned meeting with U.S. President Barack Obama in California. In a separate meeting, Chinese General Fan Changlong told Choe that recent tensions have 'jeopardized peace and stability on the peninsula,' Xinhua reported. Relations among Pyongyang, Beijing, and Washington have grown strained this year amid North Korea's hostile rhetoric towards the U.S. and South Korea. The sharp rhetoric followed stricter U.N. sanctions after North Korea's third underground nuclear test in February, as well as annual military exercises held by the U.S. and South Korea. In recent weeks, North Korean rhetoric has lessened, and the U.S.-South Korean drills ended in late April. However, North Korea fired rockets earlier this month after criticizing the presence of a U.S. nuclear-powered aircraft carrier in a South Korean port and its participation in joint naval exercises. In a separate development, a North Korean border town has opened to Western tourists, offering a glimpse of 'living history.'

Die skerp retoriek het gevolg op strenger VN-sanksies ná Noord-Korea se derde ondergrondse kerntoets in Februarie, sowel as die VSA en Suid-Korea se jaarlikse militêre oefeninge. Noord-Korea het egter vroeër vandeesmaand vuurpyle afgevuur nadat hulle die teenwoordigheid van ’n Amerikaanse kernkragskip in ’n Suid-Koreaanse hawe en die deelname aan gesamentlike vlootoefeninge gekritiseer het. article_content: As digital technology continues to transform organizations, marketing departments are often the first to adopt and experiment with modern tools like analytics and digital dashboards. Still, the foundational aspects of marketing—product, price, placement, and promotion—remain just as important today as they were almost a century ago. It might be tempting to believe that, since so much information is now accessible online, traditional marketing jobs would become obsolete. In reality, the profession has shown remarkable adaptability. Modern marketers combine expertise in digital strategies and data analysis with established marketing principles to succeed. Today’s successful marketing professionals are recognized not only for their understanding of customers but also for their advanced skill with technology and data. By leveraging these digital tools, they can engage buyers more precisely and guide purchasing decisions at exactly the right moment. Although the legacy concept of the 4Ps is still significant, it is how marketers now use modern tools to implement these principles that sets them apart. This integration of tradition and technology drives robust business development. Sales and business development teams, leaders, and stakeholders must become versatile in both traditional and digital practices—particularly in navigating longer, more complex sales cycles that may be misunderstood by executive leadership. According to Gartner, buyers interact with sales representatives in only about 17% of their purchasing process; the rest of their journey (83%) is spent researching independently and reaching consensus internally. To genuinely stand out, professionals need to influence and support buyers during that independent research phase, not just during direct contact. This means understanding buyer motivations and positioning products or solutions in a way that aligns with customer goals such as visibility, advancement, or efficiency. While sales teams have widely implemented tools like CRMs, these systems are often used more for tracking than for building authentic relationships. The next evolution involves applying digital tools to anticipate when customers are ready to make a purchase and smoothly transitioning from advisement to selling. With the risk of overwhelming decision makers with too much information, it is essential to tailor and time communications effectively. Equipping teams with technological skills and platforms is vital for competitive success. To stay ahead, organizations must adopt innovative technologies—such as artificial intelligence, geofencing, blockchain, and advanced analytics—alongside developing adaptable talent, since relying only on old methods is insufficient. Ultimately, market forces are driving adaptation whether companies like it or not; those who invest in people and tools are best positioned to succeed. Forbes Business Development Council is highlighted as an exclusive community for senior-level professionals seeking to grow in this fast-evolving landscape.
translated_content: Soos digitale tegnologie organisasies deurlopend transformeer, is dit dikwels bemarkingspanne wat eerste nuwe hulpmiddels soos ontleding en digitale dashboards begin gebruik. Tog bly die kern van bemarking—produk, prys, plasing en promosie—net so relevant soos altyd. Al lyk dit of tradisionele bemarkingsrolle oorbodig raak omdat soveel inligting aanlyn beskikbaar is, bewys hierdie veld sy aanpasbaarheid. Vandag se bemarkers kombineer sterk digitale vaardighede en data-analise met beproefde bemarkingsbeginsels vir sukses. Die hedendaagse bemarker blink uit nie net met kliënte-insig nie, maar ook met moderne tegnologie en data. Digitale hulpmiddels help om kopers meer akkuraat te bereik en aankoopbesluite te beïnvloed op die presiese oomblik wanneer dit saak maak. Die 4Ps van bemarking is steeds belangrik—die moderne toepassing daarvan deur nuwe gereedskap is waarin bemarkers nou uitsonder. Die samevloeiing van tradisie en tegnologie versterk besigheidsontwikkeling. Verkoops- en ontwikkelingpanne, leiers en belanghebbendes moet vaardighede in beide tradisionele en digitale praktyke kombineer—veral met die langer en ingewikkelde verkoopsiklusse wat dikwels deur uitvoerende bestuur onderskat word. Gartner toon kopers spandeer slegs sowat 17% van hul besluitnemingsproses in direkte gesprek met verskaffers; vir die res (83%) doen hulle onafhanklike navorsing en interne samesprekings. Om werklik uit te staan, moet professionele mense waarde toevoeg tydens die kliënt se selfnavorsingsfase, nie net tydens direkte interaksie nie. Dis belangrik om kopers se behoeftes te verstaan en jou oplossing só te rangskik dat dit hul doelwitte ondersteun, soos sigbaarheid, bevordering of doeltreffendheid. Hoewel CRMs in verkoopspraktyke algemeen is, is dit dikwels ‘n interne rekord en nie ‘n ware verhoudingstool nie. Die volgende stap is om digitale hulpmiddels te gebruik om kliënte se koopgereedheid te voorsien en van adviseur tot verkoper te skuif. Inligtingsoorvloed is ‘n uitdaging; dis nou krities om kommunikasie te balanseer en spanlede toe te rus met relevante digitale vaardighede en platforms. Om mededingend te bly, moet besighede nuwe tegnologieë soos KI, geofencing, blockchain en gevorderde analise integreer, tesame met aanpasbare talente—ou praktyke alleen gaan nie werk nie. Of ‘n maatskappy gereed is of nie, markkragte dryf verandering. Dié wat in mense én tegnologie belê, lei die pad vorentoe. Die Forbes Business Development Council staan uit as ‘n eksklusiewe netwerk vir senior kundiges wat in hierdie vinnig veranderende besigheidsomgewing wil uitblink.

article_content: Adam Johnson, a 29-year-old member of the Nottingham Panthers ice hockey team, died after a skate blade caused a fatal neck injury during a Saturday game against the Sheffield Steelers. The Sheffield Steelers’ Matt Petgrave was involved in the accident, in which his skate blade struck Johnson. Johnson was transported to Northern General Hospital in Sheffield, where he was declared deceased shortly after arrival. His partner, Ryan Wolfe, identified him at the hospital. Coroner Tanyka Rawden of Sheffield opened an inquest confirming Johnson’s identity and offered condolences to his family and community. The inquest is adjourned until January 26 for a review, not a full hearing. South Yorkshire Police are conducting a thorough investigation, which includes reviewing video of the incident; the process may be lengthy. As a response to this tragedy, the Elite Ice Hockey League (EIHL) will strongly recommend, but not enforce, the use of neck guards for players and officials. An EIHL spokesperson reiterated their commitment to player safety, noting collaboration with clubs, players, and authorities to continually improve safety standards. Even though the English Ice Hockey Association will require neck guards from 2024, this does not apply to EIHL as it is governed separately.

Johnson is na die Northern General-hospitaal in Sheffield geneem waar hy kort daarna dood verklaar is. Sy lewensmaat, Ryan Wolfe, het hom by die hospitaal uitgeken. Sheffield se lykskouer, Tanyka Rawden, het die geregtelike ondersoek geopen en Johnson se identiteit bevestig, en innige simpatie aan sy familie en die gemeenskap betuig. Die ondersoek is tot 26 Januarie uitgestel vir 'n hersiening, nie die volle verhoor nie. South Yorkshire-polisie doen 'n deeglike ondersoek, insluitend die hersiening van videobeelde van die insident; die proses mag lank duur. Hoewel die Engelse Yshokkie Vereniging nekbeskermers van 2024 af sal verplig, geld daardie reël nie vir die EIHL nie omdat dit afsonderlik gereguleer word.

article_content: Dubai International Airport is set to exceed its pre-pandemic passenger record from 2019, indicating a strong recovery in global aviation after COVID-19 restrictions. By the third quarter this year, the airport had already served 64.5 million passengers and is projected to reach 86.8 million by the end of the year, surpassing the 86.3 million travelers seen in 2019. The airport's busiest year remains 2018, with 89.1 million passengers. Paul Griffiths, CEO of Dubai Airports, conveyed excitement about the faster-than-expected comeback, noting that the target will be met nearly a year ahead of projections. Between January and September, the airport handled 308,000 flight movements. India continues to be the top market, trailed by Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, the United States, and Russia. Despite the Russia-Ukraine war, UAE airlines, including Emirates, have maintained services to Moscow. Although Dubai International leads in international passenger traffic, Atlanta's Hartsfield-Jackson Airport is still the world's busiest overall in terms of total passengers. The announcement comes as the Dubai Air Show unfolds at Al Maktoum International Airport, which mainly handles cargo and private jets. During the show, Emirates agreed to a $52 billion Boeing aircraft order while FlyDubai signed an $11 billion deal with Boeing. The article also briefly mentions various unrelated economic updates, notably from India, that are not connected to the main aviation topic.

article_content: The West Africa Broadcast and Media Academy (WABMA) has expressed deep sorrow over the passing of its Executive Director and renowned broadcaster, Nkemjika Attoh, who died on Wednesday in Enugu State. In a statement on Thursday, Registrar Joseph Obari described Attoh's death as a 'colossal loss.' According to WABMA Chairman Kevin Ejofor, Attoh’s declining health over the past year did not stop him from passionately championing development journalism in Nigeria until his final weeks. "This is a huge loss to us at WABMA, where Jika spent the last years of his life dedicated to advancing media professionalism. The entire Nigerian media landscape shares in this loss, which has sent shockwaves throughout the industry. Our prayers are with our dear friend and colleague as he journeys on," the statement read. Attoh was a distinguished anchor on Africa Independent Television’s flagship breakfast show, KAAKAKI, and a news anchor at CHANNELS Television in Lagos. He later served as a journalism trainer for the BBC World Service Trust (BBC MediaAction) and as a media consultant for ENABLE in Nigeria. Attoh’s leadership extended to roles such as Managing Director of Enugu State Broadcasting Service (ESBS), Broadcast Manager and Trainer at Lagoni Media, board member of West Africa Democracy Radio in Dakar, Senegal, and as the visionary behind the creation of BLAZE FM (Awka) and COSMOS FM (Enugu). Ejofor highlighted that Attoh would be remembered for his significant leadership in the broadcasting sector, including consulting for numerous government-owned and private radio stations in Nigeria and beyond. He is especially remembered for establishing the first 24-hour FM broadcast with compelling programming in southeastern Nigeria. At WABMA, Attoh's most impactful legacy was in developing multiple training centers and providing innovative multimedia training modules. As Executive Director, he helped set WABMA’s academic and professional direction. He will be sorely missed.

In 'n verklaring Donderdag het Registrateur Joseph Obari Attoh se dood as 'n 'grootskaalse verlies' beskryf. Volgens WABMA se voorsitter, Kevin Ejofor, het Attoh se verswakkende gesondheid oor die afgelope jaar hom nie gekeer om steeds passievol ontwikkelingjoernalistiek in Nigerië te bevorder tot in sy laaste weke nie. "Dit is 'n groot verlies vir ons by WABMA, waar Jika die laaste jare van sy lewe daaraan gewy het om mediaprofessionalisme te bevorder. Die hele Nigeriese mediawêreld deel in hierdie verlies, wat skokgolwe deur die bedryf stuur. Ons gebede is by ons dierbare vriend en kollega op sy laaste reis," lui die verklaring. Hy was later 'n joernalistiek-opleier vir die BBC World Service Trust (BBC MediaAction) en 'n mediakonsultant vir ENABLE in Nigerië. Attoh se leierskap het gestrek tot poste soos Hoofbestuurder van die Enugu State Broadcasting Service (ESBS), Uitsaai Bestuurder en Opleier by Lagoni Media, raadslid van West Africa Democracy Radio in Dakar, Senegal, en as die dryfkrag agter die stigting van BLAZE FM (Awka) en COSMOS FM (Enugu). Ejofor het beklemtoon dat Attoh vir sy groot leierskapsrol in die uitsaaisektor onthou sal word, insluitend sy konsultasiewerk vir talle staats- en privaatradiostasies in Nigerië en verder. Hy word veral onthou vir die stigting van die eerste 24-uur FM-uitsaai met boeiende programme in Suidoos-Nigerië. By WABMA was Attoh se belangrikste nalatenskap die ontwikkeling van verskeie opleidingsentrums en die aanbied van innoverende multimedia-opleidingsmodules. article_content: A Sydney father shared his harrowing encounter with a terror suspect just moments before the man entered a downtown café and took dozens of people hostage. Craig Stoker, from Eastlakes, described bumping into the gunman on the street, right outside the café after buying his morning coffee. He said the gunman wore a black shirt with white writing, a matching headband, and carried a blue bag. He was accompanied by two other similarly dressed men. ‘The bag bumped into me, and there was something hard inside it. I told him to watch where he was going,’ Stoker recalled. ‘He turned around and said, “Do you want me to shoot you too?” I looked into his eyes, and they looked wild.’ Shortly afterward, witnesses saw one or two men walk into the café and produce a weapon from a blue bag. Moments later, police arrived at the scene. Rodrigo Neryt, arriving at Channel 7 for his first day of work experience, heard screams coming from the café as he passed by. Police quickly began evacuating people from the first floor above the Lindt Café. Family and friends of a hostage told Daily Mail Australia that they were left without information about the situation. ‘We weren't provided with any details, and we heard there was a space for families to wait, but officers couldn't confirm it,’ one family friend said. Rosemary Healion, who works at Frederick Jordan Chambers, reported that hundreds of her colleagues were inside the building at the time. ‘I'm so worried, as anyone would be. I nearly walked into the café—I get coffee there all the time,’ she said. David Wilson, a window cleaner, described seeing police converge on Martin Place as he and a colleague worked across from the Lindt Chocolate Café. ‘We saw people running and police with guns drawn. Some people came out—mostly coffee drinkers from what we could see,’ he said. His colleague immediately began filming the scene. Nearby office workers, Gabriella Barry and Lisa Maloney, were locked in their building opposite the café until they were evacuated. Their building housed several government offices and treasuries. ‘We’ve been locked in since 11 am, seeing everything unfold across the street. We've received dozens of calls from worried friends and colleagues,’ Barry said. Witnesses recalled seeing staff and customers sobbing, their hands pressed against the café windows. ‘We've tried to reassure people over the phone, but we were shaking ourselves,’ Barry added. There was shock at the suggestion that the event was related to terrorism. ‘It's shocking. It doesn't happen here. No one knows how to react,’ Maloney said. John Edwards, who works at 53 Martin Place across from the café, said his building was evacuated soon after the incident began. ‘Security just told us to get out,’ he said. Throughout the ordeal, police worked to evacuate and secure the area while witnesses experienced fear and uncertainty as the hostage situation unfolded.

article_content: According to a new report, some of the fastest growing population centers in Asia and Africa face the greatest risk from climate change. The Climate Change Vulnerability Index (CCVI), released by UK-based risk analysis firm Maplecroft, evaluated the climate risks and adaptive capacities of 193 countries using factors such as population density, development, natural resources, reliance on agriculture, and conflict. Out of all nations assessed, 30 were classified as being at 'extreme risk.' The top five most vulnerable are Haiti, Bangladesh, Sierra Leone, Zimbabwe, and Madagascar, while Vietnam, Indonesia, and India also rank within the top 30. The report is part of Maplecroft's fourth annual Climate Change and Environmental Risk Atlas. The analysis further examines the impact of climate change on towns and cities. Six out of the world's 20 fastest growing cities—including Calcutta (India), Manila (Philippines), Jakarta (Indonesia), and Addis Ababa (Ethiopia)—are rated 'extreme risk' by the CCVI. Charlie Beldon, principal environmental analyst at Maplecroft, warns that cities such as Manila, Jakarta, and Calcutta—key economic hubs in emerging markets—could see an increase in heat waves, flooding, water shortages, and severe storms due to climate change. He adds that the strain on already overwhelmed urban infrastructure could have significant consequences for local residents, businesses, national economies, and global investors. The report notes Manila is the commercial center of the Philippines, with its population expected to rise by 20% over the next decade. Following recent consecutive typhoons, Manila has proven highly exposed to severe weather—more so than any other of the world's fastest growing cities. Thailand is currently facing a climate-related crisis that has resulted in hundreds of deaths. Maplecroft says this disaster could cause negative ripple effects on businesses, especially local tech firms, and disrupt global supply chains. Bangkok is experiencing its worst flooding so far. Beldon stresses that as megacities grow, more people are forced to live on vulnerable land, such as flood plains or marginal areas. Urban expansion must be accompanied by greater investment in infrastructure and civic amenities. The report finds that the least vulnerable countries are almost all in Northern Europe, with Finland, Ireland, Sweden, and Norway among the top performers. Iceland ranks as the least vulnerable, and Qatar is also listed among the safest nations. The US is considered low risk overall, though some coastal states like Florida, Louisiana, Georgia, North Carolina, and South Carolina are labeled 'high risk.' Events like Hurricane Katrina highlight that even wealthy countries can be severely affected by climatic disasters. The report comes just before the global population is expected to reach seven billion. At the launch of the State of the World Population 2011 report in London, United Nations Populations Fund executive director Babatunde Osotimehin described this milestone as 'a challenge, an opportunity and a call to action.'

article_content: David McIntosh, the fiancé of model Kelly Brook and a former 'Gladiators' TV star, will not face further charges following a van crash during a controversial badger cull in Gloucestershire. McIntosh, 28, was tasked with transporting dead badgers for disposal as part of an authorized cull. During a night shift just before 1am on September 29, he crashed his VW Transporter into a bus shelter in Gloucester city centre. He claimed to have lost control when a police radio used to communicate anti-cull protester locations fell under the brakes. Police denied this account, suggesting that McIntosh fell asleep at the wheel, a view supported by passenger John Parker, who was injured in the crash. Despite earlier considerations of perjury charges due to conflicting statements, Gloucestershire Police announced that no further action would be taken, prompting criticism from anti-cull campaigners like Peter Martin. McIntosh admitted to driving without due care and attention and without a valid licence. At Stroud Magistrates' Court, he was fined £91, given a £20 victim surcharge, £30 in prosecution costs, and six penalty points. Natural England clarified that McIntosh was not their employee but was hired by a culling company licensed by the body. McIntosh, originally from Altrincham, Cheshire, has a background in the military, television, and modeling. Brook, his fiancée, has previously worked with animal rights groups opposing the cull. The couple announced their engagement last month with a celebratory Instagram post.

article_content: A newborn baby girl, found abandoned in a Walmart plastic bag in Houston, Texas, has been released from the hospital as authorities continue searching for her family. Hospital staff at Texas Children's Hospital named the baby Chloe. Now a week old, Chloe even has her first tooth, which she showed to photographers as she smiled for the cameras. She was discovered last Tuesday outside an apartment complex after a woman's dog picked up a scent and led her to the bag, revealing the infant inside. Paramedics transported Chloe, who still had about three inches of umbilical cord attached, to Texas Children's Hospital, where she was found to be in good condition. Estella Olguin from Child Protective Services told KHOU that Chloe was healthy, did not have a fever, and did not suffer from exposure to the elements that evening. Doctors believe Chloe was abandoned just hours after birth and was born slightly premature at 35 weeks' gestation. CPS is trying to locate Chloe's biological parents to gather medical history information. Olguin emphasized that while the parents do not need to claim the baby, information about family medical history would help Chloe's future caregivers. Chloe is currently in foster care, and a judge will decide her future at a hearing scheduled for March 4, according to the Houston Chronicle. Doctors noted Chloe's early tooth is a genetic trait and could help identify her family. Sgt. Gordon Trott of the Harris County Sheriff’s Office said that the unnamed woman was walking her pet around 7pm when her dog discovered the Walmart bag between a tree and a bush near the Stonegate Villas Apartments on Grant Road. Initially, the woman thought it was a dead animal, but she was surprised to find a baby inside. The baby was naked but had a normal body temperature, suggesting she had not been outside for long. Although her umbilical cord hadn't been clamped, someone had cleaned her after birth. Officials with the Harris County Sheriff's Office Crimes Against Children Unit said they have few leads, as there are no surveillance cameras in the area. Sgt. Trott stated that if the resident had not walked her dogs, the child might have remained undiscovered overnight and could have died. Texas has a Safe Haven law allowing infants to be left at a hospital or fire station without legal consequences, but endangering or abandoning a child is a third-degree felony punishable by two to ten years in prison. If the mother is a juvenile, she may face proceedings in juvenile court. Authorities urge the biological parents to come forward; investigators aim to understand the circumstances of the abandonment and will consult with the District Attorney's Office if the parents are found. Chloe has been placed in a foster home, and her wellbeing is being monitored while the investigation continues.

Chloe is in ‘n pleeggesin geplaas en haar welsyn word gemonitor terwyl die ondersoek voortgaan.

article_content: Mike Lindell, CEO of MyPillow, is facing worsening legal and financial setbacks. This week, his legal teams in Minnesota and Washington formally requested to withdraw from representing him in high-stakes defamation lawsuits brought by Dominion Voting Systems and Smartmatic. According to court filings reported by Insider, law firms Parker Daniels Kibort LLC and Lewin & Lewin LLP are owed millions in unpaid legal fees. Up until the end of 2022, Lindell paid his attorneys regularly. However, beginning in 2023, his payments slowed significantly. Attorney Andrew Parker noted in court documents that while small payments were made in August 2020 and September 2023, these covered only a fraction of Lindell’s outstanding debt. Parker's firm kept working with Lindell in hopes he would secure funding, but on October 2, they were notified that Lindell and MyPillow could no longer pay their legal bills. Parker stated that continuing without payment would put their small firm at substantial financial risk. Both the Minnesota and Washington courts have approved the firms’ withdrawal. Speaking to Politico, Lindell praised his lawyers’ courage in taking his case, explaining that they could no longer continue without payment and that he currently has no funds to pay them. Lindell’s financial and legal woes have intensified recently, yet he still vocally supports former President Donald Trump’s claims of election fraud. Last Saturday, Lindell told Steve Bannon’s 'War Room' podcast that MyPillow is being audited by the IRS over call center employees’ remote work commissions during the COVID-19 pandemic. Additionally, in September, Lindell said that MyPillow’s credit line with American Express was abruptly cut from $1 million to $100,000, and in July he auctioned off factory equipment after losing over $100 million in retail sales. Major retailers including Walmart, Costco, Bed Bath & Beyond, QVC, JCPenney, and Wayfair have stopped stocking MyPillow products in stores, further impacting the company’s revenue. Despite these setbacks, Lindell has continued spending large amounts to develop new media ventures and products, such as a video-streaming app, a social media platform, and a new Wi-Fi security device for voting machines. He claims to have spent between $50 and $60 million and said he recently borrowed $5 million and sold personal assets to cover expenses. Lindell told Politico he has no immediate plans to hire new lawyers, voicing concern that attorneys may be reluctant to take on his case given recent events. MyPillow did not respond to requests for comment from Insider.

Tot aan die einde van 2022 het Lindell sy prokureurs gereeld betaal. Vanaf 2023 het die betalings egter beduidend vertraag. Prokureur Andrew Parker het in hofstukke aangedui dat hoewel klein betalings in Augustus 2020 en September 2023 gemaak is, dit slegs ‘n gedeelte van Lindell se skuld gedek het. Lindell se finansiële en regsgedinge het onlangs toegeneem, maar hy ondersteun steeds Donald Trump se bewerings van verkiesingsbedrog. Verder het Lindell in September gesê MyPillow se kredietlyn by American Express is skielik van $1 miljoen tot $100 000 verminder, en in Julie het hy fabriekstoerusting opgeveil nadat hy meer as $100 miljoen in kleinhandelsverkope verloor het. Hy beweer dat hy reeds tussen $50 en $60 miljoen spandeer het, en sê hy het onlangs $5 miljoen geleen en eiendom verkoop om uitgawes te dek. article_content: By Jennifer Smith Published: 15:09 EST, 1 December 2013 | Updated: 15:17 EST, 1 December 2013 Four people have been arrested on suspicion of murder after a woman's body was found at a home in Richmond, south-west London. Police were called to an address on Lower Mortlake Road on Saturday after a neighbor expressed concerns about a resident's welfare. At the scene, officers discovered the body of a 43-year-old woman, who was pronounced dead. Two men, aged 48 and 21, and two women, both aged 27, have been arrested and are being held at different police stations across London while awaiting questioning by senior detectives. Richmond and Twickenham police entered the address at around 2pm on Saturday, November 30. The case has been referred to the Metropolitan Police Homicide and Major Crime Command, who are now leading the investigation. A police spokesperson stated: 'On entering the address, officers discovered the body of a woman believed to be 43 years old. She was pronounced dead at the scene.' A post-mortem examination was scheduled to take place today at Kingston Mortuary. Investigators have identified the victim and are in the process of notifying her next of kin. Comments on this case are closed for legal reasons.

article_content: Yellow-banded Joro spiders, first identified in Georgia in 2014, have established themselves throughout much of the southeastern United States, according to experts. Recent research from Clemson University confirms that these spiders are 'here to stay,' but they are not dangerous to humans. The Joro spiders, originally from East Asia, arrived in Georgia nearly a decade ago. They spread by 'ballooning,' using silk threads to catch the wind and travel to new places. Their bodies can grow to about an inch long, with legs reaching up to four inches, and females are generally larger and more colorful than males. David Coyle, a Clemson University professor of forest health and invasive species, reported a surge in Joro spiders on his South Carolina property. Coyle and colleagues used 20 variables to model the spiders' likely spread in the U.S., finding that eastern North America's climate matches their native environment, supporting expectations for continued expansion. Currently, Joro spiders are found in over 46,000 square miles across Georgia, South Carolina, North Carolina, and Tennessee, and have also been reported in Alabama, Maryland, Oklahoma, and West Virginia. Studies show they're more cold-resistant than golden silk spiders, increasing their potential for northward spread. University of Georgia entomologist Will Hudson observed the spiders multiplying rapidly, describing their webs as 'spooky' and reminiscent of a scene from the movie 'Arachnophobia.' Despite their size and eye-catching webs, Joro spiders are not dangerous to people or pets. University of Georgia studies found them to be quite shy. ‘They may look intimidating, but they really pose no danger to people or pets,’ Coyle said. Ongoing research is monitoring whether Joro spiders influence the numbers of native spider species, but for now, there's no evidence of significant negative impact. Richard Hoebeke, the entomologist who first identified Joro spiders in the U.S., encourages people to accept their presence. Experts recommend using a broom to move the spiders if unwanted, instead of killing them.

Onlangse navorsing van Clemson Universiteit dui aan dat hierdie spinnekoppe 'hier is om te bly', maar hulle is nie gevaarlik vir mense nie. Die Joro-spinnekoppe, afkomstig van Oos-Asië, het byna ’n dekade gelede in Georgië aangekom. Hulle versprei deur 'ballonering', deur hul sy te gebruik om op die wind na nuwe plekke te dryf. Hulle kan sowat ’n duim groot word, met pote wat tot vier duim lank is. Wyfies is oor die algemeen groter en meer kleurvol as mannetjies. David Coyle, professor in bosgesondheid en indringer-spesies aan Clemson Universiteit, het op sy eiendom in Suid-Karolina 'n toename in Joro-spinnekoppe waargeneem. Hy en ander navorsers het 20 veranderlikes gebruik om die spinnekop se verspreiding te modelleer en het bevind dat die oostelike deel van Noord-Amerika se klimaat ooreenstem met hul oorspronklike leefgebied—wat uitbreiding moontlik maak. Joro-spinnekoppe word tans oor meer as 46 000 vierkante myl in Georgië, Suid-Karolina, Noord-Karolina en Tennessee aangemeld, asook in Alabama, Maryland, Oklahoma en Wes-Virginië. Studies wys hulle is beter bestand teen koue as die goue sissy-spinnekop, wat verdere verspreiding noordwaarts moontlik maak. Will Hudson, ’n entomoloog aan die Universiteit van Georgië, beskryf dat hulle vinnig toeneem en hul webbe maak die plek amper soos ’n toneel uit die fliek 'Arachnophobia.' Ten spyte van hul grootte en opvallende webbe is Joro-spinnekoppe nie gevaarlik vir mense of troeteldiere nie. Navorsing wys hulle is nogal skugter. 'Hulle mag groot lyk, maar dit hou geen gevaar vir mense of troeteldiere in nie,' sê Coyle. Wetenskaplikes hou steeds dop of Joro-spinnekoppe 'n invloed op plaaslike spinnekoppe het, maar tot nou toe is daar geen sterk negatiewe impak op inheemse spesies nie. Richard Hoebeke, die entomoloog wat die spesie in die VSA geïdentifiseer het, sê mense moet aanvaar dat Joro-spinnekoppe nie gaan verdwyn nie. As jy nie die spinnekop wil hê nie, gebruik 'n besem eerder as om dit dood te maak.

article_content: Lenders in India have requested government permission to access income tax returns through the National Securities Depository Limited (NSDL) to help verify information declared during loan applications, according to sources familiar with the matter. Banks have reported cases of loan applicants providing inflated or false income details with forged documents, which has led to fraud or the disbursal of loans beyond applicants' actual incomes. This request follows recent action by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), which has increased risk weights on unsecured personal loans, credit cards, and loans to non-banking financial companies (NBFCs) by 25 percentage points due to concerns over potential risk. Last month, banks sought direct integration with the Income Tax Department or access through NSDL to enable online income tax return verification, according to officials. There is currently no mechanism for online validation of income tax returns. One bank executive noted that verifying the income declared in tax returns is vital for granting credit. If approved, lenders would log into the tax department's reporting portal with approved credentials, but borrowers would first need to authorize access. A similar online verification system exists for PAN numbers through Protean eGov Technologies. Banks have observed that many loan applicants, regardless of loan size, have submitted falsified data to raise their borrowing limits. For example, Can Fin Homes uncovered fake ITRs in 37 accounts at its Bhilwara branch in Rajasthan last year after investigating complaints. Another bank official said that direct access to tax returns would help banks more efficiently identify creditworthy borrowers and deliver loans faster. The growing number of individuals filing income tax returns would provide banks with more data for applicant assessment. ITR filings almost doubled from 33.6 million in 2013-14 to 63.7 million in the assessment year 2021-22. According to the Ministry of Finance, 7.41 crore tax returns were filed for assessment year 2023-24 as of last month, including 5.3 million first-time filers. The ministry stated this increase reflects a broadening tax base due to reform efforts. In 2020, the Income Tax Department enabled a compliance check for scheduled commercial banks, allowing them to check in bulk whether individuals, via their Permanent Account Numbers (PANs), had filed tax returns. This was partly to limit large cash withdrawals by persons who had not filed returns. Under current rules, banks can access PAN, a masked version of the holder's name, and ITR filing status for the previous three assessment years. Separately, the tax department reportedly found tax evasion close to ₹10,000 crore over three years by e-commerce sellers on platforms like Instagram and Facebook, having sent notices to 45 brands so far. Additionally, Nawaz Modi, the estranged wife of Raymond managing director Gautam Singhania, has accused him of assaulting her and one of their daughters.
translated_content: Leners in Indië het die regering versoek om toegang tot inkomstebelastingopgawes deur die Nasionale Sekuriteitesdepot (NSDL) te kry sodat hulle verklarings wat tydens leningaansoeke gemaak is, kan verifieer, volgens bronne vertroud met die saak. Banke het gevalle gerapporteer waar aansoekers oordrewe of vals inkomstebesonderhede met vervalste dokumente voorsien het, wat gelei het tot bedrog of dat lenings groter as hul werklike inkomste toegestaan is. Hierdie versoek volg op optrede deur die Reserwebank van Indië (RBI), wat die risikogewigte op onversekerde persoonlike lenings, kredietkaarte en lenings aan nie-bank finansiële maatskappye (NBVK's) met 25 persentasiepunte verhoog het weens kommer oor risiko. Verlede maand het banke direkte integrasie met die Inkomstebelastingdepartement, of toegang deur NSDL, versoek om aanlyn verifikasie van inkomstebelastingopgawes moontlik te maak, volgens amptenare. Daar is tans geen meganisme om inkomstebelastingopgawes aanlyn te verifieer nie. ’n Bankbestuurder sê dat verifikasie van verklaarde inkomste in belastingopgawes baie belangrik is vir die toekenning van krediet. As dit goedgekeur word, kan leners aanmeld by die departement se portaal met vooraf goedgekeurde geloofsbriewe, maar aansoekers sal eers toestemming moet gee. 'n Soortgelyke aanlyn verifikasiestelsel bestaan reeds vir PAN-nommers via Protean eGov Technologies. Banke het opgemerk dat baie leningaansoekers, ongeag die leenbedrag, vals data voorsien het om hul leenlimiete te verhoog. Byvoorbeeld, Can Fin Homes het verlede jaar by hul Bhilwara-tak in Rajasthan 37 rekeninge met vervalste ITRs opgespoor ná ondersoeke na klagtes. Nog 'n bankbeampte sê direkte toegang tot belastingopgawes sal banke help om kredietwaardige leners beter en vinniger te identifiseer. Die groeiende getal individue wat inkomstebelastingopgawes indien, gee banke meer data om leningaansoekers te evalueer. Die aantal ITR-indienings het byna verdubbel van 33.6 miljoen in 2013-14 tot 63.7 miljoen in die aanslagtig 2021-22. Volgens die Ministerie van Finansies is daar teen verlede maand 7,41 crore opgawes vir die aanslagtig 2023-24 ingedien, insluitend 5,3 miljoen eerste-keer indieners. Die ministerie meen hierdie styging wys op 'n wyer belastingbasis danksy hervormings. In 2020 het die Inkomstebelastingdepartement ’n nakomingskontrole vir geskeduleerde handelsbanke ingestel, om in grootmaat te bepaal of mense, via hul PAN-nommers, belastingopgawes ingedien het. Dit was ook bedoel om groot kontantonttrekkings deur persone wat nie opgawes ingedien het nie, te beperk. Volgens die huidige reels het banke toegang tot die PAN, ’n gemaskerde weergawe van die houer se naam, en die ITR-indieningsstatus vir die laaste drie aanslagtige jare. Afsonderlik het die belastingdepartement glo sowat ₹10,000 crore se belastingontduiking oor drie jaar by e-handelaars op platforms soos Instagram en Facebook gevind, en reeds aan 45 handelsmerke kennis gegee. Verder het Nawaz Modi, die vervreemde vrou van Raymond se besturende direkteur Gautam Singhania, hom daarvan beskuldig dat hy haar en een van hul dogters aangerand het.
post_content: Indian banks want direct access to tax returns through NSDL to fight loan fraud after major cases of fake income details. More tax filers = better checks for fairer loans! 🏦📈 #BankingNews #IndiaFinance #LoanVerification
translated_post: Indiese banke vra nou toegang tot belastingopgawes via NSDL om teen vals lening-aansoeke te veg. Meer mense dien opgawes in, so banke kan nou beter kyk! 💸🇮🇳 #Bankwese #Belasting #Lenings

article_content: Nanci Griffith, renowned for her gentle, crystalline voice and her Grammy-winning 1993 album 'Other Voices, Other Rooms,' has found renewed energy after a decade marked by personal and political challenges. Diagnosed with thyroid and breast cancer in the late 1990s, Griffith also struggled with a political climate she disagreed with, both of which affected her creative output. However, the election of Barack Obama brought Griffith a sense of optimism and inspired her latest album, 'The Loving Kind' (Rounder Records). The changes in her personal life and in American politics revitalized her songwriting, helping her shift focus away from her illnesses and toward the music that has always sustained her. Griffith identifies as someone 'fed up with negativity,' and says she was inspired not just by Obama’s election, but by the resilience and hope of the American people. Motivated by her country’s complex history, she began infusing her songs with stories of social justice and real-life events. In discussing her new album, Griffith notes that many of its songs were inspired by significant events and people, such as the Supreme Court case Loving v. Virginia, which struck down bans on interracial marriage, and the story of Philip Workman, whose controversial execution in Tennessee affected her deeply. A passionate opponent of the death penalty, Griffith writes songs she describes as a form of musical journalism, aiming to inform her audience about important social issues. While she acknowledges the emotional burden of writing about real events, Griffith insists it’s vital for audiences to hear these stories. She notes that music has often been a pathway to awareness for herself as well, citing influences like Pete Seeger and Odetta. Reflecting on the broader state of the country, Griffith expresses hope and admiration for President Obama and finds inspiration in Americans’ perseverance. For her, songwriting about topical events requires diligence and accuracy, while more personal songs—like 'Up Against the Rain'—tend to flow naturally. Griffith also shares that her song 'Sing' was inspired by Shania Twain’s perspective on artistry as a calling, not a choice, reinforcing Griffith's own belief in the importance of sharing impactful stories through music.
translated_content: Nanci Griffith, bekend vir haar sagte, kristalhelder stem en haar Grammy-bekroonde 1993-album 'Other Voices, Other Rooms', het nuwe energie gekry na 'n dekade vol persoonlike en politieke uitdagings. Sy is in die laat negentigs met tiroïed- en borskanker gediagnoseer, en het ook gesukkel met 'n politieke klimaat waarmee sy nie saamgestem het nie, wat haar kreatiwiteit beïnvloed het. Die verkiesing van Barack Obama het egter vir Griffith hoop gebring en haar nuutste album, 'The Loving Kind' (Rounder Records), geïnspireer. Die veranderinge in haar lewe en die Amerikaanse politiek het haar liedjieskryf verkwik en haar gefokus op die musiek wat haar altyd dra. Griffith beskryf haarself as iemand wat 'klaar is met negatiwiteit', en sê sy is nie net deur Obama se verkiesing nie, maar ook deur die veerkragtigheid en hoop van die Amerikaanse mense geïnspireer. Gemotiveer deur haar land se ingewikkelde geskiedenis, begin sy om stories van sosiale geregtigheid en werklike gebeure in haar musiek te verwerk. In haar nuwe album sê Griffith dat baie van die liedjies geïnspireer is deur belangrike gebeure en mense, soos die Hoogste Hof-saak Loving v. Virginia, wat interrassige huwelik-verbod opgehef het, en die verhaal van Philip Workman, wie se kontroversiële teregstelling in Tennessee haar diep geraak het. As 'n sterk teenstander van die doodstraf, skryf Griffith liedjies wat sy as musikale joernalistiek beskou, wat die doel het om haar gehoor oor belangrike sosiale kwessies in te lig. Sy erken die emosionele las daarvan om oor werklike gebeurtenisse te skryf, maar glo dit is noodsaaklik dat mense hierdie stories hoor. Sy sê musiek het dikwels haar bewus gemaak van gebeure, met invloede soos Pete Seeger en Odetta. Oor die toestand van die land sê Griffith sy is hoopvol en vol bewondering vir president Obama, en vind inspirasie in Amerikaners se deursettingsvermoë. Vir haar vereis liedjies oor aktuele sake noukeurigheid, terwyl meer persoonlike liedjies, soos 'Up Against the Rain', natuurlik vloei. Griffith deel dat haar liedjie 'Sing' geïnspireer is deur Shania Twain se siening dat kunstenaarskap 'n roeping is, nie 'n keuse nie, wat haar eie oortuiging oor die belangrikheid van impakvolle musiek bevestig.
post_content: Folk legend Nanci Griffith bounced back after health battles & tough politics — Obama’s election inspired fresh songs on 'The Loving Kind.' She tackles real-life stories for justice & hope! 🎶💪 #NanciGriffith #FolkMusic #Inspiration

article_content: Orono, Maine is in chaos as fear sweeps the community after Nichole Cable, 15, was reportedly murdered in a chilling, calculated attack. Allegations say Kyle Dube, 21, masterminded a predatory social media scheme to lure and deliberately kill Nichole, and possibly targeted other local teens through fake profiles. Law enforcement warns more victims might exist, fueling widespread terror. With Dube’s trial starting, authorities fear his methods could motivate copycat criminals, forcing parents to keep their kids away from school. When Nichole vanished after meeting a supposed online 'friend' on May 13, 2013, her mother faced a slow search effort that drew public outrage. Nichole’s remains were finally found eight days later, shining a harsh spotlight on alleged weaknesses in law enforcement’s response as Maine faces a spike in social media-related killings. Authorities allege Dube not only wore a ski mask but engineered a wave of fraudulent online identities, with local police now probing the existence of a criminal network behind multiple fake accounts. Schools are deeply shaken—waves of students are staying home as panic spreads, and teachers plead for a 'total lockdown' to keep everyone safe. Regional School Unit 34 has reported mass absences and growing alarm across Old Town High School. Dube’s trial has turned the courthouse into a fortress, with extra security after credible threats and widespread fear of violent reprisals from a traumatized public. The judge’s decision to block Dube’s attorneys from listing alternative suspects has only fueled talk of cover-ups and judicial misconduct, leaving families demanding answers. Superintendent David Walker claims the community’s sense of safety is gone, warning of a rising wave of predatory online attacks that authorities fear could have already begun. Experts note if Dube is convicted, he’ll join a disturbing trend of internet killers who leave entire communities reeling in their wake.
translated_content: Orono, Maine verkeer in chaos soos vrees die hele gemeenskap oorspoel nadat Nichole Cable, 15, na bewering vermoor is in ’n koue, berekende aanval. Aansprake lui Kyle Dube, 21, het ’n roofdieragtige sosiale media-strategie beplan om Nichole te lok en doelbewus dood te maak – en moontlik ander plaaslike tieners deur vals profiele geteiken. Wetstoepassers waarsku daar kan meer slagoffers wees, wat wydverspreide paniek aanhelp. Met Dube se verhoor wat aan die gang is, vrees owerhede sy metodes kan navolgers aanmoedig, en ouers hou hul kinders nou weg van die skool. Toe Nichole op 13 Mei 2013 verdwyn na sy ’n sogenaamde aanlyn 'vriend' gaan ontmoet het, het haar ma ’n stadige en ontstelde soektog tallose kritiek ontlok. Nichole se oorblyfsels is eers agt dae later gevind, met die tragedie wat vrae oor polisie se reaksie aan die orde gestel het terwyl moorde gekoppel aan sosiale media in Maine glo toeneem. Owerhede beweer Dube het nie net ’n balaklawa gedra nie, maar ook ’n netwerk van valse identiteite geskep. Plaaslike polisie ondersoek nou ’n moontlike kriminele groep wat agter menige vals rekeninge skuil. Skole is in beroering—baie leerlinge bly tuis uit vrees, en onderwysers vra vir ’n 'volledige toesluit' vir veiligheid. Streekskooleenheid 34 rapporteer massa-afwesighede en stygende paniek by Old Town Hoërskool. Dube se verhoor het die hof in ’n vesting verander, met ekstra sekuriteit na berigte van dreigemente en vrees vir gewelddadige vergelding vanuit die bang gemeenskap. Die regter se besluit om alternatiewe verdagte name te verbied, het eintlik die gemeenskap kwaad gemaak en gesprekke oor moontlike toe-dek geprikkel. Superintendent David Walker sê almal se gevoel van veiligheid is vir altyd verlore, en hy waarsku ’n nuwe golf van online aanvalle kan reeds begin het. As Dube skuldig bevind word, sê kenners hy word deel van ’n groeiende lys van internetmoordenaars wat gemeenskappe getraumatiseer.
